Description:
About us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
About the team:
EDC Retail  is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.
About the role: 
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.   
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market. 
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts. 
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE. 
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap. 
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management. 
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team. 
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly 10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.
Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role 
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset
Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.
Qualification:-
Graduate/Post Graduate.

3+ years of experience strong understanding handling LAP Product
Problem Solving ability

Description:
Ways of Working - Mandate 3 : Employees to be located in their place of posting / respective office base location.
About Swiggy: 
Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city.
You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants - learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement.
This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success.
You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
-Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
-Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
-Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
-Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
-Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
-Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
-Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
-Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
-80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
-0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
-Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
-Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
-Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
-Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate
AboutCompany: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Description:
Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.
Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the company's business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan
Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications
Requirements
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities - Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Salesforce Administrator/Advanced Administrator.

Salesforce Certified AI Associate.

Opportunity to work remotely with flexible work hours.
Exposure to cutting-edge Salesforce tools and technologies.
Collaborative and innovative work environment.

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Specialist - Training to join our team at STARTEK. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in training and development, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Roles and Responsibility


Develop and implement comprehensive training programs to enhance employee skills and knowledge.

Conduct workshops, seminars, and other training sessions to promote continuous learning and growth.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify training needs and develop targeted solutions.

Design and deliver engaging and interactive training materials and content.

Evaluate the effectiveness of training programs and recommend improvements.

Provide coaching and mentoring to support employees' professional development goals.


Job Requirements


Proven experience in training and development, focusing on adult learning principles.

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team, demonstrating flexibility and adaptability.

Experience with training software and technologies, including authoring tools and learning management systems.

Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.

Description:
In a world where customers consistently interact with your brand across multiple channels-including digital and social-we at Startek value our ability to effectively garner those interactions and CX insights, analysing, unlocking, and providing intelligence that drives digital transformation and further revenues for you, our client.

Our partnerships have always been about more than building emotional connections with customers; they are about using artificial intelligence, omnichannel orchestration and providing CX insights & technologies, that has the power for digital transformation We do this across 46 locations in 13 countries, with over 40,000 employees managing almost half a billion customer interactions every year for over 150 clients in different industries.

Quality sourcing and achieving targets as defined
Regular collections and maintaining customers in current bucket, regularizing and normalizing delinquent customers
Compliance on all business parameters, zero audit findings on his / her sourced customer segment / portfolio

Description:
Group Company: AU Small Finance Bank Limited
Designation: Business Manager MBL
Office Location:
Position description: The Business Manager is responsible for driving business growth and managing relationships within the assigned area, while also servicing existing clients
Primary Responsibilities:
1. Ensure 100% achievement of assigned business targets (volume and value).2. Identify new business prospects and areas through market initiatives such as leafleting, canopy activities, and direct sourcing.3. Coordinate with prospective and existing customers to generate new business opportunities and ensure client engagement.4. Build and maintain strong customer relationships to drive repeat business and enhance brand presence in the market.5. Manage the sourcing process from lead generation to disbursement, ensuring completeness of documentation and formalities.6. Collaborate with collections and credit teams to manage portfolio quality, follow up on delinquent cases, and control WIRR and fee realization.7. Perform field verifications of customers residence, business premises, and credit-related assets to ensure creditworthiness and mitigate risk.8. Conduct physical verification of key financial documents such as ITRs, bank statements, property documents, and legal papers.9. Prepare and recommend basic Credit Appraisal Memos (CAM) and coordinate approvals from credit, legal, technical, operations, and store departments.10. Assist in the collection and utilization of marketing data to support telecalling and self-sourcing efforts.11. Ensure timely and accurate preparation and submission of MIS reports related to sourcing, disbursement, audits, and operational pendency.12. Follow proper procedures for handling and movement of property documents and customer files in coordination with the central operations team.

Description:
Advt. Ref. No. NABCONS/CO-HR/25/PBCS/2026-27 Dated: 13 November, 2026
Requires Experienced Junior Technical Supervisors /Engineers (Civil) for Head Office and Regional Offices/Training Establishments for Ground-level Monitoring for Premises related Projects of National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development

Location: Itanagar,Pune,Chennai,Dehradun,Mumbai

Primary Duties and Key Responsibilities:
i. Implementation, monitoring, co-ordination and supervision of civil construction/renovation/redevelopment works of building related infrastructural system and other related jobs in office buildings and residential colonies of Bank.
ii. Identification of civil/interior repair/ maintenance works required in the office buildings/residential colonies and preparation of concept, detailed estimates, preparation of tenders/quotation document, preparation of financial estimate/BOQ as per Bank's approved/market rates for these works to receive necessary approval.
iii. Ground level monitoring and supervision of repair and maintenance work of office buildings. NABARD has its office buildings in all state capitals of the country, either owned or rented.
iv. Ground level monitoring and supervision of repair and maintenance works ongoing in staff quarters to ensure the quality standards and timely completion of works. They will have responsibility to undertake regular maintenance, repair and renovation of staff quarters located in various cities of the country, as per Bank's guidelines.
v. Repair and maintenance of Visiting Officers flats (VoFs), Single Room Accommodations (SRAs) located at various premises all over the country, as per Banks guidelines.
vi. Supervision and monitoring of Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) works such as housekeeping, electrical, plumbing, carpentry, pest control, gardening, VOF management, deadstock maintenance etc.
vii. Taking measurements of completed works related to construction/ renovation/redevelopment/repair/maintenance and ensuring the proper completion of works.
viii. Certification of bills as per onsite measurement and recommendations for payment by competent authority.
ix. Conducting visual structural audit and implementation of recommendations of detailed audit done by expert, in NABARD official and residential buildings.
x. Regular liaison with engineers and officers of state or municipal bodies for local level approvals regarding maintenance, repair, renovation or property related matters.
xi. Verification of dead stock articles provided in office and colonies to ensure that these are in good working condition. To recommend for repair, replacement etc. in case of non-functional items.xii. Ensuring quality, timely completion and compliance in all the works.
Educational Qualification:
Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized Institute or University with minimum60% marks
Required Experience:
Minimum 03 years experience of working in residential/ office buildings/ commercial buildings projects (maintenance/construction)
Other skills and competencies:
Good knowledge of MS office, Google tools, including advanced Excel features for day-to-day operations. Experience in Zoho projects or any other project management software shall be preferred. Knowledge of relevant Engineering Software will be preferred.Excellent written & oral communication and presentation skills in English and local languageThe ability to coordinate and prepare technical and financial proposals in response to EOIs and bids will be preferred.
Age: Maximum Age as on date of application: 35 Years
Contract Period
The Junior Technical Supervisors (PBCS) would be hired on contract for a period of 11 months with further periodic extensions based on the performance and NABARD discretion.
Termination
NABCONS may terminate the contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason thereof. However, in normal course, NABCONS may terminate the engagement by giving one (01) month notice in advance within the contract period.
How to Apply
Interested candidates may apply online in the prescribed format within 07 days from 13 November 2026 to 19 November 2026 by clicking links and filling the details therein:
Link to apply: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/gkPpaeWiCa
Instructions
Before applying, candidates should read all the instructions carefully and ensure that they fulfil all the eligibility criteria for the post. NABCONS would admit candidates on the basis of the information furnished in the ON-LINE application and shall verify their eligibility at the stage of interview/ joining. If, at any stage it is found that any information furnished in the ON-LINE application is false/incorrect or if according to the NABCONS, the candidate does not satisfy the eligibility criteria for the post, his/her candidature will be cancelled and he/she will not be allowed to appear for the interview/joining not allowed to continue, if joined.
Candidates are requested to apply only ON-ONLINE through NABCONS website (www.nabcons.com). No other mode of submission of application will be accepted.
Important Dates/ Timelines
Last date for submission of online applications: 19 November 2026 (Midnight)
NABCONS reserves the right to make change in the dates indicated above.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1) The candidate should have android smart phone.
2) The candidate should have personal Bike and driving licence.

Job role
1. On-Site Maintenance and Repairs: Conduct regular inspections, maintenance, and repairs on a wide range of oil and gas equipment, including fuel dispensers and other types of equipment at retail outstations like Petrol pumps, to ensure their optimal performance and minimize downtime. 2. Troubleshooting: Diagnosing and troubleshooting complex technical issues that may arise during the operation of equipment, utilizing a deep understanding of the specific systems and processes involved in our industry.
3. Installation and Commissioning: Assisting with the installation, configuration, and commissioning of new equipment (fuel dispensers and other types of equipment at retail outstations like Petrol pumps), ensuring that it operates according to specified guidelines and safety standards.
4. Customer Support: Providing technical support and guidance to clients or customers, addressing their concerns, and offering solutions to maximize the efficiency and safety of their operations.
5. Safety Compliance: Ensuring that all work performed adheres to industry safety standards and regulations, and identifying potential safety hazards or risks to prevent accidents and promote a secure working environment.
6. Documentation and Reporting: Maintaining detailed records of service activities, including maintenance schedules, repairs performed, and any modifications made, and providing comprehensive reports to supervisors or management as required.
7. Training and Knowledge Sharing: Attending training sessions or workshops to enhance the understanding of equipment operations, maintenance procedures, and safety protocols.
8. Continuous Improvement: Identifying opportunities for process improvement and efficiency enhancement within the scope of equipment maintenance and service delivery, and proposing relevant solutions to management for consideration.
9. Field Operations Coordination: Collaborating with other team members, including engineers, technicians, and project managers, to coordinate field operations, prioritize tasks, and ensure timely and effective resolution of technical issues.
10. Adherence to Company Policies: Following company policies and protocols, including those related to quality control, health, safety, and environmental protection, to uphold the organization's reputation and maintain high operational standards.

Description:
Job Summary
We are urgently hiring a Consultant Gynecologist for a hospital in Roing, Arunachal Pradesh, to support its women's healthcare services. The role involves evaluating gynecological and obstetric patients, managing related conditions, and providing suitable treatment in coordination with the hospital's clinical team.
Designation
Consultant Gynecologist
Location
Roing, Arunachal Pradesh
Employment type
Full-Time
Qualification
MS / MD / DNB in Obstetrics Gynecology or DNB
Experience
0 8 Years
Job Status
Open
Hospital Infrastructure Gynecology Services
The hospital in Roing, Arunachal Pradesh, provides multispecialty care with outpatient, inpatient, and operation theatre services. The Consultant Gynecologist will work closely with the pediatrics, anesthesia, and other departments to deliver integrated maternal and women's healthcare to patients from Roing and the surrounding region.
Clinical Responsibilities
Conduct gynecology and obstetrics OPD consultations and oversee inpatient treatment.
Provide antenatal, intrapartum, and postnatal care, including management of normal and high-risk pregnancies.
Perform deliveries, including Cesarean sections, and other gynecological surgical procedures as required.
Diagnose and manage menstrual disorders, infertility, PCOS, infections, and other gynecological conditions.
Guide patients on family planning, nutrition, preventive care, and reproductive health.
Position Overview
We are recruiting a Consultant Gynecologist for a hospital in Roing, Arunachal Pradesh.
The role includes gynecology and obstetric consultations, inpatient management, and surgical procedures.
The selected doctor will coordinate with other departments for appropriate referrals and integrated treatment.
Both freshers and experienced candidates are welcome to apply.
This position offers an opportunity to contribute to women's healthcare services within an established hospital setup.

Description:
Job Title: Store Executive

Company: Pavai Infra Geotech
Work Location: Project Sites Pan India
Experience: 2 to 3 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Qualification: Diploma , BE / B Tech Civil

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced and responsible Store Executive to manage day-to-day store operations at our project sites across India. The candidate should have experience in inventory management, material handling, stock maintenance and documentation.

Key Responsibilities

Manage daily site store operations and maintain proper inventory records.
Receive, inspect and verify incoming materials against purchase orders and delivery challans.
Issue materials to site engineers and other departments based on approved material requisitions.
Maintain stock registers, inward and outward records, and material issue reports.
Monitor stock levels and coordinate with the purchase team for material replenishment.
Conduct periodic physical stock verification and reconcile discrepancies.
Ensure proper storage, identification and safety of materials.
Maintain records of tools, equipment, consumables and construction materials.
Prepare daily, weekly and monthly stock reports.
Coordinate with project managers, site engineers, vendors and the accounts department.
Ensure proper documentation of material receipts, transfers and returns.

Required Skills

2 to 3 years of experience in site store management, preferably in construction / infrastructure projects.
Knowledge of inventory management and stock maintenance.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and computer operations.
Experience in maintaining GRN, MRN, material inward/outward registers and stock reports.
Good coordination and communication skills.
Ability to independently manage site store operations.

Candidate Requirements

Candidates must be willing to work at project locations across Pan India.
Must be flexible to relocate or travel based on project requirements.
Immediate joiners will be preferred.
Candidates with construction or infrastructure project experience will be given preference.

Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume on below mail id.

HR Mail ID : careers@pavaigeotech.com
Contact no: 9842952214





Perks and benefits
Food allowance, Travel allowance, House rent allowance, Health insurance, Accidental insurance, Provident fund
AboutCompany:
Pavai Infra Geotech is a leading provider of geotechnical and ground engineering solutions, established in 1976 and headquartered in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. The company specializes in delivering innovative, reliable and cost-effective solutions for major infrastructure and civil engineering projects across India and Bhutan.
With expertise in geotechnical design, drilling, grouting, ground improvement, deep foundations, slope stabilization and excavation support, Pavai has successfully contributed to several major infrastructure developments, including metro rail, highways, bridges, dams and railway projects.
Driven by technology, engineering excellence and a commitment to quality, Pavai continues to support India's infrastructure growth through specialized engineering solutions and project execution.

Education:
Degree/Diploma from accredited culinary college or university. Ability to effectively read, write and speak English
Experience:
2+ years experience in a 5 star + hotel, cruise ship or high-profile restaurant performing the functions of a similar position.
Certification from accredited advanced food safety program. Extensive knowledge in VSP preferred.
Knowledge, Skills Abilities:
Experience in high volume operation of at least 500 meals per service.
Extensive kitchen machinery and knife safety knowledge.
Experience working in all major culinary brigade stations with extensive knowledge in designated station.
Responsible producing in the preparation of all food in the assigned station in the kitchen in accordance with the established company menus and recipes.
Responsible for quality, quantity, attractiveness and correctness of all food items served from the station as per companys standard recipes.
Responsible for quality, quantity, attractiveness and correctness of all food items served from the station as per companys standard recipes.
Responsible for the performance, appearance, and dress as well as personal conducts of themselves.
Controls actual hours worked and comply with MLC2006 and report any discrepancies between these and the published work schedules to Sous Chef supervising his station.
Responsible for checking that quantity and quality of items ordered from stores are received and stored in proper condition and thereafter used in the correct way, FIFO.
Follows a daily work plan assigned to his station in accordance with the planned menu and recipes of the day.
Public Health:
Directly responsible for executing food handling and cleaning procedures in accordance with USPH standards in the assigned station in the kitchen organization as outlined in the Safe Food Handling Manual and cleaning specifications per station.
Responsible to implement and execute proper maintenance and cleaning procedures in the station assigned to him in order to ensure good appearance and condition of these areas. And inspects the cleaning procedures and cleanliness of work area and equipment done by all personnel in his assigned station.
Reports any malfunctioning equipment or furnishings in need of repair or refurbishing to the Sous Chef supervising his station.
Maintains a high level of productivity, cleanliness and sanitation throughout the entire station at all times.
Responsible for ensuring that proper work and cleaning methods are being followed in order to produce and serve safe, wholesome, high quality and attractive food for passengers and crew.
Responsible for the proper use of equipment and utensils to prevent damage or undue maintenance requirements.
To be familiar with and execute the Seabourn HESS-MS appropriate to their position.
The Demi Chef de Partie is responsible to produce and execute the products according the daily menus, checklists and operational needs as per Executive Chef de Cuisine.

The Demi Chef de Partie plays an integral role in providing a service to the Seabourn guest. Work should always be completed in a satisfactory manner in order to maintain and exceed the company s goal. Any decisions made to compromise the product will have a negative impact on the guest s experience.

Reporting relationships:
The Demi Chef de Partie reports directly to the Chef de Partie and is supported by the Sous Chef.

Education:
Degree/Diploma from accredited culinary college or university. Ability to effectively read, write and speak English

Experience:
3+ years experience in a 5 star + hotel, cruise ship or high-profile restaurant performing the functions of a similar position.

Certification from accredited advanced food safety program. Extensive knowledge in VSP preferred.

Knowledge, Skills Abilities:
Ability to deliver 5 star culinary products.
Experience in high volume operation of at least 500 meals per service.
Extensive kitchen machinery and knife safety knowledge.
Experience working in all major culinary brigade stations with extensive knowledge in designated station.

Responsible for directing, supervising and assisting in the preparation of all food in the assigned station in the kitchen in accordance with the established company menus and recipes.
Responsible for quality, quantity, attractiveness and correctness of all food items served from the station as per companys standard recipes and follow up with FIFO.
Responsible for the performance, appearance, dress and personal conduct of all employees assigned to his station. Reports on these subjects objectively and timely to his Executive Sous Chef.
Controls actual hours worked of the employees assigned to the station and report any discrepancies between these and the published work schedules to Executive Sous Chef supervising his station.
Responsible for checking that quantity and quality of items ordered from stores are received and stored in proper condition and thereafter used in the correct way. FIFO.
Prepares a daily mise en place list for the designated section in accordance with the planned menu and recipes for the day.
Works closely and cooperates with superiors, colleagues and subordinates in order to achieve the highest possible guest satisfaction from the products served.
Prepares a daily requisition for Executive Chef for all items ordered from stores for use in his station.
Execute all special orders and dietary requirements.
Responsible for helping to maintain a team atmosphere in the department.
Public Health:
Responsible to implement and execute proper maintenance and cleaning procedures in the station assigned to him in order to ensure good appearance and condition of these areas.
Reports any malfunctioning equipment or furnishings in need of repair or refurbishing to the Executive Sous Chef supervising his station.
Maintains a high level of productivity, cleanliness and sanitation throughout the entire station.
Responsible for ensuring that proper work and cleaning methods are being followed in order to produce and serve safe, wholesome, high quality and attractive food for guests and crew.
Responsible for the proper use of equipment and utensils to prevent damage or undue maintenance requirements. Report to have replaced.
Assigns all cleaning responsibilities within his station according to the cleaning schedule and report to the Executive Sous Chef regarding any problems, which have occurred. If station has GPA personnel assigned, he is responsible for his performance.
To be familiar with and execute the Seabourn HESS-MS appropriate to their position.
Assists the Sushi Chef de Cuisine in the preparation of various Sushi products in the speciality restaurant.

The Chef de Partie is required to adopt a pro-active approach in solving challenges that may arise in their station. Guest satisfaction is the ultimate goal and the Chef de Partie should ensure that all decisions made have the guest in mind. Assisting teammates plays an integral role in this position and they should therefor encourage and coach those that work with him.

Reporting Relationships:
The Chef de Partie reports directly to the Chef de Cuisine.

Description:
Resident Engineer (RE) - Civil Position: Resident Engineer (Civil) Project: HEO 240 MW Hydro Electric Project Location: Project Site, Arunachal Pradesh Employment Type: Full-time, Site-based Experience Required: 7-10 Years Qualification
B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognized university/institution.
Proficiency in computer-aided design tools, project management software (MS Project/Primavera), and technical documentation.
Experience Overview
Minimum 8 years of total post-qualification experience in execution, site supervision, and quality control of major infrastructure projects, with a strong preference for Hydro Electric Projects (HEP), Tunneling/Underground works, or Dam/Powerhouse construction.
Key Responsibilities
Site Execution & Supervision: Act as the primary on-site engineering representative to oversee daily civil construction activities, including surface/underground excavation, slope stabilization, tunneling, concreting, and structural works.
Quality Assurance & Control (QA/QC): Ensure all construction materials (cement, steel, aggregates) and workmanship rigorously comply with national standards, project technical specifications, and design drawings.
Progress Monitoring: Track daily site progress against baseline construction schedules, report bottlenecks, and assist senior management in developing recovery plans for delayed activities.
Technical Compliance & Drawings: Review construction drawings, method statements, bar-bending schedules, and technical submittals at the site level, flagging discrepancies proactively.
Contract Administration Support: Maintain meticulous daily site records, measurement books (MB), joint measurements, and documentation required for tracking variations and contractor billing.
Safety & Health Compliance: Strictly enforce site safety rules, health guidelines, and environmental protocols, working closely with the HSE team, particularly given the challenging Himalayan terrain of Arunachal Pradesh.
Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate smoothly with contractors, testing laboratories, and multidisciplinary project teams to resolve technical issues swiftly on-site.
At Surbana Jurong, we put talent, hard work, teamwork and a fun workplace together to approach problems and solve them creatively and collaboratively. Join us in making a positive impact on the world!

Strong leadership and team management abilities

Ability to work independently while driving collaboration across multiple levels.

Description:
Job Title: Apprentice Hiring for 2026- 2027
Location: Bangalore
About the programme:
This 12-month apprenticeship, under India's National Apprenticeship Training Scheme, provides valuable on-the-job training; Please note, there is no obligation for permanent employment with Deutsche Bank Group upon completion of the Apprenticeship Training tenure.
Role Description
About DWS
DWS, publicly listed asset management division of Deutsche Bank, is one of the world's leading investment management organizations with assets under management. DWS provides flexible products and solutions to a wide range of investment opportunities across all asset classes from pooled funds to highly customized portfolios for a wide range of investors and offers individuals and institutions traditional and alternative investments across all major asset classes.
About the team
The Platform Sustainability function is a cross-divisional function, linked to both the investment and product divisions of DWS Group. It coordinates and steers the business implementation of DWSs Sustainability Strategy as well as the sustainability related regulatory requirements in the product and investment areas. Its focus is on the liquid product range of DWS Group and the product-related sustainability activities for alternative investments. Its activities comprise the development of sustainability-related frameworks as well as their integration into engagement processes, ESG integration processes and product-specific investment policies.
The Product Infrastructure & Standards team is part of Platform Sustainability within the Product Division.
The team is responsible for developing the sustainability-related product infrastructure including data management and contributing to product disclosure processes.
In this responsibility, the team plays a key role in designing efficient processes for a technology-driven future. In addition, the team actively contributes to navigating regulatory developments that are shaping the industry. To achieve this, it works closely together with colleagues across the Product Division and other relevant sustainability experts at DWS globally.
Your key responsibilities
As a Product Sustainability Analyst of the Product Sustainabilitys Infrastructure & Standards Team, you will be jointly responsible for
Analysing and conceptualizing the sustainability-related data and process flow from product development to the monitoring of investment guidelines compliance
Coordinating and overseeing the implementation of systematic changes in close collaboration with business and infrastructure teams
Developing a workflow tool for product launches
Automating existing processes related to fund disclosures
Supporting development of sustainability-related product infrastructure with exposure to sustainability specialists and close
collaboration with sustainability investment experts
Your skills and experience
Essential skills:
University degree in Commerce/Science or similar
Candidates with full time exp refrain from applying
Candidates with Master degree refrain from applying
Candidates holding PF/UAN no. not eligible to apply
Fresh graduates only can apply
Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) for documentation purposes

Your Role

As a Data Analytics Architect, you will be responsible for designing end-to-end data architectures, establishing data standards and frameworks, and enabling business-driven analytics solutions. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and governance functions to deliver scalable, secure, and high-quality data ecosystems.



In this role, you will:

Define, design, and lead the implementation of end-to-end scalable data architectures from concept through production deployment.
Ensure alignment of data solutions with enterprise architecture standards, business objectives, and industry best practices.
Collaborate with compliance, privacy, risk, security, platform, and operations teams to incorporate all business and regulatory requirements into data solutions.
Develop data strategies, architectures, and policies covering:
Data Governance
Master Data Management (MDM)
Metadata Management
Data Quality
Data Security and Privacy
Provide technical leadership and act as a trusted advisor for data-related initiatives across programs.
Define and establish scalable, reusable standards, frameworks, and best practices for data architecture and analytics.
Lead data analysis activities including data profiling, transformation design, integration requirements, and quality assessments.
Design, document, and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
Oversee the complete data lifecycle, ensuring high-quality, scalable, and maintainable data solutions.
Guide development teams on architecture, implementation approaches, governance, and continuous improvement practices.
Conduct advanced analytics to generate actionable insights, identify trends, and measure key business outcomes.
Design visual analytics and dashboards that enable effective decision-making across stakeholders.
Apply statistical and analytical techniques to solve complex business problems and uncover business value.
Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, scientists, and platform teams to implement scalable analytics solutions.
Drive quality, governance, and delivery excellence across data and analytics initiatives.
Manage and optimize large-scale structured and unstructured datasets for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases.



Your Profile

Mandatory Skills
12+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Analytics, and Enterprise Data Management.
Strong expertise in Data Architecture and Data Modeling techniques.
Hands-on experience in Data Engineering and Data Integration (ETL/ELT).
Deep understanding of Data Warehousing and Lakehouse Architecture.
Experience implementing Data Governance, Data Quality, and Master Data Management frameworks.
Strong capabilities in Data Analysis, Data Profiling, and Data Transformation.
Experience designing Business Intelligence and Data Visualization solutions.
Expertise in Statistical Analysis, Predictive Analytics, and Data Mining methodologies.
Experience working with Big Data platforms and distributed data processing frameworks.
Proficiency in SQL and programming languages such as Python and PySpark.
Strong understanding of Cloud Data Platforms and modern analytics architectures.
Experience in Data Security, Privacy, Compliance, and Regulatory requirements.
Knowledge of DataOps, CI/CD practices, and automation frameworks.
Strong stakeholder management, consulting, and technical leadership skills

Description:
Job Summary
Cisco's Global Lab Solutions (GLS) team is seeking a highly motivated and skilled Lab Systems Operations Engineer to manage cutting-edge liquid cooling rack infrastructure, operate precision thermal/environmental chambers, and maintain network lab sustainability metrics across our Bangalore engineering facilities. As Cisco accelerates its next-generation Silicon One ASICs, AI/ML compute clusters, and high-density routing platforms, you will work at the forefront of hardware lab innovation - ensuring high-density equipment reliability, optimizing lab Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE), reclaiming stranded power capacity, and driving sustainable operations.


Key Responsibilities
Liquid Cooling Infrastructure: Manage, monitor, and maintain in-rack and row-based Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs), secondary fluid loops, manifold distribution systems, and quick-disconnect (QDC) couplings powering high-density AI/ML compute racks.
Fluid Chemistry Maintenance: Perform routine fluid sampling, pH testing, glycol concentration analysis, biocide/corrosion inhibitor monitoring, and particulate filtration servicing.
Thermal Chamber Operations: Oversee the day-to-day operation, test scheduling, and preventative maintenance of environmental test chambers, executing precision thermal stress profiles (-40 C to +85 C).
Instrumentation Calibration: Deploy and calibrate sensors, thermocouples (T/K-type), RTDs, pressure transducers, and thermal imaging cameras to capture component-level thermal gradients.
Sustainability Telemetry Monitoring: Leverage Smart PDUs, LIMIT portal, and Command Center telemetry to monitor real-time rack power draw (kW), optimize lab PUE, and proactively reclaim stranded electrical and cooling capacity.
Leak Detection Safety Systems: Maintain continuous surveillance over liquid leak detection sensor ropes, optical sensors, automated shut-off solenoid valves, and emergency containment protocols.
Collaborative Engagement: Collaborate with BU Engineering Tech Leads, thermal OEMs (nVent, Motivair, CoolIT), and Workplace Resources (WPR Facilities) on facility integration, chilled water feeds, and lab placement.
Documentation Best Practices: Develop and maintain comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), chemical Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and ensure compliance with ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 environmental standards.


Who You Are
Academic education in Mechanical Engineering, Biotechnology / Chemical Engineering, Electrical Electronics, Thermal Engineering, Instrumentation, or related disciplines (B.S./B.E./B.Tech or M.S./M.Tech with a minimum average GPA of 3.5 out of 4 or 8.5 out of 10)
Experience up to 3 years in laboratory operations, thermal/environmental testing, fluid dynamics/cooling systems, data center facilities, or precision analytical operations is desired but not essential
Academic knowledge of Thermodynamics, Heat Transfer, Fluid Mechanics, Closed-Loop Hydraulics, and Thermal Resistance
Working knowledge or familiarity with liquid cooling systems (Direct-to-Chip cold plates, CDUs, manifolds, dielectric/water-glycol fluids)
Familiarity with environmental test chambers, temperature profiling, thermocouple instrumentation, and data logging
Exposure to lab telemetry platforms (Smart PDUs, DCIM, LIMIT portal) or basic scripting (Python, Shell, MATLAB) is a plus.
Good debugging skills, good problem-solving, and analytical skills
Basic understanding of how laboratory equipment and electro-mechanical hardware operate
Positive energy, motivation to learn, and ability to work as part of a team
High level of work autonomy, disciplined safety adherence, and sense of responsibility
Desire for improvement of current skillset in a fast-paced working environment
Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Description:
Role & responsibilities
We are looking for enthusiastic and creative Digital Marketing Executives to join Nexus Infosys. The role involves managing digital content, video editing, graphic designing, website management, SEO and online advertising.

1. Video Editing, Graphic Designing & Content Creation
Edit Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and promotional videos.
Create attractive social media posts, banners, posters and marketing creatives.
Develop engaging content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.
Create product videos, product demonstrations and promotional content.
Assist with product photography and video shoots.
Create marketing content for leading IT brands and our BenQ Experience Centre.
2. Website Management & E-commerce
Manage and maintain the company's WordPress and WooCommerce website.
Upload new products and update product descriptions, images and pricing.
Manage website pages, banners, categories and product listings.
Assist with website updates, improvements and user experience optimisation.
Ensure product information and website content are regularly updated.
3. SEO & Google Ads
Assist in managing Google Ads campaigns, including Search and Performance Max.
Perform keyword research and competitor analysis.
Work on on-page SEO, meta titles, meta descriptions and blog publishing.
Monitor website performance using Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
Assist with Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking.
Analyse digital marketing performance and prepare reports.


Preferred candidate profile
Freshers and candidates with 01 year of experience are welcome.
Basic knowledge of Canva, Photoshop or other graphic designing tools.
Knowledge of video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Filmora or CapCut.
Basic understanding of WordPress and WooCommerce.
Interest in SEO, Google Ads and digital marketing.
Good communication, writing and creative skills.
Knowledge of social media platforms and current digital trends.
Willingness to learn, take initiative and handle multiple responsibilities.


Perks and benefits
Opportunity to work with leading technology brands.
Hands-on experience in e-commerce and digital marketing.
Practical exposure to Google Ads, SEO and website management.
Creative freedom and opportunities to develop new ideas.
Learning, skill development and career growth opportunities.
Friendly and collaborative working environment.
AboutCompany:
About Nexus Infosys

Nexus Infosys is an established LED Monitor Distributor and IT Hardware Solutions company with over 15 years of industry experience. We specialise in the distribution and marketing of LED monitors, display solutions, computer peripherals and IT hardware from leading global brands including BenQ, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Acer, ASUS, MSI, LG, Samsung and ViewSonic.

We are an authorised regional distribution partner for multiple leading monitor brands and also operate the BenQ Experience Centre in Mumbai, showcasing the latest monitor and display technologies.

We are focused on expanding our e-commerce business through our website, www.mynexusinfosys.com, and strengthening our digital presence across social media platforms.

Our objective is to increase online sales, drive website traffic, improve search engine visibility, build brand awareness and generate quality customer enquiries through effective digital marketing and content creation.

At Nexus Infosys, we encourage creativity, innovation and continuous learning. Team members get the opportunity to work on real-world e-commerce projects, digital marketing campaigns, website management and creative content for leading technology brands.

Join Nexus Infosys and be part of our digital growth journey!

Description:
First impressions are everything.
When guests arrive at our hotels, we want that impression to be memorable.
The same goes for departures.
When guests leave, we want them to go with a smile and a feeling that we were there for them throughout their stay.
We want to build an experience that is memorable and unique from start to finish.
Our Guest Arrival Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their arrival and departure experiences.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Arrival Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Arrival Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing more than 75 pounds with assistance.
.
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Arrival Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Summary
Job Title: Apprentice Hiring
Location: Mumbai
About the programme: This 12-month apprenticeship, under India's National Apprenticeship Training Scheme, provides valuable on-the-job training; Please note, there is no obligation for permanent employment with Deutsche Bank Group upon completion of the Apprenticeship Training tenure.


Role Description
Deutsche Bank PB is one of the world's leading global wealth managers. It serves the holistic needs of 3 million clients and has a unique client proposition, especially for Retail clients, Small medium enterprises, Family entrepreneurs, Ultra High Networth Individuals (UHNWI) and affluent customers. Leveraging its global network and expertise from across Deutsche Bank, it provides capital markets expertise and international solutions tailored to the individual needs of clients. These include wealth planning over generations and international borders, asset management with individual risk management, loans and deposits as well as the development of bespoke solutions for individuals or selected institutions in close collaboration with experts in Investment Banking and Asset Management.
The role is part of a desk extension team in PB CFO and supports the CFO / Performance Management team in Germany; having a local reporting line in Mumbai.


Your key responsibilities
Support the flash and actual processes, including relevant explains, interacting with the regional/central CFO teams and Performance Mgmt teams / business heads where required
Ensuring timely completion of monthend process and GGL restatement process
Participation in automation initiatives, leveraging tools such as Power Query, Co-pilot, and other digital solutions to enhance process efficiency and reporting effectiveness.
Monthly / Weekly Revenue / Flow / Volume reporting analysis for senior management
Conduct various ad hoc analysis and strategically address issues that are complementary to the regular planning and forecasting processes
Other CFO tasks as necessary


Your skills and experience
Commerce Graduate or MBA Finance with specialization in Financial accounting reporting
Good communication and articulation skills with experience in facing off to business heads
Ability to work in a diverse team with cross-cultural exposure
Very good desktop and presentation skills
Experience in Automation tools like Power Query, Python, Co-pilot etc. preferred
Aptitude for analytical tasks and ability to pull out the key messages
Very Good Excel working knowledge
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.


How we'll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career.
Coaching and support from experts in your team.
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Encourage, recruit, register, and schedule guests to participate in recreation activities. Promote a fun and relaxing atmosphere for guests. Provide information to guests about available recreation facilities and activities. Promote the rules and regulations of the recreation facility intended for the safety and welfare of guests and members. Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Follow company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance is clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation.

Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Process payments for rental equipment, recreation activities, facility rentals, or retail sales. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems.

Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 50 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.

Description:
Job Summary
Function SummarySales Manager - Tele Sales role at Axis Max Life Insurance focuses on driving virtual insurance sales through digital platforms. Key responsibilities include conducting virtual meetings, generating leads, and achieving sales targets. The role requires strong communication, relationship management, and customer service skills. Candidates with sales experience in insurance or financial services are preferred.
We are seeking a proactive and customer-focused Virtual Field Sales Representative to join our insurance sales team. The ideal candidate will leverage technology to conduct virtual meetings and webinars, build relationships, and sell insurance products to potential clients. The role requires excellent communication skills, a self-driven attitude, and a passion for sales in the insurance industry.


Key Responsibilities
Conduct virtual meetings and product presentations to prospective clients via video calls, webinars, or online platforms.
Prospect and generate new leads through digital channels such as social media, emails, and online marketing campaigns.
Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of prospects through regular follow-ups and nurturing of relationships.
Provide personalized insurance advice and product recommendations based on customer needs. Achieve sales targets and KPIs by converting leads into policies.
Collaborate with team members and use CRM software to track and report sales activities and progress.
Stay updated on the latest insurance products, industry trends, and regulations to offer the best advice to clients.
Manage customer inquiries and concerns, providing excellent customer service throughout the sales process.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers to encourage repeat business and referrals.


Key Competencies / Skills
Handling Customer Complaints
Relationship
Leading people
Strong communication and presentation skills
Self-motivated
Professionalism
Organization
Knowledge of CRM systems
Knowledge of online sales tools


Qualifications / Experience
Bachelor s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred)
Proven experience in sales, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector

Associate Consultant - Risk - Internal Audit


The Opportunity
The objective of our advisory risk services is to provide clients with a candid and reliable overview of their risk landscape. Our solutions can be used by our clients to build confidence and trust with their customers, the overall market and when required by regulation or contract.

Ensure compliance with engagement plans and internal quality risk management procedures.
Awareness of internal auditing standards issued by IIA and ICAI.
Demonstrate an application solution-based approach to problem solving technique.
Manage the engagement budgets and support superiors in developing marketing collaterals, business proposals and new solution / methodology development.
Develop strong working relationships with client (process owner/functional heads).
Attention to detail and mentor young interns and analysts within the practice.
Contribute to knowledge management sessions within the practice.
Bring and utilize extensive knowledge of the client's business/industry to identify technological developments and evaluate impacts on the client's business.
Demonstrate excellent project management.

Data analytics

Description:
Job Title: Apprentice Hiring for 2026- 2027
Location: Mumbai, India
About the programme:
This 12-month apprenticeship, under India's National Apprenticeship Training Scheme, provides valuable on-the-job training; Please note, there is no obligation for permanent employment with Deutsche Bank Group upon completion of the Apprenticeship Training tenure.
Role Description
About DWS
DWS, publicly listed asset management division of Deutsche Bank, is one of the world's leading investment management organizations with assets under management. DWS provides flexible products and solutions to a wide range of investment opportunities across all asset classes from pooled funds to highly customized portfolios for a wide range of investors and offers individuals and institutions traditional and alternative investments across all major asset classes.
About the team
The Platform Sustainability function is a cross-divisional function, linked to both the investment and product divisions of DWS Group. It coordinates and steers the business implementation of DWSs Sustainability Strategy as well as the sustainability related regulatory requirements in the product and investment areas. Its focus is on the liquid product range of DWS Group and the product-related sustainability activities for alternative investments. Its activities comprise the development of sustainability-related frameworks as well as their integration into engagement processes, ESG integration processes and product-specific investment policies.
The Product Infrastructure & Standards team is part of Platform Sustainability within the Product Division.
The team is responsible for developing the sustainability-related product infrastructure including data management and contributing to product disclosure processes.
In this responsibility, the team plays a key role in designing efficient processes for a technology-driven future. In addition, the team actively contributes to navigating regulatory developments that are shaping the industry. To achieve this, it works closely together with colleagues across the Product Division and other relevant sustainability experts at DWS globally.
Your key responsibilities
As a Product Sustainability Analyst of the Product Sustainabilitys Infrastructure & Standards Team, you will be jointly responsible for
Analysing and conceptualizing the sustainability-related data and process flow from product development to the monitoring of investment guidelines compliance
Coordinating and overseeing the implementation of systematic changes in close collaboration with business and infrastructure teams
Developing a workflow tool for product launches
Automating existing processes related to fund disclosures
Supporting development of sustainability-related product infrastructure with exposure to sustainability specialists and close
collaboration with sustainability investment experts
Your skills and experience
Essential skills:
University degree in Commerce/Science or similar
Working knowledge of any coding language
Experience in working on ESG related topics
Good knowledge of project management
Experience on Automation projects (preferred)
Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) for documentation purposes
Strong analytical and methodological thinking to understand (regulatory) sustainability-related requirements and the associated implications and risks
Proactive solution-oriented mindset to effectively work hand in hand with different teams
Competencies:
Highly motivated, self-sufficient and ability to learn quickly
Intercultural competence, superior communication skills and strict attention to detail
Highly structured and dedicated approach to work
High interest in taking on new challenges

About Accenture

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song- all powered by the world's largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

What would you do?

Accenture is a trusted, innovative, comprehensive, and experienced partner to leading platform companies and other organizations. The Trust and Safety (Content Moderation and Responsible AI) offering(s) within Accenture helps keep the internet safe and helps platform companies accelerate, scale, and improve their businesses.
Accenture s Trust & Safety team, serves as an important line of defense by helping improve the quality and safety of online content while gaining hands-on job experience. They often systematically test, evaluate, and challenge AI systems and platforms to improve the integrity, quality and safety of content, including generative AI. You will deliver value to our clients, while making a larger impact on society.
You will be responsible for analyzing and reviewing user profiles, audio, videos, and text-based content and or investigating, escalating and or resolving issues that are reported by users or flagged by the system. Due to the nature of the role, you may be exposed to objectionable or disturbing content flashing lights or contrasting light and dark patterns.

What are we looking for?
This role requires active participation in Accenture s well-being support program, designed specifically for the Trust & Safety community, provides valuable skills to promote individual and collective well-being.
This is meaningful work that helps keep the internet safe and responsible. It may also be challenging, at times. In this role, you may be directly or inadvertently exposed to, work with, view, or proactively engage with potentially disturbing, objectionable, and sensitive content (e.g., graphic, violent, sexual, or egregious) and expose AI systems to adversarial scenarios. Therefore, Trust & Safety resources need strong resilience and coping skills. We care for the health and well-being of our people and provide the support and resources needed to perform their role responsibilities.
This role requires active participation in Accenture s well-being support program, designed specifically for the Trust & Safety community, provides valuable skills to promote individual and collective well-being.

Roles and Responsibilities:
Role Details and
Key Responsibilities:
Review, classify and or remove, work with, view, or proactively engage with content according to client guidelines, using specific tools and channels
Understand and remain updated on changing client policies and guidelines Stay up-to-date with industry trends, identified generative AI shortcomings and advancements in content moderation and or responsible AI regulations, governance, policy, and consulting work.
Investigate, resolve, and relay complex content issues to the broader Trust and Safety team
Develop and execute prompt strategies to interrogate large language models on various topics related to responsible AI, including medical advice, legal advice, and other sensitive areas.
Analyze the model s responses for appropriateness, inappropriateness, refusal to answer, or appending disclaimers to the response according to client definitions and guidance.
Collaborate with other team members to create a comprehensive understanding of responsible AI issues based on a model s responses.
Contribute to the development of best practices and guidelines for content moderation and responsible AI governance and policy.
Basic Qualifications and Skills Needed:
Strong coping, emotional resilience, and stress-management skills
Excellent comprehension, communication, and ENGLISH skills
Ability to perform duties objectively, devoid of inherent biases or personal beliefs, in the best interest of client policies
Strong attention to detail
Comfort synthesizing and analyzing information from multiple streams
Strong critical thinking and decision-making skills
Preferred Qualifications:
Deep familiarity and passion for responsible AI, the internet, internet platforms, and internet culture
High affinity and cultural awareness of political and social situations regarding the relevant market and region that will be supported

Any Graduation

Job Description
Responsibilities:
- Design and implement advanced solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs).
- Demonstrate self-driven initiative by taking ownership and creating end-to-end solutions.
- Conduct research and stay informed about the latest developments in generative AI and LLMs.
- Develop and maintain code libraries, tools, and frameworks to support generative AI development.
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high code quality standards.
- Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from design and testing to deployment and maintenance.
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align messaging, contribute to roadmaps, and integrate software into different repositories for core system compatibility.
- Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Demonstrate excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment. Primary Skills:
- Natural Language Processing (NLP): Hands-on experience in use case classification, topic modeling, Q&A and chatbots, search, Document AI, summarization, and content generation. AND/OR
- Computer Vision and Audio: Hands-on experience in image classification, object detection, segmentation, image generation, audio, and video analysis.
- Generative AI: o Proficiency with SaaS LLMs, including Lang chain, llama index, vector databases, Prompt engineering (COT, TOT, ReAct, agents). Experience with Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock for text/audio/image/video modalities. o Familiarity with Open-source LLMs, including tools like TensorFlow/Pytorch and huggingface. Techniques such as quantization, LLM finetuning using PEFT, RLHF, data annotation workflow, and GPU utilization.
- Cloud: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Cloud certification is preferred. - Application Development: Proficiency in Python, Docker, FastAPI/Django/Flask, and Git.

Requisition Id: 1761806
Consultant
EY is looking for Consultant.
T he opportunity
As a Consultant you will help the team deliver and contribute to the profitable growth by ensuring client engagements are executed in an efficient manner.
Your key responsibilities
Your client responsibilities:
o Conduct the engagement in a professional manner and in accordance with
client expectations and as defined by the terms and conditions of the contract.
o Preparation and filing of individual tax return, e-TDS return, drafting of
s ubmiss i ons before tax authorities, representation before the tax authorities,
advising on outbound/ inbound structuring in connection with movement of employees, working knowledge of immigration and provident fund in connection with expatriates, etc
Your people responsibilities:
o Exhibit positive attitude and demonstrate willingness to learn.
o Work constructively with team to evaluate and improve personal and team
performance.
o Contribute and leverage knowledge from individuals, databases and other
sources.
o Provide timely and high-quality services and work products that exceed client
expectations.
Operational Excellence / Day to day responsibilities:
o Participate in executing work within a group by assisting by delivering work
effectiv e ly, and teaming with tax professionals to provide comprehensive tax solutions.
o Ensure that the areas of work assigned are executed in accordance with the
work programme and the firm s methodologies and guidance, and
professional standards.
o Use electronic working papers, efficiently including various software
applications and sources of knowledge in an appropriate manner to conduct
research.
o Acquire and demonstrate competence in technical knowledge, and
compliance process by keeping up to date on trends, developments and technical authorities and apply them to moderately complex situations.
o Analyze and convert data into a tax product (advisory/compliance) and
ensure accuracy and timeliness of the product.
o Where applicable thoroughly check documents and make available for tax
inspections in an appropriate manner.
o Demonstrate professionalism through a positive and cooperative attitude and
by maintaining the confidential and proprietary nature of client relationships and related work products.
o Contribute to the overall success of the team by developing a thorough understanding of our methodologies and tools to enhance service delivery;
keeping team members informed of work status; actively seeking
2
assignments when unassigned; proactively seeking opportunities to provide tax services; challenging traditional procedures used in the past; and
attempting to find new approach
Skills and attributes for success
Good Communication skills (Written Oral)
Profi c ient in MS word, excel, power point
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
Strong Analytical/Numerical ability
Enthusiastic and Self Starter
Team Player
Ability to grasp details
Good time management skills
T o qualify for the role y ou must have
A certified CA
0-1 year of relevant experience
Ideally you ll also have
Good interpersonal skills
Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative
Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excell e nt client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.
About EY
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we re using the fin a nce products, expertise and systems we ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we ll make our ambition to be the best employer by 2020 a reality.
