Description:
Hiring: TSS Real Estate

Location: BANGALORE
Work Mode: Work from Office + Field Visits
Experience: Property Sales preferred

Salary -17000 per month fixed

About the Role

We are looking for a Business Development Associate (BDA) who will work closely with property owners and prospective tenants to facilitate property transactions and close deals.

The candidate will receive leads from the company, visit properties with clients, understand owner requirements, identify potential tenants, and drive the deal to closure.

Key Responsibilities
Handle company-generated leads and connect with potential clients/tenants.
Visit properties and show them to prospective tenants/clients.
Travel approximately 3040 km daily for property visits and client meetings.
Understand and manage property owner requirements.
Identify suitable and potential tenants based on property requirements.
Coordinate between property owners and tenants throughout the transaction.
Conduct property visits, explain property details, and address client queries.
Negotiate and follow up with both parties to close the deal.
Maintain regular follow-ups with leads until closure.
Build strong relationships with property owners and clients.
Maintain updated records of leads, property visits, follow-ups, and closures.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Real estate knowledge is preferred.
Good understanding of property types, location, configuration, and surface/built-up/carpet area.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Good convincing, negotiation, and sales skills.
Comfortable with daily field travel of 3040 km.
Ability to understand client and owner requirements and match them effectively.
Target-oriented and strong in follow-ups.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple property/client requirements.
Ideal Candidate

Someone who is sales-driven, confident in client interactions, comfortable with field work, and has a good understanding of the real estate market.

If you enjoy meeting clients, exploring properties, and closing real estate deals, this role is for you!e & responsibilities

AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

Inside Sales Executive
Department: Sales
Are you a motivated individual with a passion for real estate sales? Join our team at
Nobroker as an Inside Sales Executive and help revolutionize the way people buy and
sell properties !!!
Location
:
:
:
Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)
Full-time
Position Type
¢ Salary Range
Up to 4.5 LPA to 5.5 LPA (inclusive of variable components
& based on current relevant experience)
About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech
unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants
and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh
new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000
transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered
in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and
Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1
billion.
Specific Responsibilities:
Prospect Identification: Identify and engage potential business opportunities.
Sales and Relationships: Build strong client relationships and effectively
communicate product value.
Problem Solving: Address client challenges with tailored solutions.
Lead Management: Handle outbound calls and follow-ups to nurture leads and
drive conversions.
Service Excellence: Maintain high service standards to ensure client satisfaction.
Revenue Generation: Focus on closing sales and meeting revenue goals.



Perks & Value Proposition:
Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company.
Free lunch and snacks: Provided to all employees.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding
performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2
years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for
all employees.
Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers:
Education: Graduation or HSC qualified.
Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills,
numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making skills.
Languages: English and Hindi mandatory; Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word).
Work schedule: Flexible for a day shift (9 hours between 8 AM - 10 PM), and
comfortable working 6 days a week, with a weekday off.
Why Nobroker?
At Nobroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a
dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape.
Take the next step in your career and apply today !!!

Description:
Title- Finance Analyst
Experience- 0-1 Year
Location-Pune
We are looking for Financial Analyst to manage financial planning, accounting, invoicing, revenue recognition, budgeting, MIS reporting, and financial compliance activities for engineering services projects.
Key Responsibilities
Financial Accounting & Reporting
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
Ensure accurate booking of revenues, expenses, accruals, and provisions.
Perform month-end and year-end closing activities.
Support statutory audit, internal audit, and tax audit requirements.
Maintain General Ledger and ensure reconciliation of balance sheet accounts.
Project Finance & Revenue Management
Monitor project-wise profitability and margins.
Review project budgets versus actual costs.
Ensure accurate revenue recognition as per contractual milestones and accounting standards.
Track unbilled revenue, deferred revenue, and WIP balances.
Coordinate with project managers and delivery teams for financial reviews.
Budgeting & MIS Reporting
Assist in annual budgeting and periodic forecasting.
Prepare business unit-wise MIS reports.
Analyze revenue, gross margin, utilization, and cost variances.
Present financial insights and recommendations to management.
Business Partnering
Evaluate commercial proposals and customer contracts.
Support pricing, profitability analysis, and business case preparation.
Provide financial guidance to stakeholders for decision-making.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Accounting Standards and Financial Reporting.
Hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting, and MIS reporting.
Knowledge of revenue recognition and project accounting.
Understanding of GST, TDS, and corporate taxation.
Proficiency in SAP (FI/CO), Oracle, or similar ERP systems.
Advanced MS Excel skills (Pivot Tables, Power Query, Financial Modeling).
Strong analytical and communication skills.

Description:
Skill required: Order to Cash - Accounts Receivable Ledger Maintenance

Designation: Order to Cash Operations New Associate

Qualifications:Any Graduation

Years of Experience:0 to 1 years

About Accenture

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song- all powered by the world's largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

What would you do?

You will be aligned with our Finance Operations vertical and will be helping us in determining financial outcomes by collecting operational data reports, whilst conducting analysis and reconciling transactions.
In this role, you will support end-to-end Order to Cash (OTC) processes, focusing on accounts receivable management, revenue recognition, and customer billing. You will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely recording of revenue in compliance with applicable accounting standards, managing customer accounts, and driving collections efficiency. The OTC team plays a critical role in optimizing working capital by reducing Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), minimizing bad debt exposure, and ensuring the integrity of revenue reporting.
The Accounts Receivables and Revenue Accounting team focuses on designing, implementing, managing and supporting order-to-cash activities by applying the relevant processes, policies and applications. The team is responsible for timely and accurate invoicing, cash application, credit management, collections follow-up, and revenue accounting activities including deferred revenue tracking, revenue reconciliation, and period-end close activities.

What are we looking for?
Qualification- B.Com Graduate
Ability to handle disputes and customer escalations
Ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Ability to perform under pressure and manage high transaction volumes
Ability to work well in a team and collaborate across functions
Adaptable and flexible to dynamic business needs
Basic understanding of accounts receivable and revenue accounting principles
Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar) is an added advantage
Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy
Good communication skills for customer and internal stakeholder interaction

Roles and Responsibilities:
In this role you are required to solve routine problems, largely through precedent and referral to general guidelines
Support accurate and timely processing of customer invoices, credit notes, and billing adjustments in line with contractual terms
Assist in cash application activities, matching incoming customer payments to open invoices and resolving unapplied cash
Perform accounts receivable reconciliations, ensuring sub-ledger balances align with the general ledger
Support collections activities by generating aging reports, following up on overdue accounts, and escalating unresolved items
Participate in month-end and period-end close activities including preparation of journal entries, accruals, and supporting schedules
Coordinate with internal stakeholders (sales, legal, operations) and external customers to resolve billing disputes and discrepancies
Maintain accurate customer master data and credit limit records
Your primary interaction is within your own team and your direct supervisor
In this role you will be given detailed instructions on all tasks
The decisions that you make impact your own work and are closely supervised
You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team with a predetermined, narrow scope of work
Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

Qualification
Any Graduation

Description:
Job Summary:
Ensures products received or produced meet technical specifications and trains others. Works under minimal supervision.
Key Responsibilities:
Verifies the final quality of products on the production line. Compares the physical characteristics of components, materials, equipment and products to technical specifications to identify defects. Separates products that do not meet the desired technical specification, using basic and/or complex measurement techniques and equipment. Documents products that do not meet technical specifications using specified systems. Trains others in the use of measurement equipment, segregation of non-conforming product and documentation. Follows the norms and standards of quality defined by the Company.
Key Responsibilities Skills
Hands-on experience in operating and maintaining metrology laboratory equipment, including CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machine), Roundness Tester, and Surface Finish Tester .
Expertise in programming and measurement execution on metrology equipment.
Strong knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning Tolerancing (GDT) and interpretation of engineering drawings.
Experience in Measurement System Analysis (MSA) , calibration management, and layout inspection activities.
Conducting and managing incoming/receiving inspection of components and materials.
Handling supplier quality issues , including investigation, containment, corrective actions, and follow-up.
Knowledge of Corrective Action Requests (CAR) and Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCAR) , including root cause analysis and effectiveness verification.
Ensuring compliance with quality standards, inspection plans, and customer requirements.
Supporting continuous improvement initiatives for metrology and supplier quality processes
Competencies:
Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Measurement Science - Analyzes measurement processes throughout the relevant traceability chain to identify and quantify sources of measurement uncertainty relevant to the appropriate applied measurement science, Metrology e. g. Chemical, Dimensional, Electrical, Mechanical, Optical and Radiation and Physical.

Quality Process Management - Proficient application of quality tools and methods (e. g. APQP, FMEA, PPAP, SPC, Capability studies, Process Audit, inspection, test, etc. ) to ensure quality of products, processes and services.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Laboratory Management - Leads technical resources while managing the business aspects of a laboratory using measure to control both the technical and business aspects of the organization and assuring the requirements of the appropriate certifications and/or accreditations are met.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Requires significant relevant work experience or specialized skills obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

Job Description
Job Title: RA- Credit Life Reporting To- Manager - Credit Life
Location :
Will be responsible for managing a leading bank Loan Verticals and branches. Purpose of the Job (overall high level summary of the job)
Managing the Group credit life business, across locations and to achieve business volume (premium) and desired penetration. Regularly engage and provide market update, training drive the ASCs (Loan Centre) to implement the set processes and ensuring seamless functioning of Grp Cr Life product within ASCs. He/she will be closely working with the Retail Asset Teams of the Bank to sell Group credit life Scheme along with the bank s primary product. He/she would plan, monitor, coach, communicate and execute sales strategies and gain mind share of the bank officials (at all levels) and then provide feedback. He/she will also in turn work with the Group Operations to follow up on issuance and clearing of pendency, if any.
Principal Accountabilities How they are achieved/measured
Manage the Group business with the Bank employees
Liaison with different departments for closure of the cases
Champion product and process to drive top line sales through business sales team and maintaining penetration levels of group insurance products with channel partner.
Coordinate and train key officials (ASSL, DSA, other bank officials) to enhance their understanding of the business to increase seller activisation
Provide market feedback on competition and other products in the market.
Manage and strengthen relationship through engagement with Partner s Zonal Leadership team, Ops Credit Team, DSAs, SMs, Field Sales Staff at all levels and across functions. Values add in key initiatives to enhance attachment ration business volume through training and service.
Tracking penetration performance and publishing dashboards, along with Group Operations.
To measure monitor the various metrics (Files and sum assured Penetration rates, seller activation, Claim denial rates/ pending rates, rejection ratios , medical TATs etc), to minimize the same and adhere to TATs and contribute to product improvement.
Monitoring and control process of Post Sales.
Managing complete claims operation end to end process.

Sales

Fresher can apply

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for an enthusiastic and target-oriented Admission Counselor to guide working professionals in choosing the right upGrad programs based on their career goals and professional experience.

Key Responsibilities
Connect with working professionals through calls and other communication channels to understand their career and learning requirements.
Counsel prospective learners about upGrads programs, courses, eligibility, and career benefits.
Follow up with leads and convert prospective learners into enrolled students.
Achieve assigned monthly admission and revenue targets.
Maintain regular follow-ups and build strong relationships with prospective learners.
Handle queries and objections related to programs, fees, eligibility, and career outcomes.
Maintain accurate lead and conversion records in the CRM.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth admission and enrollment process.

Requirements
0-3 years of experience in Inside Sales, EdTech Sales, Admission Counseling, Telesales, or Business Development.

Job Description
Responsibilities:
- Design and implement advanced solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs).
- Demonstrate self-driven initiative by taking ownership and creating end-to-end solutions.
- Conduct research and stay informed about the latest developments in generative AI and LLMs.
- Develop and maintain code libraries, tools, and frameworks to support generative AI development.
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high code quality standards.
- Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from design and testing to deployment and maintenance.
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align messaging, contribute to roadmaps, and integrate software into different repositories for core system compatibility.
- Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Demonstrate excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment. Primary Skills:
- Natural Language Processing (NLP): Hands-on experience in use case classification, topic modeling, Q&A and chatbots, search, Document AI, summarization, and content generation. AND/OR
- Computer Vision and Audio: Hands-on experience in image classification, object detection, segmentation, image generation, audio, and video analysis.
- Generative AI: o Proficiency with SaaS LLMs, including Lang chain, llama index, vector databases, Prompt engineering (COT, TOT, ReAct, agents). Experience with Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock for text/audio/image/video modalities. o Familiarity with Open-source LLMs, including tools like TensorFlow/Pytorch and huggingface. Techniques such as quantization, LLM finetuning using PEFT, RLHF, data annotation workflow, and GPU utilization.
- Cloud: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Cloud certification is preferred. - Application Development: Proficiency in Python, Docker, FastAPI/Django/Flask, and Git.

Description:
Position: Python Automation Engineer/Lead
Key Responsibilities-
Design, build and maintain automated test frameworks in Python and Pytest for embedded devices and the software that runs on them.
Strong hands-on experience in FlaUI for Windows desktop application automation.
Strong programming expertise in Python with PyTest / Robot Framework.
Write automated tests across levels: integration, system and end-to-end, including tests run on hardware and on simulators.
Work with updating Automation framework
Run tests on real instruments analyse logs and debug failures across hardware, firmware and software.
Execute manual/automation test case and report defects
Defect tracking and verification.
Follow Test process to ensure adequate quality
Must have skills-
- Strong proficiency in Python and Appium.
- Hands-on experience with automation testing frameworks such as PyTest/Unittest.
- Building test automation frameworks from scratch or extending existing ones.
- Embedded or device testing: hardware-in-the-loop, simulators, serial/TCP/IPC communication, log analysis.
- Linux command line and shell scripting.
- Git and pull-request based workflows.
- CI/CD exposure (Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines or GitHub Actions).
- Solid grasp of test design techniques: boundary values, equivalence classes, negative testing.
- Good written and spoken English for working with global teams.
Location: IN-GJ-Ahmedabad, India-Ognaj (eInfochips)
Time Type: Full time
Job Category: Engineering Services

Position: Senior Engineer - Linux BSP (Solutions)
Key Responsibilities
- Responsible for design and development of real time embedded software/firmware and PC/mobile based software application.
- To Analyse domain specific technical or low level requirement and modification as per end customer or system requirement.
- Participate in High level and low level software design
- Perform software testing including unit, functional and system level requirement including manual and automated
- Performs software requirement to design to coding to testing traceability
- Performs code review following coding guidelines and static code analysis
- Troubleshoots software problems of limited difficulty.
- Documenting technical deliverable like software specifications, design document, code commenting, test cases and test report, Release note etc. throughout the project life cycle.
- Follow defined process for software Development life cycle
- Develops software solutions from established programming languages or by learning new language required for specific project.
Experience / Skills Required
- Strong knowledge for Linux device drivers, Linux Kernel Programming, Linux Kernel Internals, Yocto / Buildroot or any other build systems
- Experience working with development tools like oscilloscope, protocol analyser, emulator, signal generator, JTAG programmer, GIT, SVN, JIRA.
- Experience working with different embedded microprocessor based on Qualcomm, TI, NXP, NVIDIA, Intel or similar
- Experience of Board support package, Device driver and boot loader development/porting.
- Understanding of hardware schematic, datasheet of hardware component to derive firmware/software specific solution
- Strong sense of ownership, passionate, fast learner, analytical mind set, perfection seeker.
Location: IN-UP-Noida, India-World Trade Tower (eInfochips)

About Homelane
HomeLane is built for designers who want moremore growth, more ownership, more earning potential, and more impact. We back designers with structured career acceleration, industry-leading rewards, real ownership of outcomes, and a growth ecosystem that evolves with youfrom your first project to leading teams or launching your own studio.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Shadow design discussions the Senior Designer does with clients; prepare Minutes of Meetings and keep track of project milestones to ensure a timely and high-quality delivery 1. Coordinate with various stakeholders to ensure a great design outcome; build relationships with teams like sales, drawing QC, project management teams and planners 5. Mandatory Qualifications: 1. Design education background - B.Arch, B.Des, M.Des, Diploma in Design 2. 0-1yr of experience in Interior Design / Architecture 3. Good communication & presentation skills 4. Basic knowledge of Modular furniture 5. Practical knowledge of SketchUp 6. A great attitude.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Act as the vital link between the Front Office Treasury dealing desk, Finance/Accounts, and Risk/Compliance teams.
Track borrowing costs, liquidity positions, and upcoming cash flow obligations to support daily cash forecasting.
Assist with statutory, internal, and concurrent audits by providing accurate transaction trails and supporting documentation.
Manage the end-to-end operational execution of periodic interest (coupon) payments and principal redemptions for NCDs.
Prepare payout schedules, calculate accrued interest, verify beneficiary details (BENPOS), and coordinate with RTAs and banking partners to ensure zero-error, on-time disbursements.
Prepare, review, and maintain end-to-end documentation for NCD issuances, including term sheets, information memorandums, debenture trust deeds, and regulatory filings.

Preferred candidate profile:
Any graduate/ CA Inter

Description:
Position: Deputy Manager / Assistant Manager Project Sales, Trade Sales & OEM Sales
Location: Mumbai/ Navi Mumbai
Company: Greenlam Industries Ltd.

Key Responsibilities

Project Sales
Develop and maintain relationships with Architects, Interior Designers, PMCs, Contractors, Builders, and Developers.
Generate specifications and business from residential, commercial, hospitality, healthcare, retail, and institutional projects.
Conduct product presentations and technical discussions with influencers and consultants.
Track upcoming projects and convert opportunities into sales.

Trade Sales
Drive primary and secondary sales through distributor, dealer, and retailer networks.
Appoint and develop channel partners for market expansion.
Ensure implementation of promotional activities and visibility initiatives.
Monitor market trends, competition, and customer requirements.
Achieve territory-wise sales and collection targets.

OEM Sales
Develop business with furniture manufacturers, modular kitchen companies, OEMs, fabricators, and institutional accounts.
Drive vendor registrations, product approvals, and annual rate contracts with key accounts.
Negotiate commercial terms and ensure smooth order execution.
Build long-term relationships with strategic customers to generate repeat business.

Key Accountabilities
Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
Expand market share and strengthen brand presence.
Generate new business opportunities and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
Coordinate with internal teams for timely execution and customer satisfaction.
Ensure timely collections and account management.
Prepare sales forecasts, MIS reports, and market intelligence updates.

Desired Candidate Profile
Graduate in any discipline; MBA preferred.
3 to 10 years of experience in Project Sales, Trade Sales, OEM Sales, Specification Sales, Institutional Sales, or Channel Sales.
Preferred industry exposure: Laminates, Plywood, Veneers, Flooring, Building Materials, Decorative Surfaces, Furniture, Interior Products, Paints, Tiles, Sanitaryware, or related sectors.
Strong network with Architects, Interior Designers, Contractors, Dealers, Distributors, Builders, and OEM customers.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.

AboutCompany:
NoBroker is a leading Indian proptech company founded in 2013 by IIT and IIM alumni. It operates a consumer-to-consumer (C2C) real estate marketplace that connects property owners directly with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for brokers and middlemen. This model aims to reduce brokerage fees and create a transparent, seamless property transaction experience. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker is among India's pioneering platforms in the real estate space and has grown rapidly to become a unicorn, securing over $361 million in funding from investors such as Tiger Global, General Atlantic, and Google. Its services span major Indian cities including Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Pune, and Hyderabad.
NoBroker provides a comprehensive suite of services beyond property listings, including rental agreements, home loans, packers and movers, home services, property management, and society management through its app NoBrokerHood. The platform boasts over 75 lakh properties registered and facilitates more than 5,00,000 annual transactions.
The company places strong emphasis on innovation, customer-centric solutions, and data-driven technology to disrupt traditional real estate processes. NoBrokers culture promotes growth, meritocracy, and problem-solving, making it a desirable workplace in India's tech ecosystem.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.

Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.

Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).

Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Executive Indirect Taxation (Bhiwadi & Bangalore location)

The Executive Indirect Taxation will support the tax function by ensuring accurate GST compliance, audit readiness, strategic liaison and effective stakeholder communication within a dynamic environment. This role focuses on the timely filing of returns, accurate reconciliation of tax ledgers, data analysis, process Improvement and supporting the teams during statutory audits and assessments.

Key Responsibilities
Prepare, review, and file periodic GST returns ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
Conduct GST audit activities, identify gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
Interpret and apply GST rules, acts, and notifications to business transactions.
Timely coordinate with internal stakeholders and external tax authorities for dispute resolution and clarifications.
Generate management information system (MIS) reports to aid decisionmaking and highlight compliance risks.
Communicate tax implications and solutions to crossfunctional teams, facilitating problem identification and resolution.

Required Skills & Experience
58 years of handson experience in indirect taxation, predominantly GST, within the manufacturing sector who has handle huge volumes of data.
Proven ability to file GST returns and perform GST audits with minimal supervision.
Strong knowledge of GST Acts, rules, and recent amendments.
Excellent liaisoning and networking skills to interact with tax authorities, auditors, and internal departments.
Proficient in tax compliance software and advanced Excel, Power Point for MIS reporting.
Effective written and verbal communication, have ability to understand and act quickly, hard-working, proactive.

Preferred Qualifications
Professional certification such as B.Com, CMA (Inter) or CA (Inter),
Experience using ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) for tax data extraction.

Description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments Incorporated (TI) is a global semiconductor design and manufacturing company that develops analog ICs and embedded processors. By employing the world s brightest minds, TI creates innovations that shape the future of technology. TI is helping about 100,000 customers transform the future, today. We re committed to building a better future - from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities and developing great minds. Put your talent to work with us - change the world, love your job!
Are you looking for a career at one of the leading semiconductor companies in the world Texas Instruments (TI) is looking for a Digital Design Verification Engineer to join the team of enthusiastic engineers who develops highly complex mixed signal devices for audio applications with industry leading performance.
These audio products are truly mixed-signal devices with highly integrated digital circuits such as a DSP core for digital filters and audio signal processing blocks, hardware processing blocks, analog controllers, various serial interfaces (Audio serial interfaces, I2C, SPI) and other digital blocks like clock-generation, registers map, Interrupts etc.
This is a great opportunity to be part of an established team that s continuing to look for growth opportunities, working with worldwide leading customers and developing cutting edge solutions in the areas of consumer electronics, industrial and automotive markets.
Position : Digital Design Verification Engineer
Domain : Consumer Audio Amplifiers and Haptics
Location : Bangalore
What can you expect to learn in this role/Opportunity
To work with the best experts in the industry.
To develop capability to work effectively in a technically challenging fast-paced and rapidly changing environment.
To innovate on core technology in verification methodologies influence decisions that have wide business impact across many products teams.
To work on cutting edge industry leading products.
To learn overall product development Process and directly influence the features, differentiation quality of the product.
To learn and develop business insights, drive open discussions with business technology leaders and drive decisions impacting product technology execution.
To build strong, influential relationships with domain experts.
To develop good communication, interpersonal skills while interacting with worldwide cross functional experts.
To learn identifying risks across domains and adapt to support changing priorities.
To present analysis and conclusions to internal customers and business leaders in a comprehensive and effective manner.
To work closely with cross-domain experts other engineers and interns.
Primary Responsibilities:
Responsible to develop detailed coverage driven Verification plan working closing with System and Application team and design team.
Owning part of digital verification of the sub-system and full-chip by working closely with other verification team members, leads including outside services.
Develop/Enhance SV/UVM based testbenches and tests and simulations at all phases (RTL, GLS),
Understanding spec and coming up with testplan. Writing TB components, testcases, checkers, assertions, enhancing with randomization and coverage-feedbacks.
RTL and GLS regression and follow-up with tracking of the various activities. Run coverage and meet the defined coverage(coverage functional) goals.
Good interaction with Digital Design team, Firmware developers, Analog Designers, and rest of the team.
Excellent teamwork, adapting to situations and ability to guide, help DV members Communication of DV status, issues, and concerns.
Innovate drive new and improved design verification methodologies where needed, work with the EDA team to upgrade tools and flows.
Interacting with Test/Silicon Validation/Application Engineering team to ensure successful use of products and support customer applications debug/analysis.
Identify and write all types of coverage measures for stimulus and corner-cases.
Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks.
Close coverage measures to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out.
Basic Qualifications: Bachelors/Masters Degree in EE/ECE
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering.
3 years of Digital design verification experience.
Basic Requirement:
Strong digital design fundamentals basic Electrical engineering
Experience with Verilog, System Verilog languages with UVM methodology.
Experience on randomization and coverage driven digital verification.
Experience in working with VIPs, creating TB components, agents, monitors, scoreboards and other ways to automate verification.
Hand on experience in RTL and Gate level simulations of complex ASIC at block and top level
Expert in using simulation tools (preferably Cadence, Xcelium/Ncsim).
Basic scripting knowledge using shell/python/perl.
Excellent debugging and problem-solving skill.
Excellent in Coverage driven verification with code coverage, functional coverage
Experience in Formal verification (using Jasper Gold) is good to have
Good communication, presentation skills and teamwork.

Preferred Qualifications:
Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Effective communication skills to interact with all stakeholders.
Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions.
Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment.
Ability to take the initiative and drive for results.
Ability to build strong, influential relationships with cross-functional teams.
Added Advantage :
Experience in silicon debug along with design and silicon validation team.
Experience in audio signal processing and understanding of audio systems/applications.
Hands-on exp on I2C, SPI, ASI protocols.
Hand on experience on Cadence tools
Preferred Skills/ Experience
3-5 years of relevant experience

IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits ETC
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep IE while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Description:
About IIFL Finance
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Job Title Customer Care Executive (Gold Loans)
Job Description -
Responsible toacquire New Customers for generating Gold Loan business and for other cross sell products

Participate in field- marketing activities toimprove the brand visibility of IIFL Finance Limited branch in the catchment areas and generate leads of prospective customers

Drive ensure continuous customer engagement through various channels

Maintaining quality portfolio by trackingcontrolling ROI

Provide after salesservice to existing customers and obtain references from them to increase thecustomer base

Strong follow up on interest collectionsto keep NPAs (non-performing assets) under control

Desired Candidate Profile (CCE) -
Candidateswith 6 months of sales experience in Banking Financial Services can applyfor the role

Fresherswith flair in Sales can also apply

In summary,the role focuses heavily on sales - acquiring new customers, engaging withexisting ones, ensuring portfolio quality, and collecting payments to minimizedefaults

Brand building through field marketing is also a key component

CTC Upto 2

37 Lacs ( for Non Metro) / 2

8Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits ETC
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep IE while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Process all guest check-ins, verifying guest identity, form of payment, assigning room, and activating/issuing room key. Set up accurate accounts for each guest according to their requirements. Enter Marriott Rewards information. Ensure rates match market codes, document exceptions. Secure payment prior to issuing room key, verify/adjust billing. Compile and review daily reports/logs/contingency lists. Complete cashier and closing reports. Supply guests with directions and property information. Accommodate guest requests, contacting appropriate staff if necessary. Follow up to ensure requests have been met. Process all payment types, vouchers, paid-outs, and charges. Balance and drop receipts. Count and secure bank at beginning and end of shift. Obtain manual authorizations and follow all Accounting procedures. Notify Loss Prevention/Security of any guest reports of theft.
Assist management in training, evaluating, counseling, motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Develop/maintain positive working relationships; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Follow company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure personal appearance is clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Ensure adherence to quality standards. Enter and locate information using computers/POS systems. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Inspect guest rooms, public areas, pool, etc. after being cleaned by Housekeeper to ensure quality standards. Run sold room reports, verify room status, determine discrepant rooms, prioritize room cleaning, and update status of departing guest rooms. Assist Housekeeping management in managing daily activities. Act as a liaison to coordinate the efforts of Housekeeping, Engineering, Front Office, and Laundry. Document and resolve issues with discrepant rooms with the Front Desk. Prepare, distribute, and communicate changes in room assignments. Communicate issues to next shift. Complete required paperwork.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Move, lift, carry, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 55 pounds without assistance and in excess of 55 pounds with assistance. Ability to push and pull a loaded housekeeping cart and other work-related machinery over sloping and uneven surfaces. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Stand, sit, kneel, or walk for an extended period across an entire work shift. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits ETC
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep IE while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Check figures, postings, and documents for accuracy. Organize, secure, and maintain all files, records, cash and cash equivalents in accordance with policies and procedures. Classify, code, and summarize numerical and financial data to compile and keep financial records, using journals, ledgers, and/or computers. Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

Description:
Field HR Associate JD
Role Summary:
The Field HR Associate will support and execute human resources activities at the ground
level across logistics sites such as warehouses, fulfillment centers, and delivery hubs. The role
involves blue-collar hiring, attendance and payroll support, engagement activities, labor
compliance tracking, and issue resolution for site-based workforce.
Key Responsibilities:
Recruitment & Onboarding
Coordinate daily/weekly hiring of warehouse associates, loaders, delivery staff, etc.
through vendors and local channels.
Manage candidate screening, document collection, and induction processes.
Maintain trackers for manpower deployment and contractor rotation.
Attendance, Payroll & HR Ops
Monitor daily attendance through biometric/manual systems.
Collate and validate attendance data for payroll input in coordination with central HR
ops.
Assist in issuing ID cards, onboarding kits, and HR documentation at the site.
Compliance & Labor Law Support
Support contract labor compliance (e.g., ESI/PF records, CLRA documentation).
Coordinate with compliance teams and vendors to ensure audit readiness at the site.
Maintain updated personnel records as per labor law norms.
Employee Engagement & Grievance Handling



Conduct engagement activities (e.g., weekly briefings, rewards, celebrations).
Act as the first point of contact for associate grievances related to wages, safety, shift
timings, etc.
Escalate unresolved issues to regional HR.
HR Reporting & Coordination
Maintain HR MIS, hiring status, attrition reports, and daily dashboards.
Coordinate between warehouse operations, vendors, and HR leadership.
Support audits, safety drills, and training rollouts.
Qualifications:
Graduate in any discipline; PG Diploma in HR preferred
13 years of experience in field HR roles (logistics, manufacturing, retail, or facility
management)
Freshers with relevant internship experience may be considered
Language: Local language fluency + basic English required
Comfortable with fieldwork and managing blue-collar workforce
Key Skills:
People-centric and proactive
Basic knowledge of labor laws and HR documentation
Strong coordination and reporting ability
Comfortable with MS Excel and attendance software



High integrity, discipline, and site ownership mindset
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Description:
Key Accountabilities
Own the programme Non-Functional Test Approach, defining the scope, objectives and delivery approach across applicable NFR areas.
Analyse and validate non-functional requirements (NFRs) and acceptance criteria.
Lead Non-Functional testing including performance, resilience, security, accessibility, operability, compatibility, scalability and recoverability.
Own the integrated non-functional test plan, aligning specialist activities with programme releases, environments and deployment milestones.
Coordinate delivery across specialist test leads, engineers, technology teams, Guidewire and third-party suppliers.
Define non-functional entry, exit and assurance criteria, ensuring results are supported by appropriate evidence.
Identify, manage and escalate non-functional testing risks, issues, dependencies, constraints and coverage gaps.
Desirable Professional Qualifications
ISTQB Advanced Test Manager or relevant specialist testing certification.
Performance testing qualifications or practical expertise using tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad or k6.
Security testing knowledge aligned with OWASP or relevant CREST practices. Accessibility knowledge aligned with WCAG 2.2.
Cloud certification such as Microsoft Azure, AWS or relevant Guidewire Cloud training.
Project Test Delivery Management Certifications e.g. PRINCE2 Practitioner/ Association of Project Management (APM)/ Agile Project Management (APMG)
Organisation Level
Workstream Leadership
Essential Skills Experience Lead and own non-functional testing
NFR Strategy and Planning: Proven experience developing and implementing non-functional test approaches for complex enterprise programmes.
Coverage and Prioritisation: Ability to translate business, technical and operational risks into a proportionate NFR test scope.
Specialist Leadership Experience: Proven experience coordinating performance, security, resilience, accessibility and operational-readiness disciplines through specialists leads and engineers.
Drive non-functional testing excellence
Innovation and Best Practices: Experience in fostering a culture of testing innovation and adopting industry best practices.
Specialist Knowledge: Strong understanding of performance, resilience, security, accessibility, operability and compatibility testing.
Shift-left Approach: Ability to embed early non-functional testing into programme lifecycle.
Problem Solving: Strong problem-solving skills to address testing challenges and provide effective solutions.
Assure requirements and deliverables
NFR Assurance Experience: Experience establishing traceability between NFRs, technical risks, test coverage, evidence and acceptance.
Test Risk Management: Ability to identify and mitigate testing risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Test Review and Standards: Experience in conducting test reviews and ensuring adherence to standards and guidelines.
Readiness Assurance: Experience assessing specialist test approaches, environments, tooling, test data, monitoring and execution prerequisites.
Support and Test Readiness
NFR Readiness: Ensure NFRs, acceptance criteria and test scope are sufficiently defined before test execution.
Environment Tooling Readiness: Coordinate readiness of environments, tooling, monitoring and observability required across NFR disciplines.
Test Data Dependencies: Ensure required test data, interfaces, integrations and external dependencies are identified and available.
Readiness Assessment: Identify and escalate readiness gaps, risks and constraints that could impact NFR delivery or release milestones.
Collaborate and communicate
Stakeholder Communication: Translate complex technical findings into clear business impacts, risks and decision points.
Clear Communication: Strong communication skills to articulate testing concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Accountability and Governance: Proven ability to establish ownership boundaries across specialist leads, engineers, delivery teams and suppliers.
NFR Assurance and Reporting
Performance Monitoring: Proficiency in defining, tracking, and reporting on key test performance indicators (KPIs).
Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to analyse testing metrics and make informed decisions based on data.
Progress Reporting: Experience in providing regular updates on test progress, challenges, and solutions to senior management and stakeholders.
NFR Test Report: Own the consolidated Non-Functional Test Report, summarising test outcomes, risks, residual issues and overall NFR quality assessment.

Description:
RPA Developer with strong hands-on expertise in UiPath and working knowledge of Microsoft Power Automate to design, develop, test, and support enterprise automation solutions.
Key Skill Requirements
UiPath (Primary Skill):
Strong hands-on experience in UiPath development.
Experience with UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, REFramework, Queues, Assets, and unattended automations.
Proven experience developing end-to-end enterprise automation solutions.
Microsoft Power Automate:
Working knowledge and development experience in Power Automate Cloud Flows and Desktop Flows.
Experience integrating Power Automate with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Outlook, Teams, and Dataverse.
Required Experience
4-6 years of experience in Robotic Process Automation (RPA) development.
Minimum 3+ years of hands-on UiPath development experience.
Experience working in Agile and/or DevOps environments.
Experience with API integrations, web services, and enterprise applications.
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.
Preferred Qualifications
UiPath certification (Associate or Advanced Developer).
Exposure to Microsoft Power Platform components such as Power Apps and Dataverse.
Knowledge of SQL queries, databases, and data integration concepts.
Experience supporting production automation environments.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
Strong ownership mindset and focus on delivering business value.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain automation solutions using UiPath.
Build and support workflows, orchestrations, queues, and reusable automation components.
Develop and maintain automation solutions using Microsoft Power Automate and integrate with Microsoft 365 services.
Analyze business requirements and create technical solution designs.
Perform unit testing, system integration testing, and user acceptance testing support.
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
Collaborate with business analysts, solution architects, and stakeholders throughout the automation lifecycle.
Implement exception handling, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization best practices.
Support deployment activities across Development, Test, and Production environments.
Maintain technical documentation, process design documents (PDDs), and solution design documents (SDDs).
Participate in code reviews and ensure compliance with development standards and governance requirements.

Description:
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced Technical Delivery Manager to lead the end-to-end delivery of complex Capital Markets technology programs across trading, post-trade, risk, treasury, and market infrastructure domains. The role requires a blend of strong delivery leadership, technical governance, client relationship management, and deep understanding of Capital Markets platforms and business processes.
The successful candidate will be responsible for driving large-scale transformation initiatives, managing distributed engineering teams, ensuring delivery excellence, and partnering with senior client stakeholders to deliver measurable business outcomes.
Position Details
Job Title: Technical Delivery Manager - Capital Markets
Experience: 12-18 Years
Key Responsibilities
Delivery Leadership Program Ownership
Own end-to-end delivery of Capital Markets technology programs across Front, Middle, and Back Office platforms.
Manage scope, schedule, budget, quality, risks, and dependencies to ensure predictable delivery outcomes.
Drive Agile/SAFe delivery, transformation initiatives, cloud modernization, commercial performance, vendor governance, and regulatory compliance.
Technical Governance Engineering Excellence
Provide technical oversight across architecture, solution design, and production readiness.
Drive adoption of modern engineering practices including CI/CD, DevOps, SRE, test automation, and cloud-native development.
Ensure engineering excellence through quality governance, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.
Client Stakeholder Management
Act as the primary delivery partner for client executives, business sponsors, and technology stakeholders.
Lead governance forums, executive reviews, and strategic planning discussions.
Ensure transparent communication, proactive risk management, and strong client satisfaction.
People Leadership
Lead and mentor high-performing, cross-functional delivery and engineering teams.
Drive talent development, succession planning, and employee engagement initiatives.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
AI Modern Engineering
Experience implementing AI-assisted software engineering practices.
Exposure to Agentic AI, SDLC Automation, Intelligent Testing, and Delivery Analytics.
Ability to leverage automation and AI solutions to improve productivity, quality, forecasting accuracy, and operational efficiency.
Required Qualifications
Bachelors Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent.
MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.
12+ years of IT experience with at least 5+ years in Delivery Leadership roles.
Proven experience managing large-scale Capital Markets programs involving 20+ resources and multi-million-dollar budgets.
Strong understanding of SDLC, architecture principles, cloud technologies, and engineering best practices.
Demonstrated success managing client-facing engagements and executive stakeholders.
Experience working with globally distributed teams across onshore, nearshore, and offshore models.

Description:
About the role
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to lead the development of a world-class franchise model. The ideal candidate will be responsible for generating leads, managing the sales funnel, onboarding new franchisees, and ensuring both the growth and retention of franchise stores. In this role, you will play a critical part in expanding our franchise network by onboarding 50 new stores per month and driving sustainable revenue growth across the franchise portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Franchise Acquisition & Expansion

• Strategic Acquisition Planning: Design and execute a comprehensive franchise acquisition strategy aligned with organizational growth targets.
• Pipeline Leadership: Oversee and optimize the full acquisition funnel, ensuring consistent inflow of high-quality prospects and timely conversions.
• Market Penetration: Identify high-potential markets and expansion zones, developing region-specific growth plans.
• Channel Diversification: Leverage digital, on-ground, partnerships, and referral ecosystems to expand franchise reach and strengthen lead quality.

Franchise Onboarding & Set-Up
• End-to-End Launch Ownership: Lead the onboarding and operational go-live of new franchise stores, ensuring all SOPs, processes, and compliance standards are met.
• Scale Management: Ensure successful onboarding of 50+ franchise stores per month, maintaining quality and standardization at scale.
• Capability Building: Establish robust training, enablement, and support frameworks to set new franchise partners up for long-term success.

Franchise Performance, Retention & Revenue Growth
• Portfolio Management: Oversee performance of the entire franchise portfolio, using data-driven insights to enhance store productivity and profitability.
• Retention & Engagement: Develop franchise retention programs, strengthen partner relationships, and proactively resolve operational challenges.
• Business Growth Initiatives: Drive revenue optimization initiatives, implement performance-improvement plans, and roll out business interventions to support consistent growth.
• Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to brand standards, operational guidelines, and customer experience expectations across all franchise stores.

Qualifications
• Experience: Minimum 5+ years in Business Development, Franchise Management, or Multi-Unit Operations within FMCG, retail, food, logistics, or telecom
• Skills: Strong leadership, stakeholder management, strategic planning, communication, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Description:
Key Accountabilities
Lead performance testing across the programme, aligned to the overall Non-Functional Test Approach.
Own the approach for load, stress, endurance, scalability, volume and capacity testing.
Define realistic workload models covering user volumes, transaction mix, concurrency, peak periods and batch processing.
Lead scripting, execution, monitoring, analysis and investigation across performance test cycles.
Identify performance bottlenecks across applications, APIs, integrations, databases and infrastructure, working with engineering teams to drive resolution.
Ensure performance environments, tooling, test data, monitoring and dependencies are ready for execution.
Own the Performance Test Report, providing clear assessment against NFRs and highlighting defects, constraints and residual risks.
Desirable Professional Qualifications
ISTQB Certified Tester Performance Testing (CT-PT) or equivalent.
Relevant LoadRunner, JMeter, k6/Grafana or performance engineering certification/training.
Microsoft Azure or equivalent cloud certification.
Relevant Guidewire Cloud / Guidewire platform training or experience.
Performance Test Expertise
Extensive experience in performance, load, stress, endurance and scalability testing for complex enterprise solutions.
Strong expertise in performance testing tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter or equivalent.
Strong knowledge of workload modelling, concurrency, throughput, response-time analysis and capacity modelling.
Proven experience diagnosing performance bottlenecks and scalability constraints across complex distributed systems.
Experience interpreting production volumes and usage patterns to develop realistic performance models.
Good understanding of capacity, scalability, resilience and cloud-performance engineering principles.
Leadership Experience
Performance Leadership: Proven experience leading performance testing and engineering within large transformation programmes.
Team Leadership: Strong collaboration, technical-direction and mentoring experience across performance engineering teams.
Cross-Team Delivery: Extensive experience working with engineering, architecture, infrastructure, database, cloud and supplier teams.
Technical Expertise
Strong understanding of web applications, APIs, microservices, databases, integrations and cloud-based architectures.
Experience using APM and observability tools to correlate application, infrastructure and database performance.
Strong diagnostic skills across CPU, memory, network, database, application runtime and cloud-resource utilisation.
Guidewire Experience: Guidewire Cloud performance-testing experience is highly desirable.
Communication Analytical Skills
Excellent communication skills to effectively communicate with stakeholders and articulate test reporting and risk.
Proven ability to communicate performance findings, defects and risks clearly.
Strong analytical capability to interpret complex performance results and identify root causes.
Ability to translate technical performance findings into service impact, risk and actionable recommendations.
Experience presenting performance evidence and recommendations to stakeholders.
Problem Solving
Diagnostic Analysis: Strong experience isolating performance bottlenecks across application, database, integration, network and infrastructure layers.
Root-Cause Investigation: Ability to correlate load-test results with APM, logs and infrastructure metrics.
Decision-Making: Demonstrable ability to recommend proportionate remediation and risk-treatment options under delivery pressure.
