Description:
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
- Own the technical data test approach, covering data migration, transformation, reconciliation and downstream data flows.
- Lead data testing across Data Migration, Policy Migration, Pricing, DataHub/InfoCenter, Cloud Data Access and SDP.
- Coordinate SQL/database-level validation/reconciliation, ETLs, interface/file validation and automated data comparison where appropriate.
- Own technical data risks, defects and exceptions, ensuring material discrepancies are quantified, resolved or formally accepted.
- Identifying environments, test data, resources, business SMEs and cross-workstream dependencies and related risks and mitigations.
- Provide consolidated technical data assurance to support migration readiness and go-live decisions.
DESIRABLE PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
- ISTQB Advanced Test Manager or relevant specialist testing certification.
- Project Test Delivery Management Certifications e.g. PRINCE2 Practitioner / APM / APMG.
- Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals or equivalent cloud-data qualification.
- Relevant SQL, database or data-engineering certification.
ORGANISATION LEVEL
- Workstream Leadership
- Client Confidential
ESSENTIAL SKILLS EXPERIENCE
Lead and own testing activities
- Data Test Leadership: Proven experience defining and implementing technical data test approaches for complex migration and transformation programmes.
- Data Test Planning: Experience of leading and coordinating data test cycles through programme milestones.
- Technical Data Testing: Extensive hands-on experience of complex data migration testing, ETL/ELT validation, SQL, source-to-target reconciliation and data-quality assurance.
Drive Testing Excellence
- Data Quality: Establish consistent validation across completeness, accuracy, integrity, consistency, uniqueness and referential integrity.
- Automation: Drive automated data comparison and reconciliation where this provides repeatability, scale and earlier feedback.
- Shift Left: Engage early with data mapping, transformation rules and migration design to identify defects before formal migration test cycles.
Assure test deliverables
- Test Deliverable Assurance: Assure data test plans, scenarios, reconciliation rules, scripts, expected results and evidence.
- Traceability: Ensure technical data requirements, mappings and key migration risks are traceable to appropriate validation.
- Reconciliation Assurance: Ensure appropriate record-level, aggregate and control-total reconciliation is performed and evidenced.
Support and Test Readiness
- Data Test Readiness: Ensure mappings, transformation rules, data requirements and acceptance criteria are sufficiently defined before execution.
- Environment Tooling: Ensure source/target environments, database access, reconciliation tooling and required test utilities are available.
- Test Data Readiness: Ensure representative datasets, expected results and baseline/reference data are available and controlled.
Collaborate and Communicate
- Stakeholder Collaboration: Excellent collaboration skills to work effectively with stakeholders, including product owners, scrum masters, and other leads.
- Clear Communication: Strong communication skills to articulate testing concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Team Coordination: Experience in coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure cohesive and aligned testing efforts.
Manage and report test metrics
- Data Test Report: Own the consolidated Technical Data Test Report, summarising coverage across source systems, reconciliation outcomes, exceptions, defects and residual data risks.
- Reconciliation: Track migrated, reconciled, rejected, failed and exception records, including reconciliation percentages and agreed tolerances.
- Data Quality: Report trends across completeness, accuracy, integrity, consistency and other applicable data-quality dimensions.
- Defect Risk Management: Lead management and escalation of data quality issues, migration defects, exceptions and residual risks.

Description:
Key Accountabilities
- Own the E2E Functional Test Approach and Plan, aligned to the Programme Test Strategy, business processes and programme roadmap.
- Lead the identification, design, prioritisation and execution of critical E2E business and customer journeys.
- Ensure traceability from business processes, requirements, features and risks to E2E scenarios, execution and evidence.
- Lead and coach the E2E test team, promoting consistent risk-based and shift-left testing practices.
- Coordinate environments, test data, resources, business SMEs and cross-workstream dependencies. Raise appropriate risks in a timely manner.
- Support capability improvements across automation, environments, data, tooling and test processes.
- Own the consolidated E2E Functional Test Report, providing an evidence-based view of quality, residual risk and readiness.
Desirable Professional Qualifications
- ISTQB Advanced Test Management/Test Analyst or equivalent.
- Guidewire PolicyCenter / BillingCenter / Guidewire Cloud experience or certification desirable.
- CII insurance qualification advantageous.
- Azure DevOps and Playwright experience advantageous.
Organisation Level
- Workstream Leadership
- Client Confidential
Essential Skills Experience
Test Expertise
- E2E Testing Expertise: Proven experience leading complex E2E functional testing spanning multiple systems, business processes/journeys and delivery teams.
- Insurance Knowledge: Strong understanding of policy, billing, payments, documents and downstream processes.
- Test Assurance: Ability to ensure coverage, traceability, evidence and defects collectively demonstrate that intended business outcomes have been achieved.
Leadership
- E2E Delivery Leadership: Proven experience leading E2E functional testing across multiple workstreams, systems and suppliers.
- Scope Management: Experience defining clear boundaries between Sprint testing, SIT, E2E testing and UAT.
- Team Leadership: Demonstrable experience directing, coaching and developing E2E testers.
Strategic Mindset
- Risk-Based Testing: Strong ability to prioritise journeys using business criticality, customer impact, complexity and change risk.
- Lifecycle Alignment: Experience using Sprint and SIT assurance to focus E2E testing on complete business outcomes.
- Regression Strategy: Experience designing maintainable, risk-based E2E regression coverage.
Communication Skills
- Communication and Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills to effectively communicate with stakeholders and articulate test approaches and risks.
- Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage business SMEs, Product Owners, Test Leads and delivery teams.
- Dependency Management: Coordinate cross-workstream dependencies, test data and readiness.
- Quality Reporting: Clearly communicate coverage, defects, risks and E2E readiness.
Forward-Thinking
- Problem Solving: Strong experience analysing complex cross-system test issues, coordinating resolution and making evidence-based decisions under pressure.
- Shift Left: Identify critical E2E journeys early in requirements and solution design.
- Automation: Identify stable, high-value journeys suitable for E2E automation.
- Continuous Improvement: Use test outcomes and defects to improve future E2E coverage.

Description:
Zensar Technologies Limited is seeking a seasoned Senior SAP Fiori Developer to join our dynamic team. In this role you will design, develop, and maintain high-quality SAP Fiori applications and ABAP components, collaborate with functional consultants, and ensure seamless integration with SAP back-end systems. You will play a key part in driving innovation, enhancing user experience, and supporting our clients digital transformation initiatives.
5-10 years of hands-on experience in ABAP development and SAP Fiori solution design.
Strong expertise in ABAP OO, BAPI, BADI, and enhancement frameworks.
Proficient in SAP UI5, Fiori elements, and SAP Web IDE (or Business Application Studio).
Experience building and customizing OData services for SAP back-end integration.
Solid understanding of UI/UX principles and responsive design for enterprise applications.
Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA or ECC environments.
Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines for SAP development.
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional agile team.
Develop and maintain ABAP programs, enhancement objects, BAPIs, BADIs, and custom reports.
Design, develop, and sustain SAP Fiori applications using SAP Web IDE and SAP Business Application Studio.
Create and consume OData services to enable Fiori UI interactions with SAP back-end data.
Implement UI/UX best practices, ensuring responsive and intuitive user interfaces.
Collaborate with functional consultants to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Perform code reviews, unit testing, and performance tuning of ABAP and Fiori components.
Document technical specifications, solution designs, and deployment procedures.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers.
Stay current with SAP roadmap, new Fiori features, and emerging UI technologies.
Support production issues and provide timely resolutions.

Description:
Zensar Technologies Limited is seeking a seasoned Business Analyst specialized in Enterprise Agreements (EA) to join our team. The role will focus on end-to-end Quote-to-Cash operations, Cisco Commerce Workspace (CCW) and reporting (CCWR) management, and ensuring seamless ordering and licensing compliance. You will work closely with sales, finance, and delivery teams to optimize processes, deliver actionable insights, and support system integrations.
7-8 years of experience as a Business Analyst in enterprise agreement or licensing domains.
Strong knowledge of Cisco Enterprise Agreements, CCW, and CCWR.
Hands-on experience with Quote-to-Cash cycles, order management, and billing systems.
Proficiency in requirement gathering, process mapping, and documentation (e.g., BPMN, UML).
Familiarity with ERP/CRM integration (SAP, Oracle, Salesforce) preferred.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business language.
Strong communication and presentation abilities.
Bachelor s degree in Business, IT, Engineering or related field; MBA a plus.
Certifications such as CBAP, PMP, or Cisco sales/partner certifications are advantageous.
Analyze and document enterprise agreement (EA) requirements and translate them into functional specifications.
Lead end-to-end Quote-to-Cash processes, ensuring accurate pricing, ordering, and contract fulfillment.
Manage CCW (Cisco Commerce Workspace) and CCWR (Cisco Commerce Workspace Reporting) configurations and data integrity.
Collaborate with sales, finance, and delivery teams to streamline order processing and billing cycles.
Conduct gap analysis and recommend process improvements for EA lifecycle management.
Prepare and present business cases, ROI analyses, and KPI dashboards to stakeholders.
Support system integrations between ERP, CRM, and Cisco commerce platforms.
Facilitate user acceptance testing (UAT) and provide training documentation.
Monitor compliance with licensing, renewal, and audit requirements.
Act as a liaison between technical teams and business units to resolve escalations.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary:
The Field Sales Executive plays a vital role in driving business expansion within the paint-chemical industry by cultivating strong, lasting relationships with key trade partners including painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. This position demands consistent performance, proactive engagement, and a hands-on approach to achieve and exceed sales targets. The ideal candidate will conduct daily site visits, maintain a strong presence at assigned retail outlets, organize shop meetings, and ensure accurate reporting all contributing to enhanced market penetration and brand visibility. With a focus on customer-centric strategies and performance excellence, this role is essential to sustaining growth and strengthening market position across the assigned territories.

Location : Jaipur City-Walled City, Ajmer

Responsibilities:
Achieve and exceed assigned sales targets consistently.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key stakeholders.
Conduct site visits per day to identify new opportunities and support customer needs.
Dedicate at least two hours daily to on-site presence at assigned retail stores to drive sales and customer engagement.
Organize and lead weekly shop meetings with applicators to promote product adoption and team alignment.
Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports through the designated online portal.


Requirements

Valid two-wheeler license is mandatory for field operations.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build relationships.
Self - motivated, disciplined, and highly driven by performance goals.
Minimum educational qualification: Graduation (preferred).
6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants).
Fresh graduates or professionals from insurance or banking sectors with demonstrated sales aptitude are encouraged to apply.
Benefits:
Net Take Home: 18k to 22k (Negotiable)
MWA: 4,000/-
Lucrative performance-based incentives
Absorption after 1 year based on performance
Travel allowance: 2,000 4,000 per month, depending on profile

Description:
Role & responsibilities

As a Venue Manager, you will drive sales and revenue across assigned venues while managing customer, owner, vendor and internal stakeholder relationships. The role combines inside sales, field engagement, venue operations and event execution.
1. Ensure all incoming customer leads are connected with through the calling app (average 80+ customer calls daily) and drive lead conversion, sales maximization, sales targets and profitability.
2. Revenue management ensure healthy revenue flow through customer and owner relationships and execution of marketing solutions launched from time to time.
3. Ensure target achievement through effective revenue generation and collection across assigned venues and products/packages.
4. Ensure smooth venue operations through effective stakeholder management, both internal and external.
5. Supervise and ensure smooth event execution to deliver an excellent customer experience.
6. Act as the signing authority for entering into customer contracts for sales bookings on behalf of the company.
7. Drive vendor optimization by identifying vendors, negotiating rates and signing/approving contracts in line with central-team guidance

Preferred candidate profile

1. At least 1 year of work experience in B2C / inside sales.
2. Prior experience in hotel, events or hospitality sectors is preferred, but not mandatory.
3. Fluency in English and the respective local language.
4. Willingness to travel to assigned venues; travel reimbursement will be applicable.
5. Own smartphone required (Android 7 or above with call-recording facility) to run the calling app; phone reimbursement applicable.
6. Own Windows 11 Pro laptop required; monthly device allowance will be provided.
7. Willingness to work 6 days a week, including weekends; weekly off will be on Monday.

Title: Technical Head
Skills: Grease and lubricant formulation development, Research & Development and product innovation, Production planning and execution, Laboratory testing and quality control, Raw material and additive selection, Process optimisation and troubleshooting, Quality assurance and root-cause analysis, Team management and cross-functional coordination
Description:
Job Description Technical Head
Company: OfBusiness
Department: Plant Operations / Technical / R&D

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Technical Plant Head to oversee production planning and execution, laboratory testing, quality assurance, and technical operations for grease and lubricant manufacturing. The role will primarily focus on R&D, formulation development, product improvement, and ensuring consistent product quality while coordinating production activities to achieve operational targets.

Key Responsibilities
1. Production Planning & Execution
Develop and manage production plans and schedules based on customer orders, inventory, and business requirements.
Ensure timely execution of production plans for grease and lubricant manufacturing.
Monitor production processes, batch execution, raw material consumption, and production yields.
Coordinate with procurement, stores, maintenance, and dispatch teams to ensure smooth plant operations.
Identify process improvements to enhance productivity, reduce wastage, and optimise manufacturing costs.

2. Research & Development (R&D) and Formulation
Lead R&D activities for the development of new grease and lubricant formulations.
Develop, modify, and optimise formulations based on customer requirements, performance specifications, and industry standards.
Work on base oils, thickeners, additives, and other raw materials used in grease and lubricant manufacturing.
Conduct formulation trials, pilot batches, and product performance evaluations before commercial production.
Support new product development, product customisation, and cost optimisation initiatives.
Troubleshoot formulation-related issues and improve product performance, stability, and consistency.

3. Laboratory Testing & Quality Control
Oversee laboratory testing of raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products.
Ensure products meet defined specifications and applicable industry standards.
Supervise testing of grease and lubricants, including viscosity, penetration, dropping point, consistency, and other relevant performance parameters, as applicable to the product portfolio.
Establish and maintain quality control procedures, testing protocols, and laboratory documentation.
Investigate quality deviations, customer complaints, and batch failures, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Ensure calibration and proper maintenance of laboratory instruments and testing equipment.

4. Quality Assurance & Process Improvement
Maintain consistent product quality across all production batches.
Develop and implement SOPs, quality standards, and process control procedures.
Ensure compliance with applicable safety, environmental, and quality requirements.
Conduct root-cause analysis for production and quality-related issues.
Work closely with production and R&D teams to ensure successful transfer of formulations from laboratory trials to commercial manufacturing.

5. Team Management & Cross-Functional Coordination
Lead and guide production, laboratory, quality, and technical teams.
Coordinate with management on production performance, product development, and quality improvement initiatives.
Maintain technical records, production reports, batch documentation, and formulation data.
Provide technical support to sales and customer-facing teams for product specifications and application-related queries.

Required Qualifications
B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Lubrication Technology, or an equivalent related field.
Relevant experience in grease and lubricant manufacturing, particularly in formulation development, R&D, production, and quality control.
Experience managing plant-level technical operations and production execution.

Key Skills
Grease and lubricant formulation development
Research & Development and product innovation
Production planning and execution
Laboratory testing and quality control
Raw material and additive selection
Process optimisation and troubleshooting
Quality assurance and root-cause analysis
Team management and cross-functional coordination

Preferred Industry Experience
Candidates from grease manufacturing, industrial lubricants, automotive lubricants, speciality lubricants, or related chemical manufacturing industries will be preferred.

Ideal Candidate Profile: A technically strong professional who can independently manage plant-level production and quality activities, with a primary focus on R&D, formulation development, laboratory testing, and successful commercialisation of grease and lubricant products.

Description:
Ensure staff is working together as a team to ensure optimum service and that guest needs are met. Inspect grooming and attire of staff, and rectify any deficiencies. Complete opening and closing duties including setting up necessary supplies and tools, cleaning all equipment and areas, locking doors, etc. Inspect storage areas for organization, use of FIFO, and cleanliness. Complete scheduled inventories and stock and requisition necessary supplies.

Monitor dining rooms for seating availability, service, safety, and well being of guests. Complete work orders for maintece repairs.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; and serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language.

Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; and identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Job Summary
Function SummaryRelationship Associate plays a pivotal role in driving business growth by managing branch relationships and collaborating with Axis Bank sellers. The role involves lead conversion, ensuring process adherence, and supporting operational excellence. The incumbent will be responsible for meeting business targets and maintaining customer satisfaction. This position requires consistent coordination with stakeholders and adherence to company guidelines.
Job SummaryManages branches, collaborates with the objective to support and contribute to Axis bank strategy, achieve operations excellence, ensure systems are deployed and help build the channel WITHIN the company guidelines and the achieve business targets.


Key Responsibilities
Managing relationship with Axis Branch Sellers and thereby meeting target through Bank s FOS
Responsible for managing the leads generated from Branch and thereby convert into quality business.
Must adhere to the process set and timely coordinate with Cluster Manager and Operations HUB. Ensuring minimal customer complain.
Shall adhere to agree TATs on first customer contact and follow-ups from the date of the lead being registered.
Ensuring 15month persistency on track and thereby ensure a robust follow up mechanism with the customers.
Coordinating with Cluster Training manager to ensure bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.
Shall be responsible for making active the branch banking sellers and thereby achieving the activation target
Ensuring LMS usage as Tracking Mechanism on line and follow up Calls


Key Competencies / Skills
Excellent Relationship Skill, Managing Various level of Bank Management , Adherence to Process


Qualifications / Experience
Graduate in Any Discipline from a UGC / AICTE approved College and University.
1 to 2 years of experience in sales, experience in Insurance will be preferred.
Experience in the fields of Life insurance sales management, Retail bank distribution, and Channel Management and/or DSA relationship

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

BRD, FRD, User Stories, Use Cases
Agile/Scrum Methodology
Process Mapping & Gap Analysis
Stakeholder Management
SQL and Data Analysis
JIRA, Confluence, Visio

Network Inventory Management
Service Fulfillment & Provisioning
Fault Management
Performance Management
Service Assurance
OSS/BSS Integration
TM Forum Standards & Open APIs
4G/5G, Fiber, or Broadband Network Operations
Qualification
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or related field with experience in Telecom OSS projects and business analysis.

We are seeking experienced Workday Functional & Technical Consultants who can support end-to-end Workday implementations, enhancements, integrations, and production support activities. The role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, configuring Workday solutions, developing integrations, creating reports, managing security, and supporting global Workday transformation initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Functional Responsibilities
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements.
Configure and support Workday modules including:
Core HCM, Recruiting, Talent & Performance, Compensation, Absence Management, Benefits, Payroll, Learning, Time Tracking
Conduct client workshops and requirement discovery sessions.
Configure business processes, approval workflows, and security.
Prepare Functional Design Documents (FDDs).
Support SIT, UAT, deployment, and post-production activities.
Drive Workday release management and continuous improvements.

Workday Studio, EIB (Enterprise Interface Builder), Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, Workday Web Services (SOAP/REST), Document Transformation
Create and maintain: Advanced Reports, Matrix Reports, Composite Reports, Composite Reports, Dashboards
Configure and administer Workday Security Framework.
Troubleshoot integration and production support issues.
Support data migration, data conversion, and testing activities.
Integrate Workday with third-party applications such as Payroll, ERP, CRM, and Identity Management systems.
Functional Skills
Strong experience in Workday HCM modules.
Expertise in business process configuration.
Requirement gathering and stakeholder management experience.
Knowledge of Workday security and organizational structures.
End-to-end implementation and support experience.
Technical Skills
Hands-on experience with Workday Studio, EIB, and Core Connectors.
Strong knowledge of XML, XSLT, SOAP, REST APIs, and Web Services.
Experience in Workday Reporting and Security.
Experience working with integrations and data transformation.
Preferred Qualifications
Workday Functional and/or Integration Certification.
Experience in global implementation projects.
Exposure to Workday Extend and Prism Analytics.
Experience working in Agile/SAFe environments.
Strong client-facing consulting and communication skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Willingness to work across multiple Workday modules and technologies.

Experience integrating Amazon Connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk, or Microsoft Dynamics.
Proficiency in REST APIs, web services, and cloud integrations.
Understanding of contact center reporting, analytics, and monitoring solutions.
AWS certifications are desirable.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Minimum 4+ years of experience implementing and managing IAM solutions.
2. Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting the Saviynt Enterprise Identity Cloud (EIC) platform in enterprise environments.
3. Design, configure, and deploy Saviynt EIC solutions tailored to client-specific identity governance and compliance requirements.
4. Experience onboarding applications using Saviynt's out-of-the-box connectors, including Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD, Workday, Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, and Oracle DB.
5. Experience with REST APIs, SCIM, and JIT provisioning for real-time identity orchestration.
6. Hands-on scripting using Groovy, JavaScript, and SQL within Saviynt.
7. Knowledge of Saviynt's Risk-Based Access, Segregation of Duties (SoD) policies, and Compliance Campaigns.
8. Understanding of Saviynt's Delegation Framework, Workflow Engine, and Custom Attributes Mapping.
9. Experience integrating Saviynt with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow and cloud platforms including Azure, AWS, and GCP.
10. Saviynt Certified Professional (SCP) or Saviynt Certified Advanced Professional (SCAP) certification is highly desirable.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Ecommerce Developer (Magento 2) to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people.
You will be responsible in developing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing our eCommerce platform based on Magento 2 on hyper scaler cloud environment including underlying components.
You will identify new and exciting functionalities and develop new modules.
If you are the person who can design and develop web / mobile platforms securely at an unbelievable pace, we would like to meet you.
To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a self-starter, top-notch communicator and passionate hands-on programmer.
Responsibilities
Optimize existing Magento 2 installation
Provide regular and emergency support for break-fixes
Troubleshoot integration and performance issues
Design interfaces, themes, templates while following best practices and maintain world-class coding styles and standard
Anticipate the performance requirements and communicate with management on remediation plans to CTO/CIO
Develop new Magento modules and functionalities
Manage and upgrade Magento add-ons and conduct code reviews/scans
Establish DevOps pipelines, Release/Change management procedures, etc.
Develop testing scenarios including unit testing, integration testing and automate those
Work with UI/UX and graphic designers to implement front-end changes
Work with content writer to implement new contents
Implement additional components such as Elastic Search, Varnish, Redis, CDN, RabbitMQ, etc.
Manage SSL certificates, software accounts, keys, etc.
Rearchitect environment and provide vertical and horizontal scaling as demand grows
Fine-tune batch jobs (Crons) or Consumers
Migrate databases and data
Develop integrations for files, images, etc.
Manage stack components and upgrade them (Ubuntu, PHP, Percona, Nginx, Composer, Firewall, Redis, etc.)
Create plans for developing mobile experience, mobile apps or PWA front end environment
Maintain confidentiality about IP, methods, processes and data
Participate in conferences, webinars and provide presentations while socializing and partnering with startups
Install security patches and monitor web traffic
brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Strong experience with Magento 2 development and debugging
Strong experience with high-performance technologies such as Nginx, Varnish, Redis, ElasticSearch
JavaScript and AJAX experience for Front-end
Extensive HTML5, LESS and CSS knowledge
Understanding of modern UI/UX trends
Experience or knowledge of React.js, Vue.js and Node.js
Experience with AWS components such as VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, WAF Cloud Formation
Linux or Ubuntu server operations working and know-hows
Experience in working with MySQL databases like MariaDB and Percona
Basic understanding of networking and ports
Experience with Google Tag Manager, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC, Facebook Pixels. A/B Testing
Strong attention to details about design styles to improve look and feel
Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks
Ability to work in a professional capacity and team environment is must
Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
Magento 2 Certification is required
Cloud Computing Certification (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and delivering digital marketing programs to kickstart the sale of our products and drive the rapid expansion and growth in the market. You will identify new and exciting opportunities and establish brand awareness. If you are the person who can execute the ambitious goals at one-third resources than the normal, we would like to meet you. To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a creative, self-starter, top-notch communicator, and passionate marketer.
Responsibilities
Comprehend categories, products, customers and business goals
Know the persona of customers and understand their needs
Research products and competitors to identify opportunities
Establish a digital marketing strategy across various engagement channels both online and offline and develop a marketing calendar
Identify syndication schedules for editorial calendars for blogs, content, and social media posts
Develop effective paid search strategies to gain market share
Plan, design, launch and optimize various PPC campaigns
Perform keyword research and audience targeting in support with management
Work with web developers and designers to manage integrations and tooling for PPC, social media, etc.
Monitor advertisement budgets and oversee search platform accounts
Track KPIs, analyze web traffic metrics, and provide recommendations and useful reports for management
Maintain partnerships with PPC ad platforms and vendors
Identify click frauds and eliminate it
Ensure the highest possible ROI on ad-spend
Perform ongoing keyword discovery, expansion, and optimization
Research and implement search engine optimization recommendations
Research and analyze competitor advertising links
Develop and implement link building strategy
Recommend changes to website architecture, content, linking, and other factors to improve SEO positions for target keywords
Build a social media strategy through the audience identification, competitive research, benchmarking and messaging including platform strategy
Setup, Review, and Optimize company pages on social media platforms
Establish metrics and goals on customer engagement and intimacy on social media to boost website traffic and gain revenue
Engage with the customer on behalf of the brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Proven SEM experience with PPC campaign management across multiple web and social channels
In-depth experience with website analytics tools such as Google Analytics
Solid understanding of performance marketing, conversion, and online customer acquisition
Expertise in keyword research, data analysis and reporting
Knowledge of ranking factors and search engine algorithms
Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in SEO and SEM
Strong business acumen and expert communicator
Experience with A/B and multivariate experiments
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, XML, JavaScript, and web development and industry-leading commerce tools
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Marketing, Quantitative, Media or a related field
Google Adwords Certification
Google Analytics and other SEO training are welcome

Description:
Network Engineer

Experience : 5 to 10 years
Location : Bangalore

We are seeking a highly skilled Network Engineer with deep expertise in Routers, Switches, Wireless Access Points, Wireless Controllers, and Firewalls to design, implement, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure. This role is responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, and security of the organizations network fabric across LAN, WAN, wireless, and perimeter security domains, supporting business continuity and enabling seamless connectivity.
Responsibilities

Router Administration & WAN Management
Design, deploy, and manage enterprise routers (Cisco, Juniper, or equivalent) across LAN, WAN, and SD-WAN environments
Configure and maintain dynamic routing protocols including OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP for optimal path selection and redundancy
Manage WAN connectivity including MPLS, leased lines, broadband, and SD-WAN overlays
Implement and maintain QoS policies to prioritize business-critical traffic across WAN links
Perform router hardening, IOS/firmware upgrades, and lifecycle management
Troubleshoot routing issues, packet loss, and latency affecting network performance and application availability
Switch Administration & LAN Management
Deploy, configure, and administer enterprise-grade switches (Cisco Catalyst, Nexus, or equivalent) in access, distribution, and core layers
Design and manage VLAN architecture, trunking (802.1Q), and inter-VLAN routing to support network segmentation
Configure and maintain spanning tree protocols (STP, RSTP, MSTP) to prevent loops and ensure redundancy
Implement link aggregation (LACP/PAGP), port security, and storm control across the switching infrastructure
Perform switch stack management, firmware upgrades, and hardware lifecycle activities
Monitor switch performance, port utilization, and MAC address tables to proactively identify and resolve issues
Wireless Access Point Deployment & Management
Deploy, configure, and manage enterprise Wireless Access Points (Cisco, Aruba, Meraki, or equivalent) across campus, branch, and remote sites
Perform RF site surveys, channel planning, and transmit power optimization to ensure seamless wireless coverage
Configure SSIDs, band steering, roaming policies (802.11r/k/v), and QoS for wireless clients
Monitor AP health, client association metrics, and interference sources to maintain optimal wireless performance
Perform firmware upgrades, configuration audits, and hardware replacement for access point lifecycle management
Support high-density wireless deployments for conference rooms, auditoriums, and open-plan office environments
Wireless Controller Administration
Administer and manage centralized Wireless LAN Controllers (WLC) and cloud-managed wireless platforms (Cisco WLC, Aruba Mobility Controller, or equivalent)
Configure and maintain controller-based policies for mobility, roaming, load balancing, and client exclusion
Manage WLAN profiles, RF groups, mobility groups, and guest access portals across controller clusters
Implement and maintain wireless security policies including WPA3, 802.1X/EAP, certificate-based authentication, and NAC integration
Perform controller software upgrades, redundancy failover testing, and disaster recovery validation
Integrate wireless controllers with AAA platforms (RADIUS/TACACS+) and network management systems for centralized visibility
Firewall & Perimeter Security Administration
Design, implement, and manage enterprise firewalls (Cisco ASA/FTD, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, or equivalent) for perimeter and internal segmentation
Create and maintain firewall rule sets, security zones, NAT policies, and application-layer inspection policies
Manage VPN configurations including site-to-site IPSec VPN and remote access VPN (SSL/TLS) for secure connectivity
Implement and maintain Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) policies, URL filtering, and threat intelligence feeds
Conduct periodic firewall rule base reviews, policy optimization, and compliance audits
Respond to security events flagged by firewall logs, and coordinate with the SOC team for threat investigation and remediation

Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field preferred
Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in enterprise network administration and engineering
Strong proficiency in routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP) and switching technologies (VLANs, STP, LACP)
Proven experience with enterprise wireless platforms (Cisco, Aruba, or Meraki) including controller and AP management
Hands-on expertise with enterprise firewall platforms (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco FTD, or Check Point)
Experience with network security standards including 802.1X, WPA3, IPSec VPN, and SSL/TLS VPN
Familiarity with network automation tools and scripting (Python, Ansible, Netmiko, or NAPALM)
Strong working knowledge of ITIL principles and ITSM practices
Industry certifications preferred: CCNA / CCNP, PCNSE, NSE 4+, Aruba ACMP, or equivalent
Current understanding of industry trends including SD-WAN, SASE, Zero Trust Networking, and cloud networking
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with strong attention to detail
Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills with ability to work under pressure during critical incidents
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams

Description:
AI Agent Developer- Senior Associate

As an AI Agent Developer you will design and develop AI-enabled solutions within our Data and Analytics Engineering practice, turning raw data into insights that support client decision-making and business growth. As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex problems, manage assigned workstreams, build meaningful client connections, and guide junior team members while navigating ambiguity and maintaining professional and technical standards. In this role at PwC, you will use advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and data visualization methods to support AI-driven automation, explore new ideas, and deliver work that aligns with broader project objectives.
Responsibilities
- Develop and optimize AI agents using Python, integrating with OpenAI API, Claude, and Azure AI Foundry for advanced natural language processing capabilities.
- Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and Prompt Engineering techniques to improve agent accuracy and contextual understanding.
- Build scalable multi-agent systems using Multi-Agent Frameworks, LangGraph, LangChain, and AutoGen for orchestrating complex AI workflows and interactions.
- Develop and maintain REST APIs to expose agent functionalities, ensuring seamless integration with cloud platforms and external systems.
- Implement observability and monitoring solutions to track agent performance, system health, and facilitate debugging across cloud environments.
-Manage data storage and querying with SQL databases, harnessing Agent Core and Github for version control and collaboration in building AI Code Assistants.
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's & Master's Degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
Expert in developing and optimizing AI agents using Python, seamlessly integrating with cutting-edge APIs like OpenAI, Claude, and Azure AI Foundry to deliver advanced NLP solutions.
- Proven ability to design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and apply sophisticated Prompt Engineering techniques that significantly enhance agent accuracy and contextual relevance.
- Skilled in building scalable, collaborative AI ecosystems using Multi-Agent Frameworks, LangGraph, LangChain, and AutoGen to orchestrate complex, multi-agent workflows efficiently.
- Experienced in developing and maintaining robust REST APIs that enable smooth integration of AI agents with diverse cloud platforms and third-party systems.
- Strong background in implementing comprehensive observability and monitoring frameworks to ensure high performance, reliability, and maintainability of AI systems in cloud environments.
- Proficient in managing data with SQL databases and leveraging tools like Agent Core and GitHub for version control, collaboration, and accelerating the development of AI Code Assistants.

Job Description Manager Forward Deployment Engineer (DevOps, AI Deployment)AI Deployment & DevOps Engineering | Forward Deployed EngineeringJob SummaryAn engineering leader who owns how AI solutions are deployed into enterprise environments across a set of accounts. You will own delivery, standards, and the customer relationship, and set the direction for building, securing, and operating AI applications in production on AWS.Key Responsibilities
Own the delivery of AI deployment work across your accounts, including scope, quality, timelines, and standards.
Set direction and standards for CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, cloud architecture, security, and MLOps/LLMOps.
Lead the responsible integration of AI solutions into legacy and regulated enterprise environments at scale.
Act as senior escalation and decision-maker on complex or high-stakes deployments.
Build reusable accelerators and patterns that raise deployment quality across the practice.
Build, lead, and grow the team through hiring, coaching, and development.
Own senior customer relationships and communicate progress, risks, and value.
Surface delivery friction and product gaps to leadership as structured field intelligence.
Required Qualifications
Extensive DevOps or platform engineering experience, including leading teams and owning delivery at scale.
Current depth in AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code.
Proven enterprise integration experience with security, identity, and governance constraints.
Proven ownership of delivery outcomes and senior customer relationships.
A clear strategy for productionising AI at scale (LLMOps/MLOps), including responsible AI, backed by delivery experience.
Strong leadership and communication skills; decisive under pressure.
Preferred Qualifications
AWS enterprise-scale architecture experience.
Enterprise AI and data platforms (Palantir Foundry, Databricks, Snowflake).
A background in consulting or managed services.
Experience in regulated industries.
A leadership or delivery certification (e.g., PMP, SAFe).
AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional.
Technical Skills & Tools
Cloud & platform: AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, EKS, Lambda, IAM), Kubernetes
Delivery & IaC: CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD), Terraform
AI productionisation: LLMOps / MLOps, model serving, evaluation, responsible AI, governance
Security & compliance: IAM, secrets management, network security, data governance
Good to have: Enterprise AI and data platforms (Palantir Foundry, Databricks, Snowflake), MLflow
Soft Skills & Competencies
Leadership of both a team and a customer relationship.
Stakeholder and customer management.
Decisive under pressure.
Coaching and people development.

Working hours: Overlap with client business hours (including US / EST), with occasional deployment support.Role & responsibilities

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Maximo Developer - Senior Associate, you will engage in business application consulting within our Technology Consulting network, focusing on Maximo Consulting. You will work directly with clients to modernize field service and operations, leveraging your skills to deliver impactful solutions. As a Senior Associate, you will navigate complex situations, build meaningful client relationships, and mentor junior team members. You will utilize your problem-solving skills and critical thinking to analyze complex concepts and anticipate client needs, contributing to the delivery of quality work.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of a dynamic team within our Technology Consulting practice. You will have the opportunity to grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills while managing and inspiring others. Embracing ambiguity, you will use these moments as opportunities to develop self-awareness and enhance your strengths. Your work will fit into the broader objectives of the firm, and you will uphold professional standards, guiding and mentoring others to deliver value to our clients.
Responsibilities
- Developing and implementing Maximo solutions to enhance asset management capabilities
- Integrating Maximo with other enterprise systems to streamline operations and data flow
- Collaborating with clients to understand their business needs and tailor Maximo functionalities accordingly
- Utilizing analytical thinking to troubleshoot and resolve Maximo-related issues efficiently
- Leading the design and architecture of Maximo applications to support field service and operations modernization
- Applying knowledge of middleware architecture to facilitate seamless application integrations
- Supporting the deployment of emerging technologies within Maximo environments to drive innovation
- Managing project timelines and deliverables to align with client expectations and industry standards
- Providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members in Maximo development and integration
- Engaging with stakeholders to gather feedback and continuously improve Maximo solutions
What You Must Have
- App Designer and DB Config: design and implement UI changes, custom Maximo applications, and schema extensions including custom objects and relationships
- At least 5 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
Strong hands-on expertise in IBM Maximo 7.6.x and IBM MAS Manage (8.x / 9.x) across multiple functional modules
– Advanced Automation Script development: complex multi-object scripts, launch-in-context extensions, custom MBO validation, integration event framework, and field-level scripting in JavaScript (Rhino) and Jython
– Deep Integration Framework expertise: design of object structures, bidirectional ERP/GIS/SCADA integration, error handling, JMS queue management, and enterprise messaging patterns
What Sets You Apart
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Master's degree preferred)
- Developing solutions using IBM Maximo Asset Management
- Integrating Maximo with enterprise systems for seamless operations
- Navigating complex middleware architecture for application integrations
- Embracing emerging technologies in energy and utilities sectors
- Managing field service mobility projects with FSM expertise
- Excelling in analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

Job SummaryA senior, customer-facing SRE who owns the reliability of a client's production systems end to end. Embedded as the main technical point of contact, you will design reliable infrastructure, lead incidents, apply AI-assisted operations, and mentor the team.Key Responsibilities
Own the reliability of production systems for one or more enterprise customers on AWS.
Define and manage SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, and ensure monitoring provides meaningful insight.
Lead the response to serious (P0/P1) incidents and run blameless post-mortems that lead to fixes.
Lead within the on-call rotation.
Operate and optimise Kubernetes clusters and AWS services as workloads grow.

Strong automation skills (Python, Go, or Bash).
Hands-on understanding of AI-assisted operations, including introducing AI SRE tooling with sensible guardrails.

Preferred Qualifications
Owning CI/CD pipelines and release automation.
Writing and maintaining Terraform modules.
GitOps workflows and Helm.
Designing telemetry collection across services.
Incident-management tooling such as PagerDuty.
Hands-on experience integrating AIOps or AI SRE tooling into production operations.

Experience delivering AI-based work or AI/ML-driven initiatives in production.
AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional.
Technical Skills & Tools
Cloud (AWS): EC2, EKS, ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, ELB/ALB, Route 53

AI-assisted operations: AI SRE tooling, AIOps, anomaly detection, automated RCA
DevOps (good to have): CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), Terraform modules, GitOps (ArgoCD), Helm

Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva and blackline End to end implementation
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.
Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization Workiva Implementation,Blackline Implementation.
Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Description:
SAP MDG Consultant

Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)

Experience:
JL4: 2-5 Years
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years


About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.

Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.

SAP MDG

Master Data Management Processes
SAP Migration Cockpit
SAP Cloud Integration
SAP Fiori for MDG
SAP BTP Exposure
Data Migration Projects
Data Warehousing Concepts
Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)

Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP MDG Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience
Generic Data Analyst or Data Steward profiles without SAP MDG experience

Description:
Meet the Team
The Silicon One ASIC delivers the silicon, optics, and hardware platforms for Cisco's core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products. With ~2,100 employees across 16 countries, we design the networking hardware for Enterprises and Service Providers of various sizes, the Public Sector, and Non-Profit Organizations across the world. Come join us and take part in shaping Cisco's ground-breaking solutions by designing, developing and testing some of the most complex ASICs being developed in the industry.
You will be in the Silicon One development organization as an ASIC Implementation Technical Lead in Bangalore India with a primary focus on Design-for-Test. You will work with Front-end RTL teams, backend physical design teams to understand chip architecture and drive DFT requirements early in the design cycle. As a member of this team you will also be involved in crafting groundbreaking next generation networking chips. You will help lead to drive the DFT and quality process through the entire Implementation flow and post silicon validation phases with additional exposure to physical design signoff activities.


Your Impact
Responsible for implementing the Hardware Design-for-Test (DFT) features that support ATE, in-system test, debug and diagnostics needs of the designs.
Responsible for development of innovative DFT IP in collaboration with the multi-functional teams, and play a key role in full chip design integration with the testability features coordinated in the RTL.
Work closely with the design/design-verification and PD teams to enable the integration and validation of the Test logic in all phases of the implementation and post silicon validation flows.
Your team will participate in the creation of Innovative Hardware DFT physical design aspects for new silicon device models, bare die stacked die, driving re-usable test and debug strategies.
The job requires the candidate to have the ability to craft solutions and debug with minimal mentorship.


Minimum Qualifications
Bachelors or a Master s Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering required with at least 10 years of experience.
Knowledge of the latest innovative trends in DFT, test and silicon engineering.
Experience with Jtag protocols, Scan and BIST architectures, including memory BIST and boundary scan.
Experience with ATPG and EDA tools like TestMax, Tetramax, Tessent tool sets, PrimeTime
Verification skills include, System Verilog Logic Equivalency checking and validating the Test-timing of the design
Experience working with Gate level simulation, debugging with VCS and other simulators.
Post-silicon validation and debug experience; Ability to work with ATE patterns, P1687
Strong verbal skills and ability to thrive in a multifaceted environment
Scripting skills: Tcl, Python/Perl.


Preferred Qualifications
Verilog design experience - developing custom DFT logic IP integration; familiarity with functional verification
DFT CAD development - Test Architecture, Methodology and Infrastructure

As an AES Guidewire ClaimCenter Business Analyst Senior Associate you will help shape and support Guidewire ClaimCenter work within our Advisory practice, focusing on business analysis, client support, and the delivery of enhancements that improve insurance operations and user experience. As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex problems, manage assigned workstreams, build meaningful client relationships, mentor junior team members, and apply critical thinking to navigate ambiguity while strengthening your personal brand and technical skills. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will contribute to Application Evolution Services for Guidewire by gathering requirements, interpreting feedback, evaluating process impacts, and supporting solution development for deployed ClaimCenter environments.
Responsibilities
Demonstrates expert abilities managing ITIL Processes; Tracking SLAs, and contracting;
- Demonstrates advanced abilities providing solution strategy and Application Evolution Services (AES, formerly AMS) delivery as a Guidewire Functional Lead. Employees in the Functional Lead position should think of themselves and be regarded by the client as a trusted advisor and think strategically about how to create value using the Guidewire Suite of products;
- Demonstrates expert abilities with ITIL Incident and Problem management for the Guidewire Suite of applications as it will be critical that Senior Business Analyst in this position are capable of navigating both business processes as well as enterprise solution perspectives at high level and holistic view;
- Demonstrates expert abilities and/or a proven record of success in leading proposal development efforts; Senior Business Analyst in these positions should be capable of delivering Advisory-level work and be able to discuss future enhancements in Guidewire roadmap discussions with the client;
- With a focus on AES, demonstrates expert organization skills and abilities assisting clients in the support of Guidewire Suite solutions and improving business processes; and taking a proactive approach to quality;
- Analyzing Guidewire ClaimCenter business needs and translating them into functional requirements for insurance operations
- Supporting client service workstreams across enhancements, defect resolution, and production support for deployed Guidewire solutions
- Configuring and validating Guidewire ClaimCenter functionality while coordinating with technical teams on integrations and system changes
- Reviewing user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria to clarify scope and identify implementation impacts
- Interpreting business feedback and data points to recommend process improvements and application adjustments
- Mentoring junior team members on Guidewire concepts, delivery methods, and issue resolution approaches
- Collaborating across application, testing, and support teams to track work progress and address dependencies
- Applying problem-solving skills to diagnose system issues, evaluate options, and support timely resolution of incidents and enhancements
- Contributing to continuous improvement efforts by identifying automation, tooling, and process opportunities within application support
What You Must Have
- Expertise in ClaimCenter and working knowledge on Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ContactManager - leading requirement gathering sessions, conduct analysis, develop functional specifications and perform business walkthroughs;
- User story creation/updation, developing process flows, UI mock ups, and developing data mapping in the standard Guidewire recommended user stories;
- Familiarity with Use case, SWOT analysis, Mindmapping, PESTLE analysis; Product Designer
- Usage of Tools JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, Splunk and familiarity with SQL
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4-9 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

Description:
Position: Senior Engineer Advanced Flight Management System (FMS) Aerospace
Role Summary:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Advanced Flight Management System (FMS) team. The ideal candidate will have strong avionics software development experience, mandatory hands-on experience in Flight Management Systems, and expertise in developing safety-critical software in a DevOps environment. The role requires ownership of product quality, collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, and a mindset focused on delivering optimized and efficient solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
- DO178 Level A verification experience
- Very good knowledge on C++.
- Display products experience will be plus
- Design, develop, integrate, and verify safety-critical FMS software.
- Work in a DevOps environment, contributing to CI/CD and continuous improvement.
- Own product quality and ensure compliance with DO-178B/C standards.
- Collaborate with Systems, Certification, and other cross-functional teams.
- Works on software design, coding, integration, and verification
- Drive software optimization, automation, and engineering best practices.
- Mentor team members and contribute to technical excellence.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor s or master s degree in aerospace, Electronics, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline.
- 3 to 10 years of experience in avionics software development.
- Mandatory experience in Flight Management System (FMS) software development. User Interface skills are recommended
- Strong knowledge of DO-178B/C and software design, development, integration, and verification.
- Experience working in a DevOps environment with CI/CD practices.
- Strong programming skills in C/C++, scripting languages, and embedded real-time software development.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Desired Competencies:
- Strong ownership and accountability for product quality.
- Ability to identify and implement optimized, scalable, and efficient solutions.
- Self-driven team player with a passion for developing high-quality, safety-critical avionics software.

Description:
Position: PLM Support Engineer
Experience: 3 to 8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai / Hyderabad (or as applicable)
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. The role involves troubleshooting workflows, CAD integrations, BOM management, release processes, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support.
Key Responsibilities
Production Support & Incident Management
Provide L2/L3 production support for PLM applications including Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam across production and non-production environments.
Act as the primary point of contact for business users for PLM operational, application, and workflow-related issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests within agreed SLA timelines.
Perform impact analysis and prioritize tickets based on business criticality.
PLM Functional Support
Support Engineering Change Management (ECM/ECR/ECO) processes and workflows.
Manage and troubleshoot complex BOM (Bill of Material) structures and product data issues.
Support product release processes, document lifecycle management, and workflow execution activities.
Assist users with process adherence, workflow execution, and system functionality.
CAD & Integration Support
Provide support for CAD integrations with Siemens NX, CATIA, and related engineering applications.
Troubleshoot CAD data loading, synchronization issues, and integration failures.
Investigate dataset validation failures, translator issues, and CAD file management problems.
Workflow & System Administration Support
Troubleshoot workflow integration issues, dispatcher failures, workflow processing delays, and PDF generation errors.
Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents.
Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Generate and publish support metrics, incident reports, ticket trend analysis, and SLA compliance reports.
Provide regular status updates to management and key stakeholders.
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and global support teams for issue resolution and deployments.
Participate in release validation, patch deployment, and post-deployment support activities.
Required Technical Skills
PLM Technologies
Strong experience in at least one or more PLM applications:
Teamcenter
Aras Innovator
SmarTeam
Functional Knowledge
Engineering Change Management (ECR/ECO/ECN)
Product Structure Management
BOM Management
Workflow Management
Release Management
Document Management
CAD Integration
Siemens NX
CATIA
CAD Data Management
Technical Skills
SQL Queries and Database Fundamentals
PLM Data Model Understanding
Workflow Configuration and Troubleshooting
Dispatcher Monitoring
PDF Generation Processes
Job Server and Vault Management
Application Log Analysis
Support Tools
ServiceNow / Jira / Remedy
Incident & Change Management Tools
Monitoring and Reporting Tools
Desired Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
3 to 8 years of experience in PLM application support.
Experience in global production support environments.
Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices.
ITIL certification is preferred.
Required Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work with global and cross-functional teams.
Customer-focused approach with strong ownership mindset.
Ability to work in rotational shifts and provide production support when required.
Strong documentation and reporting skills.
Preferred Skills
Teamcenter BMIDE knowledge.
Teamcenter Active Workspace exposure.
Aras administration/support experience.
Understanding of manufacturing and engineering business processes.
Exposure to deployment and release management activities.
Experience in performance tuning and application monitoring.

Description:
Role: Workday Recruiting Consultant
Exp: 2 to 10 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM, Recruiting certification.
Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up Questionnaires, Job requisitions, Evergreen Requisitions.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring Job Posting Templates, Career Sites, Job Applications Business Process while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on configuring Referrals, Prospects, Candidates.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Compensation, Absence, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Recruiting.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Recruiting areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Advanced Compensation, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.
AboutCompany:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
