Description:
Role / Job Title- Manager - Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant
Experience - 8 - 14 years

Key Skills -Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll, US Payroll, Payroll Configuration, Elements, Calculation Cards, Balances, Fast Formulas, Payroll Flows, Retro Processing and Costing
Location - Bangalore/Hyderabad/ Pune /Gurugram

Role & responsibilities

8 - 14 years of experience in Oracle HCM applications, with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll.
Must have worked on at least two end-to-end Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations, with strong Oracle US Payroll experience; Canada Payroll experience is a plus.
In-depth hands-on configuration across Legislative Data Groups, payroll definitions and calendars, Payroll Statutory Units / Tax Reporting Units, elements, input values, element eligibility, calculation cards, balances, payment methods and payroll costing.
Strong knowledge of QuickPay, payroll flows, retroactive processing, proration, balance adjustments, costing and payment processing.
Hands-on expertise in Payroll Fast Formulas and troubleshooting complex payroll calculation and configuration issues.
Strong understanding of US payroll processing, including federal, state and local taxation, quarter-end / year-end activities and legislative updates.
Experience with HDL / payroll data conversion, payroll extracts and reporting, with the ability to collaborate with technical teams on integrations and extensions.
Ability to perform fit-gap analysis, translate business requirements into scalable configuration, and lead unit testing, UAT / regression testing, quarterly release readiness and production issue resolution.
Strong client-facing communication and delivery leadership, including risk / escalation management, team guidance and working knowledge of Core HR and related HCM touchpoints.
As a Manager, you will serve as the functional lead and client-facing subject matter expert for Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll, combining deep payroll configuration expertise with delivery leadership across implementation, enhancement and production support engagements.
Lead the Oracle HCM Payroll functional workstream across solution design, configuration, testing, cutover, hypercare and ongoing support.
Lead client requirement and design discussions, translate payroll policies into Oracle configuration, and provide clear recommendations on solution options and impacts.
Own complex payroll functional issues from analysis through resolution, driving root-cause analysis and sustainable fixes.
Review payroll configurations, functional designs and deliverables for quality, accuracy, controls and adherence to agreed standards.
Manage incidents, service requests, changes and problem records in line with SLAs / KPIs, including prioritization, risks, escalations and stakeholder communication.
Coordinate with Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Time and Labor, Integrations, Reporting and Finance teams, and lead quarterly release impact assessment and regression testing.
Mentor functional consultants, provide configuration oversight, build team capability and drive continuous improvement while maintaining strong client relationships.

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening
Data Warehouse Testing, ETL Testing, SQL, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Migration Testing, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, JIRA, Agile.
Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience
Provide your feedback on BizChat

Role
National Strategic Accounts Manager
Job Level/ Designation
M2/AGM
Function / Department
Enterprise/Strategic Accounts
Location
Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore
Job Purpose

The Client Manager is responsible to understand the business and most important be a bearer of relationship with Enterprise Customer, with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for the assigned Enterprise Customers. End to end operational excellence for the entire customer life cycle journey from opportunity to closure. The role of Client Manager is to focus on incremental product wise Revenue Market Share from those assigned accounts.
Key Result Areas/Accountabilities
Single & Most important bearer of Relationship with Enterprise Customer with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for all assigned Enterprise Customers.
Responsible for the incremental revenue growth on all product lines.
Farming - Protecting the Existing Revenue Stream from Competition & Downward Tariff Revision
Seeding New Products & Services - Cross Selling & Up selling - to enhance overall revenue
Business planning & Accurate Forecasting on Revenue, Order booking, Gross Addition, Gross Net, Net Addition, Churn, Billing, Collection & Bad debts.
Coordination with Cross Functional team to ensure sync in terms of tariff offering, other circle acquisitions, Order fulfilment, Issues Resolution & various other day to day activities
Monitor the service delivery and service assurance aspects are in line with agreed SLA / MSA
Facilitating Collections Team to ensure timely payments and reduction in bad debts
Manages detailed Account Dossier, Accont plans , Heat Map and update periodically.
Adhere and comply to all processes and systems of VIL & VIBS
Collaborative aproach within the team and organisation
Account Engagement and Account Mapping across multi levels /verticals
End to end operational responsibility leading to CXX
Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience
Competencies
Experience in managing global and a track record of global accounts/ enterprise solution selling
Experience in complex change management and operating in a matrix, fast moving and technical environment.
Experience in working in multi-cultural environment ability to manage an international and distributed team.
Team player, strong influence and relationship management skills, customer centric.
Strong communication and decision making skills– ability to balance conflicting interests and ability to lead in a high-growth, high-uncertainty environments
Learning
To learn new products and services so as to be updated with the Customer needs and market trends
Apply the learning in own Customer scenario
Must have technical/ professional qualifications
Experience handling Strategic Accounts and C-level engagement
Education: MBA and Engineering background preferred
5+ years of experience
Should have preferably worked with Telecom, Technology Companies

Design and optimize preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance processes aligned with business objectives.

Description:
Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network | Areas of Work: Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) | Level: Manager | Location: Bangalore, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Pune | Overall Relevant Exp: 7+ years
As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns the value story for the engagement - defines value metrics and KPIs, establishes the baseline, builds the business case, and tracks value realization.
Defines the agentic solution design - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Drives business development and pre-sales - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact


Qualification
Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.
Desirable skills
Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).
Industry domain depth in one or more sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Health, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, or Telco.
Familiarity with AI & Data Solution Architecture and AI-enabled operating models.
Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
Comfort with "vibe coding" - rapidly prototyping working software using AI coding assistants.
Product management experience spanning discovery, scoping, and delivery.
Process discovery and analysis using process-mining tools such as Celonis or Signavio to uncover inefficiencies and automation opportunities; Lean Six Sigma certification a plus.
Agile / Scrum / hybrid delivery with sound SDLC governance; a relevant AI or Agentic AI certification is a plus.
Educational Qualification
MBA or Master's degree from a Tier 1 college is preferred.

Description:
Level 6: GN - SC&E - PRH - Process Excellence - Senior Manager
Management Consulting Senior Manager - Industry & Workflow Advisor / Value Architect
Accenture Strategy and Consulting
Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network | Areas of Work: Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) | Level: Senior Manager | Location: Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai | Overall Relevant Exp: 10+ years
As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a senior, process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns enterprise value realization - defines the value story, value metrics, KPIs, and success metrics, governs the business case, and drives benefits realization at portfolio level.
Defines and governs the agentic solution design and AI adoption strategy across engagements - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Leads business development and pre-sales for AI-led reinvention pursuits - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact.

Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs end to end.
Experience leading and aligning cross-functional teams - engineering, data, and business - to deliver outcomes.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.


Qualification
Desirable skills
Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).
Industry domain depth in one or more sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Health, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, or Telco.
Familiarity with AI & Data Solution Architecture and AI-enabled operating models.
Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
Comfort with "vibe coding" - rapidly prototyping working software using AI coding assistants.

Description:
Level 6: GN - SC&E - PRH - Process Excellence - Senior Manager
Management Consulting Senior Manager - Industry & Workflow Advisor / Value Architect
Accenture Strategy and Consulting
Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network | Areas of Work: Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) | Level: Senior Manager | Location: Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai | Overall Relevant Exp: 10+ years
As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a senior, process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns enterprise value realization - defines the value story, value metrics, KPIs, and success metrics, governs the business case, and drives benefits realization at portfolio level.
Defines and governs the agentic solution design and AI adoption strategy across engagements - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Leads business development and pre-sales for AI-led reinvention pursuits - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact.

Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs end to end.
Experience leading and aligning cross-functional teams - engineering, data, and business - to deliver outcomes.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.


Qualification
Desirable skills
Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).
Industry domain depth in one or more sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Health, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, or Telco.
Familiarity with AI & Data Solution Architecture and AI-enabled operating models.
Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
Comfort with "vibe coding" - rapidly prototyping working software using AI coding assistants.
Product management experience spanning discovery, scoping, and delivery.
Process discovery and analysis using process-mining tools such as Celonis or Signavio to uncover inefficiencies and automation opportunities; Lean Six Sigma certification a plus.
Agile / Scrum / hybrid delivery with sound SDLC governance; a relevant AI or Agentic AI certification is a plus.
Educational Qualification
MBA or Master's degree from a Tier 1 college is preferred.

About the Role
Capgemini is seeking highly skilled SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultants to join our growing SAP Finance Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Central Finance, SAP S/4HANA Finance, financial process transformation, data migration, and system integration. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-wide Central Finance solutions for global clients.
Key Responsibilities
SAP Central Finance Implementation & Solution Design
Lead and participate in end-to-end SAP Central Finance (CFIN) implementation projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP Central Finance solutions.
Configure and support SAP CFIN functionalities including:
Initial Load & Replication
Central Payment
Central Reconciliation
Application Interface Framework (AIF)
Source System Mapping
Key & Value Mapping
Design and implement real-time financial data replication using SAP LT Replication Server (SLT).
Collaborate with business teams to harmonize finance processes across multiple ERP landscapes.
Integration & Data Migration
Integrate SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems into the SAP Central Finance environment.
Manage data migration activities, including data cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
Support financial master data governance and integration with SAP MDG.
Ensure data consistency, completeness, and accuracy throughout migration and replication processes.
Troubleshoot replication and interface issues to ensure business continuity.
Finance Transformation & Process Optimization
Drive finance transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA Central Finance capabilities.
Analyze existing business processes and recommend improvements based on SAP best practices.
Enable process standardization and harmonization across global business units.
Support business stakeholders in defining future-state finance operating models.
Financial Reporting & Support
Support financial reporting, analytics, and consolidation requirements.
Develop and enhance reporting solutions using SAP Fiori, Embedded Analytics, SAC, and BW.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Provide post-go-live support and resolve issues related to:
Data Replication
Financial Postings
AIF Monitoring
Mapping Errors
Reconciliation Discrepancies
Financial Reporting
Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP Central Finance (CFIN).
Expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance and SAP FI/CO.
Experience with:
SLT Replication
AIF Framework
MDG Integration
Data Migration & Reconciliation
Financial Master Data Management
SAP Fiori Applications
Understanding of SAP integration methodologies and architecture.
Functional Expertise
Strong knowledge of:
General Ledger (GL)
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Cost Center Accounting
Profit Center Accounting
Internal Orders
Bank Accounting
Financial Closing & Reporting
Preferred Experience
6 to 15 years of SAP consulting experience.
Minimum 4+ years of hands-on SAP Central Finance experience.
At least one full lifecycle SAP Central Finance implementation is preferred.
Experience working on global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
Exposure to Treasury, Group Reporting, and Cash Management would be an advantage.
Experience in Agile and SAP Activate methodologies.

Description:
Role: EY- Assurance Manager ( Audit )
Experience: 5 to 9 years
Notice Period - Immediate to 30 Days
Location: Pune and Bangalore
Mode of work - Hybrid

As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.

The opportunity:

Were looking for individuals who are qualified accountants with excellent leadership skills.
The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe, and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles

Your key responsibilities:

Support a portfolio of engagements, by leading a team of Assistant Managers, Seniors and Associates
Ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY methodology and in line with the engagement teams expectations
Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key engagement team counterparts, such as Assurance executives based in Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure that these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Work closely with the engagement team to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance while maintaining the highest levels of quality of service.
Proactively discuss work flow management with the engagement teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and engagement teams.
Establish expectations regarding value to be delivered to the respective aligned GDS or engagement teams.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS Assurance.
Standardize assurance processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
Help team members grow by encouraging them to actively contribute to the team.
Lead by example, delegate work successfully and develop and maintain high performing teams.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback and training.
Use technology and tools to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery.
Contribute to technical and soft-skills training to continually develop the team’s skills.
Actively participate in organizational initiatives, such as recruitment, diversity and inclusiveness, trainings, and others.

Skills and attributes for success:

Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
Knowledge of UK GAAP or US GAAP and International assurance standards is an added advantage.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience
Qualified ACCA / CPA with 7-8 years of post-qualification relevant experience
Articleship with other top or mid -tier accounting firms
Experience in either:

a) Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews / matters.

b) MNC or larger Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service
Environment.

c) Big 4 Firms - Indian & Global practice.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.

What we look for:

A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.

What we Offer:

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

About EY:

EY | Building a better working world:

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.

Description:
Job Description: Data Modeler Developer
Location: Bangalore / Pune
Experience: 7-15 Years
Role Purpose
Design and maintain high-quality enterprise data models for Private Banking and Wealth platforms, ensuring consistent, governed, and scalable data structures across client, portfolio, and transaction domains. This role focuses on data modelling, metadata, and data design, supporting integration across multiple banking systems while adhering to enterprise data standards.
Key Responsibilities:
• Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models aligned to enterprise standards
• Develop data models across key wealth domains including client, account, portfolio, product, and transactions
• Translate business and functional requirements into robust data structures and schemas
• Define and maintain data models supporting integration across core banking, CRM, and digital platforms
• Establish and manage data entity relationships, hierarchies, and normalization standards
• Perform detailed metadata design, including naming standards, definitions, data types, and attribute structures
• Ensure all data models comply with data governance, quality, and control frameworks
• Maintain data model documentation, standards, and reusable artefacts
• Support data lineage and traceability through well-structured modelling practices
• Collaborate with engineering teams to support implementation of data models into databases and data platforms
• Ensure consistency of data models across multiple systems and platforms
• Contribute to enterprise data standards, modelling guidelines, and best practices
• Participate in design reviews and architecture governance forums
• 5-8 years of experience in data modelling
• Strong experience in Private Banking / Wealth Management domain
• Understanding of wealth data structures (client lifecycle, portfolio, transactions, products)
• Experience working with multi-system banking environments

Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior Java Developer with 7-12 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing enterprise-grade applications using Java and related technologies. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices architecture, REST APIs, cloud technologies, and modern software development practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable and high-performance enterprise applications.
Build and maintain Microservices-based applications using Java and Spring Boot.
Develop RESTful APIs and integrate with internal and external systems.
Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical design decisions.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.
Implement security, logging, monitoring, and observability best practices.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, QA teams, and DevOps engineers.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

Your Role

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Finance Functional Consultant with strong expertise in Oracle Fusion Financials implementation, support, enhancement, and transformation projects. The ideal candidate should possess in-depth knowledge of Finance business processes and hands-on experience across Oracle Fusion Financial modules.
Lead and participate in Oracle Fusion Financials implementation, upgrade, rollout, and support projects.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into Oracle Fusion solutions.
Configure and support Oracle Fusion Financial modules based on business needs.
Conduct Fit-Gap Analysis, Solution Design, CRP, SIT, UAT, Go-Live, and Hypercare activities.
Work closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and project managers.
Prepare functional design documents and coordinate with technical teams for reports, integrations, conversions, and extensions.



Your Profile

Troubleshoot functional issues and provide timely resolutions.
Ensure adherence to Oracle implementation best practices.
Deliver end-user training and prepare project documentation.
Strong hands-on experience in the following Oracle Fusion Finance modules: General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management (CM), Expense Management, Tax Management, Financial Reporting Center (FRC)
Expertise in end-to-end Finance business processes including Record-to-Report (R2R), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), and Order-to-Cash (O2C).
Experience in requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
Knowledge of Oracle Fusion reporting tools such as OTBI, BI Publisher, Smart View, and Financial Reporting Studio.
Experience with security setup, approval workflows, and role-based access controls.
Strong understanding of integrations with other Oracle Fusion modules such as SCM, Procurement, Projects, and HCM.

We value flexibility and support a healthy work-life balance through remote and hybrid work options.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
Career development programs and certifications in cloud technologies.
A diverse and inclusive workplace that fosters innovation and collaboration.

Description:
Job Summary
As a Lead Engineer - Basic Automation Testing, you will play a critical role in ensuring the successful planning, coordination, governance, and deployment of software releases across complex healthcare products and platforms. You will serve as both a Release Coordinator and Release Engineer, driving releases from initiation through production deployment while collaborating with Engineering, QA, Product, and Customer teams.


Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks and test suites across UI, API, and database layers.
Drive end-to-end test coverage including functional, regression, integration, and automation testing of critical business workflows.
Automate high-value test scenarios to reduce manual effort and improve release quality.
Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines, and enhance test infrastructure for speed, reliability, and scalability.
Ensure quality ownership across Agile sprints by validating features, tracking defects, debugging failures, and supporting release readiness.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Developers, Business Analysts, and QA teams to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
Analyze automation results, identify root causes, and drive defect resolution.
Establish automation best practices, coding standards, and reusable framework components.
Contribute to continuous improvement of testing strategies, quality metrics, and engineering processes.
Mentor junior automation engineers, and promote quality engineering culture across teams.
Support test planning, estimation, risk assessment, and quality governance activities.
Drive innovation through adoption of modern tools, frameworks, and testing methodologies.


Experience
7 - 9 Years


Location
Mumbai
Pune
Chennai
Bangalore


Educational Qualifications
Engineering Degree - BE/ME/BTech/MTech/BSc/MSc.
Relevant certifications in Release Management, DevOps, Agile, Scrum, or Cloud technologies are desirable.


Skills
Mandatory Technical Skills:
UI and API Test Automation Expertise (Selenium / Playwright / Cypress / REST Assured/SoapUI/Postman)
Programming and OOP Skills (JavaScript / TypeScript / Java / Python / C#)
CI/CD and Test Integration (Jenkins/Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions/Git)
Automation Framework Design and Development
Test Strategy, Test Planning and Defect Management
Agile/Scrum Methodologies
Good to Have Skills:
Advanced SQL
BDD (Cucumber)
TDD Practices
AWS/Cloud Exposure
Performance Testing (JMeter, LoadRunner)
Docker and Kubernetes
Security Testing
Test Management Tools (Jira, Zephyr)
Healthcare Domain Knowledge
Microservices Testing
Service Virtualization
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
Strong collaboration and teamwork mindset
Ability to lead automation initiatives and mentor teams
Effective planning and organizational skills
Ability to work in a fast-paced Agile environment
Customer-centric approach with focus on quality and continuous improvement

Avenue E-commerce Limited (AEL) is an online extension of Avenue Supermarts Limited flagship brand. Job Description: Assistant Manager MIS & Business Analytics (Finance)

Role Objective:
We are looking for a highly analytical and result-oriented professional to lead MIS reporting, financial data analysis, dashboard development, and business performance tracking. The primary responsibility will be to transform raw financial and operational data into meaningful insights that enable management to make informed business decisions.

Key Responsibilities:
1. MIS Reporting & Management Dashboards
Develop, manage, and enhance daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for management.
Design interactive dashboards to track business performance, profitability, revenue, expenses, and other key performance indicators.
Consolidate data from multiple sources and ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely reporting.
Develop customised reports and dashboards based on management requirements.
Automate repetitive reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.

2. Business Insights & Data Analytics
Analyse large volumes of financial and operational data to identify trends, patterns, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Develop new reports, analytical models, and performance metrics to provide deeper visibility into business performance.
Identify the reasons behind revenue fluctuations, cost increases, margin changes, and deviations from targets.

3. MIS Automation & Process Improvement
Build advanced Excel-based reports and dashboards using Pivot Tables, Power Query, advanced formulas, and data models.
Develop Power BI dashboards and automated reporting solutions wherever applicable.
Improve data collection, validation, reporting formats, and analytical processes.
Establish standardised KPI definitions and reporting practices across departments.
Ensure data integrity, confidentiality, and reliability of management information.

Description:
Company Name: Tribeca Developers

About the Company:

Tribeca is the largest branded luxury developer in India! Established in 2012, we have grown to become the largest developer of Trump-branded properties in the world (after the Trump Organization). Our current employee strength comprises more than 250+ associates across Mumbai, Pune, Delhi-NCR, Kolkata, and Bangalore, and we have a team of incredibly talented, hungry, bright, and passionate folks, including IIT, IIM, Wharton, and SPA toppers and industry stalwarts. At Tribeca, we are focused on creating world-class products and customer experiences. We pioneered the concept of branded residences in India and are developing over 6 million square feet of branded residential projects in India. We are also proud to be developing the world's largest rooftop terrace.

About this role

This role drives project strategy and financial performance, supporting senior leadership in decision-making and project oversight. It manages cash flows, budgeting, and AOP tracking, while ensuring projects meet time, cost, quality, and profitability targets through strong financial analysis and cost optimization.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop project strategies and provide key insights for product development.
Assist senior management with decision-making, bid management, and project oversight.
Manage project cash flows, track collections, and allocate funds effectively.
Prepare the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and cash flow statements; monitor project targets as per the AOP.
Establish and ensure success criteria for projects, including time, cost, technical, and performance parameters.
Monitor project timelines and costs to achieve committed profit margins and ensure timely completion.
Implement cost optimization strategies, suggest cost control measures, and focus on value engineering, waste reduction, and productivity improvement.
Handle financial transactions, analyse expense statements, and use charts/models to identify trends and predict future outcomes.

Qualification & Experience:

MBA - Finance/ CA
2+ years of experience in highly analytical environments such as top management consulting firms or corporate strategy roles.

Key Skills & Attributes:

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with keen attention to detail.
Proven experience in managing senior stakeholders.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to create compelling presentations.
Financial planning, cash flow management, and project monitoring Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint; knowledge of ERP/BI tools a plus Excellent communication and presentation skills
Ability to manage senior stakeholders and influence decisions
Project management, cost optimization, and KPI tracking

Description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way youd like, where youll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where youll be able to reimagine whats possible. Join us and help the worlds leading organizations
Your Role

We are looking for experienced Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Consultants to join our Cloud Practice. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in designing, implementing, migrating, administering, and supporting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure environments while ensuring scalability, security, performance, and availability of enterprise applications.
Design, deploy, and manage Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) solutions.
Implement and support OCI services across compute, networking, storage, security, database, and monitoring domains.
Perform cloud migration and modernization of Oracle and non-Oracle workloads.
Configure OCI Identity and Access Management (IAM), security policies, and governance controls.
Implement high availability, disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity solutions.
Manage OCI networking components including VCN, Load Balancers, FastConnect, VPN, and DNS.



Your Profile

Monitor cloud environments and troubleshoot performance, availability, and security issues.
Configure and manage OCI Database services, Autonomous Databases, and Exadata Cloud services.
Support infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
Collaborate with application, database, middleware, and security teams for end-to-end cloud solutions.
Prepare technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and operational procedures.
Hands-on expertise in:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Compute Services, Virtual Cloud Network (VCN), Block, Object File Storage, IAM Cloud Security, Load Balancer, DNS Networking, FastConnect VPN, Monitoring Logging, OCI Resource Manager, Terraform
Experience with OCI migration, implementation, and administration projects.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, security, and infrastructure management.
Experience in troubleshooting and optimizing cloud environments.
Knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows administration.



What you''ll love about working with us

We value flexibility and support a healthy work-life balance through remote and hybrid work options.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
Career development programs and certifications in cloud technologies.
A diverse and inclusive workplace that fosters innovation and collaboration.
We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise andstrong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of 22.5 billion.
Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.

www.tribecadevelopers.com

Location: Lower Parel, Mumbai
Job Type: Full-Time
Reporting To: Chief Financial Officer

Job Summary:

The Head Corporate Accounts will lead the corporate accounts function and oversee financial reporting, management information systems (MIS), consolidation of accounts and audit-related activities. The role will be responsible for ensuring accuracy, consistency and timeliness of corporate financial information and strengthening accounting controls and reporting processes.
Key Responsibilities:

Accounting & Financial Reporting

Oversee corporate accounting activities and ensure accurate and timely maintenance of books of accounts across group entities.
Lead the preparation and review of periodic standalone financial statements under Ind AS and IGAAP, as applicable to each entity.
Ensure correct application of Accounting Standards and Ind AS, including revenue recognition (Ind AS 115), inventory, borrowing cost and project-cost accounting relevant to real estate.
Review account reconciliations, schedules and supporting documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy.

MIS & Monthly Closure

Drive monthly book closure within defined timelines, including monthly PAT and cash flow reporting.
Oversee preparation of MIS reports and provide meaningful financial insights to management, including variance analysis against budget.

Consolidation

Manage consolidation of accounts and ensure consistency of accounting policies and accuracy across subsidiaries, SPVs and joint arrangements.
Ensure timely reconciliation and elimination of inter-company transactions and balances.

Audit

Coordinate and oversee internal and statutory audit processes, including audit schedules, documentation and closure of observations.
Act as the primary point of contact for auditors on accounting and reporting matters.

RERA & Statutory Compliance

Oversee quarterly and annual RERA compliances, including CA certificates for withdrawals from designated project accounts and annual compliance reports, in coordination with project and legal teams.
Monitor accounting policies, internal controls and compliance with applicable accounting and statutory requirements.

Controls, Systems & Process Improvement

Ensure effective use of SAP / ERP for accounting, reporting and closure processes.
Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, reporting systems and control mechanisms, including Internal Financial Controls (IFC).
Coordinate with business and finance stakeholders for timely closure of financial reporting requirements.

Team Leadership

Guide, develop and support the accounts team to ensure effective delivery of the function.
Qualifications & Experience:

Chartered Accountant (CA).
Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in financial reporting, MIS, consolidation of accounts and audit.
Experience in managing corporate accounts and coordinating audits.
Real estate or multi-entity business experience would be an advantage.

Key Competencies:

Sound knowledge of Accounting Standards and Ind AS, with hands-on experience in preparing financial statements under both IGAAP and Ind AS.Sound understanding of MIS, consolidation and audit processes.
Leadership, team management and stakeholder management skills.
Strong analytical ability and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple reporting deliverables and deadlines.

Job Title: Risk Senior Specialist
Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President
Location: Mumbai, India
Role Description
Market and Valuation Risk Management (MVRM) provides an independent view of market risks and valuation to Deutsche Bank s senior management. Market risk team manages Deutsche Bank s Market Risk position in an independent and neutral way.
You will be a part of the Market Risk Analysis and Control (MRAC) function within MVRM and will be responsible for the provision of all official market risk metrics and core analysis in support of risk management decision making for Rates asset class. The team operates a business/asset class and risk metric aligned organizational matrix supported by central functions. The team has a global presence with staff located in London, New York, Berlin, Singapore, Mumbai and Bangalore.
You will be exposed to risk management techniques viz. analysis/computation of VaR, SVaR, IRC, Backtesting, FRTB for a diverse range of derivative products. The team is also proficient in combining this risk knowledge with best in class automation and visualization skills including python/VBA/Tableau to provide value added analytical outputs to its stakeholders
You will be expected to be proficient in automation tools (python essentially) with sufficient knowledge of risk to enhance the output of the team.
Your key responsibilities
This role is within the Rates Asset class team. The primary responsibilities are:
Risk validation and ensure appropriate controls in place
Review and understand the historical simulation VaR, FRTB and Backtesting(outlier analysis), including staying abreast of the development of this metric and related drivers
Facilitating better risk analysis and automated reporting infrastructure to stakeholders using required programming tools(python/Tableau etc.) is a critical part of profile
Perform deep dive analysis into concentrations of risk or emerging items of interest, providing high quality and accurate information at a level for senior management consumption
Perform analytical analysis of our limit to generate proposals for limit changes and for new limits
Support the analysis and communication of business portfolio level topics to senior management and their committees
Your skills and experience
Experience in working with commodities especially Energy asset class is a must.
Experience in working with python and tableau is a must.
University degree in Economics, Mathematics or other quantitative subject.
5+ years experience in Market Risk within the Financial Market / Investment Banking industry (other relevant backgrounds e.g. Trading, Product Control, IPV will also be considered)
Proficiency in Python/VBA, Tableau, MS Office tools is essential for the role
Good understanding of other Market Risk measurement techniques e.g. VaR, RNIV, Economic Capital, IRC.
Excellent communication skills; ability to articulate technical and financial topics with global stakeholders
A reliable team player with the motivation to work in a dynamic, international and diverse environment
Able to multi-task and deliver under tight deadlines
A committed and motivated individual for self-development and growth
Hands on coding skills(Python specifically) and Tableau skills will be a significant plus
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Your Role
We are looking for a skilled and proactive SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management) Technical Consultant to design, develop, enhance, and optimize complex warehouse and supply chain management solutions. Programming Enhancements: Expert-level ABAP on SAP HANA, OO-ABAP, BADIs, BAPIs, Enhancement Framework, IDocs, and ALE.
Warehouse Processes Knowledge: Good understanding of EWM core processes-Inbound (goods receipt, putaway), Outbound (picking, packing, loading), Internal movements, Replenishment, and Physical Inventory.
RF Device Integration: Experience with RF Framework, ITSmobile, barcode scanning, and mobile data entry setup.
Problem Solving: Strong analytical, debugging, and performance optimization skills.

We value flexibility and support a healthy work-life balance through remote and hybrid work options.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
Career development programs and certifications in cloud technologies.

Description:
Delivery / Program Manager Telecom
Experience Level: Senior (15+ years)
Role Overview:
The Delivery/Program Manager will lead complex, multi-project programs in the telecom domain. This role combines strong technical expertise with program management skills to ensure successful delivery of large-scale IT transformation initiatives for global telecom clients.
Key Responsibilities:
Program Leadership & Delivery: 
Drive end-to-end delivery of strategic programs involving OSS/BSS systems and wholesale processes.
Define program scope, technical architecture alignment, timelines, and success metrics.
Technical Oversight: 
Collaborate with solution architects and engineering teams to ensure technical integrity of solutions.
Review designs, integration plans, and ensure compliance with industry standards.
Stakeholder Management: 
Act as the primary technical and delivery interface for client leadership.
Manage expectations and ensure alignment between business and technical objectives.
Governance & Reporting: 
Establish governance frameworks, track KPIs, and ensure adherence to SLAs.
Conduct regular program reviews and executive-level reporting.
Risk & Issue Management: 
Identify technical and delivery risks early; implement mitigation strategies.
Financial Management: 
Manage program budgets, forecasts, and profitability.
Team Leadership: 
Lead cross-functional teams (architects, developers, testers, PMs) across geographies.
Mentor technical leads and delivery managers for performance excellence.
Continuous Improvement: 
Drive adoption of Agile/DevOps practices and automation initiatives.
Implement best practices for technical delivery efficiency and quality improvement.
Required Skills & Experience:
Domain Expertise: 
Strong understanding of telecom wholesale processes: interconnect, roaming, carrier billing, settlements, and partner management.
Technical Knowledge: 
Deep knowledge of OSS/BSS systems, mediation, rating, billing platforms, APIs, and integration frameworks.
Exposure to cloud-native architectures, microservices, and containerization.
Program Management: 
15+ years of IT delivery experience, with at least 5 years in technical program management.
Proven track record of managing multi-million-dollar programs.
Certifications: 
PMP, SAFe, or equivalent certifications preferred.
Leadership & Communication: 
Excellent stakeholder management and executive-level communication skills.
Ability to manage global delivery teams and vendors.
Tools & Methodologies: 
Proficiency in Agile, DevOps, and ITIL practices.
Experience with Jira, MS Project, and other program management tools.
Education:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
MBA or equivalent business qualification is a plus.

Description:
Territory Sales Manager (TSM)
About NoBroker Technologies Private Limited
NoBrokerHood, a part of NoBroker Technologies Pvt.Ltd. Our founders understood the need to have a tech-enabled
visitor and community management system, that aims to make life convenient, hassle-free, and secure for the
residents of a gated community. Thus, NoBrokerHood was launched. NoBrokerHood is a smart visitor, society and
accounting management system. From our start in late 2018, NoBrokerHood is currently securing 20,000+ societies
under its hood. From catering to all the society needs like complaint management, gate entry, maintenance bill
payments, digital notice board, it also has features like Marketplace, home services and more. NoBrokerHood goes
beyond visitor and gate management delivering an end-to-end community experience that empowers residents
and management committees with digital convenience, revenue growth, and future-ready innovation.
To know more about NoBrokerHood, visit our website - https://www.nobrokerhood.com/
About the role:
We are currently looking to hire an energetic, highly motivated, can-do attitude individual who is willing to join our
team as a Territory Sales Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for acquiring leads and generating revenue
by onboarding new apartment complexes and societies into NoBrokerHood by meeting with prospective clients in
person and explaining the product.
Job Description:-



Minimum 1-5 years of proven sales track record and ability to meet targets.
Lead generation through prospecting referral and web researches
Should have an interest in Business Development (B2C/ B2B) for Software Application Products
/solutions.

Meet prospective clients, execute effective product demonstrations, and emphasize product features and
benefits with a focus on the value of the solution.


Capabilities of selling Hardware IOT devices

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated Generative AI Engineer with hands-on experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), MCP (Model Context Protocol), and AI Agent Frameworks. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-grade AI applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), autonomous agents, and advanced retrieval systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop AI-powered applications using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Build and deploy Agentic AI solutions capable of autonomous reasoning and task execution.
Implement RAG architectures using vector databases and enterprise knowledge sources.
Develop integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP) for AI tool and data connectivity.
Build multi-agent systems using modern Agent Frameworks.
Fine-tune prompts and optimize LLM performance for business use cases.
Develop AI workflows for document processing, knowledge management, and conversational AI.
Integrate AI services with enterprise applications using APIs and microservices.
Collaborate with data scientists, product teams, and software engineers to deliver AI solutions.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend best practices.
Required Skills
2-6 years of software development experience.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models.
Experience building RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.
Knowledge of Agentic AI architectures and autonomous AI agents.
Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration and AI tooling.
Hands-on experience with AI Agent Frameworks such as:
LangGraph
LangChain
CrewAI
AutoGen
Semantic Kernel
LlamaIndex
Experience with Vector Databases:
Pinecone
ChromaDB
Weaviate
Milvus
FAISS
Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or Open Source LLMs.
Strong understanding of Prompt Engineering and AI application development.
Experience with REST APIs and Microservices.
Familiarity with Git, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Preferred Skills
Experience with AI Observability and Evaluation Tools.
Knowledge of Fine-Tuning and Model Optimization.
Experience with Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
Exposure to NLP, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning concepts.
Knowledge of CI/CD for AI deployments (LLMOps).
Experience building AI Chatbots, AI Assistants, and Enterprise Search solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related field.
AboutCompany:
Infosys is a NYSE listed global consulting and IT services company with more than 317k employees. From a capital of US$250, we have grown to become a US$ 18.6 billion (LTM Q4 FY24 revenues) company with a market capitalization of US$ 74.42 billion.

Description:
Job Summary :
We are seeking an experienced SAP BTP CPI Integration Consultant to design, develop, and maintain integration solutions on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) using Cloud Platform Integration (CPI). The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP integration technologies, cloud architecture, and API management.
Role & responsibilities
Design and implement integration scenarios using SAP CPI for SAP and non-SAP systems.
Develop and configure iFlows, adapters, and mappings in CPI.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams to gather integration requirements.
Ensure secure and efficient data exchange between on-premise and cloud systems.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize integration flows for performance and reliability.
Work with SAP BTP services such as API Management, Event Mesh, and Connectivity.
Document technical specifications and integration architecture.
Stay updated on SAP integration best practices and new features.
Experience in SAP CPI and integration projects.
Strong knowledge of SAP BTP, Cloud Integration, and API Management.
Hands-on experience with SOAP, REST, OData, IDoc, and SFTP protocols.
Familiarity with security concepts (OAuth, SSL, certificates).
Experience in mapping techniques (XSLT, Groovy scripting).
Understanding of SAP ERP, S/4HANA, and other SAP modules.
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
Preferred candidate profile
SAP CPI certification.
Experience with SAP Event Mesh, Integration Suite, and Cloud Connector.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices for integration.

Job Description
Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager, AVP
Location: Mumbai, India
Alternative Locations: Pune, India / Bangalore, India


Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with data analytics, reporting tools or process automation solutions is advantageous.

How we’ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
About us and our teams

The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,
Best in class leave policy.
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritisation of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organisational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
