Job Summary
Job Title: Risk Manager - Sustainability Risk
Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President
Location: Mumbai, India


Role Description
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures - but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That s why we are Investors for a new now .
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients financial future. And in return, we ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.
This is your chance to invest in your future.
Read more about DWS and who we are here.


Team / division overview
The DWS Chief Risk Office provides independent oversight across key risk types and supports effective risk decision-making.
The Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) team coordinates cross-risk governance, risk reporting and risk appetite / legal entity risk management processes, and is responsible for independent review and challenge across areas including strategic, capital and sustainability risk.
The Sustainability Risk team, as part of ERM, integrates sustainability risks and adverse environmental and social impacts into DWS s risk management framework. It develops the ESG risk strategy and risk appetite, monitors risk levels, and supports second-line functions in developing ESG / sustainability-related control objectives.


Your key responsibilities
As a Risk manager you will (be)
Maintain and develop the integration of Sustainability Risks and Adverse Impacts in the DWS Group Risk Management Framework
Support the development and monitoring of appropriate qualitative and quantitative measures to enhance the DWS Risk Appetite Statement in relation to sustainability risk
Review and challenge 1LoD processes related to sustainability and ESG (controls, assessments etc.)
Support quantitative and qualitative external disclosures related to sustainability risk
Enhance the consideration of Sustainability Risks across key risk management framework components such as the Risk and Control Self-Assessment and the Risk Inventory
Regular review and challenge of the control framework to ensure alignment with evolving laws and regulations
Providing updates to senior stakeholders and forums on key ESG initiatives
Other tasks include analytical deep-dives, change initiatives, maintaining stakeholder dialogue and support for the team as projects arise.


Your skills and experience
University degree in Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Business Administration, Risk Management or a related discipline.
Minimum 3 years experience in sustainability / ESG risk management, ESG disclosures, or a comparable front-office role
Good understanding of European sustainability-related regulations, standards and industry developments
Working knowledge of the asset management industry and its regulatory environment.
Understanding of core risk management concepts, including risk identification, assessment, controls, risk drivers, scenario analysis and internal/external events.
Demonstrated ability to identify, assess, and manage sustainability risks and impacts originating from or impacting ESG factors.
Understanding of the interaction between sustainability risks and traditional risk types, including operational, reputational and financial risks.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across a complex organization.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver effectively in a dynamic environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.


How we ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career.
Coaching and support from experts in your team.
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

Job Description
Position Summary
We are seeking a professional, customer-focused, and highly organized Receptionist
to serve as the first point of contact for employees, visitors, customers, and external
stakeholders. This role is responsible for managing front desk operations, visitor
management processes, communication channels, and supporting emergency
response communications. The successful candidate will work closely with the
Physical Security team, Global Workplace Services (GWS), and business leadership to
ensure a safe, secure, and welcoming workplace environment.
1) Front Desk Visitor Management
Serve as the primary point of contact for all visitors, guests, vendors, and contractors
entering the facility.
Manage visitor registration, badge issuance, access verification, and check-in/check-
out procedures.
Maintain accurate visitor logs and ensure compliance with company security
policies.
Coordinate VIP visits and executive guest arrivals.
2) Telephone Communication Management
Manage incoming telephone calls and route inquiries appropriately.
Respond professionally to employee, customer, and vendor inquiries.
Support office-wide communications and announcements as required.
3) Email Administrative Support
Manage shared reception and workplace email inboxes.
Coordinate meeting room bookings and visitor notifications.
Maintain records, reports, and workplace documentation.
4) Emergency Communication Response Support
Support emergency communications during incidents, evacuations, and business
continuity events.
Assist Security and Facilities teams during emergencies.
Participate in emergency drills and preparedness programs.
5) Security Team Collaboration
Act as an integral member of the Physical Security team.
Support access control, badge management, and workplace security initiatives.
Report security concerns and maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.
6) Coordination with GWS and Business Leaders
Partner closely with GWS to support smooth workplace operations.
Coordinate workplace requirements with facilities and service providers.
Support business leaders with meetings, events, and visitor arrangements.

Qualifications
Bachelors degree or equivalent experience preferred.
2+ years of experience in reception, administration, workplace services, hospitality,
or similar roles.
Strong communication, customer service, and organizational skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams).

Key Competencies
Customer Focus
Professional Communication
Teamwork Collaboration
Attention to Detail
Problem Solving
Integrity Confidentiality
Time Management
Crisis and Emergency Response Awareness
Stakeholder Management

Reporting Relationship
Reports To: Regional Security Manager (APAC/India)

Success Measures
Positive visitor and employee experience.
Accurate and compliant visitor management processes.
Effective emergency communication support.
Strong collaboration with Security, GWS, and business stakeholders.
Timely response to inquiries and workplace support requests.
Maintenance of a secure, professional, and welcoming office environment.

Role Objective:
To provide exceptional front-office services while supporting workplace security,
employee safety, and business operations through effective visitor management,
communication, and collaboration with Physical Security, GWS, and organizational

Role & responsibilities


Job Title: Business Development Manager / Senior Manager Mid-Market (B2B Sales)

Company: G4S Secure Solutions India
Location: Multiple Locations / Pan-India Hubs
Experience: 2 – 8 Years
Role Type: Full-Time, Individual Contributor

About the Role
We are looking for high-energy, target-driven Business Development Managers to drive our Mid-Market corporate sales across Pan-India hubs. In this role, you will focus on acquiring new mid-sized corporate clients and expanding business within existing accounts.
You will manage mid-sized commercial deals (ranging from 20 Lakhs to 85 Lakhs+ / 25K–100K in annual contract value), allowing you to focus purely on high-impact corporate accounts while smaller transactional inquiries are handled by our operations team.

What’s in It for You? (Compensation & Growth)
Monthly Payouts: Fast-paced monthly performance tracking with monthly commission payouts.
Multi-Year Earning Potential: Earn trailing commissions in Years 2 and 3 for multi-year contracts you close, plus an Annual Target Bonus.
Clear Career Path: High performers hitting targets for 2 consecutive years qualify for fast-track promotion to Enterprise Sales roles.
Key Responsibilities
1. New Business Acquisition (50% of your time)
Identify and pitch to potential corporate clients across industrial corridors, manufacturing plants, logistics hubs, and commercial buildings through cold calling, field visits, and networking.
Follow up on and convert inbound leads from digital marketing, website inquiries, and branch referrals.
Prepare accurate pricing proposals/cost sheets using company tools and respond to commercial RFQs while maintaining healthy profit margins.
Close multi-year security service contracts within the mid-market segment.
2. Account Expansion & Retention (35% of your time)
Build strong relationships with existing mid-market clients to expand manpower deployments across new sites.
Cross-sell electronic security solutions (CCTV, access control, and intrusion detection packages) to existing customers.
Manage timely contract renewals (targeting 90%+ retention) and execute annual price revisions aligned with statutory minimum wage updates.
3. Sales Operations & Smooth Handover (15% of your time)
Maintain up-to-date pipeline data, meeting notes, and deal stages in Salesforce (CRM).
Coordinate closely with Branch Operations and Finance teams after contract signing to ensure smooth deployment and timely billing.

Who We Are Looking For
Experience & Education:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (MBA in Sales/Marketing is a plus).
Manager: 2–5 years of proven experience in high-volume B2B / field sales.
Senior Manager: 5–8 years of proven B2B / commercial services sales experience.

Skills & Competencies:
Sales Hustle: Strong track record in B2B field sales, cold calling, lead qualification, and closing deals quickly.
Client Relationship Management: Ability to engage and negotiate with Business Owners, Plant Heads, Facility Managers, and Purchase Officers.
Commercial Acumen: Comfortable working with pricing/costing sheets, profit margins, and basic labour compliance/minimum wage structures.
Tech-Savvy: Hands-on experience using CRM tools (like Salesforce) and MS Excel.
(Preferred) Basic understanding of manned guarding or electronic security systems (CCTV, access control).

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 5 to 8 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.

Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.

Job Summary
We are looking for a dynamic and results-oriented Senior Sales Executive to drive business growth by acquiring new clients and developing strong relationships with existing customers. The candidate will be responsible for promoting logistics and supply chain services, generating new business opportunities, achieving sales targets, and expanding the company's customer base.
The ideal candidate should have experience in B2B sales, logistics, transportation, freight forwarding, or supply chain services, along with strong communication, negotiation, and client acquisition skills.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and generate new business opportunities through cold calling, networking, references, and market research.
Acquire new corporate clients, exporters, importers, manufacturers, and distributors.
Promote logistics services, including FTL, LTL, transportation, warehousing, and freight forwarding.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers.
Understand customer requirements and propose suitable logistics solutions.
Prepare quotations, negotiate pricing, and close sales deals.
Conduct client meetings, presentations, and regular follow-ups.
Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and update customer information in the CRM.

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Logistics, or a related field.
4 to 8 years of experience in B2B sales or business development.
Experience in logistics, transportation, freight forwarding, or supply chain management preferred.
Strong client acquisition and lead-generation skills.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Good understanding of FTL, LTL, warehousing, and transportation services.
Ability to prepare commercial quotations and negotiate service rates.
Strong customer relationship management and follow-up skills.
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, and CRM tools.
Self-motivated, target-oriented, and capable of working independently.

Preferred Candidate Profile
Experience in selling logistics and transportation services.
Existing contacts with manufacturers, exporters, importers, and corporate clients.
Strong networking and business development abilities.
Ability to independently manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation to deal closure.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Senior Developer
Capgemini development team • module owner • AI-native • C# / .NET
Role summary
A senior C# engineer who owns one or more delivery slices end to end design, build, tests, deployment to QA and Pre-Production, integration with third-party systems, and business review — and is accountable for the result working on integration, not merely passing in isolation. Works evaluation- and test-driven, uses agentic AI development tools as the default way of working, and holds the flow and quality disciplines of the team without exception. There is no testing team to hand quality to.
Working context
The team is small and senior by design. Where work is well-specified, AI-augmented engineers are expected to deliver materially more every two weeks than a conventional team; where work is ambiguous — interpreting a plan rule, judging a country's payment logic — the constraint is the engineer's judgment, and AI adds nothing.
Quality is not a phase and not a department. Each senior developer owns the entire range of work for a slice: the code, the tests that prove it, the integration behavior, the documentation, and the board that shows where it is. Nothing is handed off to a testing team in the traditional way; the Senior Quality Architect designs the quality system, but the developer is accountable for the outcome inside it.
Part of the work is inheriting and evaluating an existing codebase built by the previous team through the forfeiture stage. Not all of it will be kept.
Key responsibilities
• End-to-end slice ownership. Take a slice from acceptance criteria to a working, integrated increment in Pre-Production. 'Done' means it works against the real interfaces or their contract-verified stubs, its tests gate the pipeline, its documentation is current and the business has seen it in a demo window — not that it compiled.
• Evaluation- and test-driven development. Write the evaluation criteria and tests before or alongside the code, for every change: unit, contract (Pact) and end-to-end (Playwright). Use the same discipline for AI-generated code — define what correct looks like first, then generate, then verify.
• Accountable for integration. Own the behavior of your slice across the interfaces it touches — SAP H1P, PeopleConnect, Clarity, Zurich, ASC, Alight/Empower, the primary bank. Contract tests first, then joint test windows with the third party's technical contact. An integration defect in your slice is your defect.
• Trunk-based delivery. Merge to trunk many times a day behind feature flags; keep the pipeline green; deploy to QA on every merge and to UAT / Pre-Production several times a week. A red pipeline is the first priority for whoever broke it.
• Flow discipline. Maintain the Kanban board as the true state of your work — every day, without being asked. Respect WIP limits, keep items moving, flag blocked work immediately, and keep work documentation (design notes, decisions, test evidence) current as part of the slice, not after it.
• Programming standards and code quality. Apply the team's programming standards on every change and hold others to them in review. Keep SonarQube quality gates green — coverage, duplication, maintainability, reliability and security ratings — and treat a failed gate as a blocker, not a warning.
• Inherited code. Evaluate the existing IBIS 2.0 modules — through the forfeiture stage — against the target architecture, the SonarQube baseline and the quality bar; remediate, refactor or replace with a documented rationale.
• Multi-country rules. Implement plan rules and payment logic so that country-specific behavior is configuration rather than code branches, working with the Rules & Country Config Lead and the business SMEs.
• Business collaboration. Demonstrate working software to the Product Owner and business SMEs in the Tuesday and Thursday demo windows; turn their feedback into backlog items the same week.
• Review. Review other engineers' changes with the same rigor applied to your own; act as reviewer of record on every merge you approve. AI review is a second pass, never the gate.
Required skills and experience
• 7+ years professional software engineering with C# as the primary language; 3+ years building and operating .NET microservices in production.
• Very comfortable with agentic AI development tools as the default way of working — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot agent mode or equivalent — including context and prompt management for a large codebase.
• Evaluation-driven and test-driven design and development as an ingrained practice, not a preference: defines what correct looks like before writing or generating code.
• Highly quality-oriented: demonstrable history of owning the full range of work for a feature and being accountable for it working on integration, in a team with no separate test function.
• Strong flow discipline: keeps Kanban boards accurate daily, respects WIP limits, documents work as it happens, applies programming standards consistently — and expects the same of peers.
• Working proficiency with SonarQube (or equivalent) as part of the definition of done: reads and acts on quality-gate results, coverage, code smells and security hotspots.
• Automated testing across the pyramid: unit frameworks (xUnit / NUnit), consumer-driven contract testing (Pact), browser end-to-end (Playwright).
• Trunk-based development with feature flags and continuous delivery pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent).
• Cloud-native delivery on GCP (or Azure / AWS with a willingness to work on GCP): containers, managed data services, secrets and identity.
• API design and enterprise integration patterns; experience integrating with SAP or another large ERP.
• Comfortable demonstrating working software to non-technical business users and taking direct feedback.
Agentic AI expectations
• Works AI-first on well-specified tasks: implementation from acceptance criteria, test generation, data mapping, migration scripts, documentation drafts — with the evaluation criteria defined before generation.
• Uses AI for comprehension of the inherited codebase and for refactoring proposals, and verifies every proposal against tests and SonarQube before merging it.
• Understands and applies the team's guardrails: AI never merges, AI never touches production data, AI-assisted changes are traceable, and business-rule interpretation is a human decision.
• Can explain to a business SME what was AI-generated and what was engineered, and why it does not change the quality bar.
Nice-to-have
• Pensions, benefits, payroll or payments domain experience — vesting, forfeiture, distribution, settlement.
• Rules-engine implementation experience.
• Exposure to SAP ECC / EhP8 interfaces (IDoc, BAPI, OData).
• Mutation testing, property-based testing or other techniques that test the tests.
Duration
Full-time from mobilization through cutover and hypercare. Candidates should expect to continue into the Capgemini managed-service team at reduced allocation.
Success measures
• First slice integrated, in Pre-Production and reviewed by the business by end of month 2.
• Every merged change carries its own tests and passes the SonarQube quality gate; pipeline pass rate on first attempt above 90% as steady state.
• Kanban board reflects true state at every daily check; no item ages past the team's limit without a documented reason.
• Integration defects attributable to owned slices found in joint test windows, not in Gate 4 or hypercare.
• Inherited modules evaluated with a written keep / remediate / replace decision by end of month 2.
• Zero Sev-1 or Sev-2 defects escaping to production from owned slices during hypercare.

Design and develop AI-powered applications using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).

Build multi-agent systems using modern Agent Frameworks.

FAISS

Description:
Job Title: Data Analyst
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Pune
Department: Customer & Retail Analytics
Employment Type: Full-time
About FedEx: FedEx provides customers and businesses worldwide with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services and also serves our customers through our retail presence. We foster an environment of growth and learning, where innovative ideas are encouraged, and diverse teams are valued for their contributions. As part of our commitment to excellence, were seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join our analytics team.
Job Summary: As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in gathering, processing, and analyzing data to drive informed decision-making and actionable insights for FedEx. Your quantitative expertise and business acumen will help develop analytical solutions to improve operations, customer experience, and business outcomes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to develop meaningful data analysis, insights summarizations/ visualizations and communicate findings that guide strategy and operational decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets using Python and SQL to support business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, formulate analytic solutions, and provide actionable insights.
Develop and maintain data models and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
Create meaningful data visualizations to communicate findings, trends, and actionable insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for business improvement.
Support data quality initiatives, ensuring accuracy and consistency across data sources.
Utilize statistical and quantitative techniques to support problem-solving and business optimization efforts.
Mandatory Skills:
Python: Proficiency in data manipulation, data analysis libraries (Pandas, NumPy), and data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
SQL: Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and complex queries.
Business Acumen: Ability to understand business context and objectives, aligning analytics with organizational goals.
Quantitative Aptitude: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
Data Visualization: Basic skills in data visualization to effectively communicate insights.
Statistical Analysis: Foundational understanding of statistical methods (e.g., regression, hypothesis testing).
Communication Skills: Ability to distill complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Good-to-Have Skills:
Power BI: Experience with Power BI for data visualization and report development.
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts for deeper pattern analysis.
Advanced Excel: Skills in advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, and data cleaning for quick analyses.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably within the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and a collaborative mindset.
Join Our Team: If you are passionate about Data analytics to drive business impact and enhance the customer experience, we invite you to join our team at FedEx. Apply now to be part of a dynamic, innovative environment where your skills and expertise will make a difference.
Application Process: To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates will be contacted for further evaluation.

Description:
Job Title: Relationship Manager - CAT - Elite
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance


As a Relationship Manager in the CAT - Elite team, you will be responsible for managing and nurturing relationships with our high-value clients, ensuring that their financial needs are met effectively. Your main focus will be on developing comprehensive financial strategies that align with clients objectives, providing personalized service, and maximizing client satisfaction. You will collaborate closely with various internal teams to deliver exceptional service and drive business growth.

Key Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain strong relationships with high-value clients, understanding their financial goals and needs.
- Provide tailored financial advice and solutions to meet client requirements, including insurance products and investment opportunities.
- Conduct regular client meetings to review portfolios, discuss market trends, and assess client satisfaction.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely and effective service delivery.
- Identify new business opportunities and drive customer acquisition through referrals and networking.
- Monitor client portfolios and recommend adjustments to align with changing financial situations or goals.
- Stay updated on industry trends, product offerings, and regulatory changes to provide informed advice to clients.

Skills and Qualifications:
- Bachelors degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Proven experience in relationship management, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.
- Strong understanding of insurance products, investment strategies, and financial planning.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with clients.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Proficiency in using CRM systems and MS Office Suite.
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a collaborative team.
- Initiative and proactive approach to managing client relationships and identifying opportunities.

Tools Required:
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software
- Financial modeling tools
- MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
- Market analysis tools and platforms
- Communication tools (email, video conferencing, etc.)

This position offers a unique opportunity for individuals who are passionate about building strong client relationships and helping clients achieve their financial objectives while being part of a dynamic team at Axis Max Life Insurance.

Description:
Job Title: Senior Manager - SAP CO (Controlling) - SAP HANA
Location: [Mumbai ,pune,bangalore]
Department: IT / Finance /
Reports to: Director of ERP Solutions / Head of Finance Systems
Position Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Manager for SAP CO (Controlling) with expertise in SAP S/4 HANA. The Senior Manager will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of the SAP Controlling module within our SAP S/4 HANA environment. This role requires both technical and functional expertise in SAP CO, along with strong leadership abilities to manage a team and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities:
SAP CO (Controlling) Implementation & Optimization:
Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of SAP CO modules (Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Drive system enhancements and process optimizations in SAP CO in the context of SAP S/4 HANA, aligning them with business requirements.
Work closely with business users and other SAP functional teams (e.g., FI, MM, SD) to ensure seamless integration and data consistency across modules.

Project Management:
Manage end-to-end SAP CO module projects including planning, requirements gathering, design, testing, and go-live support.
Oversee SAP CO HANA transformation and migration projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and in budget.
Manage and mentor a team of functional consultants and business analysts.

Team Leadership & Collaboration:
Lead and develop a high-performing team of SAP CO professionals.
Provide guidance on troubleshooting, performance tuning, and solution optimization.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into system functionality.

System Maintenance & Support:
Ensure the continued smooth operation of the SAP CO module by providing technical support and troubleshooting.
Oversee regular system upgrades, patches, and performance tuning for SAP HANA.
Monitor and ensure data integrity and consistency across financial and controlling modules.

Continuous Improvement:
Identify opportunities to enhance SAP CO processes and tools for greater efficiency and accuracy.
Stay updated on the latest SAP innovations, particularly SAP S/4 HANA and best practices in CO and finance modules.

Qualifications:
Experience:
8-12 years of hands-on experience with SAP CO, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership or senior management role.
Extensive experience with SAP S/4 HANA implementation, migration, or optimization in a Controlling context.
Proven track record in managing SAP CO projects, end-to-end implementations, or system enhancements.

Skills:
Strong expertise in SAP CO configuration (Cost Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Experience with SAP FICO integration (FI, MM, SD, etc.).
In-depth knowledge of SAP S/4 HANA features and capabilities related to CO.
Strong project management skills with a solid understanding of Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certifications (e.g., SAP certifications, PMP) are a plus.

Additional Skills/Desirable:
Experience with other SAP modules (e.g., SAP MM, SD, and FI).
Knowledge of financial reporting and compliance requirements.
Ability to work effectively with business users and senior leadership.
Experience with SAP Fiori, SAP Analytics Cloud, or other reporting tools is a plus.

Description:
Data Engineer
Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Gurgaon, Chennai
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Building the machine learning production System(or MLOps) is the biggest challenge most large companies currently have in making the transition to becoming an AI-driven organization. This position is an opportunity for an experienced, server-side developer to build expertise in this exciting new frontier. You will be part of a team deploying state-of-the-art AI solutions for Fractal clients.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
As MLOps Engineer, you will work collaboratively with Data Scientists and Data engineers to deploy and operate advanced analytics machine learning models. You ll help automate and streamline Model development and Model operations. You ll build and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring, and operations. You ll also troubleshoot and resolve issues in development, testing, and production environments.
Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation Develop scalable ML pipelines
Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry
Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML E2E PaaS/SaaS
Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components
Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud(AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem Be an integral part of client business development and delivery engagements across multiple domains.
QUALIFICATIONS: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
3-12 years experience building production-quality software
Strong experience in System Integration, Application Development or DataWarehouse projects across technologies used in the enterprise space
Basic Knowledge of MLOps, machine learning and docker
Object-oriented languages (e.g. Python, PySpark, Java, C#, C++ )
Experience developing CI/CD components for production ready ML pipeline.
Database programming using any flavors of SQL
Knowledge of Git for Source code management
Ability to collaborate effectively with highly technical resources in a fast-paced environment
Ability to solve complex challenges/problems and rapidly deliver innovative solutions
Team handling, problem solving, project management and communication skills & creative thinking
Foundational Knowledge of Cloud Computing either one AWS, Azure or GCP
Hunger and passion for learning new skills
Recommended (not mandatory): completion of Fractal Data Science Professional Certificate" with this - https: / / www.coursera.org / professional-certificates / fractal-data-science
EDUCATION:
B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or related technical degree OR Equivalent.

Description:
As a Digital Transformation Specialist, you will lead a high-impact portfolio, connecting technology and business needs and delivering concrete results. You will be responsible for developing, implementing and executing IT capabilities within this area of expertise, planning and building IT solutions from business functions. You will work in a multinational team, conducting one or more projects/programs, and be the single focal point (SPOC) between IT Technology and the business for these transformation projects/programs. They will also be responsible for interacting with functional leaders and business units to monitor and execute projects/programs.
How you'll make an impact
Execute the PLM strategy, aligning it with digital transformation objectives and driving business value in the engineering and manufacturing areas
Integrate PLM with ERP, MES, and downstream systems, ensuring seamless data flow and process integration
Act as a promoter of the Digital Thread and configuration management, expanding traceability, collaboration and decision-making along the value chain
Optimize cross-functional processes using Lean and Six Sigma, with a focus on BOMs, process plans, roadmaps, and supply chain integration
Engage business and IT stakeholders, capturing complex requirements and facilitating global collaboration
Drive PLM governance and change management, supporting the adoption of new tools and continuous improvement initiatives
Act as a reference expert in PLM, guiding teams and supporting training on platforms such as Windchill or Teamcenter
Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable internal and external standards, procedures and guidelines.
Your background
Relevant experience in IT and digital transformation, with a strong background in Computer Science or Engineering and deep knowledge in PLM systems and strategy
Experience in leading global PLM transformation programs in engineering and manufacturing, with hands-on experience in Windchill, Teamcenter or similar platforms
Advanced knowledge of the processes that connect PLM to manufacturing, including mBOMs, process plans, routings, and integration with ERP and MES
Proven ability to manage third-party vendors and virtual delivery teams on a global scale, ensuring alignment across distributed stakeholders
Application of Lean, Six Sigma and Industry 4.0 concepts for optimization of cross-functional processes in engineering, supply chain, quality and procurement
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English and proven experience in multicultural and multinational environments
Travel availability of up to 30%, supporting deployments at global engineering plants and sites, as well as stakeholder relationships
More about us
We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.
We can provide more information during the recruitment process.

Our benefits offering for this role generally includes:
Private medical care and life insurance
Access to fitness and wellness programs
Access to benefits platform with discounts and perks
Employee Capital Plans (PPK)
Equipment for working from home or allowances for setting up a workplace at home
Spectacles and contact lenses allowance
Company events and team-building activities
Psychological support program
Free parking available
You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.

Description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a Customer Experience Manager to ensure sales process compliance and deliver an excellent customer experience throughout the vehicle purchase and delivery journey.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor adherence to dealership sales processes and escalate deviations to the General Manager.
Track customer satisfaction scores, analyze feedback, identify gaps, and implement corrective actions.
Monitor customer concerns and ensure timely resolution of complaints.
Train and guide the sales team on customer-centric practices and process improvements.
Monitor the pre-delivery process, vehicle condition, documentation, accessories fitment, and delivery readiness.
Ensure timely pre-sales and post-sales customer follow-ups and feedback collection.
Monitor home installation services and customer feedback.
Ensure accurate customer details and tentative delivery dates are recorded in Order Taking Forms (OTFs).
Monitor showroom cleanliness, upkeep, display standards, and customer-facing areas.
Ensure effective customer engagement and follow-up throughout the sales journey.

Eligibility Criteria
Education: Graduate in any discipline.
Experience: 15 years of experience in sales; automobile industry experience preferred.

Required Skills
Strong customer service and relationship management skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Problem-solving and conflict-resolution abilities.
Strong execution, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to analyze customer feedback and drive process improvements.

Description:
Job Summary
Lead Facilitator - Nagaland - East Hub
Location: Kohima, Nagaland
Responsibilities
Design
Ability to design contextualized training structure with new activities and workshops based on local emerging needs and context.
Improvise contents of the workshop in the moment and be aware of the plan / curriculum being only a guiding document.
Converse, make sense and contextualize content of the workshop based on the group.
Facilitation
Keep the process connected to the program goals.
Hold space for the group and individuals to express themselves deeply.
Invite individual and group creativity.
Improvise and be spontaneous in front of a group.
Hold an attitude of welcome and inclusion.
Develop the culture of appreciation.
Managing Strong Emotions in a group (Manage Triggers).
Be able to track the journey of the group and individuals.
Training
Train other facilitators / stakeholders on the Principles / Practices / Processes of facilitation with a minimum of 10-day TOT workshop.
Provide one-on-one mentoring on principles of facilitation.
Accountability
Accountable for ensuring high-quality implementation of the SEL Teacher s Handbook by strengthening the facilitation capacity of SRGs, identifying emerging learning needs, enabling continuous improvement, and supporting coherence across implementation partners.
Accountable for nurturing a facilitative culture of reflection, appreciation, feedback, and collaborative learning within the team and across stakeholders. Accountable for making thoughtful real-time facilitation and design decisions that respond to emerging group needs while remaining aligned to programme intent.
Accountable for independent designing, facilitating, and adapting sessions based on the context.
Delivering complex facilitation spaces in alignment with program goals.
Accountable for mentoring peers, managing emotions in groups, and building a culture of feedback, reflection, and appreciation.
Supports cross-team alignment and champions inclusion and care in all spaces held.
Accountability for quality, alignment, and transformation - ensuring that sessions stay connected to program goals and that spaces remain inclusive, adaptive, and deeply engaging.
Qualifications
Be able to facilitate with young people and adults.
Be able to facilitate / train both in in-person and on-line modes.
Be able to recognize the needs of the program, people, and deliverables, and respond effectively keeping the core values of Dream a Dream in mind.
Ability to solve problems, make decisions independently and take initiative.
Focus and invest in developing the Being of a facilitator.
Designing, developing, and contextualizing the workshops and content, meeting the needs of the target audience.
Be able to hold space for the people, team, and target audience, where they feel heard, seen and respected for who they are.
Design and deliver by applying the Arc of Transformation in workshops / trainings.
Have creative practice of their own.
Experience
Minimum 5 years of experience in facilitation and training roles within education or nonprofit sectors, focusing on complex program management and strategic partnerships.
Earlier experience of working in Northeast or Nagaland with knowledge of local culture, landscape, and language (Nagamese) will be an advantage.
Travel Requirement
This role requires flexibility to travel locally and nationally based on program needs.
General Responsibilities
Contribute to East Hub and state strategy and cross-state learning.
Collaborate with other internal teams.
Uphold Dream a Dream's values of equity, dignity, and inclusion.
Travel across different parts of the state as required.

Description:
Trainee, Program Implementation
Location: Nagaland, Haryana
About Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical
Antarang Foundation runs 2 programs: 1) Career Aware with students of municipal schools and low-income private schools studying in 9th and 10th standard across Mumbai, Pune, Udaipur and Goa. 2) Career Ready with students of low-income private junior colleges studying in 11th and 12th standard across our five geographies. The role of Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical is to provide end to end support to the facilitators and partner schools/colleges to be able to deliver the program with the required quality. From orienting the schools/colleges at the start of the year, distributing the books/materials to them, allocation of facilitators, to ensure data comes back on a timely basis and gets scanned and uploaded on to our systems, we do it all.
Position Overview
If you have a knack for management, multi-tasking, problem solving coupled with the traits like consistency, spontaneity and dependability, this is the place you may want to be in.
This position is an opportunity for you to impact the career journeys of more than 60,000 young adults and you will need to do everything to make their experience with us, a smooth and memorable one. You will specifically have a very important role in working with our High-tech OMR scanner to ensure student information gets uploaded on our systems timely and accurately. This is a Full-time position and requires an dependable and committed candidate who has an eye for detail.
Responsibilities
Data Management and Upload (PRIMARY): Ensuring filled OMR sheets come back on a timely basis from facilitators
Checking if the sheets are filled as expected, else getting it rectified with facilitators
Scanning approx 2000 sheets per hour on our high tech scanner and and doing minor troubleshooting if required
Operations and Administration: Sorting and Packaging of student books and getting it couriered to schools
Operations and Administration: Managing the storage of books and scanned OMRs and optimum utilization of office space.
Operations and Administration: Packaging of gifts/momentos if required and couriering it to all the Headmasters
Operations and Administration: Maintaining the inventory of medium wise books and other program Related materials
Vendor Management: Coordinating with the vendors (Courier, Books printing and Scanner) to get the tasks done
Vendor Management: Maintaining the bills/invoices and submitting it to the Finance department
Communication: Coordinating with Headmasters to share the progress and solve for the issues Escalate it on a timely basis to ensure speedy resolution of the same
Communication: Keeping the internal teams looped in to seek their support and inputs
Communication: Writing emails to the stakeholders in reference to the task in hand
Student Support and Tracking: Making student support calls to collect information and tracking their journeys post of our programs
Student Support and Tracking: Maintaining, updating the database with the same and preparing reports
Student Support and Tracking: Interpreting data from dashboards and reporting trends to the team.
Profile Requisites
Minimum 1-year commitment required with 8.5 hrs per day
Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks
Clear verbal and written communication, knowledge of local language
Tech Savvy (comfortable using Microsoft Office; confident of learning to operate scanners, dashboards)
Ability to do a certain task multiple times with focus without getting bored
Readiness to give hand and feet support even at odd hours (if and when required).

Description:
Field Enumerators (15 Posts): Position Summary:
We are seeking dedicated and enthusiastic Field Enumerators to conduct baseline assessments for students in primary schools. The successful candidates will visit schools, interact with children to make them feel comfortable, ask assessment questions, and accurately record their responses using a provided tool. This role requires excellent communication skills, proficiency in English, and the ability to use technology effectively. Prior experience working with primary-grade children is highly desirable.
Key Responsibilities:
Visit assigned schools to conduct baseline assessments with students.
Create a welcoming and comfortable environment for children to ensure accurate and honest responses.
Ask assessment questions as per the guidelines and record responses using the designated tool.
Ensure accuracy and completeness of recorded data.
Report any issues or inconsistencies encountered during the assessments to the project supervisor.
Maintain the confidentiality and integrity of the data collected.
Adhere to the schedule and complete the assessments within the stipulated timeframe.
Utilize technology tools efficiently to record and manage data.
Communicate effectively with school staff and maintain a professional demeanor at all times.
Qualifications/Requirements:
Must have a two-wheeler to travel to conduct the assessments
Proficiency in English (both written and spoken) is a mandatory requirement.
Proficiency in the local language is required.
Basic knowledge and experience in using tech tools and software.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to make children feel at
ease.
Attention to detail and accuracy in data recording.
Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.
Flexibility to travel to various school locations as required.
High school diploma or equivalent; higher education in education, psychology, or a
related field is a plus point.
Functional area:
Chozuba Block, Dist. Phek
Employment type:
Temporary/Contract
Salary:
450 INR per day + 250 INR Travel allowance

Description:
Job role
A field service engineer's responsibilities usually focus on the the interaction of multiple technical systems and components and software. They are often seen performing direct maintenance or repairs on complex technology systems. Field service engineers' responsibilities may include, for example: Troubleshooting problems.
Job role
1.On-Site Maintenance and Repairs: Conduct regular inspections, maintenance, and repairs on a wide range of oil and gas equipment, including fuel dispensers and other types of equipment at retail outstations like Petrol pumps, to ensure their optimal performance and minimize downtime.
2.Troubleshooting: Diagnosing and troubleshooting complex technical issues that may arise during the operation of equipment, utilizing a deep understanding of the specific systems and processes involved in our industry.
3. Installation and Commissioning: Assisting with the installation, configuration, and commissioning of new equipment (fuel dispensers and other types of equipment at retail outstations like Petrol pumps), ensuring that it operates according to specified guidelines and safety standards.
4.Customer Support: Providing technical support and guidance to clients or customers, addressing their concerns, and offering solutions to maximize the efficiency and safety of their operations.
5.Safety Compliance: Ensuring that all work performed adheres to industry safety standards and regulations, and identifying potential safety hazards or risks to prevent accidents and promote a secure working environment.
6.Documentation and Reporting: Maintaining detailed records of service activities, including maintenance schedules, repairs performed, and any modifications made, and providing comprehensive reports to supervisors or management as required.
7.Training and Knowledge Sharing: Attending training sessions or workshops to enhance the understanding of equipment operations, maintenance procedures, and safety protocols.
8.Field Operations Coordination: Collaborating with other team members, including engineers, technicians, and project managers, to coordinate field operations, prioritize tasks, and ensure timely and effective resolution of technical issues.
9.Adherence to Company Policies: Following company policies and protocols, including those related to quality control, health, safety, and environmental protection, to uphold the organization's reputation and maintain high operational standardsRole & responsibilities

Description:
Job Summary
NagaEd is seeking a Program Manager to lead the implementation, monitoring evaluation (ME), and stakeholder engagement for a portfolio of school education programs in rural areas. Based in Nagaland, this role is crucial in ensuring that these programs are delivered effectively, aligned with community needs, and contribute to improving teaching quality and school outcomes. The Program Manager will work closely with schools, teachers, government bodies, and communities to ensure smooth execution across programs. The role will involve managing junior team members, contributing to program design, and ensuring that stakeholder voices are integrated into program implementation and improvements.
Organisational Unit Function
1. Program Implementation
Oversee and coordinate the implementation of a portfolio of education programs and school improvement initiatives in rural schools across the assigned districts.
Ensure all program interventions align with state and national education policies (e.g., NEP 2020).
Support teacher training sessions and ensure schools adopt best practices across programs.
Identify and resolve challenges in program execution, ensuring smooth rollout of each initiative.
Work collaboratively with internal teams to provide field-level insights that refine program strategies.
2. Monitoring Evaluation (ME)
Track progress against objectives and key performance indicators (KPIs) for each program.
Conduct field visits to monitor teacher effectiveness, student learning, and school improvements across the program portfolio.
Collect and analyze qualitative and quantitative data to measure program impact.
Prepare reports and case studies to document lessons learned and best practices.
Provide insights and recommendations for program adjustments based on findings.
3. Stakeholder Community Engagement
Serve as the key liaison between NagaEd, school administrators, teachers, and local communities.
Organize meetings, focus groups, and discussions to gather stakeholder feedback on program delivery.
Ensure community voices are integrated into program design, delivery, and ongoing improvements.
Work closely with local government education authorities, NGOs, and community leaders to build support for interventions.
Act as a bridge between stakeholders and NagaEd's internal teams, ensuring two-way communication.
4. Team Supervision Support
Provide guidance and manage junior program staff supporting field activities.
Foster a collaborative and supportive work environment, ensuring team members have the resources needed for success.
Ensure smooth coordination between field teams and internal teams across all programs.
Reporting Relationships
Reports to: Director
Supervises: Junior Program Officers, Field Coordinators (if applicable)
Communications (Internal/External)
School Administrators; Teachers - Implement training, ensure school adoption of interventions across programs
Government Education Authorities - Align programs with policies, secure support
Community Leaders; Parents - Gather feedback and ensure community involvement in education initiatives
NagaEd Team (Program Design, ME, and Training Teams) - Share field insights to refine interventions across the program portfolio
Selection Criteria
Essential
3+ years of experience in program management, implementation, stakeholder engagement, or ME.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Education, Social Work or a related field.
Strong coordination and field-level execution skills, ensuring smooth program implementation.
Experience in data collection, analysis, and reporting for ME activities.
Ability to liaise with local communities, education authorities, and school leaders.
Strong interpersonal skills, able to facilitate discussions and consultations with diverse stakeholders.
Willingness to be based in Nagaland, and travel to rural schools.
Desirable
Experience working in teacher training or school improvement programs.
Prior experience in community-driven program implementation.
Job Details
Location: Kohima
Probation: 3 Months

Description:
Department: Mission SOAR Nagaland
Reports To: Academic Lead
Location: Kohima


Purpose of the Position
Academic Manager will support the Academic Lead in coordinating academic design and capacity-building activities under Mission SOAR Nagaland. The role ensures timely consolidation of inputs from ecosystem partners, government stakeholders, and field educators into actionable frameworks, materials, and training resources. The Academic Manager will provide critical operational and project management support to enable the Academic Lead to focus on pedagogical quality and stakeholder alignment.


Organisational Unit Function
Support the Academic Lead in consolidating frameworks, lesson plans, assessments, and training resources.
Coordinate with SCERT, DIETs, and other state institutions for feedback and approvals.
Track design timelines and milestones, ensuring timely delivery of academic outputs.
Manage quality control documentation and review cycles across partners.
Support facilitation of co-design workshops and training sessions.
Organize academic content for dissemination through DIKSHA or other platforms.
Maintain records of academic interventions, iterations, and evidence of impact.
Prepare inputs and updates for governance and reporting processes.


Reporting Relationships
This role reports to the Academic Lead (with dotted-line coordination with the Programs Lead).


Selection Criteria

Essential
Postgraduate degree with 7 years of program/academic coordination experience.
Familiarity with curriculum design, training programs, or education reform.
Strong project management and organisational skills.
Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder coordination abilities.
Ability to manage timelines and quality assurance processes.
Experience with educational technology platforms is desirable.

Description:
Position: Regional Head Northeast: Manipur, Nagaland and Assam (Programmes, Partnerships & Business)

About Dharmalife
Dharmalife (www.dharmalife.in) is a social impact organization advancing inclusive progress across India through two core pillars — People and Planet. Working in over 40,000 villages across 15 states, it has built a rural network of 20,000+ women entrepreneurs, known as Dharmalife Entrepreneurs (DLEs), who drive sustainable community development.

The organization works alongside women by enhancing their economic power, agency, and leadership, while addressing key social and environmental challenges. Through this network of DLEs, Dharmalife promotes sustainable livelihoods, behaviour change, and solutions across key domains — Health, Well-being, Livelihood, Education, Care, Clean Energy, Sustainability, and Circular Economy.

By 2030, Dharmalife aims to advance 1 million rural women through sustainable livelihoods and care support. Its group entities — Dharmalife Foundation, Gajam India Pvt. Ltd., Dharmalife Labs, and Dharmalife Society — work together to create lasting systemic change at scale.

Position Summary
The Regional Head – Northeast-Manipur, Nagaland and Assam is the senior leadership position in the region responsible for driving Dharmalife’s growth, programme delivery, partnerships, and operational excellence across the region.

The role combines four critical dimensions:
Business and Sales Growth through the Dharmalife Entrepreneur (DLE) network
DLE Group Development and Entrepreneur Ecosystem Strengthening
High-Quality Execution of Donor and CSR-Funded Programmes
Strategic Government and Institutional Partnership Development

The Regional Head serves as the primary representative of Dharmalife within the Northeast region, along with central office functions, and is responsible for achieving commercial, social impact, operational, and stakeholder engagement objectives across all assigned districts

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Growth & Revenue Generation
Drive state-level sales and revenue targets across region, across Dharmalife products, services, and programme-linked business opportunities.
Strengthen entrepreneur productivity, customer outreach, and market penetration.
Develop district-wise growth plans and sales strategies.
Monitor sales conversion, order fulfilment, collections, inventory movement, and business performance.
Identify new business opportunities and market expansion areas.
Improve DLE earnings and income-generating opportunities.
Drive sustainable business growth through community-based distribution models.

2. DLE (Dharmalife Entrepreneur) Network Development & Community Engagement
Lead recruitment, onboarding, activation, and retention of DLEs and DLTs.
Build and strengthen village-level DLE groups and entrepreneur collectives.
Increase active participation and engagement of women entrepreneurs.
Develop leadership capabilities among high-potential DLEs.
Ensure regular field engagement, group meetings, and entrepreneur support.
Improve entrepreneur retention and productivity.

3. Programme & Project Execution
Lead implementation of donor-funded and CSR-supported programmes across the Northeast.
Ensure achievement of programme deliverables, timelines, budgets, and impact indicators.
Monitor beneficiary outreach, training completion, adoption metrics, and community engagement.
Ensure high-quality implementation across Health, Livelihood, Education, Care, Clean Energy, Sustainability, Circular Economy, and future programmes.
Maintain programme documentation, field evidence, case studies, and reporting standards.
Support surveys, assessments, research activities, audits, and donor visits.
Ensure safeguarding, compliance, and quality standards are maintained.

4. Government & Strategic Partnerships
Develop strategic relationships with: State Rural Livelihood Missions (SRLMs); Women & Child Development Department; Labour Department; Education Department; Tribal Development Department; Skill Development Missions; Renewable Energy Agencies; District Administration; and Panchayati Raj Institutions
Build partnerships with CSR foundations, corporate partners, financial institutions, NGOs, development organizations, Academic and research institutions
Identify opportunities for programme convergence, co-funding, and scale-up.
Represent Dharmalife at state-level/ region level forums, consultations, and stakeholder meetings.
Facilitate approvals, coordination, and institutional support for programme implementation.

5. Team Leadership, Governance & Operations
Lead and mentor Territory Channel Managers, Cluster Heads, Enterprise Leaders, and other teams.
Drive performance management, coaching, and capability development.
Conduct regular reviews and field visits.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies and operating procedures.
Monitor budgets, resource utilization, and operational efficiency.
Ensure data quality, reporting discipline, and governance standards.

Candidate Profile

Education
Graduate or Postgraduate in: Rural Management; Business Administration; Social Work; Development Studies and Related disciplines

Experience Required
8–12 years of relevant experience.
Experience in rural markets, social enterprises, development sector, livelihood promotion, microfinance, channel management, CSR, or large-scale field operations.
Proven experience managing multi-district or state-level teams across the region.
Demonstrated success in both programme delivery and business development.
Experience working with government stakeholders and donor-funded programmes will be preferred.

Competencies Required

Leadership Competencies: Strategic Thinking; Execution Excellence; Team Leadership; Ownership & Accountability

Functional Competencies: Rural Market Development; Programme Management; Sales & Business Development; Stakeholder Engagement; Partnership Development; Community Mobilisation; Data-Driven Decision Making;

Behavioural Competencies: Integrity; Collaboration; Resilience; Learning Agility; Entrepreneurial Mindset; Relationship Building

Travel Requirement
This position requires extensive travel across the Northeast, including regular visits to the Head office (Delhi), villages, DLE groups, programme sites, government offices, partner organizations, and district headquarters. Field immersion and direct stakeholder engagement are critical success factors for this role.

Why Join Dharmalife
This role is a chance to lead one of India's largest women-led rural entrepreneurship and impact ecosystems and to directly contribute to livelihoods, sustainability, community development, and social transformation at scale.
AboutCompany: Dharmalife is a grassroot level social impact organization committed to fostering inclusive progress for both people and the planet. Its initiatives are driven by women change agents, known as Dharmalife Entrepreneurs (DLEs), and are supported by data-driven insights, innovative approaches, and technology. Operating through a network of over 20,000 rural women entrepreneurs across 40,000 villages in 15 states, Dharmalife has positively impacted more than 17.5 million individuals, including 500,000 children. We aim to enhance womens economic autonomy and leadership while promoting sustainable practices, thereby contributing to the creation of resilient communities. By 2030, Dharmalife aims to empower 1 million rural women through sustainable employment, livelihood growth, and care support.

Job Summary
Digital Marketing Associate (1 Post): Manage and strengthen our online sales operations across e-commerce platforms, preferably Amazon. The role involves managing product listings, improving product visibility, driving online sales, and coordinating with entrepreneurs and internal teams to ensure smooth marketplace operations.


Requirements
Graduate in any discipline; a background in business, marketing, commerce, or a related field is desirable.
Prior experience in e-commerce operations or online marketplace management, preferably Amazon Seller Central.
Understanding of product listings, catalogue management, inventory, order fulfilment, and online sales.
Knowledge of e-commerce advertising, promotional campaigns, and sales analytics.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for sales tracking, reporting, and data analysis.
Strong analytical, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple products, stakeholders, and deadlines independently.
Experience working with food products, handloom, handicrafts, MSMEs, or rural enterprises will be an advantage.
Basic product photography, image editing, or Canva skills are desirable
Freshers with skills or knowledge in the above-mentioned requirements can also apply


Key Responsibilities
Manage product listings, catalogue updates, pricing, and inventory across e-commerce platforms, preferably Amazon Seller Central.
Oversee order processing, packaging, dispatch, returns, and customer enquiries to ensure smooth marketplace operations.
Plan, execute, and monitor e-commerce advertising and promotional campaigns to improve product visibility and drive online sales.
Monitor marketplace account health, resolve operational issues, and coordinate with platform support teams.
Track payments, reconcile settlements, and maintain accurate sales and financial records.
Analyse sales trends, SKU performance, advertising results, and conversion rates to identify opportunities for business growth.
Coordinate with entrepreneurs to collect product information, monitor stock availability, and ensure timely order fulfilment.
Facilitate the onboarding of new entrepreneurs, brands, and products onto e-commerce platforms.
Prepare regular sales, performance, and progress reports for internal reviews, donors, and programme partners.
Maintain accurate records of entrepreneur onboarding, product listings, sales, and market-access outcomes to support programme monitoring and donor reporting.
Coordinate with internal teams to collect data, document achievements, and ensure timely submission of programme and donor reports.


Functional Area
Chumoukedima


Employment Type
Full Time
Working Hours: 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Working Days: Monday to Saturday

Description:
Job Summary
The Employment Livelihood Supervisor will be responsible for supporting the implementation, supervision, and monitoring of employment, livelihood, skilling, entrepreneurship, and value-chain development initiatives across Nagaland.
The role will work closely with youth, entrepreneurs, producers, community groups, artisans, trainees, government departments, financial institutions, corporates, development partners, and other stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of programmes and achievement of project outcomes.
Responsibilities
Employment Livelihood Programme Implementation: Support the planning and implementation of Employment Livelihood programmes and projects.
Coordinate day-to-day field activities and ensure timely achievement of programme targets.
Supervise programme activities across assigned locations and ensure compliance with project plans and guidelines.
Identify implementation challenges and coordinate with the concerned team for timely resolution.
Livelihood Value-Chain Development: Support the implementation and strengthening of various livelihood value chains promotion.
Work with producers, entrepreneurs, community groups, and other stakeholders across different stages of the value chain, including production, processing, value addition, packaging, marketing, and market linkage.
Support initiatives related to Banana Fibre, Pineapple Fibre, and other livelihood enterprises.
Assist in identifying opportunities for improving productivity, product development, market access, and income generation.
Document challenges, learnings, innovations, and success stories from livelihood interventions.
Financial Institution-Supported Initiatives: Support the implementation and field-level coordination of programmes undertaken in collaboration with development and financial institutions.
Coordinate with beneficiaries, entrepreneurs, producer groups, community institutions, and project stakeholders.
Ensure that project activities and deliverables are implemented in accordance with approved plans and timelines.
Support beneficiary identification, mobilisation, training, enterprise development, monitoring, and reporting.
Maintain accurate project records and supporting documentation as required by partners and funding agencies.
Youth Mobilisation Employment Support: Mobilise youth for employment, skill development, entrepreneurship, and livelihood opportunities.
Conduct outreach activities in communities, educational institutions, training centres, and other relevant locations.
Support career guidance, job-readiness, and employment-related activities.
Facilitate linkages between youth and relevant employers, training institutions, and livelihood opportunities.
Track employment and livelihood outcomes of programme participants.
Enterprise Entrepreneur Support: Provide field-level support to aspiring and existing entrepreneurs.
Assist entrepreneurs in identifying opportunities, challenges, and potential market linkages.
Support enterprise development activities, including business planning, capacity building, product development, and market access.
Coordinate with relevant technical experts, financial institutions, and market partners where required.
Field Supervision Stakeholder Coordination: Conduct regular field visits to monitor programme activities and beneficiary progress.
Supervise field staff, mobilisers, trainers, and other project personnel, as assigned.
Build and maintain relationships with government departments, financial institutions, employers, educational institutions, community organisations, producer groups, and other stakeholders.
Represent in field-level meetings, workshops, consultations, exhibitions, and other programme events.
Monitoring, Documentation Reporting: Maintain accurate records of beneficiaries, enterprises, training activities, production, employment, placements, and livelihood outcomes.
Collect, verify, and maintain programme data and supporting documentation.
Prepare regular field visit reports, progress reports, case studies, success stories, and other project documentation.
Track project indicators, milestones, outputs, and outcomes against approved targets.
Support the preparation of reports and updates required by YouthNet s partners and funding agencies.
Market Linkages Promotion: Support market linkage initiatives for products developed through livelihood value chains.
Assist in identifying potential buyers, institutional markets, retailers, distributors, and other market opportunities.
Support exhibitions, fairs, product showcases, buyer-seller meets, and promotional activities.
Coordinate with relevant teams on branding, packaging, marketing, and product promotion.
Key Deliverables
Timely and effective implementation of assigned Employment Livelihood projects.
Achievement of beneficiary, training, employment, enterprise, and livelihood targets.
Effective field-level implementation of financial institution-supported initiatives.
Strengthened livelihood value chains.
Increased participation of youth and communities in sustainable livelihood and employment opportunities.
Improved market and institutional linkages for livelihood enterprises.
Accurate and timely programme data, documentation, and reporting.
Regular field monitoring and follow-up with beneficiaries and stakeholders.
Documentation of programme outcomes, success stories, and lessons learned.
Qualifications Requirements
Bachelor s degree in Development Studies, Social Work, Rural Development, Management, Economics, Sociology, Agriculture, Entrepreneurship, or a related field.
2-4 years of relevant experience in livelihood development, employment, entrepreneurship, skill development, value-chain development, community development, or programme implementation.
Experience working with development organisations, government programmes, financial institutions, NGOs, CSR programmes, or donor-funded projects will be an advantage.
Experience in livelihood value chains, enterprise development, market linkages, or community-based programmes will be preferred.
Familiarity with the socio-economic and livelihood context of Nagaland will be an advantage.
Key Skills Competencies
Employment and livelihood programme implementation
Value-chain and enterprise development
Field supervision and community mobilisation
Youth engagement and employment facilitation
Stakeholder and partner coordination
Market linkage and business development
Monitoring, data collection, and reporting
Team coordination and problem-solving
Strong written and verbal communication
MS Office/Google Workspace proficiency
Willingness to undertake frequent field travel across Nagaland
Personal Attributes
Strong ownership and accountability
Proactive and solution-oriented approach
Good interpersonal and community engagement skills
Ability to work with diverse stakeholders
Strong organisational and coordination skills
Adaptability to field-based working environments
Commitment to youth development, employment generation, and sustainable livelihoods
Employment type
Full Time
Notes
For Queries - Working Hours: Monday to Friday (10:00 am to 4:30 pm)
Or you can upload your resume via WhatsApp and one of our YouthNet Job Centre Representatives will call you back
