Description:
Greetings from Stylam Industries Limited !

Business Development Executive (Export Sales)
Department: Export Sales / International Business

Industry Preference: Laminates / Plywood / HPL / Building Materials / Manufacturing / Export Industry

1. Job Purpose
To develop international business opportunities, generate export sales leads, identify potential overseas distributors and customers, and drive revenue growth by promoting the company's laminate, HPL and allied product portfolio across international markets.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities
Identify and develop new international customers, distributors, dealers, importers and project-based business opportunities.
Generate export sales leads through online platforms, trade portals, LinkedIn, exhibitions and international business networks.
Promote the company's product portfolio, including Decorative Laminates, HPL and other allied products in overseas markets.
Prepare quotations, commercial proposals, Proforma Invoices and follow up with international customers for order closures.
Coordinate with existing international customers to develop long-term business relationships and achieve repeat orders.
Conduct market research to identify new geographical markets, competitors, pricing trends and business opportunities.
Coordinate with internal teams for product samples, pricing approvals, order processing and shipment schedules.
Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery conditions and other commercial requirements with international customers.
Follow up on enquiries, quotations, customer requirements and pending orders to ensure business conversion.
Achieve assigned export sales targets, customer acquisition targets and revenue objectives.

3. Key Skills Required
International Business Development
Export Sales & Lead Generation
International Customer Acquisition
Distributor & Dealer Development
Export Documentation Knowledge
International Market Research
Negotiation & Commercial Skills
CRM & Sales Pipeline Management
Communication & Presentation Skills
Sales Target Achievement

4. Educational Qualifications
MBA in International Business / Marketing or Graduate in Commerce / Business Administration.
Good command of written and spoken English.
Knowledge of international trade practices and export procedures.

5. Preferred Candidate Profile
3+ years of experience in export sales or international business development.
Experience in building materials, laminates, plywood, HPL or related manufacturing industries preferred.
Exposure to international markets, distributors, importers and overseas customer handling.
Knowledge of export pricing, Incoterms, international payments and basic export documentation.
Willingness to travel internationally, wherever required.
AboutCompany:
Stylam Industries Limited is a leading manufacturer and supplier of high-quality laminates, exterior claddings, and adhesives. The company has a strong presence in the construction and interior design industry and is known for its innovative and durable products.
Established in 1991, Stylam Industries has grown to become a trusted name in the laminate and cladding industry. The company is committed to using cutting-edge technology and sustainable practices to produce a wide range of decorative laminates, compact laminates, door skins, and exterior claddings, catering to the diverse needs of architects, interior designers, and builders.
Stylam Industries emphasizes quality and design, offering a variety of surface finishes, textures, and patterns to meet the aesthetic and functional requirements of residential, commercial, and industrial projects. The company's adherence to international quality standards and continuous product innovation has earned it a strong reputation in domestic and international markets.
In addition to its product offerings, Stylam Industries Limited is known for its customer-centric approach, providing comprehensive support, technical expertise, and customized solutions to its clients. The company's commitment to sustainability is reflected in its environmentally responsible manufacturing processes and eco-friendly product options.
Overall, Stylam Industries Limited continues to be a frontrunner in the laminate and cladding industry, known for its commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction.
CompanyAddress: Plot No.192-193 Phase I, Industrial Area Panchkula , PANCHKULA, Haryana, India

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Senior Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
GOV: Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Minimum 5 years of experience in consulting, advisory, strategy, research, analytics, policy, or project management. Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. Experience in conducting research, stakeholder engagement, interviews, and quantitative and qualitative analysis. Excellent communication, report-writing, and presentation development skills. Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment and manage diverse stakeholders. Strong client management and project coordination skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other analytical and reporting tools. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality outcomes. Experience in government advisory, public policy, economic development, institutional strengthening, or transformation projects will be an added advantage. Engage with clients to understand business challenges and deliver practical, evidence-based solutions. Support the planning, execution, and monitoring of consulting and advisory assignments across government, public sector, and private sector engagements. Conduct market assessments, policy research, stakeholder consultations, and data analysis to generate meaningful insights and recommendations. Prepare high-quality reports, presentations, strategy papers, business cases, and other client deliverables. Develop financial, operational, and impact assessments to support informed decision-making. Work closely with project teams, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. Build and maintain strong client relationships while ensuring high standards of service and professionalism.
Skills and attributes
To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
Any Post Graduation
Experience
5+ years of overall experience
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
About Us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team:

Oil & Gas. This team is directly responsible for growth of Oil and Gas offline transactions & users at Paytm.

About the role:

Team Lead KAM - To work with the business to understand and manage Programs being run for the Clients/Brands. And for accelerating the core growth metrics focusing on sales & distribution. Provides guidance and instruction to a working group about a project or portfolio of projects. These leads are responsible for monitoring the efforts of the team members and getting the work done effectively and efficiently with the proper utilization of resources.

Skills that will help you succeed in this role:

2+ yrs. of experience in Distribution sales in fintech, Banking/ Sales, EDC Sales.
Develop plans and strategies for developing business and achieving the company's sales goals.

Create a culture of success and ongoing business and goal achievement.
Hire and build a new team to support our growing needs and future projects.
Define optimal sales force structure.

Define and coordinate sales training programs that enable staff to achieve their potential and support company sales objectives.

Manage customer expectations and contribute to a high level of customer satisfaction.

Define sales processes that drive desired sales outcomes and identify improvements.

Going to the Merchant and educating him/her about the benefits of the Swipe machine (EDC) converting them and managing their accounts.

Exceptional communication, presentation skills and relationship building skills.

Ability to aggressively manage the successful execution of a sales strategy.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree

Should have a strong understanding of the local language.

Self-motivated and goal-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients and attend industry events.

Education: Applicants must possess bachelors degree or above

Why join us:

We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that is how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India

Description:
Designation: Senior Associate NOC L2
Experience: 25 Years
Qualification: BE/B.Tech/MCA preferred
Certification: CCNA/CCNP preferred

Key Roles & Responsibilities
Monitor and manage network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, wireless access points, and ISP links, to ensure high network availability and performance.
Perform advanced network troubleshooting using tools such as Ping, Traceroute, packet analysis, and network monitoring dashboards.
Diagnose and resolve complex Layer 2 network issues, including VLAN misconfigurations, Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) problems, port errors, and trunking issues.
Investigate and resolve network connectivity problems, including network loops, broadcast storms, link failures, packet loss, and high latency.
Configure and manage network switches, VLANs, access/trunk ports, and other Layer 2 network configurations as per operational requirements.
Implement and maintain network segmentation through VLAN configurations and ensure proper traffic isolation and network security.
Monitor network performance, bandwidth utilization, device health, and network alerts to proactively identify and resolve service degradation.
Act as an escalation point for NOC L1 engineers, providing technical guidance and resolving issues beyond L1 troubleshooting capabilities.
Coordinate with ISPs, internal IT teams, and OEM support teams for troubleshooting, incident resolution, and service restoration.
Assist in network maintenance activities, firmware upgrades, switch replacements, firewall changes, and planned network change activities.
Support network redundancy, failover testing, and high-availability (HA) configurations to ensure business continuity.
Manage network incidents, maintain accurate ticket updates, perform initial root cause analysis (RCA), and ensure incident resolution within defined SLAs.
Collaborate with senior network engineers and architects for network optimization, infrastructure improvements, and capacity planning.
Follow established SOPs, change management procedures, incident escalation matrices, and shift handover processes.
Maintain network documentation, troubleshooting records, configuration backups, incident reports, and daily network health reports.

Required Technical Skills
Advanced Networking Fundamentals: Strong understanding of TCP/IP, OSI Model, IP addressing, subnetting, VLANs, LAN/WAN, DNS, DHCP, and routing concepts.
Layer 2 Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience in troubleshooting VLAN misconfigurations, STP issues, broadcast storms, network loops, trunking problems, and switch port errors.
Network Troubleshooting Tools: Proficiency in Ping, Traceroute, packet flow analysis, and basic packet capture tools such as Wireshark.
Switching & Routing: Working knowledge of Layer 2/Layer 3 switches, VLAN configuration, access/trunk ports, STP, inter-VLAN routing, and basic routing protocols.
Network Monitoring & Performance: Experience with monitoring tools such as PRTG, SolarWinds, or similar NMS platforms for device availability, bandwidth utilization, and performance analysis.
Network Security & Segmentation: Understanding of VLAN-based network segmentation, firewall policies, access control, and secure network configurations.
High Availability & Redundancy: Basic understanding of network redundancy, link failover, HA configurations, and network availability management.
Incident & Escalation Management: Ability to handle L1 escalations, troubleshoot critical incidents, coordinate with stakeholders, and ensure SLA compliance.
ISP & Vendor Coordination: Experience in troubleshooting ISP connectivity, packet loss, latency, and link instability while coordinating with service providers and OEMs.
Technical Documentation: Ability to prepare incident reports, RCA documentation, network diagrams, configuration records, and shift handover reports.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications
BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related discipline preferred.
CCNA certification or equivalent hands-on networking knowledge preferred.
2-5 years of experience in enterprise network operations, NOC L2 support, or network infrastructure management.
Hands-on experience with Cisco Layer 2/Layer 3 switches and enterprise networking environments.
Knowledge of Fortinet FortiGate firewalls, including basic firewall policies, routing, interfaces, and troubleshooting, will be an added advantage.
Understanding of wireless networking, including Wi-Fi access points, SSID configurations, VLAN mapping, and wireless connectivity troubleshooting.
Familiarity with network monitoring tools, incident management systems, and change management processes.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to handle critical network incidents and guide junior NOC engineers.
Willingness to work in 247 rotational shifts as per NOC operational requirements.

Role Expectations
The Senior Associate NOC L2 will be responsible for advanced network troubleshooting, proactive infrastructure monitoring, Layer 2 network configuration, incident resolution, and technical escalation support for NOC L1 engineers.
The role requires strong hands-on networking knowledge, the ability to independently troubleshoot complex connectivity issues, coordinate with ISPs and OEMs, and ensure timely incident resolution within defined SLAs.
The candidate will also support network maintenance, infrastructure upgrades, high-availability testing, and continuous improvement of network stability and operational efficiency.

Job Description-

The Associate IT Security Operations will support the IT Security team in day-to-day security
operations, monitoring, alert handling, ticket management, and coordination with IT teams for
security-related activities.
The role requires a basic understanding of EDR/XDR, DLP, vulnerability and patch
management, along with a strong willingness to learn and work with new cybersecurity
technologies.
Experience
13 years of experience in IT Security, Cybersecurity, SOC, IT Operations, or a related field.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor and support day-to-day IT Security Operations activities.
Monitor and perform initial triage of security alerts from EDR/XDR and DLP platforms.
Have a basic understanding of EDR/XDR concepts, endpoint security alerts, malware
detections, and security incidents.
Support DLP alert monitoring, investigation, and incident closure.
Monitor vulnerability and patch management status and coordinate with IT teams for
remediation.
Track security issues and incidents through the organization's ticketing/ITSM tool such
as ServiceNow or equivalent.
Ensure security tickets and alerts are investigated and updated within defined SLAs.
Support endpoint security activities and identify devices with security-agent or
compliance issues.
Assist senior team members with security incident investigations and remediation
activities.
Prepare basic security operations reports and maintain operational trackers.
Follow defined security SOPs, processes, and escalation procedures.
Work closely with IT Infrastructure, Network, Endpoint, IAM, and other teams for
security remediation.
Stay updated with cybersecurity concepts and demonstrate eagerness to learn and work
with new security technologies and tools.
Technical Understanding
The candidate should have a basic understanding of:
EDR/XDR: CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, Microsoft Defender, or similar
platforms.
DLP: Microsoft Purview, Forcepoint, Symantec/Broadcom, or similar solutions.
Vulnerability Management: Qualys, Tenable/Nessus, Rapid7, or similar tools.
Patch Management: Intune, ManageEngine Endpoint Central, SCCM/MECM, or
equivalent.
Ticketing/ITSM: ServiceNow, Jira, ManageEngine ServiceDesk, or equivalent.
Basic understanding of Windows endpoints, networking, malware, phishing,vulnerabilities, and cybersecurity incidents.

Qualifications & Skills
1–3 years of relevant IT/Security Operations experience.
Basic understanding of cybersecurity and endpoint security concepts.
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Good written and verbal communication.
Ability to follow processes and work within defined SLAs.
Strong willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.
Ability to work effectively with multiple IT and Security teams.
Key Focus
IT Security Operations | EDR/XDR | DLP | Vulnerability & Patch Management | Security Alert
Monitoring | Ticket Management | Incident Support

Description:
Travel: Willingness to travel to offices, warehouses, and other business locations across India
.
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Sr. Associate Network Engineer (L2) to
manage, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure. The
candidate must have hands-on experience with Fortinet FortiGate firewalls, Cisco
switches, Cisco Meraki wireless access points, and FortiAP wireless solutions.
The role involves handling L2 network incidents, troubleshooting complex connectivity
and performance issues, supporting network deployments, coordinating with ISPs and
OEM vendors, and ensuring network availability across corporate offices and
warehouse locations.
Key Responsibilities
1. Firewall Management – Fortinet
Configure, manage, and troubleshoot FortiGate firewalls.
Manage firewall policies, NAT, routing, VLANs, IPsec VPNs, and SSL VPNs.
Monitor firewall health, traffic logs, security events, and resource utilization.
Troubleshoot connectivity, VPN, and policy-related issues.
Support firmware upgrades, configuration backups, and security patching.
Work with FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer for centralized management and log
analysis, where deployed.
2. Switching and Routing – Cisco
Configure and troubleshoot Cisco Layer 2 and Layer 3 switches.

Manage VLANs, trunk ports, access ports, STP, EtherChannel, and inter-VLAN
routing.
Troubleshoot DHCP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, and network connectivity
issues.
Diagnose switching loops, packet drops, port errors, and network latency.
Support switch installation, configuration, replacement, and firmware upgrades.
Maintain network diagrams, IP address records, and configuration backups.
3. Wireless Network Management – Cisco Meraki and FortiAP
Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot Cisco Meraki wireless access points and
FortiAPs.
Manage SSIDs, VLAN mapping, authentication, RF settings, channel allocation,
and transmit power.
Troubleshoot Wi-Fi connectivity, authentication failures, roaming issues,
interference, and high latency.
Analyze wireless client connectivity, signal strength, channel utilization, and
access point performance.
Manage wireless configurations through the Meraki Dashboard and
FortiGate/FortiAP management interfaces, as applicable.
Support wireless surveys, AP installations, coverage validation, and Wi-Fi
optimization at offices and warehouse sites.
4. Network Monitoring and Incident Management
Monitor network infrastructure using tools such as PRTG, SolarWinds, Nagios, or
equivalent platforms.
Investigate alerts, identify root causes, and resolve L2 network incidents within
defined SLAs.
Perform systematic troubleshooting of LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, firewall, and internet
connectivity issues.
Escalate L3 or OEM-dependent issues with detailed troubleshooting evidence.
Prepare incident reports, root cause analysis (RCA), and preventive action plans.
Participate in change management, maintenance windows, and major incident
resolution.
5. Site Deployment and Vendor Coordination
Travel to corporate offices, warehouses, and other business sites for network
deployment and troubleshooting.

Support installation, commissioning, migration, and replacement of firewalls,
switches, and wireless access points.
Coordinate with ISPs, OEMs, and field support teams for fault resolution and
service restoration.
Validate network connectivity, wireless coverage, and infrastructure readiness at
new sites.
Maintain site inventory, network documentation, standard configurations, and
operational checklists.
Required Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience with Fortinet FortiGate firewalls.
Practical experience with Cisco Layer 2/Layer 3 switches.
Mandatory experience with Cisco Meraki Wi-Fi access points and FortiAPs.
Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, subnetting, routing, NAT,
and VPN technologies.
Experience with wireless troubleshooting, RF fundamentals, roaming, and Wi-Fi
performance optimization.
Familiarity with network monitoring tools such as PRTG, SolarWinds, or Nagios.
Working knowledge of incident management, change management, and ticketing
systems.
Ability to use troubleshooting tools such as ping, traceroute, nslookup/dig, packet
captures, and firewall logs.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Ability to handle critical incidents in a fast-paced environment.
Strong documentation, ownership, and follow-up skills.
Working Conditions
Willingness to travel across India as per business requirements.
Flexibility to work in rotational shifts, including nights, weekends, and public
holidays, if required.
Availability for on-call support during critical network outages and business-
impacting incidents.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology,
Electronics, or a related field.
Fortinet NSE/FCP, Cisco CCNA, or relevant networking certifications are an
advantage.
Experience supporting distributed enterprise networks, warehouses, branch
offices, or multi-site infrastructure is preferred.

Description:
SASE Network Security Engineer
Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)

Role Overview
We are seeking a skilled SASE Network Security Engineer to design, implement, operate, and continuously improve our enterprise Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and Security Service Edge (SSE) platform. This role is critical to enabling secure, high-performance connectivity for distributed users, devices, and applications while advancing our Zero Trust security strategy.

The ideal candidate combines deep networking expertise with modern cloud-delivered security capabilities and will play a key role in migrating legacy remote-access and web-proxy solutions to a converged SASE architecture.

Key Responsibilities
Design, deploy, and manage SASE/SSE solutions including Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Firewall-as-a-Service (FWaaS), and threat protection.
Configure and optimize traffic steering, SSL/TLS inspection, client deployment, policy enforcement, and high-availability designs.
Lead migration of legacy VPN, web proxy, and remote-access technologies to cloud-delivered SASE services.
Monitor platform performance, analyze logs and telemetry, troubleshoot complex issues, and drive continuous optimization of security posture and user experience.
Develop automation scripts, infrastructure-as-code approaches, and maintain high-quality technical documentation.
Collaborate with Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, Architecture, Identity, and Operations teams to ensure alignment with Zero Trust principles and enterprise standards.

Required Qualifications
2+ years of experience in network engineering, network security, cloud security, or cybersecurity engineering.
Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating enterprise SASE/SSE platforms (e.g., Zscaler, Netskope,Cisco Secure Access, or equivalent).
Strong understanding of SASE and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) architectures and principles.
Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, Routing and Switching, VPNs (IPsec, SSL/TLS), proxy technologies, and traffic engineering.
Experience with identity federation and authentication (SAML, OIDC, SCIM) and major IdPs (Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD, Okta, etc.).
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid connectivity patterns.
Excellent troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
Vendor certifications (e.g., Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Netskope, Cisco) related to SASE/SSE or network security.
Experience with SD-WAN technologies and integration with SASE.
Knowledge of DLP, CASB advanced features, Remote Browser Isolation (RBI), and threat protection capabilities.
Scripting/automation experience (Python, PowerShell, Terraform, Ansible, or similar).
Experience with SIEM platforms and security monitoring workflows.
Prior experience in large-scale enterprise or regulated environments.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Entry level management position that focuses on successfully accomplishing the daily objectives in the kitchen. Assists in leading staff while personally assisting in all areas of the kitchen, including food production; purchasing and kitchen sanitation. Position contributes to ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Maintains food handling and sanitation standards.
- Performs all duties of Culinary and related kitchen area employees in high demand times.
- Oversees production and preparation of culinary items.
- Ensures employees keep their work areas clean and sanitary.
- Works with Restaurant and Banquet departments to coordinate service and timing of events and meals.
- Complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Communicates areas in need of attention to staff and follows up to ensure follow through.
- Leads shifts while personally preparing food items and executing requests based on required specifications.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Checks the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Assists in determining how food should be presented and creates decorative food displays.
Supporting Culinary Team Activities
- Supervises daily shift operations.
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
- Ensures completion of assigned duties.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, giving feedback as needed.
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Participates in an on-going employee recognition program.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.

Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.

Description:
Role: Business Development Associate (BDA)
Team: Enterprise Team
Reporting: TBD

Core Responsibilities:
Account Management: Onboarding merchants on the platform is the first stage of a long-term relationship between PhonePe and the account. The strength of these relationships, combined with our technology-based solutions, will eventually determine the success of PhonePe in each market in terms of market share and revenue. BDA's task is to develop a deep understanding and relationship with each account that any competitor finds it an uphill task to onboard the merchant account. The incumbent needs to up sell & cross sell new products and services featured in the org such as Smart speaker, EDC machines & tracks certain other products that are suitable for our merchant base. The BDA is expected to engage with merchants and address their queries or escalations, along with Re KYC tracks in a timely manner referring to products & services.

Map Competition: To be able to take timely action, it is imperative that we monitor the market and be informed of competitions initiatives. This will ensure that appropriate response strategies are being formulated and implemented. The BDA must benchmark competition, share best practices internally and ensure that PhonePe always stays one step ahead in the market. The incumbent is expected to own the market or the geography assigned and ensure the health or the portfolio of the merchants.
Qualifications:
12th + Education Qualification.
0-2 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management (enterprise experience preferred).
Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Understanding of CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel).
Skills required:
Excellent written/verbal communication.
Strategic thinking and market research skills.
Resilience and ability to handle rejection.
AboutCompany:
About PhonePe Group:
Phonepe is the leader in the UPI based payments in India with a market share of more than 50.1%. Our goal is to make payments so easy, safe and universally accepted that people never feel the need to carry cash or cards again. We believe India is at the cusp of a new mobile revolution, which will change the way we manage our money on the go. We see ourselves facilitating this change, through technology and dogged customer centricity. PhonePe went live in 2016 and crossed 5 bn transactions on its platform in 2019. Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.

Description:
Lead - Business Development
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.
Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, FTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.
AboutCompany:

The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Knowledge of DataStage components including:
Designer
Director
Administrator
Manager
Parallel Jobs
Sequence Jobs
Understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
Experience in Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting.
Knowledge of source code management tools such as Git.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Job Title: DataStage Developer
Experience: 2-8 Years
Location: PAN India
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a talented IBM DataStage Developer with 23 years of experience in ETL development, data integration, and data warehousing projects. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in IBM InfoSphere DataStage, SQL, and database technologies, with the ability to design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL solutions that support business intelligence and analytics initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy ETL jobs using IBM InfoSphere DataStage.
Develop and maintain data integration workflows for loading data from multiple source systems into data warehouses and data marts.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical ETL solutions.
Implement data cleansing, validation, and transformation logic.
Optimize DataStage jobs for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support UAT activities.
Troubleshoot ETL job failures and resolve production issues.
Work closely with database administrators, business analysts, and data architects.
Maintain technical documentation and adhere to development standards.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance with organizational policies.
Required Skills
2 - 8 years of hands-on experience in IBM InfoSphere DataStage development.
Strong experience in ETL design and development.
Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Knowledge of DataStage components including:
Designer
Director
Administrator
Manager
Parallel Jobs
Sequence Jobs
Understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
Experience in Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting.
Knowledge of source code management tools such as Git.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
AboutCompany:
Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 46 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over three decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.

To learn more about Infosys and see our ideas in action please visit us at www.Infosys.com

Description:
Responsibilities
OE shall be owner of his / her service area in terms of all operations related actions and shall Execute daily service operations with a team of assigned Technicians within a given service areas
Ensure quality of service delivery by effective supervision on technicians - on the job as per company SOPs
Ensure technicians carry out treatment within a given Time on Site (ToS) in a competent manner. (OE to engage technician via route riding, training on the job).
Plan execute 02 TPAs (Technicians Performance Assessment) per assigned technician with 2 development programs per year. Coach train assigned technicians in order to improve the service quality
Convey special instructions, if any, to technicians to execute the job as per Service Docket (liaison with Sales colleagues)
Carry out pest management audits of customer sites as per agreed schedule by i or R auditor.
Complete close customer audit non-conformities (external / internal). Follow up implement CAPA at customer site
On Site Documentation: Implementation of SOP, Compliance and closure of audits non-conformities (Internal / External). Send service dockets of completed services to NKA for invoicing on time.
Handle assigned customer complaints in his / her service areas, within 24 hours resolve complaint at earliest, as per the customers convenience and update the Root Cause in iCABS to ensure proper ticket closure
Identify resolve service delivery issues in coordination with the Branch Manager
Conduct daily 10 min stand up meeting monthly operations meeting
Be conversant with STP (Service Track Pest) and monitor, analyze visit extraction notes for all high infestation related service visits on a daily basis; take action.
Digital Initiative: Be conversant with all in house systems.
Maintain Material consumption, Overtime Hrs. schedule at an agreed targeted level for the assigned service area and for technician
Approval of conveyance amount for assigned technicians
Monitor report to ABM/BM on input costs at all major sites as per gross margin agreed discuss action plans to bring it within limits
Actively drive Service Product Leads for assigned technician group within service area by implementing STA (See, Tell, Ask) and T.I.M.E. (Train, Incentivise, Monitor, Engage) on the job coaching to create density of customers.
Innovation: conduct trials and report findings as per the guidelines, implement new service lines as per the SOPs.
Minimum 18 customer visits per week for Resi SA (Residential Small Accounts segment heavy branch), includes, Customer complaints. For Specific Site based OEs -Number shall not be applicable but Retention of customer/s at site would be main KPI with all scheduled services completed efficiently and effectively.
Inventory: Help ABM/BM to manage Inventory - coordinate with other Ops colleagues
to manage Stock Levels of branches forecasting, Indenting receipt of material for branch (as an assigned function within branch by BM).
Ensure APL (Approved Preparations List) is followed by all assigned technicians all chemical containers have original labels
Ensure proper schedule of maintenance repairs of equipment is established followed (via JOC).
Promote highest grooming standards (uniform, Safety shoes, PPEs)
Encourage technicians to plan their leaves in advance to curb absenteeism
Help Resolve any Grievances IR issues of Technicians bring to the notice of ABM/BM on day today basis
Report any deviation that could impact service quality or productivity of technicians like- over commitments, recommendation regarding night service (if it is not needed), covered area mismatch, etc


Requirements
Minimum B. Sc. (Chemistry / Zoology / Agriculture). Any prior experience in operations of pest management or service industry is desirable.
Proficient in use of computer applications systems with Excel, Word, PowerPoint (or its equivalent)
Should get well versed with various internal company systems such as iCABS, STP, iAuditor, SRA, SQA, SQS, TPA, myRentokilPCI, Service Leads App, U+ etc

Description:
Job Summary
Agilent is looking for passionate and motivated young scientists to join our team as Field Application Engineers (FAE) supporting our LCMS (Liquid Chromatography Mass Spectrometry) and GCMS (Gas Chromatography Mass Spectrometry) business. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work closely with leading pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, food, environmental, and research laboratories across India. As a Field Application Engineer, you will serve as a technical expert, helping customers develop analytical workflows, optimize methods, and maximize the value of Agilent's advanced analytical instrumentation. You will collaborate with sales, product specialists, application scientists, and customers to drive technology adoption and business growth.


Responsibilities
Develop and optimize LCMS and GCMS analytical methods and workflows for applications including pharmaceuticals, pesticides, antibiotics, food safety, and other emerging markets
Design and execute experiments to support development of new applications and workflow solutions.
Generate scientific data and contribute to application notes, technical publications, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Collaborate with leading researchers, industry experts, and key opinion leaders to drive innovative analytical solutions
Deliver customer demonstrations, technical seminars, and product trainings.
Support customer onboarding, workflow implementation, and application troubleshooting.
Participate in scientific conferences, workshops, and industry events to showcase Agilent technologies.
Work closely with commercial and technical teams to support strategic business growth in LCMS and GCMS.


Qualifications
M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
Strong academic understanding of chromatography and mass spectrometry techniques.
Hands-on laboratory experience through coursework, research projects, internships, or thesis work is preferred.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and scientific communication skills.
Passion for customer engagement and scientific consulting.


Desired Skills
Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact confidently with customers and internal stakeholders.
Curiosity to learn new technologies and applications.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a dynamic environment.
Willingness to travel extensively (up to 75%) across assigned territories.


Additional Details
Full-time weekly schedule.
Travel Required: 50% of the Time
Shift: Day
Duration: No End Date
Job Function: Sales

Description:
Product Sales Executive (PSE) Institutional Sales
Department: PSD
Function: Institutional Sales
Designation: Product Sales Executive (PSE)
Reporting To: ABM/ Regional Manager
Experience: 3 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location - Mumbai, Kolkata, Patna, Bihar


Job Purpose
The Product Sales Executive (PSE) Institutional Sales will be responsible for driving product
sales and business growth through institutional customers. The role involves identifying new
business opportunities, developing relationships with key institutional clients, generating
enquiries, preparing quotations, negotiating commercial terms, and ensuring achievement of assigned sales targets.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and develop new institutional customers and business opportunities.
- Manage relationships with existing institutional clients and ensure repeat business.
- Conduct regular customer visits and understand product requirements.
- Generate leads through market visits, references, networking and other business development activities.
- Present and demonstrate products to institutional customers as required.
- Prepare and submit quotations, proposals and commercial offers.
- Coordinate with internal teams for pricing, product availability, dispatch and delivery.
- Follow up on enquiries, quotations and orders to ensure timely conversion.
- Negotiate with customers within approved company guidelines.
- Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
- Maintain an updated database of institutional customers, prospects and sales activities.
- Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer requirements.
- Ensure timely collection of outstanding payments in coordination with the finance team.
- Handle customer queries and coordinate for resolution of complaints.
- Maintain regular sales reports, visit reports and pipeline updates.
- Support the organization in developing new territories, accounts and product opportunities.

Key Accountabilities / KPIs
- Achievement of assigned sales targets.
- New institutional customer acquisition.
- Revenue and product-wise sales growth.
- Enquiry-to-order conversion.
- Number and quality of customer visits.
- Development of active sales pipeline.
- Customer retention and repeat orders.
- Timely payment/collection follow-up.
- Gross margin as per company guidelines.
- Accuracy and timely submission of sales reports.

Target Customer Segments
The candidate may be responsible for developing business from:
- Corporates and large organizations
- Educational institutions
- Hospitals and healthcare institutions
- Government/semi-government institutions
- Hotels and hospitality organizations
- Dealers/distributors and institutional buyers
- NGOs and other bulk purchasers
- Other B2B/institutional customers relevant to the company's product portfolio

Candidate Profile
Qualification:
- Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in Sales & Marketing will be an added advantage.

Experience:
- 3 years of experience in B2B, institutional sales, corporate sales or field sales.
- Freshers with strong communication and sales aptitude may also be considered.
Skills Required:
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong negotiation and relationship-management skills.
- Ability to generate leads and convert prospects into customers.
- Target-oriented and self-motivated approach.
- Good presentation and convincing skills.
- Basic knowledge of MS Office/Excel and CRM systems.
- Willingness to travel extensively for customer meetings.
- Ability to work independently.

Desired Competencies
- Business development
- Customer relationship management
- Sales planning and execution
- Negotiation skills
- Market intelligence
- Follow-up and closing skills
- Problem-solving ability
- Time management
- Result orientation

2. Serve as an active member of the medical staff in main lab, collection center,
3. Relate and function effectively with NABL other accrediting agencies, Appropriate administrative officials, healthcare community, the patient / clients.
4. Define, implement, and monitor standards of performance and quality improvement of the medical laboratory service orservices.
5. Monitor all processes in the laboratory to determine that reliable data is being generated.
6. Ensure availability of sufficiently qualified personnel with adequate training and experience to meet the needs of the laboratory.
7. Plan, set goals, develop, and allocate resources appropriate to the medical environment.
8. Provide effective and efficient administration of the medical laboratory service, including budget planning and control with responsible financial management, in accordance with institutional assignment of such responsibilities.
9. Provide educational programs for the medical and laboratory staff and participate in educational programs of the institution.
10. Implement a safe laboratory environment in compliance with good practice and applicable regulations.
11. Address any complaint, request, or suggestion from users of laboratory services. Ensure good staff morale.
12. Report authorization of Hematology, Biochemistry, Immunoassay, Clinical Pathology, and serology
13. Routine review of QC for all departments with review of reports including CBC, MP, PS, Reticulocyte count, Fluid routine, ICT/DCT, Blood group before approving
14. Formulate review and recheck policies for all tests and ensure compliance with the help of Lab supervisor and technicians.
15. Verification of critical, unusual, and abnormal test results before release
16. Interpret, Correlate, and generate medically significant laboratory data.
17. Attending all sorts of client queries related to test enquiries and interpretation of test results.
18. Approval of SOPs for use and ensure compliance with respect to accreditation requirements.
19. Ensure review of monthly MIS
20. Ensure results are reported within turnaround time with the help of section head.
21. Review and improvement of reports formats.
22. To identify new equipment, tests, technology, products and standardization of assays.
23. Identify needs for resources (human / equipment / infrastructure) and submit to senior management for approval.
24. Attending conferences/workshops to ensure updated knowledge about recent trends.
25. To spend time reviewing daily pendency status on reports not released as well as sample received cases to avoid patient dissatisfaction.
26. To keep a watchful eye on instrument maintenance and hygiene of lab and practice 0 tolerance in this area. Any instrument failure due to user s should be avoided totally as it affects our patient and business.
27. To ensure sample processing is not stopped due to KIT non availability.
28. To ensure that every PR is approved on time and any gaps are highlighted.
29. COL/ Lab Head should work with BU Heads in forecasting CAMP s and other seasonal activities and order KITs sufficiently.
30. To keep a close watch on technical complaints. Ensure analytical complaints get logged, DE flagging is minimized. For recorded complaints and initiate proper CAPA and must also discuss in weekly calls with the team on learning and preventive actionsand timely escalation of analytical complaints/ Legal threats
31. To spend quality time on understanding patient and customer VOC especially on cases we are not resolving on time. COL/Lab Head should guide the team to resolve issues on time andsupport them wherever technical input is required.
32. To participate in weekly meetings along with BU/SBU Heads to resolve issues as well as seek support wherever needs from nontechnical team.
33. To take responsibility to train the non-technical team for better business and customer engagement.
34. COL/Lab Head must contribute at least 8 hours in a month in training and sharing knowledge to the team through a formal mechanism.
35. To promote MHL test to larger communities of clinician through KOL Connects. They must use our report as a tool to promote test by recommending new test based on diagnosis in the report.
36. To make time at least once a month to meet B2B clients, collection centers, customers to understand the pulse of the market.
37. To follow guidelines objectively as per MHL Policy and ensure a culture of data-based decision making and discussions; hence every month compliance is very important. It is at most importance for to have self-Compliance from every lab and noncompliance is given utmost importance for closure.
38. To give sufficient time to check and review the Lab managers /Technical team on quality, material consumption and technical performance.
39. Ensure that processes needed for the quality management system are established, implemented, and maintained.
40. Reporting to laboratory management, at the level at which decisions are made on laboratory policy, objectives, and resources, on the performance of the quality management system and any need for improvement.
41. Ensuring the promotion of awareness of users needs and requirements throughout the laboratory organization.

Excellent communication and analytical skill.

Lab Operations Team

Description:
Job Summary
Function Summary: IRDA Regulation on IMF was released, where companies which are LLP / Pvt limited / cooperative societies were allowed to distribute financial products. IMFs are allowed to deal in Insurance of 6 companies (2LI, 2GI, 2HI), mutual funds, banking products, post etc. Max Life spotted this opportunity to attract established financial distributors from the market to engage and distribute Max Life products - Pearl Acquisition. A dedicated team of 50 CDMs were recruited in two phases and trained to hire and foster these relationships. Currently we have 95 licensed IMFs on board and expected to touch 150 which are work in progress. The pool of IMFs primarily comprises top Agents in Insurance, Wealth Managers, Loan DSA, CA, ex-employees from financial services with an existing customer base. Present IMFs carry avg. 2500 customers and big turnover book. As a later part of Pearl acquisition strategy, Insurance Managers is a career option provided to establish financial distributors who are not able to meet the requirements of forming an IMF. This has also proven to be an exciting opportunity. Insurance Manager is a part-time employee model which provides a platform to the pearl to associate with MLI and improve their earnings, flexible working hours and better choices for their customers. IMFs will be different from an ADM/APC as they will not be recruiting and mentoring Agents and will only source business by penetrating into their existing client base. Avg book size with them is also 750 customers.


Key Responsibilities
Understand the IMF regulation, value proposition registration process
Independently implement the IMF acquisition plan in the territory
Identify potential leads and sources for prospective IMFs, coordinate with HO for referred leads
Connect with prospects, organize seminars for IMF acquisition
Ensure conversion of leads through effective pitch of IMF value proposition
Ensure quality of IMFs in sync with desired profile
Enable the setup of IMFs of agreed prospects
Understand all regulatory requirements and manage the IMF registration process with IRDA
Oversee technology support to enrolled IMFs
Ensure seamless contracting of IMFs with Max Life
Manage performance of setup IMFs in steady state
Develop understanding of products, coach IMF staff on product USP s
Implement a performance management and rewards system
Drive IMF profitability through improving productivity of IMF s, sellers, controlling cost of sales
Provide marketing, training and operational support to IMFs
Manage attrition of IMFs through revival or replacement


Measures of Success
IMF Acquisition
Revenue
IMF Activity Retention
Quality of Business


Qualifications and Experience
Educational Background: Preferably a graduate
Work Experience: At least 5-6 years of experience in Sales Distribution, Key Account Management


Knowledge / Skills / Abilities
Written communication
Presentation skills
Interpersonal skills
Stakeholder management
Partner management
Strategic initiatives management
Program management
Training
Coaching the Partner employees

The agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. Agent Quality Recruitment
Agent Development

Position- Lab Technician

To perform assigned analytical testing procedures in an accurate, precise, and timely manner in the assigned lab.

AboutCompany:
Established in 1949, Dr Lal PathLabs today is the largest and most respected diagnostic service provider in the country. It has a proven track record of over six decades for strict adherence to international standards and benchmarks. Dr Lal PathLabs offers widest test menu and has a pan India presence in all important cities and towns of India, in the form of state-of-the-art laboratories and patient service centres.

The company has more than 190 Labs and over 2000 centres across India and international operations in Nepal and Bangladesh.

It serves over 13 million customers every year through its widest test menu and panels in the disciplines of Molecular Diagnostics, Biophysics, Flow Cytometry, Immunophenotying, Cytogenetics, Endocrinology, Genetics, Nutrition and Metabolism, Oncology, Toxicology, Immunohistochemistry, Infectious diseases, Biochemistry, Haematology, Histopathology and Cytology.

Dr Lal Path Labs has internationally accepted external and internal quality assurance programs in place. The Company is India's highest accredited laboratory, with accreditation from College of American Pathologists (CAP), National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL), Ministry of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and ISO 9001:2000 certification.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Function Summary
The Bancassurance Department within Axis Max Life Insurance plays a critical role in driving the distribution of life insurance products through our strategic partnership with Yes Bank. This department leverages Yes Bank s existing customer base and infrastructure to offer insurance solutions.

Customer Relationship Management

A key aspect of the role is to increase the bank s customer awareness about life insurance solutions and achieve targeted penetration of cross-sell within the branch s customer base. The candidate will effectively drive reward and recognition programs for bank staff and regularly train them on life insurance concepts and new product introductions.
Key Responsibilities
Establishing strengthening relationship with branch manager staff to gain leads from them.
Involvement in work site activities (putting up stalls and making presentations in corporate.

Train the bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.
Key skills required
Communication skills
Strategic thinking
Product Knowledge
Problem solving
Time management
Customer relationship management

Goal oriented
Customer centricity.

About IIFL Finance: IIFL Finance is a leading financial services provider in India, known for its comprehensive range of solutions including loans, insurance, and investment products. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial sales and a deep understanding of the local property market.

DSA Network for Sales Maximization: Maximize sales through a network of DSA by effectively managing connector and builder relationships to ensure strong business
Disbursement Target Management and Achievement: Drive Disbursement Target vs Achievement for LAP product - as per expected business growth plan.
Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams such as underwriting and customer service to ensure smooth customer service.
Market Research: Stay informed about local real estate trends, property values, and competitive offerings. Use market insights to refine sales strategies and identify new opportunities.
Desired Candidate Profile:
3+ years of experience strong understanding handling LAP Product
Problem Solving ability
Bachelors degree in finance or any other field - Graduation is a must

The Muthoot Finance Ltd. is hiring for its branches located at BHAGALPUR (Naugacchia), KATIHAR (Kursela, Manihari, Gerabari, Daulat Ram Chowk, Mirchabari, Sonaili, Salmari), PURNIA (Gulabbagh), ARARIA and KISHANGANJ (Subhash Pally, Bahadurganj, Thakurganj). Therefore searching suitable Male candidates for the below positions,

Post: JUNIOR RELATIONSHIP EXECUTIVE (JRE)

Eligibility criteria:-
Must be a Graduate (excluding BTech/BE/LLB/Distance/Open)
Atleast 06 months in any field
Fluency in the local language
Candidate should be from the local area or ready to relocate
Computer knowledge is mandatory
Age below 30 years

Duties & Responsibilities:-
Achieving the allotted branch targets.
Acquiring new customers and addressing all product inquiries through branch walk-ins, sales activities, marketing promotions, etc.
Regular follow-up for interest collection and NPA reduction.
Responsible for regular branch operations including KYC process, gold appraisal, strong room operations, gold packet preparation, closures and renewals.
Cross-selling all products and increasing branch walk-ins.
Ensuring error-free audit reports and proper compliance at the branch.
Maintaining punctuality, discipline and a high level of morality in line with the ethics & values of the company.
Cost control.
Other duties as instructed by higher authority.

Female / Male Graduate or Masters qualified in between 2023 to 2026 will be hired for Six Months Internship program, who can be later appointed as CUSTOMER CARE EXECUTIVE (CCE) / JUNIOR RELATIONSHIP EXECUTIVE (JRE)

Interested candidates can email updated CV at HRSGR@MUTHOOTGROUP.COM
AboutCompany: Muthoot Finance Ltd., the flagship company of The Muthoot Group was founded in 1939, by Shri M. George Muthoot. The company today is Indias largest and the worlds biggest Gold Loan Company. Listed on both BSE and NSE, the company is registered with the RBI, today it has a presence across India and abroad through its network of 5,000+ branches with above 30,000 staff members. Apart from Gold Loan, Muthoot Finace also provides Gold Coins, Money Transfer, Insurance, Foreign Currency Exchange, Pan Card, NCD, Demat Services to its customers.

AboutCompany:
SBI Life Insurance (SBI Life / ‘The Company’), one of the most trusted life insurance companies in India, was incorporated in October 2000 and is registered with the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) in March 2001.
