Additionally, SBI Life is committed to enhance digital experiences for its customers, distributors and employees alike.
SBI Life strives to make insurance accessible to all, with its extensive presence across the country through its 1,146 offices, 27,040 employees, a large and productive network of about 253,799 agents, 62 corporate agents and 9 bancassurance partners with more than 41,000 partner branches, 150 brokers and other insurance marketing firms.
In addition to doing what’s right for the customers, the company is also committed to provide a healthy and flexible work environment for its employees to excel personally and professionally.
SBI Life strongly encourages a culture of giving back to the society and has made substantial contribution in the areas of child education, healthcare, disaster relief and environmental upgrade. In 2024-25, the Company touched over 53,000 direct beneficiaries through various CSR interventions.
Listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange ('BSE') and the National Stock Exchange ('NSE'), the company has an authorized capital of Rs. 20.0 billion and a paid-up capital of Rs. 10.0 billion. The AuM is Rs. 4,758.1 billion.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Respond to any questions from guests and follow up with guests to ensure their requests have been met to their satisfaction. Take and confirm reservations and cancellations. Supply guests with information regarding property amenities, services, room features, and local areas of interest and activities. Respond to guest requests for special arrangements or services (e.g., spa services, transportation, religious services, babysitting, financial services, business center services, interpretation services, reservations, dry cleaning, entertainment/sporting events, shopping) by making arrangements or identifying appropriate providers. Contact appropriate individual or department as necessary to resolve guest requests.
Collaborate with management to develop and carry-out ideas and procedures and set goals to continuously improve department performance. Assign and ensure work tasks are completed on time and that they meet appropriate quality standards. Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets; protect the privacy and security of guests and coworkers. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Description:
Role & responsibilities:
Vendor Acquisition & Onboarding: Identify, evaluate, and onboard fleet vendors to support business expansion and operational efficiency.
Scaling & Network Expansion: Develop strategies to scale vendor partnerships across multiple regions, ensuring adequate fleet availability.
Community Engagement: Organize and lead community meetups in Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities to educate and encourage drivers to transition into fleet ownership.
Government Coordination: Work closely with government agencies and employment programs to source and hire blue-collar drivers efficiently.
Performance Management: Track vendor performance metrics (SLAs, compliance, cost efficiency) and implement improvement initiatives.
Process Optimization: Streamline vendor onboarding, contract management, and operational workflows to reduce inefficiencies.
Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure all fleet vendors adhere to regulatory requirements, safety standards, and company policies.
Stakeholder Coordination: Work closely with internal teams (Operations, Finance, Compliance) to align vendor strategies with business goals

Person Specifications- Skillsets/Education:
Functional Skills Operations Management, Data Analysis, Stakeholder Management
Experience - Relevant experience in Logistics/ Manufacturing industry.
Behavioral Skills - Good communication and people management, analytical skills, task prioritization and follow-up, Hustler, Go-Getter attitude
Exposure to work in /Ability to work well in a team environment. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders for business purposes/in order to gain credibility with senior management.

*Should be open for extensive travel.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Job Title: Service Engineer X-Ray & C-Arm
Company: Trivitron Healthcare
Locations: Bangalore | Chennai | Aurangabad | Ahmedabad
Experience: 2–7 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Job Description
We are looking for technically skilled and customer-focused Service Engineers to handle installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance and breakdown support for our X-Ray and C-Arm product portfolio.
The ideal candidate should have experience in servicing medical equipment, preferably in X-Ray, C-Arm, Radiology or Medical Imaging systems.
Key Responsibilities
Install, commission and maintain X-Ray and C-Arm systems at customer locations.
Diagnose and resolve technical issues and equipment breakdowns within defined service timelines.
Perform preventive maintenance, equipment inspections and functional testing.
Maintain service reports, records and technical documentation.
Coordinate with the Service Head and technical teams for troubleshooting complex issues.
Manage service spares, tools and testing equipment effectively.
Provide basic product operation and technical training to customers.
Support Sales and Applications teams during product demonstrations and customer visits.
Ensure compliance with service, quality and safety procedures.
Maintain strong customer relationships and ensure customer satisfaction.
Travel extensively within the assigned territory as required.
Required Qualifications
Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Biomedical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, Medical Electronics or a relevant discipline.
2–7 years of experience in medical equipment servicing.
Prior experience in X-Ray, C-Arm, Radiology or Medical Imaging equipment is preferred.
Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Experience in installation, commissioning and preventive maintenance.
Good communication and customer-handling skills.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

Description:
Job Purpose

To manage and drive sales through distribution in order to attain market leadership in the given territory, through growth in gross numbers and revenues
Key Result Areas/Accountabilities

Sales
Establish a Best-in-Class distribution footprint and a strong promoter channel where the TSM is supervising promoters
Deliver sales target for all products (voice-prepaid / post-paid, data etc.) by executing the distribution strategy
Help zone and circle achieve Revenue targets by driving secondaries through Mass Retail distribution and by pushing unlimited products penetration
Monitor quality of acquisition through the distribution channel
Competition Tracking & reporting schemes & programs
Ensure availability of stock at retail while adhering to the norms
Execute promotional activities for channel partners to drive sales and build market credibility
Revenue
Achieve zonal revenue target for the distribution channel across all products
Distribution expansion and extraction
Achieve retail (MBO) expansion targets through increase in number of outlets in existing and new geographies
People
DSE Management
Target Setting DSE
DSE Beat Plan adherence
Systems/formats at DSE end
Drive Distribution KPIs delivery
MD/AD/SD Management
DSE Availability monitoring
Monitor Stock holding
Day to day Performance Review & discussions
Problem Solving
Load Out monitoring
Systems/formats at MD point
HSW compliance
Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience

Good communication skills
Sales Planning & Forecasting
Products Services & Technology Knowledge - Consumer
Leads Decision Making & Delivering Results
Analytical Thinking
Building Team Commitment
Must have technical / professional qualifications

Essential : Graduation - Regular
Desired : post - graduation in business management/MBA
work ex: 1 - 4 years
Experience with distribution planning and channel implementation.

Description:
Kindly Note : We are considering candidates who can relocate to the below mentioned locations

Job Location: Bangalore, Vadodara, Chennai

Job Requirements
This position is a mechanical integrity technical position for fixed equipment in support of petrochemical facility
This position provides technical support to the client with a focus on managing the risk based inspection program, troubleshooting, asset improvement, and technology selection
Provide strong technical leadership in Inspection/Corrosion Management for Oil & Gas upstream/downstream assets
Provide technical solution in upstream/downstream Asset Integrity
Has ability to create innovative solutions /automations/ methodologies to build a differentiation for Quest Global
Integrity assessment/assurance activities like FFS, Corrosion Evaluations and Remaining Life Studies
Drive and manage Integrity Engineers to execute the workflows with Quality at scale 
Provide pre-sales support for new business deals and post-sales support for the new projects assigned
Drive core team members to recruit skilled resources or train internal resources to achieve the targets
Act as a bridge between customer, sales organization and global technical teams
Lead Develop, nurture and manage global customer relationships and drive strategic partnering initiatives to address unique business situations and complex technology needs
Review technical scoping, estimation, fitment and feasibility studies, mapping customer expectations and solution design, prepared by Program Managers and Project Leader
Degradation evaluations related to pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping circuits, fired equipment, flares, above ground storage tanks, and/or pressure relief devices.
Monitoring and surveillance of integrity parameters to ensure reliable operations.
Troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and integrity recommendation stewardship.
Bad actor identification and analysis to reduce equipment downtime.
Data analytics, digital tools/ technologies and operationalize upgraded work practices through digital transformation.
Overall integrity effectiveness and management which includes, criticality assessments, consequence/ complexity rating of fixed equipment, development of fit-for-purpose risk based strategies, setting optimum task intervals including considerations to local regulations/ statutory requirements, timely review of inspection findings, and ever-greening of strategies.
Regional oversight and stewardship of integrity work product metrics for quality, effectiveness, and efficiency in achieving business unit/ manufacturing site objectives.
Work Experience
Engineering degree (Mechanical/Materials or Chemical) 3 to 8 years of oil gas experience in related industry (refining/petrochemical/LNG/oil & gas) 
Should have sound knowledge on Oil & Gas upstream and downstream business in the following areas 
- Risk Based Inspection methodologies 
- Fixed equipment inspection tasks/ procedures 
- Inspection Optimization
- Piping Circutization/TML development 
- API Damage Mechanisms of Refinery/Chemicals 
- In-service inspection of all types of fixed equipment 
- Knowledge of materials and standards 
- Knowledge of corrosion & welding
- Knowledge of NDTs
-Thickness inspection management and analysis
- Corrosion management and analysis
- Inspection plan development/ optimization.
- Knowledge of software (APM Meridium/Pestra/Credo, etc.) 
- Ability to lead teams 
- Excellent communication 
Should have working knowledge of oil and gas plant operations 
Should have exposure to Operating condition Safety, SHE risks, spill/ safety incident and equipment failure opportunities 
Should have Knowledge of various roles and responsibilities of engineers working in the oil and gas field/site 
Should have knowledge of corrective and preventative maintenance strategy 
Should have knowledge of International standards in design, quality, and procedures for approved equipment
Working knowledge in key sections of ASME Sec Div. 1/2, ASME Sec V, ASME Sec IX, ASME Sec Il, ASME B31.3/ B31.1/ B31.4/ B31.8, ASME PCC-2
Field in-service inspection and repair of pressure equipment, heat exchangers, piping systems, pressure relief devices and above ground storage tanks in operating unit
Good to have skills:
Certification and in-depth working knowledge in API 580, API 510, API 570, API 571 , API 653, NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist, BSI ISO/ ENI AS Standards, AWS/ CSWIP/ ASNT NDT Techniques
Experience with Meridium/Credo/Pestra and SAP

Description:
Designation: Senior Interior Designer
Location: Mumbai, Bangalore, Vadodara
Experience: 3 to 6 Years


About Livspace

Livspace is a leading technology-driven home interiors and renovation platform, providing end-to-end interior solutions for homeowners. We combine design, technology, project execution, and customer experience to deliver beautiful and functional homes.
Job Overview
We are looking for an experienced and creative Senior Interior Designer who can independently manage residential interior design projects from concept to final design closure.
The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in space planning, modular interiors, design concepts, client management, and design software, along with the ability to deliver high-quality designs within defined timelines.

Required Skills

Strong knowledge of residential interior design and space planning.
Excellent understanding of modular kitchens, wardrobes, living rooms, bedrooms, and complete home interiors.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max/3D visualization tools, and MS Office.
Strong knowledge of materials, finishes, hardware, lighting, and furniture.
Excellent presentation and client-handling skills.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to understand client needs and convert them into practical design solutions.
Strong attention to detail and design aesthetics.
Ability to manage multiple projects and work within deadlines.
Good understanding of design feasibility, execution requirements, and site constraints.
Experience & Qualification

3 to 6 years of relevant experience in residential interior design.
Bachelor's/Diploma degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.
Candidates with experience in home interiors, modular interiors, design studios, or interior design companies will be preferred.
Strong portfolio demonstrating residential interior design projects is preferred.

Description:
Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle
Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our
Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a
minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local
network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting
monthly disbursement targets.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
• Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement
targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by
the company.
• Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities
through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
• Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used
vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
• Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of
customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
• End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document
collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
• Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in
monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired
portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used
CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
• Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle
market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
• Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-
building skills.
• Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for
extensive field travel.

What We Offer
• Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive
structure.
• Travel allowances.
• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.

Description:
Position : Associate Director / Director

Department: Tax Restructuring/Succession Planning Team
Designation: Associate Director / Director (10+ years)
Experience: 10+ years post-qualification
Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA)
Location: Vadodara (Preferred) | Ahmedabad | Mumbai
Role Overview
We are looking for experienced Chartered Accountants to join its Succession Planning Team. The role involves independently leading succession and estate planning assignments for business families and HNIs, covering the complete process from understanding family objectives to structuring, drafting and implementation.
The candidate should have the ability to understand business strategy, ownership structures and long-term family objectives and design appropriate succession structures beyond conventional tax and legal considerations.

Key Responsibilities
1. Succession & Estate Planning
Lead succession and estate planning assignments for operating businesses, promoter shareholdings, immovable properties, investments, artwork and other family wealth.
Analyse family ownership structures, family dynamics, commercial objectives and long-term goals.
Design succession structures involving private trusts, Wills, family arrangements, family charters, gifts, partition arrangements, holding structures and family governance mechanisms.
Advise on ownership succession, management succession, business continuity and next-generation involvement.
2. Transaction & Corporate Structuring
Consider M&A, business restructuring, business sales and other corporate events while designing succession structures.
Handle succession planning for pre-IPO and IPO-bound businesses, considering DRHP disclosures, promoter contributions, lock-in and holding-period requirements.
Advise on listed company succession matters involving SEBI regulations, promoter and promoter-group requirements, disclosures, transfer restrictions and regulatory approvals.
3. Tax, Legal & Regulatory Advisory
Analyse Indian tax, stamp duty, Companies Act, FEMA, SEBI and succession-law implications.
Handle assignments involving NRIs, non-resident trustees or beneficiaries, foreign trusts, overseas foundations and foreign assets.
Assess overseas taxation, succession laws and inheritance or estate-tax implications, coordinating with specialist teams wherever required.
4. Documentation & Implementation
Draft, review and finalise trust deeds, Wills, family arrangements, shareholder agreements, family charters, partition deeds and other legal documents.
Prepare structure notes, technical opinions and presentations explaining available alternatives, risks and recommended structures.
Lead client and family discussions and translate commercial and family objectives into practical legal and tax structures.
Coordinate with internal specialists and external legal, tax, regulatory and valuation advisers for implementation.
5. Team Management
Supervise junior team members.
Review research, documentation, drafting and technical work.
Ensure quality and timely execution of succession planning assignments.

Follow company standards relating to Health, Safety, Security and Environment (HSSE).
Maintain high standards of ethical conduct and commercial integrity.
Comply with applicable competition and antitrust requirements and approved commercial processes.

Strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language. In certain geographies where communication in local language is desired (e.g. Japan, China), excellent command of local language with reasonable proficiency in English preferred.

Description:
CBRE is seeking a high-performing senior professional to join our Office Leasing practice as Landlord Representation.

In this role, you will lead business development, strategic landlord advisory, and deal execution for major institutional investors, developers, and asset owners. You will be responsible for securing multi-asset leasing mandates across key markets, formulating asset positioning strategies, driving revenue targets, and delivering end-to-end commercial real estate transactions.

Key Responsibilities

Mandate Origination & Business Development: Drive pipeline growth by identifying, pitching, and securing high-value Landlord Representation mandates; expand existing accounts through strategic relationship management.
Strategic Advisory & Commercial Structuring: Formulate asset-specific leasing strategies, pricing models, rent escalation structures, lock-in terms, tenant incentives, and positioning frameworks based on competitor benchmarking and occupier demand.
Portfolio & Governance Management: Oversee multi-asset, multi-city portfolios; establish structured client governance including weekly reporting, leasing dashboards, milestone tracking, and escalation frameworks.
Marketing & Positioning Execution: Conceptualize and drive go-to-market strategies, broker engagement protocols, collateral development, and targeted campaigns in collaboration with branding and design agencies.
Transaction Execution & Deal Closure: Lead high-value lease negotiations, prospect engagement, heads of terms drafting, and transaction closures while advising landlords on risk mitigation.
Stakeholder & Ecosystem Engagement: Build and maintain high-level relationships with institutional landlords, developers, corporate occupiers, investors, and third-party channel partners/agents.
Cross-Functional Integration: Collaborate with CBRE Research, Capital Markets, Project Management, and Occupier Services to deliver integrated solutions and cross-sell business lines.
Team Leadership & Performance: Mentor junior and mid-level team members, manage channel partner ecosystems, and ensure alignment with regional revenue and occupancy targets.

Candidate Profile

Experience: 712+ years of relevant commercial real estate experience, with a proven track record in Landlord Representation, agency leasing, and developer account management.
Occupier Relationship: Experience in engaging with regional and international occupiers, institutional landlords, developers, and corporate real estate (CRE) heads.
Portfolio Capabilities: Proven capability to manage multi-asset, portfolio-wide leasing mandates across geographic markets.
Commercial & Financial Acumen: Deep knowledge of commercial office lease structures, financial modeling, market dynamics, and yield optimization strategies.
Leadership & Influence: Strong negotiation, pitch presentation, and client advisory skills with an ownership mindset and the ability to operate effectively at senior executive levels.
AboutCompany:
CBRE Group, Inc.(NYSE:CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2020 revenue).

The company has more than 100,000 employees serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves a diverse range of clients with an integrated suite of services, including facilities, transaction and project management; property management; investment management; appraisal and valuation; property leasing; strategic consulting; property sales; mortgage services and development services.

CBRE was the first international real estate services firm to set up an office in India. Since then, our operations have grown to include more than 9000 professionals across 10 offices, with a presence in over 200 cities in India.

Please visit our website at www.cbre.com

Description:
Dear Candidate,
Looking to build something meaningful for Indias MSMEs? Join Tata nexarc, a digital-first B2B platform from the house of Tata, as our Cluster Sales Manager Steel.

Role - Cluster Sales Manager Steel
Experience: 5+ years | Location: Ahmedabad and Bangalore

About the role:
Tata nexarc serves MSMEs with raw material procurement, credit and logistics solutions. We are looking for a self-driven Steel expert to generate demand and build our procurement business from the ground up in a defined cluster.
Key Responsibilities:
Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets (number of clients and GMV) for your cluster.

Graduate or BE (Civil/Mechanical); MBA preferred.
5+ years in B2B business development, sales or account management, with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
Experience selling steel (fabricated structures, TMT bars, coils or related products).
Experience with CRM, data analytics and BI tools; MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Strong communication skills and full professional proficiency in the regional language.
An entrepreneurial mindset, ideally with startup experience.

Why Join Us:
Join a start-up from the house of Tata. Build the India Stack with a nation-first vision of uplifting SMEs, in a fast-paced culture built on Integrity, Pioneering, Unity, Responsibility and Excellence. You get high autonomy through agile cross-functional teams, and you will work on SME-focused products. Benefits include need-based health, wellness and childcare leaves, Tata group employee benefits, and medical, term life and personal accident insurance.

Skills: Steel Sales, B2B Sales, Business Development, Account Management, TMT Bars, MSME, CRM, Negotiation

If this sounds like you, apply now and be part of the Tata nexarc journey.

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

If you are an immediate joiner and excited about shaping the future of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

EcomEx Smart Shipping & Logistics for eCommerce Businesses

EcomEx is a technology-driven logistics aggregation platform designed for eCommerce, D2C brands, marketplaces, and online sellers across India. Key Features

Multi-Carrier Shipping Platform

AI-Powered RTO Reduction

Reduce Return-to-Origin (RTO) losses with intelligent courier recommendations, automated Non-Delivery Report (NDR) management, and proactive shipment recovery tools that help improve successful delivery rates.

Unified Shipping Dashboard

Manage all shipping operations from one platform. Seamlessly integrate with popular eCommerce platforms and marketplaces to automatically sync orders, generate bulk shipping labels, track shipments in real time, and streamline fulfillment processes.

Real-Time Tracking & Visibility

Monitor shipments from pickup to delivery with live tracking updates and centralized order management.

Additional Logistics Solutions

International Shipping

Expand your business globally with reliable cross-border shipping solutions and end-to-end shipment management.

B2B Cargo Shipping

Move bulk consignments efficiently with B2B logistics services starting from 140 for 10kg.

Warehousing & Fulfillment

Optimize inventory storage, order processing, packing, and dispatch through EcomEx's fulfillment and warehousing network.

Pricing

Free Platform Access

- No registration fee
- No subscription charges
- No platform fees
- Suitable for startups, growing brands, and high-volume sellers

Competitive Shipping Rates

- Domestic shipping starts from 19 for 500g
- B2B cargo shipping starts from 140 for 10kg
- Pay only for the shipments you create

Function Summary
Sales Manager - Tele Sales role at Axis Max Life Insurance focuses on driving virtual insurance sales through digital platforms. Key responsibilities include conducting virtual meetings, generating leads, and achieving sales targets. The role requires strong communication, relationship management, and customer service skills. Candidates with sales experience in insurance or financial services are preferred.


Job Summary
We are seeking a proactive and customer-focused Virtual Field Sales Representative to join our insurance sales team. The ideal candidate will leverage technology to conduct virtual meetings and webinars, build relationships, and sell insurance products to potential clients. The role requires excellent communication skills, a self-driven attitude, and a passion for sales in the insurance industry.


Key Responsibilities
Conduct virtual meetings and product presentations to prospective clients via video calls, webinars, or online platforms.
Prospect and generate new leads through digital channels such as social media, emails, and online marketing campaigns.
Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of prospects through regular follow-ups and nurturing of relationships.
Provide personalized insurance advice and product recommendations based on customer needs. Achieve sales targets and KPIs by converting leads into policies.
Collaborate with team members and use CRM software to track and report sales activities and progress.
Stay updated on the latest insurance products, industry trends, and regulations to offer the best advice to clients.
Manage customer inquiries and concerns, providing excellent customer service throughout the sales process.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers to encourage repeat business and referrals.


Key Competencies / Skills
Handling Customer Complaints
Relationship
Leading people
Effective


Desired qualification and experience
Bachelor s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred).
Proven experience in sales, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.
Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to build rapport via virtual channels.
Self-motivated with a high level of professionalism and organization.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple virtual sales processes simultaneously.
Knowledge of CRM systems and online sales tools.

Description:
Job Summary
Function Summary: Sales Manager - Tele Sales role at Axis Max Life Insurance focuses on driving virtual insurance sales through digital platforms. Key responsibilities include conducting virtual meetings, generating leads, and achieving sales targets. The role requires strong communication, relationship management, and customer service skills. Candidates with sales experience in insurance or financial services are preferred.
Job Summary: We are seeking a proactive and customer-focused Virtual Field Sales Representative to join our insurance sales team. The ideal candidate will leverage technology to conduct virtual meetings and webinars, build relationships, and sell insurance products to potential clients. The role requires excellent communication skills, a self-driven attitude, and a passion for sales in the insurance industry.


Key Responsibilities
Conduct virtual meetings and product presentations to prospective clients via video calls, webinars, or online platforms.
Prospect and generate new leads through digital channels such as social media, emails, and online marketing campaigns.
Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of prospects through regular follow-ups and nurturing of relationships.
Provide personalized insurance advice and product recommendations based on customer needs. Achieve sales targets and KPIs by converting leads into policies.
Collaborate with team members and use CRM software to track and report sales activities and progress.
Stay updated on the latest insurance products, industry trends, and regulations to offer the best advice to clients.
Manage customer inquiries and concerns, providing excellent customer service throughout the sales process.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers to encourage repeat business and referrals.


Qualifications / Experience
Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred).
Proven experience in sales, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.
Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to build rapport via virtual channels.
Self-motivated with a high level of professionalism and organization.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple virtual sales processes simultaneously.
Knowledge of CRM systems and online sales tools.

Description:
Position: Senior Engineer - Linux BSP (Solutions)
Key Responsibilities
- Responsible for design and development of real time embedded software/firmware and PC/mobile based software application.
- To Analyse domain specific technical or low level requirement and modification as per end customer or system requirement.
- Participate in High level and low level software design
- Perform software testing including unit, functional and system level requirement including manual and automated
- Performs software requirement to design to coding to testing traceability
- Performs code review following coding guidelines and static code analysis
- Troubleshoots software problems of limited difficulty.
- Documenting technical deliverable like software specifications, design document, code commenting, test cases and test report, Release note etc. throughout the project life cycle.
- Follow defined process for software Development life cycle
- Develops software solutions from established programming languages or by learning new language required for specific project.
Experience / Skills Required
- Strong knowledge for Linux device drivers, Linux Kernel Programming, Linux Kernel Internals, Yocto / Buildroot or any other build systems
- Experience working with development tools like oscilloscope, protocol analyser, emulator, signal generator, JTAG programmer, GIT, SVN, JIRA.
- Experience working with different embedded microprocessor based on Qualcomm, TI, NXP, NVIDIA, Intel or similar
- Experience of Board support package, Device driver and boot loader development/porting.
- Understanding of hardware schematic, datasheet of hardware component to derive firmware/software specific solution
- Strong sense of ownership, passionate, fast learner, analytical mind set, perfection seeker.
Location: IN-UP-Noida, India-World Trade Tower (eInfochips)
Time Type: Full time
Job Category: Engineering Services

Company Name: Ipath Infotech Pvt. Ltd.
Designation: Jr. System Admininstrator
Working Days: 5 Days working
Shift: 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM | 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM
Job Location: Shyamal Cross Rd, Satellite


Job summary

1. Role Overview
* Responsible for managing and maintaining IT infrastructure, servers, networks, firewalls and virtual machines.
* Provide technical support to development and QA teams.
* Ensure smooth daily IT operations and infrastructure availability.
2. Key Responsibilities
* Manage Windows and Linux servers, virtual machines and network infrastructure.
* Configure and troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, VLANs, routers, switches, firewalls and VPNs.
* Support GitLab, Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines and application deployments.
* Set up and maintain development, QA and staging environments.
* Monitor backups, perform restore tests and support disaster recovery.
* Assist with AWS, Azure, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP and Microsoft 365 administration.
* Troubleshoot server, application, connectivity and permission-related issues.
* Maintain technical documentation, SOPs, asset records and deployment checklists.
3. Required Skills:
* Practical experience with Windows Server and Linux administration.
* Good understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, NAT, VPN and firewalls.
* Basic knowledge of Git, GitLab, Docker and CI/CD.
* Familiarity with backup and recovery procedures.
* Exposure to AWS, Azure, IIS, Nginx, PostgreSQL or SQL Server is preferred.
* Independently handle routine server, network and infrastructure support.
* Monitor system availability, backups and infrastructure performance.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for a proactive and motivated Business Development Intern who is interested in learning and building a career in IT business development and sales. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication and writing skills, a logical and analytical mindset, an innovative approach, and the ability to quickly adapt to new tools, processes, and environments. You will work closely with our business development and leadership teams to identify potential clients, research new business opportunities, support lead generation, and understand how IT services are positioned and sold in global markets.


Key Responsibilities
Lead Generation through Business Journals, LinkedIn, Google, Upwork, and other effective professional networking platforms
Perform outbound cold warm calls and emails to the targeted prospects to reach the right decision-maker
Identifying, qualifying, and securing business opportunities; coordinating business generation activities; developing customized targeted sales strategies
Building business relationships with current and potential clients
Understanding client needs and offering solutions and support; answering potential client questions and follow-up call questions; responding to client requests for proposals (RFPs)
Collaborating with sales and leadership to secure, retain, and grow accounts
Creating informative presentations; presenting and delivering information to potential clients at client meetings, industry exhibits, trade shows, and conferences
Creating and maintaining a list/database of prospect clients; maintaining a database (Salesforce, CRM, Excel, etc.) of prospective client information
Maintaining a pipeline of all sales administration using CRM software
Collaborating with management on sales goals, planning, and forecasting; maintaining short- and long-term business development plans


Skills Qualifications
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Good logical thinking, problem-solving, and research skills
Quick learner with the ability to adapt to new tools, processes, and environments
Proactive, self-motivated, and willing to take initiative
Innovative and creative mindset with the ability to generate new ideas
Basic understanding of lead generation, client research, and business development
Familiarity with Upwork, Fiverr, Freelancer, PeoplePerHour (PPH), or Guru is a plus
Good understanding of LinkedIn, Google research, email communication, and professional networking
Comfortable learning and using CRM, Excel, and other business development tools
Ability to understand client requirements and communicate them clearly
Strong willingness to learn about IT services, technology, AI, and digital solutions
Freshers are welcome; attitude, communication, curiosity, and learning ability matter more than prior experience


Experience
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; the ability to call, connect, and interact with potential customers
Persuasive and goal-oriented

Description:
Position: Mobile Build Automation Engineer
AWS DevOps Engineer - Mobile CI/CD
o Design, implementation, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines for mobile application build automation using Jenkins and Bitrise.
o Develop and manage Jenkins Declarative/Scripted Pipelines for automated application build, testing, packaging, and release workflows.
o Integrate GitHub with Jenkins/Bitrise for source control, branch management, pull requests, webhooks, tagging, and release automation.
o Integrate SonarQube, Black Duck, and other code-quality, security, and dependency scanning tools into CI pipelines.
o Implement automated quality gates, security checks, vulnerability scanning, and compliance controls within the CI process.
o Manage mobile application artifacts such as APK, AAB, IPA, and other build outputs, including versioning, publishing, retention, and traceability.
o Implement and maintain artifact repositories using Artifactory, Nexus, AWS S3, or equivalent platforms.
o Automate mobile application builds and deployments using Kotlin/Gradle and other relevant mobile build tools.
o Develop automation scripts and utilities using Python, Shell/Bash, and Groovy for Jenkins pipeline automation.
o Work with AWS services to support CI/CD infrastructure, build environments, artifact management, security, and monitoring.
o Troubleshoot and optimize CI/CD pipelines, build environments, dependencies, and release processes to improve reliability and build performance.
o Provide technical leadership, establish DevOps/DevSecOps best practices, and collaborate with development, QA, security, and architecture teams to continuously improve the mobile software delivery process.
Key Skills: AWS, Jenkins, Jenkins Pipeline, Bitrise, GitHub, SonarQube, Black Duck, CI/CD, Mobile Build Automation, Python, Kotlin, Shell Scripting, Groovy, Artifact Management, DevSecOps.
Location: IN-GJ-Ahmedabad, India-Ognaj (eInfochips)
Time Type: Full time
Job Category: Engineering Services

Key Responsibilities-
Design, build and maintain automated test frameworks in Python and Pytest for embedded devices and the software that runs on them.

- Good written and spoken English for working with global teams.

Description:
Job Title: Team Leader - HNI Dealing - Branch Broking

Company Name: Bajaj Broking

Job Description
As a Team Leader - Branch Broking, you will be responsible for driving individual business performance as well as leading the branch dealing team to achieve overall business objectives. The role involves managing your own HNI client portfolio, generating revenue through client acquisition and trading activities, and simultaneously guiding the team to achieve their respective targets.

You will be accountable for individual revenue generation, team productivity, client acquisition, retention, and overall business growth while ensuring superior client servicing, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve overall business and revenue targets.
Drive team-level revenue generation, client acquisition, activation, and retention.
Monitor individual team members' performance and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
Support team members in acquiring new clients, increasing client engagement, and improving revenue productivity.
Oversee trading activities across equity, derivatives, Nifty, and stock options.
Ensure timely sharing of stock, sector, and market updates with clients.
Handle key HNI relationships and resolve escalated client queries.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and develop team capabilities.
Coordinate with research and internal teams to provide relevant investment insights and strategies.
Ensure accurate trade execution, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
Track individual and team performance through regular business reviews and reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.
Coordinate with Branch and Regional leadership to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned individual revenue targets through HNI client acquisition, relationship management, and trading activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA will be an added advantage.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in dealing, sales, or business development within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to HNI clients.
Prior experience in team handling or a supervisory role will be preferred.
Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity, derivatives, and investment products.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship management, and people-management skills.
NISM Series VIII Certification is mandatory.

Job Description:
A highly skilled and motivated AI Architect for designing, developing, and implementing artificial intelligence (AI) solutions within an organization. The role focuses on leveraging AI & GenAI technologies, machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and predictive analytics to solve complex business problems and drive innovation. The AI Architect bridges the gap between business objectives and technology, ensuring that AI systems align with the organization's strategic goals.

What we're looking for:
Education: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in AI projects, data science, or a related field.

Skills:
Expertise in AI & GenAI technologies, frameworks, and methodologies (e.g., supervised/unsupervised learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision).
Proficiency in programming languages like Python or .Net
Strong understanding of cloud technologies (Azure & GCP), APIs, and microservices.
Knowledge of big data processing tools (e.g., Hadoop, Apache Spark).
Hands on experience with tools and platforms used in AI development (e.g., Azure AI Foundry, Ollama, DataBricks etc.).
Proven experience in managing technical projects, preferably in AI, machine learning, or data-driven technologies.
Experience in architecting AI Solutions using on premise and Cloud technologies.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively.
Experience with agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Trello) for managing technical projects.
Knowledge of AI ethics and regulatory compliance frameworks.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
Proficiency with data engineering and cloud architecture principles.

What you'll be doing:
Define and design AI architecture, frameworks, and strategies to meet organizational needs.
Evaluate and select AI tools, platforms, and frameworks to develop innovative solutions.
Supervise or contribute to the development, training, and optimization of Large as well as small language models.
Ensure seamless integration of AI solutions with existing business processes while ensuring that the solution complies with customers internal policies and guidelines.
Design AI solutions that are scalable, secure, and maintainable over time.
Stay updated on the latest advancements in AI and machine learning to propose innovative solutions.
Strong understanding & knowledge about Microsoft Azure cloud and deploying PaaS & SaaS applications on Azure
Strong architecture background especially in AI Solutions and Cloud technologies.
Collaborate with external vendors and partners to leverage their expertise and solutions.
Project Planning and Execution
Define project scope, goals, and deliverables that align with business objectives.
Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and milestones for AI development and deployment initiatives for the inhouse GenAI platform.
Collaborate with business units for ROI determination and identify KPI’s for measuring ROI for each project.
Manage day-to-day project activities to ensure successful execution and timely delivery.
Anticipate potential risks and challenges in AI projects (e.g., data limitations, algorithm performance issues, regulatory concerns).
Proactively implement risk mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
Ensure that AI projects comply with data privacy regulations, industry standards, and ethical guidelines.
Promote responsible use of AI technologies across all projects.

Team Collaboration and Coordination
Act as the primary liaison between AI research teams, data scientists, engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders.
Facilitate regular meetings and communications between business units and IT to discuss AI project progress, challenges, and opportunities.
Plan and coordinate work between onsite and offshore AI teams.
Foster collaboration among team members and remove obstacles to productivity.

What We Offer:
Competitive Salary
Work Life Balance
Professional Development
Innovative Work Environment.
Recognition and Rewards

Description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting monthly disbursement targets.

Key Responsibilities & KRAs

Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by the company.
Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired portfolios.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-building skills.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for extensive field travel.

What We Offer
Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive structure.
Travel allowances.
Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial institution.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Deliver sales targets (volume, value, profitability) in industrial and building segments

Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.

Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.

SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Experience: 25+ Years

Job Description:
EcomEx is looking for an experienced Sales Director / Business Development Director to lead our sales and business development activities and drive overall revenue growth.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue targets.
Generate new B2B business and acquire new customers.
Build and manage a strong sales pipeline.
Develop relationships with business owners, founders, CXOs and decision-makers.
Identify new markets, customers and business opportunities.
Conduct client meetings, presentations and negotiations.
Close new business and grow existing accounts.
Develop strategic partnerships and referral networks.
Build, manage, train and motivate the sales team.
Set sales targets and monitor team performance.
Conduct regular sales and pipeline reviews.
Develop sales processes, reporting systems and SOPs.
Monitor market trends and competitor activities.
Work closely with operations and customer support teams for successful customer onboarding and retention.
Take ownership of sales growth and revenue generation.

Candidate Requirements:
25+ years of experience in Sales / Business Development / B2B Sales.
Proven track record of achieving sales and revenue targets.
Strong customer acquisition and business development experience.
Experience managing and leading sales teams.
Excellent communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
Ability to build strong relationships with senior decision-makers.
Strong commercial and business understanding.
Target-oriented, proactive and result-driven approach.
Ability to independently identify, develop and close business opportunities.

Industry:

Candidates from all industries are welcome.
Experience in Logistics, E-commerce, D2C, SaaS, IT, Technology, FMCG, Manufacturing, Retail, Telecom, Banking, Insurance or other B2B industries will be considered.
AboutCompany:
EcomEx Smart Shipping & Logistics for eCommerce Businesses

EcomEx is a technology-driven logistics aggregation platform designed for eCommerce, D2C brands, marketplaces, and online sellers across India. By connecting businesses with 25+ leading courier partners, including major national carriers, EcomEx enables seamless shipping management through a single, easy-to-use dashboard.

With coverage across 29,000+ pin codes, EcomEx helps businesses automate their shipping operations, reduce logistics costs, and improve delivery performance. Domestic shipping rates start from just 19 for 500g, making it an affordable and scalable solution for businesses of all sizes.

Key Features

Multi-Carrier Shipping Platform

Access multiple courier partners from a single dashboard. Compare shipping rates, delivery timelines, and serviceability to select the most efficient carrier for every order.

AI-Powered RTO Reduction

Reduce Return-to-Origin (RTO) losses with intelligent courier recommendations, automated Non-Delivery Report (NDR) management, and proactive shipment recovery tools that help improve successful delivery rates.

Unified Shipping Dashboard

Manage all shipping operations from one platform. Seamlessly integrate with popular eCommerce platforms and marketplaces to automatically sync orders, generate bulk shipping labels, track shipments in real time, and streamline fulfillment processes.

Real-Time Tracking & Visibility

Monitor shipments from pickup to delivery with live tracking updates and centralized order management.

Additional Logistics Solutions

International Shipping

Expand your business globally with reliable cross-border shipping solutions and end-to-end shipment management.

B2B Cargo Shipping

Move bulk consignments efficiently with B2B logistics services starting from 140 for 10kg.

Warehousing & Fulfillment

Optimize inventory storage, order processing, packing, and dispatch through EcomEx's fulfillment and warehousing network.

Pricing

Free Platform Access

- No registration fee
- No subscription charges
- No platform fees
- Suitable for startups, growing brands, and high-volume sellers

Competitive Shipping Rates

- Domestic shipping starts from 19 for 500g
- B2B cargo shipping starts from 140 for 10kg
- Pay only for the shipments you create

Description:
Company Description

NoBroker.com is Indias first and only PropTech Unicorn, revolutionizing the real estate market by eliminating brokers and enabling seamless property transactions through a technologically advanced platform. Founded in 2014 by alumni from renowned institutions like IIT and IIM, NoBroker serves over 3 million monthly customers across cities including Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, Chennai, Delhi-NCR, and Hyderabad. With funding totaling $366 million from prominent investors such as General Atlantic and Tiger Global, NoBroker offers a wide range of services like brokerage-free property listings, online rental agreements, home services, and society management software. With a passionate team of 5,000+ members, NoBroker is dedicated to simplifying real estate dealings and delivering a brokerage-free experience for its users.
Role Description

The Area Sales Manager (B2B) is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru. The role involves identifying and acquiring new business clients, managing and nurturing existing customer relationships, and achieving sales targets by promoting NoBroker's B2B solutions. The candidate will lead strategic initiatives, analyze market trends, and collaborate across teams to deliver innovative solutions to clients. Regular reporting, forecasting, and active participation in sales strategy development are also key responsibilities. The role requires a hands-on, solution-oriented approach to establish strong client partnerships and drive growth.
Qualifications

Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, and client relationship management
Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
Ability to analyze market trends and develop strategic sales plans
Proficiency in CRM tools, sales software, and data-driven decision making
Leadership and team collaboration skills, with the ability to manage and guide junior team members
Goal-oriented with excellent problem-solving abilities
Strong understanding of the real estate or PropTech industry is an advantage
Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or related field is preferred
Industry
Real Estate

Description:
Wockhardt Hospitals Limited is looking for Critical Care Medicine to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

Patient Assessment : Perform comprehensive assessments of critically ill patients to determine medical conditions and treatment needs. Treatment Planning : Develop and implement individualized treatment plans for patients in the intensive care unit, addressing their specific medical needs. Ventilator Management : Manage and oversee mechanical ventilation for patients requiring respiratory support. Monitoring : Utilize advanced monitoring equipment to assess patients' vital signs and respond promptly to changes in their condition. Diagnostic Procedures : Perform and interpret diagnostic procedures, such as chest X-rays, echocardiograms, and laboratory tests. Collaboration : Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals, including surgeons, nurses, and respiratory therapists, to optimize patient care. Family Communication : Communicate effectively with patients' families, providing updates on the patient's condition, treatment plan, and prognosis. Emergency Response : Respond to medical emergencies within the hospital, particularly in critical care areas. Documentation : Maintain accurate and up-to-date medical records, documenting patient assessments, interventions, and outcomes.

Description:
Finance | Internal Auditor

Location: Bengaluru / Gujarat
Employment Type: Full-time
Experience: 3+ Years
Travel: Willingness to travel across India

About The Akshaya Patra Foundation:
The Akshaya Patra Foundation is a not-for-profit organization implementing the Government of India's PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal) Programme. With a presence across 16+ states and 80+ kitchens, the Foundation serves over 2.35 million meals and 1 million morning snacks every day.
Our mission is to ensure that no child is deprived of education because of hunger. We are committed to strengthening our operational and financial processes as we work towards our vision of serving 6 million meals every day by 2030.
Role Overview
The Internal Auditor will be responsible for conducting internal audits, evaluating financial and operational processes, identifying control gaps, and assessing organizational risks across various locations and functions.
The role requires an analytical and detail-oriented professional who can independently conduct audits, assess internal controls, recommend process improvements, and support the implementation of corrective actions to strengthen the organization's financial governance and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities
1. Internal Audit & Process Review
Conduct periodic internal audits, process audits and thematic audits across departments and locations.
Review financial transactions, accounting processes, documentation and supporting records to ensure accuracy and compliance.
Evaluate the effectiveness of existing internal controls and identify gaps in processes.
Assess adherence to approved policies, procedures and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
2. Risk Management & Internal Controls
Identify potential financial, operational and process-related risks.
Evaluate risk exposure and recommend appropriate control measures.
Support the development and strengthening of internal control frameworks.
Assess control effectiveness and highlight areas requiring corrective action.
3. Data Analysis & Audit Reporting
Analyse financial and operational data to identify discrepancies, unusual trends and potential risks.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, findings, risk areas and recommendations.
Present audit findings and actionable insights to relevant stakeholders and management.
Maintain proper audit documentation, working papers and supporting evidence.
4. Process Improvement & Corrective Actions
Recommend improvements to existing financial and operational processes.
Work closely with respective departments to address audit observations and implement corrective measures.
Monitor and track the closure of audit findings and agreed action plans.
Support process standardization and documentation across locations.
5. Compliance & Documentation
Review compliance with internal policies, financial procedures and applicable statutory requirements.
Ensure proper maintenance of audit records and documentation.
Support management in strengthening governance, transparency and accountability.

Educational Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
CA Inter / CMA Inter / M.Com / MBA (Finance) will be preferred.
Candidates with relevant professional certifications in Internal Audit, Risk Management or Finance will have an added advantage.

Experience & Skills Required
Minimum 3+ years of experience in Internal Audit, Finance Audit, Risk Management or Internal Controls.
Good understanding of accounting principles, financial processes and internal control systems.
Experience in conducting process audits, identifying control gaps and preparing audit reports.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and data interpretation skills.
Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.
Knowledge of Power BI and data analytics tools will be an added advantage.
Strong communication, documentation and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple audit assignments.
Willingness to travel across different locations in India.

Key Competencies
Analytical Thinking and Attention to Detail
Risk Identification and Assessment
Process Orientation
Problem-Solving and Decision-Making
Effective Communication
Integrity and Professional Ethics
Stakeholder Collaboration
Why Join Us?
Be part of an organization where strong financial governance and operational accountability contribute directly to creating a meaningful social impact. Your work will help strengthen systems, improve processes and ensure that organizational resources are utilized effectively towards our mission of ending classroom hunger.
AboutCompany:
The Akshaya Patra Foundation :-
The Akshaya Patra Foundation is one of the worlds largest not-for-profit organisations implementing the Government of Indias Mid-Day Meal Programme. With operations across 16+ states and 78+ kitchens, the Foundation serves over 2.35 million meals and 1 million morning snacks daily to school children.
With a vision to serve 6 million meals per day by 2030, the organisation is committed to eliminating classroom hunger and enabling education through a scalable and sustainable model.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 5 to 8 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

The Client Service at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks’ financial instruments. To further enhance merchants’ business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.

6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Description:
Job Summary
As an Associate in the Financial Institutions Group Client Support team, you will provide consultative support for business intelligence tools and financial data products. You will manage complex client queries, troubleshoot data-related issues, and help clients maximize the value of our platforms.
You will act as a client advocate, working closely with Sales, Product, Technology, Content, and Industry Research teams to improve the client experience, support data quality initiatives, and contribute to product adoption and revenue growth.


The Team
The Financial Institutions Group team provides specialized support to clients across financial institutions, government organizations, universities, and other market participants. With team members across multiple global locations, the team operates in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
Associates develop strong subject matter expertise in financial institutions, banking regulations, mortgage data, demographic research, asset-level analytics, and market intelligence workflows.


The Impact
In this role, you will help strengthen client relationships by delivering timely, accurate, and consultative support. Your work will contribute to client retention, product usage, operational efficiency, and overall client satisfaction.
You will also help identify product enhancement opportunities, improve internal workflows, and support initiatives that enhance data quality and platform usability.


Responsibilities
Provide advanced client support via phone, email, and chat, resolving complex and data-intensive inquiries.
Conduct investigative client conversations to understand business needs, troubleshoot issues, and recommend effective solutions.
Act as a client advocate by identifying opportunities to improve product usability, data quality, and presentation.
Build customized Excel models, templates, and workflows using multiple datasets, including data not directly available on the platform.
Support clients in using mapping tools for mortgage, demographic, asset-level, and market analysis.
Partner with Product and Technology teams to test new features, enhancements, and platform updates with a focus on the end-user experience.
Lead proactive outreach campaigns related to product enhancements, new datasets, and workflow improvements.
Conduct client webcasts and product demonstrations, showcasing knowledge of FIG products, data, and industry trends.
Create Salesforce reports and analyze support trends to improve workflows, team procedures, and client outcomes.
Lead assigned projects from planning through execution and identify opportunities for process improvement.
Mentor new hires and junior team members through training, knowledge sharing, and best-practice development.
Collaborate with global teams across Sales, Product, Technology, Content, and Industry Research to resolve complex client issues.


What We're Looking For

Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field.
Strong understanding of finance, capital markets, banking, or the global economy.
Prior experience in client support, financial data, research, product support, or a related role preferred.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and professionally.
Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.
Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across global, cross-functional teams.
Strong working knowledge of MS Excel and common business tools.
Ability to learn and apply tools such as SQL, Salesforce, mapping platforms, and financial data products.
Flexibility to work rotational shifts and weekends based on business requirements.
