Description:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy is currently looking for dynamic personnel in Quality Assurance Team at Insulation Kit Center for the Transformers Business to join their team in Halol, India, where we have two state of the art insulation kit centers. These kit centers are supplying insulation kits for all major large power transformer manufacturers in India as well as Hitachi Factories in HUB APMEA. This team seeks a skilled and motivated individual.
Transformers BU team leverages innovative and diverse technology to transform energy, delivering social, environmental, and economic value and enabling a sustainable energy future for current and future generations. The business's comprehensive portfolio includes power transformers, traction transformers, insulation and components, digital sensors, and transformer services.The ideal candidate must enjoy working in a dynamic, fast-paced business environment. He or she must be flexible in accommodating business requirements and experience in working with diverse groups and cultures. The ability to multitask & deliver within timelines is essential. The candidate will have excellent communications skills. The job requires travelling to visit customers when needed.


How you'll make an impact
Develops and implements quality assurance strategies and plans to enhance production quality, efficiency, and effectiveness.
Lead QMS and ensure the system established is fulfilling the ISO requirements such as Functional requirements, Audit requirements, regular review of ISO processes and upgrade them for continuous improvement. Provides internal reporting on quality assurance activities, progress, and outcomes to relevant stakeholders.
Utilizes data-driven insights to drive/contribute decision-making and implement necessary process improvements.
Conducts training programs and workshops to promote quality awareness to develop the skills of manufacturing personnel.
Collaborates with manufacturing teams to address customer-specific quality requirements. Assist in analyzing customer feedback and identifying areas for improvement.
Participate in cross functional projects aimed at improving product quality through manufacturing/assembly process improvements.
Participates in development and implementation of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions to mitigate process risks. Conducts process audits and inspections to verify compliance with process risk mitigation measures.
Conducts comprehensive risk assessments for manufacturing/assembly processes to identify potential risks by performing activities like failure mode and effects analysis (PFMEA).
Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Involves in PPAP and supplier development activities and lead with cross functional team till supplier onboarding in line with the global Hitachi guidelines.
Incoming quality inspections and maintaining relevant data and records, supporting suppliers for improving their QMS and rejection rates and processes.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background
Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech in Electrical / Mechanical engineering
Relevant experience 6 to 8 years in quality assurance function at any large transformers manufacturing unit.
Experience in Transformer Insulation Kits manufacturing will be an added advantage
Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Certified

Description:
Key missions of the position:
We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Service Engineer to join our team, specializing in the Troubleshooting of field complaint and perform installation, commissioning and maintenance of Wabtec systems. The candidate will require to have a strong understanding of mechanical, electrical and Pneumatic circuit diagrams, electronic components, and their working principles. This role requires hands-on experience in trou
bleshooting, repairing of Electrical, mechanical and pneumatic systems.
Roles and responsibility are as below:
Production Support: Assist in the Installation, commissioning, Testing of Wabtec system/Product in the rolling stock
Field Complaint Resolution: Troubleshoot and resolve the field complaints related to Wabtec systems, providing timely resolution and closure of the complaints. Such requirement relates to troubleshooting the Mechanical, electrical, electronics, pneumatic or maintenance related issues and relacing the defective part to close the complaint within the contractual timelines.
Installation and Commissioning: Support the installation and commissioning of the Wabtec product and performing the required testing. Enabling customer to perform the task in a right manner if needed.
Retrofit, Maintenance and Repairs: Perform retrofit, regular maintenance and emergency repairs on Wabtec products inline with procedure and site requirement.
Reporting and Documentation: Report and record the field interventions performed by himself and associated team. The service engineer would require making a report of the issue and also get the Joint notes or associated document as needed by customer contract. Daily, weekly and Monthly reports to be submitted to manager.
NCR and Failed Part Management: Maintain accountability for Non-Conformance Reports (NCR), maintain consumed spares/Failed part and site spares data. Organizing the dispatch of the defective parts from site to plant in co-ordination with plant team.
Customer Interaction: Communicate effectively with clients to understand their issues and provide clear explanations of the work performed. Follow up the closure of Nonconformity reports and work orders issued.
Travel: Willingness to travel across India to various sites as needed for warranty, installation & Commissioning, retrofit and maintenance service for the customer order.
Safety, Quality, and Compliance: Ensure all work is performed in accordance with our organizations strict safety, quality, and compliance standards.
Education/Training
BE / B.Tech in Mechanical / Electrical & electronics.
Professional Experience:
How many years of professional experience in a specific professional area are required for the position?
Minimum of 6 years of experience in a similar role (Field service) preferably in the transportation railways or Lifts and escalator with good troubleshooting skills
Key Competences (Transversal/Professional)
Reading and interpreting circuit diagrams : Intermediate
Knowledge on software installation : Novice
Troubleshooting & repair:Advanced
problem-solving abilities: Advanced
Microsoft Office:Intermediate
Communication: English speaking and writing:Intermediate
Languages:
English and Hindi & Any other regional language (is an added advantage)
Other Specifications:
Position will be initially in Eastern region, subsequently transferrable anywhere in the country
Ability to learn quickly. Agility to adapt to new environment/ business strategies
Collaborate with multiple departments
Passionate to lead and take initiatives
Good attitude and interpersonal relationship

Description:
The opportunity

As an Electrical Design Engineer specializing in Transformer Design at the Global Engineering Center in Vadodara, India, youll be part of a dynamic team that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration. The Transformers Business Unit is leading the way in energy transformation, delivering advanced solutions across a wide range of industries.
This role offers a unique opportunity to work alongside experts from diverse backgrounds, united by a shared commitment to building a sustainable future.

How you'll make an impact

Designing of oil filled Power Transformers up to 400 kV range (LPT, LMPT) (Power, GSU and Arc Furnace, reactor, dry type & Rectifier Transformers).
Preparation of Tender, especially for the repair/retrofit/upgradation projects & further detail engineering.
Preparations of cost estimates.
Preparation of ordering specifications for accessories, spare parts and components,
Conducting design review meetings with cross functional teams & customers for technical issues.
Basic understanding of schematics and mechanical design.
Basic understanding in Transformer inspection, testing and failure analysis (Root Cause Analysis).
Understanding in core & active part and tank drawings.
Good coordination with TRES team and external customers for smooth execution of projects.
Site Visit, as & when required.
Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Living Hitachi Energys core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background

B.E / B. Tech Electrical Engineering.
8-12 years experience working in Electrical design for Power Transformers manufacturing Industry. Candidates with higher experience also to be considered.
Understanding of Transformer Electrical Design, Thermal, Dielectrics, Short circuit and sound performance and transformer mechanics
Should have good understanding of IS/ IEC /IEEE Standards & Canadian Standards.
Experience in Simulation or software development would be advantageous.
Experience on Microsoft office and tools.
Ability to speak with and work together with the technical teams in different parts of the world.
Demonstrated team building skills, would be a preference.
Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required.

Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.

Good local market knowledge.
Target-driven mindset with a customer-first approach.
Own a vehicle (two-wheeler/four-wheeler preferred).
Fluency in English, Hindi, and a local language.
Availability to work 6 days a week (including weekends).

Real Estate Knowledge

Problem-Solving & Negotiation

Customer-Centric Approach

Job Summary:

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Engineer with 6+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in both front-end and back-end technologies, along with experience in cloud platforms, API development, and modern software development practices.

Description:
Job Title: Intern
Department: Operations
About Business line/Function: The Operations team includes different business units such as Securities Services, Wealth Management, Global Banking Operations, Markets Operations (back office & middle office) and Client engagement & Financial Securities.
These business units provides services to global clients across Asia, Europe & US region offering a wide range of services, which include custody operations, fund accounting, middle-office operations, static data management, trade clearing and settlement operations, securities lending, corporate action, Tax Operations, AML / KYC and other transversal services.
Position Purpose: The purpose of the roles is to provide service to Clients and their Portfolios related activities pertaining to different markets across the globe. 
The incumbent will be managing the daily operations/workflow within the business group and helps the Leads in achieving the process deliverables. 
Responsibilities
Processing of transactions within the agreed timelines
Ensure all the transactions are completed and approved in the system within the TAT /SLA
Ensure all the transactions are processed with at most care without errors/mistakes.
Prioritize the work and conduct investigation with due diligence on all the discrepancies.
Taking corrective measures/action in consultation with the Leads
Escalate unresolved open items to the Leads
Maintain Communication Channels with internal peer groups.
Participate in Cross Training and ensure the Knowledge transfer between the team and processes is happening on periodic basis.
Participate in Brainstorming Sessions and share the best practices and ideas with the peer groups and team members.
Consistently evaluate and update documented procedures to ensure they are complete, accurate and current
The position interfaces with other Process Associates, Mid Office Staff, Relationship Managers and Clients
The position interfaces with International Team Members of BNP Group and its Clients or Vendors or Sub-Custodians
Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure adherence to compliance and risk management policies and procedures. Identify and report any potential risks or compliance issues.
Quality Assurance: Conduct regular self-checks to ensure that all processes and transactions meet the required standards and guidelines.
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
The candidate should be able to read, write and speak in French language
Strong analytical skills, detail orientation, service commitment, solid organizational and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in shifts as required.
Specific Qualifications:
Graduation in any discipline
DELF B1 and above certification in French language
Location: Mumbai/ Chennai/ Bangalore
About BNP Paribas Group:
BNP Paribas is the European Unions leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Groups commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
About BNP Paribas India Solutions:
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, color, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. Description:
Third Party Pay Roll
Officer - Costing & Budgeting
Location: Bangalore RO
Experience Required
Minimum 4 years of experience in Costing & Budgeting.
Mandatory experience in handling Real Estate Projects (Residential, Commercial, Mixed-use developments).
Job Purpose
The objective of this position is to prepare and monitor construction budgets, estimate quantities, perform cost analysis, and support effective cost control for real estate projects. The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate cost estimation, budget monitoring, rate analysis, and timely reporting.
Key Responsibilities
Cost Estimation
Preparation of BOQs and quantity estimation based on construction drawings.
Analysis and interpretation of drawings received from Structural Consultants, Architects, and MEP Consultants.
Preparation of project cost estimates for residential and commercial real estate developments.
Assist in budget planning during project feasibility and execution stages.
Cost & Budget Monitoring
Preparation of detailed project budgets and periodic budget revisions.
Monitor project costs against approved budgets and identify variances.
Track budget vs. actual expenditures and provide recommendations for cost optimization.
Prepare and submit monthly cost monitoring reports to management.
Rate Analysis
Conduct rate analysis for various construction activities and materials.
Maintain and update cost databases considering location-wise and project-specific parameters.
Evaluate vendor quotations and support procurement teams in cost comparison exercises.
Develop benchmarking data for residential and commercial projects.
Reporting & Coordination
Prepare MIS reports related to project costs, budgets, and forecasts.
Coordinate with Project, Procurement, Contracts, and Finance teams for cost tracking and control.
Support management in decision-making through cost analysis and reporting.
Key Competencies
Strong knowledge of construction costing, budgeting, and estimation.
Ability to read and analyze architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.
Proficiency in MS Excel and cost estimation tools.
Good analytical and reporting skills.
Attention to detail and ability to work within timelines.
Key Deliverables
Timely and accurate cost estimation.
Effective project budget preparation and monitoring.
Accurate rate analysis and cost benchmarking.
Monthly budget variance and cost monitoring reports.
Cost optimization recommendations for real estate projects.
This version aligns the role to an Officer level and emphasizes the requirement of 4+ years of experience in real estate project costing and budgeting.

Description:
The opportunity:
The Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC) is a competence center with around 2600+ skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project Management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energys units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy To date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.The Inventory Management Lead will play a vital role in ensuring effective inventory control and data accuracy across global operations. By collaborating with internal teams and stakeholders, this role will focus on minimizing excess inventory, standardizing processes, and improving data integrity within the organization. The Inventory Management Lead will provide actionable insights, optimize stock utilization, and drive alignment across plants worldwide, contributing to operational efficiency and strategic business objectives.
How youll make an impact:
Lead the implementation of the GA SCM TTL strategy in collaboration with internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment with global policies, processes,systemsand the defined governance model.
Partner with GA Hubs and Global Product Groups (GPGs) toconsolidatevolume data andvalidateGA TTL budget forecasts,targetsand planning assumptions.
Act as the key liaison with the TTL Center of Expertise (CoE), reviewing centrally managed initiatives and coordinating their effective implementation within GA.
Monitor TTLCoEservice-level performance and drive corrective actions or improvement initiatives whererequired.
Track GA SCM TTL initiatives in close alignment with the TTLCoE, ensuring progress, risks and dependencies are clearly visible.
Drive standardization, processharmonizationand supplier consolidation across GA Hubs and GPGs.
Engage GA Hubs and GPGs toidentify, develop andconsolidatea pipeline of opportunities supporting delivery of the GA TTL cost reduction (CR) and cost avoidance (CA) plan; conduct regular reviews tomonitorprogress against targets.
Act as a change agent by building awareness, supporting stakeholder engagement and enabling the successful rollout of new TTL projects,toolsand processes.
Provide regular and ad hoc updates on TTL topics, regulatorychangesand compliance requirements;identify,addressor escalate gaps to ensure GAremainscompliant.
Collaborate with counterparts across other Business Units to exchange knowledge, benchmark performance and implement relevant best practices.
Represent GA in relevant workshops and provide input on GA forecasts,performanceand annual TTL budget planning.
Support best-in-class delivery against Hitachi Energy KPIs, includingmaintainingaccuratepurchasing information records (PIRs), such as material weights and country of origin data.
Undertakeadditionalresponsibilities asrequiredto support the team and evolving business priorities.
Your background:
Bachelors degree in engineering, supply chain management,logistics, businessadministrationora relateddiscipline.
Minimum of five yearsrelevant experience in supply chain management, transport, trade,logistics,procurementor a related operational environment.
Experience working in cross-functional,matrixedor global organizations, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business units,functionsand geographies.
Knowledge of SAP or similar enterprise systems is desirable.
Fluent English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong commercial awareness, with an understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements or a willingness to develop thisexpertise.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management,negotiationand influencing skills.
Proactive and accountable, witha strong senseof ownership and the ability to drive topics forward independently.
Structured,collaborative,and results-oriented, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver outcomes in a dynamic environment.
Analytical and solutions-focused, with strong problem-solving capability and attention to detail.
Comfortable working across cultures and countries, with a mindset that supports collaboration, continuousimprovementand change adoption.

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Java Developer with expertise in NMS (Network Management System) and EMS (Element Management System) development for telecom and networking products. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining network management applications used for monitoring, configuration, fault management, and performance management of network devices.
Key Responsibilities
Application Development
Design, develop, and maintain NMS/EMS applications using Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and REST APIs.
Develop modules for Fault Management (FM), Configuration Management (CM), Performance Management (PM), and Inventory Management (IM).
Implement northbound and southbound interfaces for network device communication.Integrate NMS/EMS platforms with network elements such as: Router, Switches, Optical devices, GPON/EPON equipment Wireless and Broadband devices
Develop adapters/plugins supporting: SNMP, v2/v3, NETCONF/YANG, RESTCONF, TL1, CLI/SSH, gRPC

Role Overview
The role involves assisting shareholders with buying and selling shares in accordance with established procedures and service standards. The candidate will also handle customer queries and provide operational support under appropriate guidance and supervision.

Key Responsibilities
Handle inbound calls and emails from shareholders, addressing their queries within agreed service standards.
Assist shareholders with share purchase and sale transactions over inbound calls.
Resolve basic customer queries and escalate complex issues to senior team members when necessary.
Support the team in completing daily workloads and meeting operational targets.
Continuously develop operational knowledge and skills while identifying opportunities to improve processes and service quality.
Perform additional duties of a similar nature as required.
Follow company policies, procedures, quality standards, and reporting requirements, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory and statutory obligations.
Carry out all responsibilities in accordance with the requirements of the company's regulators.
Adhere to established physical and information security procedures to protect company and customer information.
Ensure all activities comply with the applicable quality management system.
Follow scheduled break timings to maintain operational efficiency and meet Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Work according to the designated US business holiday calendar.

Required Skills, Experience, and Competencies
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and telephone communication skills, with strong active listening abilities.
Shift Flexibility: Willingness and ability to work in US shifts.
Customer Support Experience: Previous experience in a customer service or customer support role
Target Achievement: Ability to meet targets related to accuracy, quality, productivity, and agreed service levels.
CRM Knowledge: Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems and practices.
Data Protection and AML: Basic understanding of data protection principles and Anti-Money Laundering (AML).
Customer Focus: Ability to understand customer needs and adapt communication styles to different personalities.
Time Management: Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and manage time effectively.
Compliance and Process Adherence: Ability to follow established procedures, policies, and regulatory requirements.
Teamwork: Willingness to support team members and contribute beyond assigned responsibilities.

Description:
Company Profile
Hitachi Energy is a pioneering technology leader that is helping to increase access to affordable, reliable, sustainable, and modern energy for all. We help to power your home, keep the factories running, and our hospitals and schools open. Come as you are and prepare to get better as you learn from others. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and plug into a team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation.
Visit us -
Business Information:
Hitachi Energy India Development Centre (IDC) is a research and development facility with around 500 RD engineers, specialists, and experts, who focus on creating and sustaining digital solutions, new products and technology. This includes product integration, testing, cybersecurity, and certification. The India Development Centre is situated in Chennai and Bangalore.

IDC collaborates with the RD and Research centres of Hitachi Energy, which are spread across more than 15 locations throughout 12 countries.
In the past 20 years, IDC has secured more than 200 international papers and 150+ patents.
Mission Statement:
We are looking for a skilled and motivated engineer to join our team of RD Engineers.
A person interested in the field of power electronic converters and contribute towards global RD projects.

How you'll make impact:
You bring broad knowledge in the field of controls design, power electronics as an experienced control engineer for power electronics.
Development of control/Protection software in MACH control platform and MATLAB Simulink.
Documentations for control software like concept documents, test reports and other supporting documents part of development.
Eagerness for learning and innovation, the readiness of mind for the use of various new tools for developments tasks but also for collaborating with the team efficiently.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your Background:

Phd or Master's degree in electrical engineering with an emphasis on Power Electronics control and control system.
Industry experience with power converters, control systems design and real-time control software.
Control software design experience in MACH control platform, MATLAB/Simulink, or other control platforms.
Proficiency in the use of simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD would be an advantage.
Python programming would be an advantage.
Team spirit with the capacity to work independently, complemented by a quick intellect and well-developed analytical skills.
Experience working in an Agile development team would be an advantage.
You like to work in multicultural/international environment.
Proficiency in both spoken written English language is required.

Manager – Learning & Development (Manufacturing & Sales)
You will be leading end-to-end capability building across manufacturing operations and commercial sales teams. This role aligns technical, operational, and sales training programs with business goals to improve shop-floor safety and productivity as well as field sales effectiveness.
Key Responsibilities
F Training Needs Analysis (TNA): Partner with plant heads, production leads, and sales leaders to identify skill gaps, operational bottlenecks, and revenue enablement needs.
F Manufacturing & Technical Capability: Design and oversee programs covering SOPs, machinery/process operations, quality standards, EHS/safety compliance, lean/operational excellence, and new-hire plant induction.
F Sales Enablement & Capability: Build and deliver training on product knowledge, consultative selling, objection handling, territory/channel management, CRM adoption, and sales onboarding.
F Program Design & Delivery: Develop blended learning solutions—including hands-on shop-floor coaching, workshops, field ride-alongs, and LMS/e-learning modules—using internal SMEs and external trainers.
F LMS & Governance: Manage the Learning Management System (LMS), training calendars, compliance tracking, vendor contracts, and the L&D budget.
F Impact & ROI Measurement: Track completion, assessments, on-the-job transfer, safety/quality metrics, and sales KPIs to evaluate and refine programs.

Preferred candidate profile
1. Should have 6–10+ years in L&D or corporate training, with demonstrated exposure to both manufacturing/industrial environments and sales/commercial teams. Hindi Speaking is a must.
2. Instructional design, facilitation and coaching, stakeholder management with plant and sales leaders, LMS/analytics proficiency, and willingness to travel to plants and sales territories.
3. Prior experience working as a learning and development manager
4. Knowledge of learning and developmental theories and practices
5. Demonstrable communication, organisational and time management skills
6. Learning Needs Analysis
7. Content Creation/Instructional Design
8. Organizational Development
9. Talent Management
10. Leadership Development
11. Team Leadership
12. Project Management
13. Vendor Management
14. Learning & Development Metrics
15. Budget Management
16. Ability to bring innovative Learning & Development ideas and proposals to the team that can improve associate career development.

An outstanding remuneration package that rewards professionalism and diligence will be on offer for the successful applicant as well as a well-defined career path. An excellent package will be on offer for the right candidate, including an above-mentioned industry base salary for the right person as well as the most complete employee benefit scheme. Description:
Job Summary
Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC) is a competence center with around 3000+ skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energy's units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy. To date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.
Mission Statement: As a Tender/Quotation Specialist for Distribution Transformer Factory - Egypt, you will be part of Indian Operation Center in India (INOPC), aiming to develop a global value chain, where key business activities, resources and expertise are shared across geographic boundaries to optimize value for Hitachi Energy customers across market.
You will support tendering activities of Distribution Transformer Factory in Egypt play a pivotal role in ensuring seamless bid submission and order booking. Work location will be based out of Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
Your Responsibilities
Product Marketing Management: Supports the product marketing organization/customer in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions. Formulates competitive bids/estimates/quotations, taking into account best available oil/ dry type transformer product mix and appropriate technical and commercial considerations for each individual situation. Ensures tenders are well documented in a timely manner and with appropriate level of detail, including full and accurate costs.
Offer Preparation - Manages the preparation of all technical (e.g. defining the most suitable technology and product type(s)), financial (e.g. total price sheet, cash flow analysis) and if necessary project management (e.g. quantifies hours of engineering and commissioning) aspects of the bid/estimate/quotation, indicating prices and trading conditions.
Order booking and SFDC Support: Customer creation/Change, Customer credit request, Order booking basing on ERP work as well as SFDC data input/configuration
Risk - Identifies potential risks in the bids, quotations and estimates, and in any related contract agreements across customers/channels. Provides information and/or participates in the Risk Review process in accordance with policy.
Documentation - Collects and archives documentation regarding the offer/order and records assumptions and decisions taken during the development process. Regularly reports the status of the bids/estimates/quotations using defined tools and collects and analyses the reasons for tenders being lost and won.
Health, safety and environment (HSE) - Ensures the project follows and complies with company health, safety, and environmental policies


Your Background
Bachelor's degree in engineering, with 2 plus years of professional experience in Distribution Transformer Tendering or Front End Sales.
Familiarity with Microsoft Excel, Word
Prociency in English language.
Preferred who have worked in sizable and well-structured organization

Location: Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata
Must have skills: GCC / GBS Strategy, Functional Operating Model Design, Shared Services Design, Sourcing & Location Strategy, Business Case Formulation, Functional Transformation such as Finance Process Transformation (O2C / P2P / R2R / FP&A)
Good to have skills: Multi-function GBS, Transition & Migration Management, Service Management & SLA Design, Agentic AI in functions, Data Visualization Tools
Experience: 12-15 years
Educational Qualification: MBA from Tier-1 Institute or CA / CPA
Job Summary:
Manage defined workstreams within GBS / GCC and operating model transformation engagements, taking responsibility for structuring the approach, shaping the analysis, and delivering high-quality outputs within agreed timelines
Own and lead projects - guiding team, reviewing outputs, and ensuring coherence across deliverables at the workstream level
Manage client presentations, workshop materials, and proposal sections independently, contributing actively to client discussions and working sessions
Develop business cases, cost analyses, value realization frameworks, and supporting models for GBS / SSC setup and transformation assignments
Apply a process and operating-model perspective across GBS design, governance, KPI and maturity frameworks, and emerging areas such as Gen AI-enabled processes
Lead business development efforts through research, pitch preparation, and proposal development
Excel as a long-term trusted advisor and partner by providing thought leadership and profound knowledge of market trends
Roles & Responsibilities:
GBS / GCC Strategy and Setup: Lead analysis of operating model options (centralized, federated, hybrid) and build-operate setup models, location and sourcing strategy, GBS guiding principles, and process taxonomy (L0-L5) design for new and scaling shared services
Operating Model Design: Design integrated operating models for GBS / GCC setups, including organizational structure options, service delivery models, and transition, knowledge-transfer, and stabilization planning considerations independently
Operating Model: Manage the design, documentation, and continuous improvement of the Operating Model by analyzing processes, roles, governance, and performance metrics to enable efficient service delivery
Cost Analysis and Value Realization: Lead analysis and detailed cost model development covering setup costs, run-rate costs, and total cost of ownership for GBS and transformation scenarios; build value realization frameworks that track benefit and savings delivery against investment over time, incorporating productivity, quality, and strategic value levers
Org Design and Sizing: Design organization structures for the GBS / SSC and retained teams - roles, spans and layers, reporting lines, and FTE sizing methodologies
SSC Location Strategy: Lead location assessment and selection studies across cost, talent availability, risk, and scalability dimensions to recommend best-fit delivery locations for shared services
KPI and Performance Frameworks: Design KPI and SLA frameworks for GBS performance management, covering operational, financial, service, and experience metrics; develop dashboards and reporting cadences aligned to governance structures
Capability Maturity Assessment: Conduct structured maturity assessments across functions and processes against leading-practice benchmarks; translate findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps with clear ownership and timelines
Governance, RACI and Interaction Model Design: Design governance frameworks (councils, decision rights, escalation paths), RACI matrices, and interaction models defining roles and collaboration patterns between the GBS, retained organization, business units, and third-party providers
Operating Model Design: Design integrated operating models for GBS / GCC setups, including organizational structure options, service delivery models, and transition, knowledge-transfer, and stabilization planning considerations
Gen AI in Functions: Contribute to assessments and recommendations on Gen AI and intelligent automation use cases across functional processes - such as AP invoice processing, reconciliations, close acceleration, and management reporting


Qualification
Professional & Technical Skills:
12-15 years of total experience in GBS consulting, operating model, functional transformation, or advisory, or in-house shared services; experience at a top-tier or Big 4 firm preferred
Experience leading workstreams in GBS / GCC design, functional operating model, or shared services engagements
Working knowledge of at least 2-3 of the following: GBS / GCC / SSC setup, operating model design, sourcing & location strategy, org design & sizing, process maturity assessment, governance & interaction model design
Ability to build and interpret cost models, TCO analyses, and value realization frameworks and GBS transformation contexts
Experience designing KPI and SLA frameworks and performance measurement structures; ability to translate strategic objectives into measurable operational metrics
Familiarity with maturity assessment approaches - capability, process, or operating-model maturity - and ability to develop actionable improvement roadmaps from findings
Familiarity with core functional processes and process taxonomy frameworks such as the L0-L5 process hierarchy
Understanding of ERP and digital technologies (e.g. SAP S/4HANA, Oracle) and automation tools such as RPA and process mining
Awareness of Gen AI adoption in one or more functions including intelligent automation use cases and their implications for GBS process and workforce design
Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau); strong structured communication and presentation skills
Additional Information:
Opportunity to work on GBS / GCC and operating model programs for marquee G2000 clients across industries
Exposure to senior stakeholder engagements and client-facing responsibilities as part of high-performing delivery teams
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to build scalable AI systems that drive business value.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models.
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, validation, and deployment.
Work with large datasets to perform data cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory analysis.
Deploy AI/ML models into production using cloud platforms and ML Ops practices.
Monitor model performance and retrain models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
Research and implement the latest advancements in AI, Generative AI, NLP, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning.
Ensure adherence to data security, governance, and ethical AI standards.

Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, and data engineering concepts.
Familiarity with REST APIs and software development best practices.
Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in Machine Learning/AI development (adjust as needed).
Experience delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
Knowledge of NLP, Computer Vision, Recommendation Systems, or Agentic AI.
Familiarity with Spark, Databricks, and big data technologies.

Description:
About the Role:
Hurix Digital is looking for an accomplished business and operations leader to lead the next phase of growth across our Content, Technology and AI Data Services businesses. This is a senior enterprise leadership role with responsibility for business operations, delivery, revenue realization, profitability, customer success, people leadership and organizational capability. The EVP will work closely with the CEO and the leadership team to build a predictable,profitable and scalable operating organizationone that delivers consistently for customers,develops strong leaders and enables sustainable business growth.

Key Responsibilities:

Business & P&L Leadership
Own operational performance across Content, Technology and AI Data Services.
Drive revenue realization, gross margin, EBITDA, productivity, utilization and cost optimization.
Lead annual operating plans, forecasting, capacity planning and business reviews.
Partner closely with Finance, Sales and business leaders to make informed decisions on growth, investments, costs and profitability.
Ensure that signed business translates into successful, profitable and sustainable delivery. The role should carry genuine business accountability; the earlier EVP framework similarly linked the position directly to growth, profitability, revenue and margin outcomes.

Delivery & Operational Excellence
Build a strong operating rhythm through dashboards, metrics, forecasting, reviews and early-warning mechanisms.
Strengthen delivery governance and establish a high-performing PMO Excellence capability.
Improve predictability across quality, timelines, capacity, productivity and margins.
Build systems and processes that reduce dependence on firefighting and individual heroics.
Drive continuous improvement through technology, automation and AI-enabled workflows.

Customer Leadership
Act as a senior executive sponsor for strategic customers.
Build strong relationships with customer leadership teams and participate actively in QBRs, reviews and critical engagements.
Lead major escalations and ensure strong recovery and closure.
Partner with Sales and Pre-Sales on solutioning, commercials, feasibility and transition of new opportunities.
Identify opportunities for account expansion and deeper customer partnerships.

People & Leadership
Build and develop a strong second line of leaders across operations and delivery.
Assess leadership capability, identify talent risks early and take decisive action where the organization needs stronger talent.
Coach high-potential leaders and create clear succession and development plans.
Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and high performance.
Be a visible and accessible leader, especially during critical business and delivery situations.
Ensure that business growth is achieved without compromising team health,leadership quality or organizational sustainability.
People and customer outcomes were already explicit components of the prior EVP incentive framework through Client Happiness, Team Happiness and People/Customer/Revenue Impact.

AI Data Services & Technology
Play a key role in scaling Hurixs emerging AI Data Services business.
Bring strong business understanding of data operations, human-in-the-loop models,expert talent ecosystems, quality, throughput, productivity and margin.
Strengthen the Technology business by connecting technology capability with customer needs, solutions and profitable delivery.
Drive practical adoption of AI and automation across operations to improve speed,quality and business economics.

Enterprise Leadership
Operate as a trusted partner to the CEO and leadership team.
Provide clear visibility into business performance, risks, customer concerns and people issues.
Surface problems early, bring data-backed recommendations and take ownership for execution.
Work effectively across Sales, Finance, HR, Solutions and other functions to drive enterprise outcomes.
Act as a strong leadership presence on the ground and help translate strategy into execution.

Experience & Background:
We are looking for a leader with approximately 20+ years of experience, including significant responsibility for large-scale operations, delivery or business-unit leadership.
The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
Meaningful P&L and business ownership, beyond project or delivery management.
Experience leading large, complex and multi-disciplinary teams.
Strong track record of driving revenue realization, profitability, productivity and operational predictability.
Executive-level customer management and experience handling strategic accounts.
Demonstrated ability to build strong leadership teams and second-line capability.
Strong numerical and analytical orientation with experience using dashboards,forecasting and operating metrics.
Experience in solutioning, pre-sales, commercials and transition from Sales to Delivery.
Exposure to AI/Data Services, technology services, digital services, learning/content services or adjacent knowledge-intensive businesses.
Strong partnership experience with Finance on business planning, revenue, cost and profitability.
Experience working with global customers and distributed teams.
Prior experience in digital learning or content services is valuable but not mandatory.
We are equally interested in leaders from technology, data and digital services who bring the right combination of business, customer, people and operating leadership.

Leadership Traits We Value
We are looking for someone who can combine:
Structure without bureaucracy.
Speed without chaos.
Customer obsession without organizational burnout.

Hurix Digital is seeking an experienced Senior DevSecOps Engineer to strengthen security across AWS cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and production environments. A day in the life of an Infoscion
As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to actively aid the consulting team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation and design and deployment

Analyze automation test results, identify defects, and track issues through resolution.

Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
Ensure automation coverage and improve testing efficiency.

Test execution, reporting, and defect management expertise.

Page Object Model (POM) Framework implementation.
Cross-browser automation testing.
Handling dynamic web elements and synchronization techniques.

Collections, Exception Handling, and Multithreading knowledge.

Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

including Commercial and Domestic systems based on Watermist or Wet Chemical technology, and other Specialised

Demand Fulfiller as Well as a Demand Generator
In addition to the all-encompassing product range, Ceasefire offers some unique solutions that are trendsetters in the
industry like the Ceasefire Launcher that is an extinguisher + suppression system or a Mini that is worlds smallest
suppression system to an Atom X which is worlds first retrofittable fire suppression system.
Our Manufacturing Edge
Ceasefires competitive edge & the quality promise stems from the companys state-of-the-art production facility with
cutting-edge manufacturing capabilities. This production facility is one of the most advanced in the world and is fully
compliant to the Factory Production Control (FPC) requirements of the highest global standards including EN3,
EN1866, LPCB, BSI, MED, PED, VDS, ISO and OHSAS.
Sales Management
The day-to-day working is fully supported by a robust yet user friendly CCRM that allows a salesperson to record
every transaction he has in his role as a recruiter and as a salesperson.
The CCRM follows the SPANCO process and allows our sales manager or CBA to follow through a sale from the
very start, i.e. from creating a customer profile sheet to making a prospect, sending him a proposal and executing
the order received. It also acts as an archive of marketing materials such as brochures, videos, manuals which can

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 5 to 8 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

Description:
JOB OVERVIEW


We are seeking an experienced Billing Platform Senior Manager Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end solution architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the entire Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in both Billing and Revenue capabilities, with extensive experience in subscription billing, usage-based billing, pricing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, financial integrations, and enterprise application architecture.
As a trusted advisor to clients, the Senior Manager will drive business transformation initiatives by translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing Billing Platform solutions aligned with industry best practices. The role requires a strong blend of functional, technical, and consulting expertise, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams, engage with executive stakeholders, and deliver large-scale digital transformation programs.
The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end solution ownership, including solutioning, architecture, business process design, functional and technical design, application configuration, integrations, data migration, development oversight, proof of concepts, testing strategy, deployment planning, user enablement, and post-go-live support. The role also requires strong leadership in project management, delivery governance, team management, quality assurance, risk management, and stakeholder communication while driving successful project milestones.
Additionally, the Senior Manager will play a key role in practice development by contributing to solution accelerators, AI-enabled delivery, capability building, pre-sales, client workshops, and thought leadership initiatives. The individual will work closely with client executives, business stakeholders, product teams, architects, functional consultants, and technical teams to deliver end-to-end Q2C solutions that optimize revenue operations, improve business outcomes, and support enterprise growth.


Years of Experience: 12 - 18 Years
Position Requirements:
Own the solution architecture and design for enterprise Quote-to-Cash transformations across Billing and Revenue, including subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, and financial integrations. Lead end-to-end Billing Platform solution architecture for large-scale implementation programs.
Manage end-to-end implementation programs by overseeing project planning, solution design, configuration, development, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, and hypercare while leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality outcomes on time and within budget. Define enterprise architecture, solution blueprints, and implementation roadmap.
Partner with client executives, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, facilitate workshops, perform fit-gap analysis, develop scalable solution designs, and provide strategic recommendations aligned with industry best practices. Excellent client-facing skills and communication (written/verbal) skills
Establish delivery governance, manage project risks and dependencies, review solution quality, ensure compliance with architectural standards, and drive successful milestone execution through proactive stakeholder communication and issue resolution.
Contribute to practice development through pre-sales, estimations, proposals, AI-enabled delivery accelerators, capability building, mentoring, solution assets, thought leadership, and the development of reusable frameworks that enhance delivery efficiency and support business growth.
Build and maintain billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, and revenue-related processes.
Design and develop integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, CRM systems, Payment gateways, Tax engines and Data warehouses
Strong hands-on experience with billing platform and experience with APIs, integrations, and data reconciliation.
Understand customer business processes/functional specifications and independently drive technical solutioning to delivery
Ability to lead business discussions with customers, discover requirements, frame a problem statement, lead solution workshops and deliver a Technical solution
Must ensure teams follow the correct procedures, best practices and documentation requirements across project phases
Drive solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Technical Skills:
API, SQL, CSS, HTML, Java Script, JSON and XML
Certifications:
BillingPlatform Partner Essential Certification (L1)
BillingPlatform Partner Pro Certification (L2)
BillingPlatform Partner Elite Certification (L3)
Additional Job DescriptionAdditional Job DescriptionThe Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As a Senior Manager - Billing Platform - Finance Solutions, you will lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will leverage your skills to drive business transformation initiatives, translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions. You will engage with executive stakeholders, delivering large-scale digital transformation programs that optimize revenue operations and support enterprise growth.

As a Senior Manager, you will guide cross-functional teams, applying sound judgment and strategic advising to solve complex problems. You will motivate and coach teams, fostering a diverse and inclusive environment that contributes to the firm's success. Your role involves crafting impactful messages, validating outcomes with clients, and navigating challenging situations with composure. You will also contribute to practice development through thought leadership initiatives and capability building.

In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will focus on implementing Oracle lead management and customer experience solutions, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Your leadership in project management, delivery governance, and stakeholder communication will drive successful project milestones and enhance delivery efficiency.

Responsibilities

- Leading the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle
- Translating complex business requirements into scalable and secure Billing Platform solutions aligned with industry practices
- Managing end-to-end implementation programs, including project planning, solution design, configuration, development, and deployment
- Engaging with executive stakeholders and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives and provide strategic recommendations
- Overseeing the development of integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, and Oracle ERP
- Driving business transformation initiatives by leveraging functional, technical, and consulting skills
- Facilitating workshops and performing fit-gap analysis to develop scalable solution designs
- Contributing to practice development through pre-sales, capability building, and thought leadership initiatives
- Building and maintaining billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, and revenue-related processes
- Validating solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle and managing project risks and dependencies
- Leading business discussions with customers to discover requirements and deliver technical solutions
- Confirming compliance with architectural standards and driving successful milestone execution through proactive communication

What You Must Have

- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 12 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Marketing, Commerce, Finance, Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science
- At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in Lead-to-Revenue or related Oracle Customer Experience (CX) Revenue Cloud applications
- Possessing BillingPlatform Partner Elite Certification (L3)
- Demonstrating proficiency in API, SQL, CSS, HTML, JavaScript, JSON, and XML
- Leading large-scale digital transformation programs in finance operations
- Excelling in client-facing communication and stakeholder engagement
- Developing scalable solution designs aligned with industry best practices

Job Title: Oracle Cloud HCM Functional Consultant (Senior Associate)

Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Kolkata,Pune, Chennai, Gurugram (PwC Acceleration Center India)

About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Oracle Cloud HCM Functional Consultant with strong expertise in multiple HCM modules and proven experience in end-to-end implementations. You will work closely with clients and internal teams to design, configure, and implement Oracle Cloud HCM solutions, driving HR transformation and process optimization.

Key Responsibilities:
Lead requirements gathering workshops and collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into Oracle Cloud HCM functional specifications
Design and configure Oracle Cloud HCM modules (Core HR, Payroll, Benefits, Absence, T&L, Compensation, Talent Management, Recruitment & Onboarding, Learning, Workforce Modelling) aligned with best practices
Manage multiple end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM implementations ensuring quality delivery within budget and timelines
Develop and execute test scripts; lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate system functionality
Provide post-implementation support and training to users for smooth adoption of Oracle Cloud HCM solutions
Prepare detailed functional design documents, configuration guides, and user manuals
Integrate Oracle Fusion HCM with third-party systems using Oracle Integration Cloud, FBDI, APIs, etc.
Use Oracle HCM Cloud tools and analytics to provide insights and contribute to HR strategy and workforce planning
Manage stakeholder relations, collaborating across project managers, technical teams, and business users to ensure success

What You Must Have:

Bachelors degree any stream
Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Cloud HCM, with at least 2 complete implementations
Expertise in 2+ Oracle Cloud HCM modules: Core HR, Payroll, Benefits, Absence, Time & Labor, Compensation, Talent Management, Recruitment & Onboarding, Learning, Workforce Modeling
Strong understanding and experience in Oracle Integration technologies (Oracle Integration Cloud, FBDI, APIs)
Excellent communication skills in English (oral and written)

Craft and convey clear, impactful and engaging messages that tell a holistic story.

Validate outcomes with clients, share alternative perspectives, and act on client feedback.
Direct the team through complexity, demonstrating composure through ambiguous, challenging and uncertain situations.
Deepen and evolve your expertise with a focus on staying relevant.
Initiate open and honest coaching conversations at all levels.
Make difficult decisions and take action to resolve issues hindering team effectiveness.

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. - Developing and sustaining diverse and inclusive high-performing teams

- Initiating open and honest coaching conversations to foster team development

Job Description: Data Engineer / Data Warehouse Developer
Experience: 4 to 7 Years

Core Technologies: Google BigQuery (GBQ), dbt, Python, Informatica IICS, SQL
Role Overview
We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer / Data Warehouse Developer with 47 years of experience in building, optimizing, and maintaining scalable data engineering and data warehousing solutions. The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in SQL, Python, Google BigQuery, dbt, and Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS), along with a solid understanding of data warehousing concepts and ETL/ELT development.
The candidate will develop robust data pipelines, implement complex transformations, automate data engineering processes using Python, optimize BigQuery workloads, and deliver high-quality, analytics-ready datasets to support business intelligence and analytical use cases.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and transformation workflows using BigQuery, dbt, Informatica IICS, Python, and SQL.
Develop complex SQL queries and reusable transformation logic to process large volumes of data efficiently.
Build and maintain dbt models, including incremental models, data tests, documentation, and dependency management.
Develop Python scripts and utilities for data processing, pipeline automation, validation, reconciliation, and operational monitoring.
Use Python libraries and APIs to integrate data sources, automate repetitive tasks, and streamline data engineering workflows.
Develop and support ETL/ELT integrations using Informatica IICS, including mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, scheduling, and error handling.
Apply data warehousing principles to design dimensional models, fact and dimension tables, star/snowflake schemas, and slowly changing dimensions.
Optimize BigQuery query performance and cost through efficient SQL, partitioning, clustering, and execution-plan analysis.
Implement data quality checks, automated validations, reconciliation processes, and exception handling.
Troubleshoot pipeline failures, investigate data discrepancies, and resolve production issues.
Use Git and established CI/CD practices for source control, code reviews, testing, and deployments.
Collaborate with business analysts, BI developers, architects, and other engineering teams to deliver reliable, business-ready data products.
Maintain technical documentation and follow engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, and maintainability.
Required Technical Skills
1. Python
Strong hands-on programming experience with Python for data engineering and automation.
Proficiency in writing reusable, modular, and maintainable Python code, including functions, classes, exception handling, and logging.
Experience with data manipulation and processing using libraries such as Pandas and NumPy.
Ability to develop scripts for data validation, reconciliation, file processing, automation, and operational support.
Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, CSV, and other common data formats.
Understanding of Python package management, virtual environments, dependency management, and debugging.
Ability to write efficient code, handle large datasets, and implement robust error handling and logging.
2. Google BigQuery (GBQ)
Hands-on experience developing and optimizing complex SQL queries in BigQuery.
Strong understanding of datasets, tables, views, materialized views, and BigQuery architecture.
Experience with partitioning, clustering, query execution analysis, and cost optimization.
Ability to design scalable data models and efficiently process large datasets.
Familiarity with integrating BigQuery workloads with Python-based applications or automation.
3. dbt (Data Build Tool)
Hands-on experience developing and maintaining dbt models using SQL and Jinja.
Understanding of dbt project structure, model dependencies, materializations, and incremental models.
Experience implementing dbt tests, source definitions, documentation, and lineage.
Familiarity with Git integration, automated testing, and CI/CD-based deployments.
4. Informatica IICS
Hands-on experience with Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services for data integration and transformation.
Experience developing mappings, mapping tasks, taskflows, and data integration workflows.
Understanding of source-to-target mapping, scheduling, error handling, and operational monitoring.
Ability to troubleshoot and optimize ETL workflows.
5. Data Warehousing and SQL
Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture and ETL/ELT design patterns.
Expertise in dimensional modeling, star and snowflake schemas, fact and dimension tables, and SCD Types 1 and 2.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, subqueries, and query optimization.
Understanding of staging, curated, and business-ready data layers, incremental loading, CDC concepts, and data quality management.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Google Cloud Platform services such as Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer, and Cloud Functions.
Experience automating cloud operations and data workflows using Python and APIs.
Familiarity with shell scripting and Linux/Unix environments.
Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.
Familiarity with BI tools such as Looker or Power BI.
Exposure to Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and reusable data products.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and using Jira.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4–7 years of relevant experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or ETL/ELT development.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Role Summary
Timely, reliable data pipelines are what turn a platform design into business value. The Data Engineer
builds and operates the pipelines that move data from source systems into the lakehouse and on to analytics and AI consumers. They ensure that the pipelines are automated, performant, secure and governed.
The role works alongside the data architect, data quality engineer, business analysts and AI engineers. Its
job is to deliver production-grade pipelines on Azure / Microsoft Fabric, with metadata and lineage
captured in Microsoft Purview.

Build batch, incremental, CDC and streaming ingestion pipelines from source systems into the Bronze layer, using Azure Data Factory and Fabric pipelines.
Develop Silver- and Gold-layer transformations in SQL, PySpark and Spark notebooks, including cleansing, conformance, enrichment and business-rule logic.
Implement dimensional models, SCDs, surrogate keys and data marts according to the architect's designs.
Integrate DQ checks, validation, quarantine and reconciliation into pipelines in partnership with the Senior Data Quality Engineer.
Ensure that pipelines publish metadata and lineage to Microsoft Purview.
Implement scheduling, dependency management, parameterization, error handling and alerting.
¢ Optimize pipelines, partitioning, file formats (Delta/Parquet) and compute usage for performance and cost efficiency.
¢ Apply access controls, masking, encryption and secure credential management in line with UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR.
¢ Maintain code in source control and deploy through CI/CD pipelines, with automated tests and environment promotion.
¢ Support production operations, incident resolution and runbooks, and coach SUTHERLAND engineers so that the pipelines can be sustained after
handover.

¢ 4+ years in data engineering, preferably within UAE government or regulated-sector environments.
¢ Advanced SQL, Python and PySpark/Spark skills.
¢ Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or Synapse.
¢ Strong understanding of Lakehouse/Medallion architecture, Delta/Parquet formats and
dimensional modelling, including SCDs and surrogate keys.
¢ Experience with CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub), source control and DataOps practices.
¢ Familiarity with Microsoft Purview metadata and lineage, and with DQ tooling.
¢ Awareness of UAE data regulation, including UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR.
¢ Excellent English communication and documentation skills; Arabic proficiency is an advantage.

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Salesforce LwC, Senior Associate-AES Operate, you will engage with clients to analyze their needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Salesforce applications. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will leverage your broad range of consulting skills to help clients optimize operational efficiency and achieve their strategic objectives. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions while embracing increased ambiguity.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will use a broad range of tools, methodologies, and techniques to generate new ideas and solve problems. You will develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, using critical thinking to break down complex concepts. Your ability to interpret data will inform insights and recommendations, reinforcing professional and technical standards. This position offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and contribute to the success of our clients and the firm.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client needs to implement Salesforce solutions that optimize operational efficiency
- Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Salesforce applications
- Collaborating with clients to understand their strategic objectives and align solutions accordingly
- Utilizing Salesforce Lightning and Salesforce Sales Cloud to enhance client business processes
- Developing and maintaining project architecture and budgeting for Salesforce implementations
- Engaging in business process modeling to improve client workflows and system integration
- Applying analytical thinking to interpret data and inform insights and recommendations
- Supporting enterprise integration and technology implementation projects
- Creating and delivering training materials to facilitate client understanding and adoption of new technologies
- Embracing change and emerging technologies to drive innovation in client solutions
Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune and Gurugram

Job Title: AEP Developer / AJO Developer / Adobe Experience Cloud Consultant
Experience: 4-8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai / Remote
Job Summary

Implement personalization and offer decisioning strategies.
Configure triggers, actions, conditions, and journey workflows.
Monitor campaign performance and optimization opportunities.
Collaboration & Delivery
Partner with marketing, analytics, and technical teams.
Translate business requirements into scalable AEP/AJO solutions.
Troubleshoot production issues and optimize platform performance.
Support governance, security, and data privacy requirements.
