Description:
Dear Candidate,

Looking to build something meaningful for Indias MSMEs? Join Tata nexarc, a digital-first B2B platform from the house of Tata, as our Sr. Associate Operations.

About the role:
Own the end-to-end order journey for steel and bitumen raw material orders, from order verification to delivery and proof of delivery. You will be the face of Tata nexarc Operations for customers.

Key Responsibilities:
Manage the full supply chain lifecycle of assigned orders: order verification, documentation checks and seller dispatch coordination.
Monitor deliveries, collect Proof of Delivery (POD), and ensure quality and compliance requirements are met.
Track payments and customer credit limits as per SOPs and payment terms.
Maintain OTIF (On-Time In-Full) delivery performance of 85% or higher, and escalate exceptions early.
Validate documents: customer and seller POs, proforma and tax invoices, e-way bills, Mill Test Certificates (MTC) and delivery proofs.
Coordinate with transporters, fleet owners and drivers, and visit seller locations and transporter hubs when needed.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Graduate or postgraduate in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics or Engineering.
2–6 years in operations, supply chain, logistics or customer operations; steel experience preferred, bitumen or commodity exposure a plus.
Working knowledge of ERP, CRM and AI-enabled productivity tools.
Strong English and Hindi communication, stakeholder management, attention to detail and a bias for action.

Why Join Us:
Join a start-up from the house of Tata. Build the India Stack with a nation-first vision of uplifting SMEs, in a fast-paced culture built on Integrity, Pioneering, Unity, Responsibility and Excellence. You get high autonomy through agile cross-functional teams, and you will work on SME-focused products. Benefits include a hybrid work model, need-based health, wellness and childcare leaves, Tata group employee benefits, and medical, term life and personal accident insurance.


Skills: Order Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, OTIF, E-way Bill, MTC, Steel, Bitumen, ERP, Stakeholder Management .

If this sounds like you, apply now and be part of the Tata nexarc journey.

Pathologist-Full Time
Raipur
Lab Operations
Role summary
Managerial Responsibilities:
Overall Management of the laboratory
Consumption management
Quality management

Technical Responsibilities:
Up gradation of advanced technologies Quality of the results.
What the role entails - Key accountabilities/ responsibilities
1. Provide advice to those requesting information about the choice of tests, the use of the laboratory service and the interpretation of laboratory data.
2. Serve as an active member of the medical staff in main lab, collection center,
3. Relate and function effectively with NABL other accrediting agencies, Appropriate administrative officials, healthcare community, the patient / clients.
4. Define, implement, and monitor standards of performance and quality improvement of the medical laboratory service orservices.
5. Monitor all processes in the laboratory to determine that reliable data is being generated.
6. Ensure availability of sufficiently qualified personnel with adequate training and experience to meet the needs of the laboratory.
7. Plan, set goals, develop, and allocate resources appropriate to the medical environment.
8. Provide effective and efficient administration of the medical laboratory service, including budget planning and control with responsible financial management, in accordance with institutional assignment of such responsibilities.
9. Provide educational programs for the medical and laboratory staff and participate in educational programs of the institution.
10. Implement a safe laboratory environment in compliance with good practice and applicable regulations.
11. Address any complaint, request, or suggestion from users of laboratory services. Ensure good staff morale.
12. Report authorization of Hematology, Biochemistry, Immunoassay, Clinical Pathology, and serology
13. Routine review of QC for all departments with review of reports including CBC, MP, PS, Reticulocyte count, Fluid routine, ICT/DCT, Blood group before approving
14. Formulate review and recheck policies for all tests and ensure compliance with the help of Lab supervisor and technicians.
15. Verification of critical, unusual, and abnormal test results before release
16. Interpret, Correlate, and generate medically significant laboratory data.
17. Attending all sorts of client queries related to test enquiries and interpretation of test results.
18. Approval of SOPs for use and ensure compliance with respect to accreditation requirements.
19. Ensure review of monthly MIS
20. Ensure results are reported within turnaround time with the help of section head.
21. Review and improvement of reports formats.
22. To identify new equipment, tests, technology, products and standardization of assays.
23. Identify needs for resources (human / equipment / infrastructure) and submit to senior management for approval.
24. Attending conferences/workshops to ensure updated knowledge about recent trends.
25. To spend time reviewing daily pendency status on reports not released as well as sample received cases to avoid patient dissatisfaction.
26. To keep a watchful eye on instrument maintenance and hygiene of lab and practice 0 tolerance in this area. Any instrument failure due to user s should be avoided totally as it affects our patient and business.
27. To ensure sample processing is not stopped due to KIT non availability.
28. To ensure that every PR is approved on time and any gaps are highlighted.
29. COL/ Lab Head should work with BU Heads in forecasting CAMP s and other seasonal activities and order KITs sufficiently.
30. To keep a close watch on technical complaints. Ensure analytical complaints get logged, DE flagging is minimized. For recorded complaints and initiate proper CAPA and must also discuss in weekly calls with the team on learning and preventive actionsand timely escalation of analytical complaints/ Legal threats
31. To spend quality time on understanding patient and customer VOC especially on cases we are not resolving on time. COL/Lab Head should guide the team to resolve issues on time andsupport them wherever technical input is required.
32. To participate in weekly meetings along with BU/SBU Heads to resolve issues as well as seek support wherever needs from nontechnical team.
33. To take responsibility to train the non-technical team for better business and customer engagement.
34. COL/Lab Head must contribute at least 8 hours in a month in training and sharing knowledge to the team through a formal mechanism.
35. To promote MHL test to larger communities of clinician through KOL Connects. They must use our report as a tool to promote test by recommending new test based on diagnosis in the report.
36. To make time at least once a month to meet B2B clients, collection centers, customers to understand the pulse of the market.
37. To follow guidelines objectively as per MHL Policy and ensure a culture of data-based decision making and discussions; hence every month compliance is very important. It is at most importance for to have self-Compliance from every lab and noncompliance is given utmost importance for closure.
38. To give sufficient time to check and review the Lab managers /Technical team on quality, material consumption and technical performance.
39. Ensure that processes needed for the quality management system are established, implemented, and maintained.
40. Reporting to laboratory management, at the level at which decisions are made on laboratory policy, objectives, and resources, on the performance of the quality management system and any need for improvement.
41. Ensuring the promotion of awareness of users needs and requirements throughout the laboratory organization.
What we are looking for in you
Excellent communication and analytical skill.
Working With
Lab Operations Team
Role demands (Travel)
Yes
Stakeholder interfaces
Yes
What we promise to you
A strong growth prospective.

Description:
Job Summary
Function Summary IRDA Regulation on IMF was released, where companies which are LLP / Pvt limited / cooperative societies were allowed to distribute financial products. IMFs are allowed to deal in Insurance of 6 companies (2LI, 2GI, 2HI), mutual funds, banking products, post etc. Max life spotted this opportunity to attract established financial distributors from the market to engage and distribute max life products - PEARL ACQUISITION. A dedicated team of 50 CDMs were recruited in two phases and trained to hire farm these relationships. Currently we have 95 licensed IMFs on board and expected to touch 150 which are work in progress. The pool of IMF s primarily comprises of top Agents in Insurance, Wealth Managers, Loan DSA, CA, Ex - employees from financial services with an existing customer base customer base. Present IMF carries avg. 2500 customers and big turnover book. As a later part of Pearl acquisition strategy, Insurance Managers is a career option provided to establish financial distributors who are not able to meet the requirements of forming an IMF. This has also proven to be an exciting opportunity. Insurance Manager is part time employee model which provides a platform to the pearl to associate with MLI and improve their earnings, flexible working hours and better choices to their customers. IM will be different from an ADM/APC as he will not be recruiting and mentoring Agents and will only source business by penetrating into his existing client base. Avg book size with them is also 750 customers.


Key Responsibilities
Understand the IM acquisition and IMF regulation, value proposition registration process
Acquisition of 6 - 7 IMs in a year independently.
Independently managing a pool of Insurance Managers mapped to them from existing pool in the beginning only.
Post successful completion of 1 year, the next level is CDM wherein the focus will be on IMF journey
Manage performance of IMs
Develop understanding of products coach IM staff on product USP s
Implement performance management and rewards system in IMs
Provide marketing, training and operational support to IMs
Manage attrition of IMs through revival or replacement
Drive quality of business sourced from IMs
Ensure right product mix and control key quality measures such as leakage and persistency.


Measures of Success
Minimum 6-8 IM Acquisition in a year
Achieving sales target through team of IMs
IM Activity Retention
Quality of Business
Create pipeline for IMF s


Qualifications and Experience
Educational Background: Minimum a graduate
Work Experience: At least 1-3 years of experience in recruiting business partners / Agents and achieving sales target through them.
Good communication skill.


Knowledge / Skills / Abilities
Excellent Written, presentation communication skills
Exceptional consultative interpersonal skills
Stakeholder management
Influencing without authority
Full understanding / experience of handling entire life cycle of a deal from initiation to successful completion

Job Description
Title : Field Sales Executive
Location: Raipur - (Bhatapara, korba and Raigarh)
Job Type: Contract (For more than 1 year)
Industry : Paint - Chemical
Summary :
This field sales role is pivotal in driving business growth by building strong relationships with key stakeholders such as painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. The ideal candidate will be responsible for consistently achieving and surpassing sales targets through proactive customer engagement, daily site visits, and active presence at assigned retail locations. By organizing regular shop meetings, maintaining accurate sales records, and leveraging a strong understanding of the market, the sales representative will play a critical role in expanding market reach and enhancing brand visibility. The position requires a self-driven, results-oriented professional with a proven ability to thrive in a dynamic, customer-focused environment.
Responsibilities :
Consistently meet and exceed assigned sales targets.
Develop and nurture long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key customers.
Conduct a minimum of two site visits per day to identify and pursue new business opportunities.
Spend at least two hours daily at the assigned store to engage customers and support sales activities.
Organize and lead weekly shop meetings with applicators to drive product adoption and team alignment.
Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports via the online portal.


Requirements
Requirements :
Valid two-wheeler is mandatory for field operations.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
Self - motivated, disciplined, and driven by performance targets.
Minimum qualification:Graduation preferred.
6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants).
Fresh graduates or professionals from insurance or banking sectors with sales aptitude are also encouraged to apply.
Other pointers regarding this job:
Age Criteria: 18years old to 30years old are eligible
Gender : Only Male can apply
Eligibility: Freshers and candidates with 1+ year experience in field sales, channel sales, banking, or insurance sales can apply.
Qualification: Graduate or Post Graduate (any year pass - out).
Work Details: Day shift role with third-party payroll (2coms).


Benefits
Benefits :
Net Take Home: 18K-22K (Negotiable)
MWA 5000/ -
Lucrative performance-driven incentives.
Absorption after 1 year on performance basis.
Travel allowance up to 2000- 5000 per month based on profile.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.


Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
Purpose of the role

The face of the D2C platform in the physical market. Visit mechanics, roadside garages, small workshops, and truck operators in an assigned territory. Demonstrate the platform, register new buyers, facilitate the first purchase, and ensure the buyer can use the app independently. This role converts an unorganized market buyer into a digital platform user.

Key Responsibility
Cover assigned pin codes daily visit mechanics, garages, and small fleet operators to introduce the D2C platform
Register new buyers on the platform (app install + profile creation) target 15+ new registrations per day
Demonstrate app search (by vehicle model and part name), part selection, payment, and delivery tracking
Facilitate the buyer's first online spare parts purchase stay with them through the transaction
Follow up within 7 days of first purchase to ensure delivery satisfaction and resolve any issues
Capture buyer feedback on platform gaps: parts not found, confusing UX, delivery complaints report weekly
Maintain a daily activity log: shops visited, registrations done, first purchases facilitated
Attend weekly territory review with Category Manager / Lead BD
Participate in platform training sessions when new features or categories are launched

Qualification & Experience

13 years in field sales, FMCG distribution, insurance agency, or fintech outreach roles
Knowledge of commercial vehicles or spare parts market strongly preferred
Smartphone proficiency; able to demonstrate app fluently in local language
High energy and comfort with ground-level market work workshops, roadside interactions
Local language fluency essential; Hindi and regional language preferred
Diploma Holder from Mechanical Background

Description:
Group Company: AU Small Finance Bank Limited
Designation: Relationship Officer Wheels
Office Location:
Position description: Primary interface of the bank with the customer as well as the channels for business sourcing
Primary Responsibilities:
1. Achieve assigned targets and productivity requirements - meet the threshold targets on monthly basis 2. Generate potential business leads from sourcing channels, follow up and bring it to closure 3. Assess customer profile, visit customer's place, collect necessary documentation and recommend customers to credit for approval 4. Ensure physical delivery of vehicle from the dealer/channel partner - stay vigilant about asset jumping/over pricing etc. 5. Follow up and collect deferrals and post disbursement documents in a timely manner. 6. Ensure only Direct sourcing from authorised dealers and empanelled channels - no third party sourcing, includes employees of other banks and financial institutions. 7. Manage relationship with dealers, Commercial Associates, referrals and other sourcing channels to generate business volumes through these channels. 8. Ensure Asset verification and Non starter-Early default cases and build relationships9. Ensure timely servicing of customer service requests

Treebo Hospitality Ventures is Indias most loved brand and one of the largest chains in the budget segment of hospitality. With a network of 850+ hotels across 120+ cities, Treebo offers travellers the unprecedented value proposition of high-quality stays at affordable prices wherever they go. We are proud of putting dignity back into budget travel where earlier the traveller was forced to contend with poor quality and hygiene. Treebo Hospitality Ventures masterfully combines engineering prowess with deep hospitality expertise. Our operational ethos is clear and focused from Treebo Club, an innovative distribution platform and extremely rewarding loyalty programme to Hotel Superhero, a cutting-edge SaaS solution and a comprehensive hotel management software. With a strong technological foundation and a passion for hospitality, THV aims to deliver exceptional experiences across our diverse portfolio. Our range of brands—Itsy Hotels, Treebo,
Treebo Premium and Medalio—provides a symphony of choices that blend quality, comfort and affordability.
Treebo is a Great Places to Work certified organisation.We take immense pride in our culture which is built on a strong foundation of 7 values. Some of these values include - “Exhibit Owner Mindset” and “Have the humility and hunger to learn and help learn”, amongst others. We
strongly believe in offering our people - “Treebs”, as they are called - unmatched opportunities to learn and grow. If you’re looking to work at a place that is built on strong fundamentals of business and professional conduct, Treebo is the place for you.
About the Role
As an Area General Manager, you will be responsible for executing the company’s strategic vision of democratizing the joy of travel. You will be responsible for a given area and the portfolio there in to ensure highest levels of guest experience, product quality and business & profitability of the assets. While managing the operations and enabling
sales for your portfolio, you will also drive the expansion of our hotel portfolio across your area and beyond through your network. This is a mission critical role that requires a perfect balance of delivering operational excellence, relationship management, and a
business development mindset.
Key Responsibilities -
1) Operational Excellence
Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple hotel properties in your area, ensuring adherence to brand standards and service benchmarks
Drive compliance with Treebo's brand standards and SOPs, health and safety guidelines, and service quality norms
Conduct audits, quality assurance checks, and drive corrective/preventive actions through hotel partners to maintain Treebo standards
Act as the key liaison between the company and hotel partners, ensuring seamless coordination and timely issue resolution
Monitor and enhance overall guest satisfaction by ensuring prompt and effective service recovery mechanisms
2) Business Development & Growth
Identify, evaluate, and onboard new hotel properties to expand the company’s portfolio within the assigned area
Negotiate terms of the agreement and ensure complete alignment with Treebo's operating procedures before onboarding any hotel
Collaborate with the central business development team to oversee launch process of the signed properties
3) Sales & MICE
Drive regional sales performance by collaborating with internal sales teams and property owners to achieve revenue targets for your portfolio
Identify and push sales POCs to close MICE deals for your portfolio properties
Support pricing, promotions, and campaigns to drive business at the property level
Engage with local corporate clients, event organizers, and travel planners to push business to your portfolio if needed
4) Team & Partner Management
Lead, mentor, and develop on-ground portfolio hotel teams to deliver exceptional guest experience in the segment
Train hotel staff in brand values, SOPs, and customer service skills to ensure consistency
Build strong relationships with hotel owners and partners to foster collaboration and long-term association
What Are We Looking For -
Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
4–6 years of experience in hospitality management with demonstrated success in both operations and business development.
Proven experience in property acquisition and/or sales in hospitality.
Knowledge and experience in the MICE segment is highly desirable.
Analytical mindset with problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned geography.
Entrepreneurial approach with a strong focus on execution and accountability.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Promote awareness of brand image internally and externally. Use sales techniques that maximize revenue while maintaining existing guest loyalty to Marriott. Communicate with potential owners via telephone to set up preview package sales/tours. Encourage guests or callers to purchase or schedule preview package sales/tours. Explain details and requirements related to attending a sales presentation to potential owners. Verify that individuals meet eligibility requirements for preview package sales/tours prior to scheduling a tour for a Marriott vacation club property. Determine and give complimentaries to guests as gifts for their patronage (e.g., rewards points, show tickets). Perform general office duties to support Sales Marketing (e.g., filing, sending emails, typing, faxing). Receive, record, and relay messages accurately, completely, and legibly.
Assist management in training, evaluating, counseling, and motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect the privacy and security of guests and coworkers. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

JOB SUMMARY
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable. Assists in the daily supervision restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction. Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Management of Restaurant Team
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.
- Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.
- Assists in supervising daily shift operations.
- Supervises restaurant and all related areas in the absence of the Director of Restaurants or Restaurant Manager.

Conducting Day-to-Day Restaurant Operations

- Communicates to Chef and Restaurant Manager any issues regarding food quality and service levels.
- Ensures compliance with all restaurant policies, standards and procedures.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
- Manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Performs all duties of restaurant employees and related departments as necessary.
- Opens and closes restaurant shifts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
- Encourages employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
- Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Meets and greets guests.
Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Supervises on-going training initiatives.
- Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Restaurant Manager.

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. Description:
Role & responsibilities

Develop short-term and long-term mine plans, bench sequencing, and overburden (OB) stripping strategy using mine planning software (e.g., Minex, AutoCAD, Deswik).
Execute surface miner deployment planning, bench height/width dimensions, and haul road gradient design suited to local geo-mining conditions.
Plan infrastructure layouts including sumps, drainage diversions, check dams, haul roads, and monsoon preparedness measures.
2. Statutory Clearances & Regulatory Compliance
Prepare documentation and support technical liaisoning for stage-wise Forest Clearance (FC-1 & FC-2), Environmental Clearance (EC), and Mining Lease execution.
Assist in obtaining statutory permissions from the Directorate General of Mines Safety (DGMS), Coal Controllers Organisation (CCO), State Pollution Control Board (SPCB), and Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA).
Coordinate pre-mining geotechnical studies, baseline monitoring, and public hearing procedures for project approval.
3. Land Acquisition & Pre-Mining Infrastructure Support
Collaborate with the Land, Liaison & External Affairs teams on DGPS boundary demarcation, surface feature surveys, and cadastral mapping.
Assist in identifying Compensatory Afforestation (CA) land, preparing land schedules, and conducting sample tree enumeration for statutory clearances.
Coordinate boundary pillaring and NOC clearances for infrastructure/utility diversions (powerlines, roads, water channels).
4. Operational Oversight & Safety Management
Supervise drilling, blasting design, and surface excavation, maintaining fragmentation control, powder factor efficiency, and vibration mitigation within statutory limits.
Implement the mine Safety Management System (SMS) in strict compliance with the Mines Act 1952, Coal Mines Regulations (CMR), and DGMS directives.
Conduct risk assessments, job safety analyses, toolbox talks, and regular safety audits across the project area.
5. Quality Control & Contractor Management
Monitor coal seam correlation, sampling, and coal quality grade assurance (GCV & Proximate analysis) to meet captive requirements.
Scrutinize technical tender specifications, monitor Mine Developer-cum-Operator (MDO) / OB contractor performance, and verify volume measurements.

Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented HR Recruiter to manage end-to-end recruitment activities across multiple business locations. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in talent acquisition, candidate sourcing, stakeholder coordination, interview management, and bulk hiring.

Working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets and Recruitment MIS.

Preferred Candidate Profile

13 years of relevant experience in HR Recruitment / Talent Acquisition.
Experience in corporate, manufacturing, industrial, or consultancy recruitment will be an advantage.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

* Supervise daily maintenance and repair activities of ambulances and support vehicles

* Good communication and coordination skills

* On-call duty for emergencies
* Workshop and field-based work

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Design and own end-to-end GenAI architectures using AWS services (Python Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, Step Functions).
Lead model selection, tuning, optimization, including embedding models, RAG pipelines, multi-agent systems, and model-drift strategies.
Define reference architectures, solution blueprints, and reusable AI frameworks.
Evaluate new GenAI capabilities and drive modernization of existing workflows.
Generative AI Development
Build and integrate applications with LLMs, image/video models, embeddings, vector databases, and inference endpoints.
Develop RAG, multi-modal, agentic workflows and fine-tuning pipelines.
Create prompt engineering guidelines, evaluation frameworks, and model guardrails (PII filtering, hallucination prevention).
Design and implement serverless applications using AWS Lambda with phyton as programming language.
Develop and maintain cloud-based solutions with a focus on scalability and performance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Optimize existing AWS Lambda functions for cost and performance efficiency.
Ensure robust security practices in all aspects of development and deployment.
Requirements:
8+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on AWS services.
Proficiency in programming languages Python.
Experience with Phyton related frame work and packages.
Strong understanding of serverless architecture and event-driven programming.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.
Preferred Qualifications:
AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Developer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect).
Experience with other AWS services like DynamoDB, API Gateway, and S3.
Knowledge of infrastructure as code (e.g., CloudFormation, Terraform).
Delivered at least one production-grade GenAI product or platform.
Experience with MLOps, DataOps, and model governance frameworks.

Description:
Overview
Our team within the Canada Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.
We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecyclefrom concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.
Atkins Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking a Civil 3D Designer to join our Water BIM team. This role will be based at our Bangalore & Gurugram office, contributing to world-class projects by creating detailed 3D models, coordinating multidisciplinary designs, and ensuring compliance with international standards.

Your Role
Roles & Responsibilities
Excellent in 3D Modelling of Pipe networks (Dry and Wet), Grading, Corridors, Cut and Fill using Civil 3D.
Excellent in Multidisciplinary 3D model coordination using Navisworks
Check model for Stage Completeness, Dimensional accuracy against modelling standards.
Ensure Level of Quality control for Completeness and adherence to company standards of all Drawings produced.
Stay informed the best practices & methodologies in BIM implementation.
Able to perform and coordinate on multi-disciplinary projects and effective implementation of BEP and BIM workflows.
Ability to determine appropriate record/As-built, test pit, drawings and point cloud data.
Identify and solve drawing/ modelling problems and troubleshooting Civil 3D issues.
Identify new logical ideas for automation to improve efficiency.
In depth knowledge of engineering drawings and specifications. Ability to work using engineers calculations and design in producing drawings / 3D modelling.
Ensures accuracy and adapts a detail-conscious approach; carefully checks details at each stage to avoid errors.
Ensure timely planning and delivery by proactively managing assumptions, dependencies, and risk.
Follow GTC BMS processes to projects
Use of Vehicle tracking

Software Skills
Autodesk Civil 3D
AutoCAD
Navisworks
MicroStation, ORD (Preferred )
ProjectWise / Forma
Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

Required Skills & Competencies
Strong understanding of: Civil engineering drawings and construction methods
Ability to work with Survey data, point clouds
Good communication and coordination skills
Attention to detail and quality-focused approach
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Job Description for Payroll Operations Associate
Position Title: Payroll Operations Associate CL -12
Location: Bangalore
Employment Type: Full Time
Must have skills: Payroll Processing
Good to have skills: SEA Payroll (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia)
Experience: Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required

Job Summary:
The Payroll Operations Associate (CL 12) is responsible for independently managing payroll-related activities with a strong focus on Malaysia payroll processing and statutory compliance. The role involves handling payroll operations, ensuring accuracy in individual taxation and social security contributions, and working closely with systems, finance, and stakeholders. The associate is expected to demonstrate strong technical aptitude, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced payroll environment.

Roles & Responsibilities:
Manage Malaysia payroll processing, statutory compliance, taxation, social security, and mandatory contributions.
Maintain payroll workflows, controls, calendars, reconciliations, variance analysis, and discrepancy resolution.
Prepare accurate payroll and statutory reports for internal stakeholders and authorities.
Support payroll system validations, updates, testing, enhancements, and coordination with relevant teams.
Collaborate with finance, systems, payroll, and business stakeholders for smooth payroll delivery.
Contribute to payroll design, planning, shared services delivery, process improvement, and automation initiatives.
Handle L2 payroll queries and provide timely resolutions within defined SLAs.
Skills & Competencies:
Technical / Functional Skills:
Good payroll processing knowledge with focus on SEA payroll.
Working knowledge of Malaysia payroll is an added advantage.
High level of accuracy and attention to detail
Good understanding of statutory compliance, audits, and payroll governance.
Hands-on experience with payroll systems and reporting tools.
Proficiency in payroll reconciliation and controls.
Soft Skills:
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Time management and ability to work effectively under tight payroll deadlines.
Effective team player with collaboration skills; able to work independently.
Professional handling of confidential and sensitive information
Quick thinker with a positive attitude, adept at creative problem-solving
Strong organizational skills and effective prioritization
Proficient in IT applications
Dedicated and dependable team player.

Additional Information:
- The ideal candidate will possess a strong educational background in commerce or a related field, along with good knowledge and experience in relevant countries Payroll processing.
- This position is based at our Bengaluru office.

Description:
Supplier Quality Plant Engineer (SQP)
Location:
Hosakote, IN, 562122 Bangalore, IN, 562122
Position Type: Professional
Permanent/Temporary: Permanent
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
Who we are and what we believe in

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group s leading brands and entities.
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
Trucks Technology & Industrial Division hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.
Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.
Supply Network Quality
Interested to join a team who works hand and in hand with our supply network partners to secure the best product quality for our end-customer Driven by a strong quality mindset Convinced that building solid relationships with supply network partners is key to continuously improve Or just curious about the title These are already good reasons to look at this job posting!
This is us, your new colleagues
The Supply Network Quality (SNQ) organization, belonging to Truck Quality, is driving the supply partner base towards premium automotive quality standards and world-class performance. We are responsible for continuously improving the supply partner base and the quality of purchased parts. There is now an opportunity to join the SNQ India team. By joining our team, you can expect to be warmly welcomed, respected and appreciated for who you are. We value difference convinced that it is key for a team to better perform in our work when everyone can express themselves freely. Your personal development is our priority making you, we hope, happy and motivated to come every day to work!
Requirements
The Supplier Quality Plant Engineer (SQP) is responsible for managing purchased-part quality activities within the Volvo plant to secure uninterrupted production and ensure supplied components meet quality requirements. We look for a candidate who enjoys working in a dynamic manufacturing environment, has strong commitment, takes ownership, works effectively both independently and in teams, and can handle a high pace. The candidate should have strong collaboration and communication skills to work with suppliers, plant functions and SQEs, be capable of managing multiple quality concerns simultaneously, and demonstrate a proactive approach to problem-solving and risk management.
Supplier Quality Plant Engineer (SQP)
Location: Hoskote,Bangalore - 562122
Main Responsibilities
Manage purchased-part quality concerns and assess risks to plant operations, other Volvo sites and customers.
Secure immediate containment through segregation, inspection, sorting, rework and replacement with suppliers and plant functions.
Manage supplier Inspection Reports and quality claims in accordance with Volvo Group processes and SPQAM requirements.
Drive supplier root-cause analysis, validate and approve 8D reports, and verify corrective-action effectiveness before closure.
Coordinate supplier quality crises and escalate risks to safety, conformity, production continuity and customers.
Collaborate with suppliers, plant functions, Engineering and SQEs to resolve concerns and prevent recurrence.
Secure supplier launch readiness for new product and localization projects with SQEs, suppliers and plant functions to support smooth Volvo plant SOP.
Monitor supplier performance and drive risk-based improvements, investigations, process reviews, audits and inspections with SQEs.
Participate in Part Handling Reviews and assess handling, packaging, logistics, assembly and product or process change risks.
Share operational evidence and lessons learned with SQEs and other Volvo plants to strengthen prevention.
Monitor Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) arising from supplier-related quality issues and drive actions.
Coordinate supplier visits at the plant and facilitate the necessary support.
Competence and Experience
Degree in Mechanical, Automobile or a relevant engineering discipline.
Experience in supplier quality, manufacturing quality or production, preferably in automotive.
Technical knowledge of manufacturing, assembly, handling, packaging and logistics.
Knowledge of automotive quality standards, core quality tools, Lean, root-cause analysis and 8D methodology.
Experience in containment, supplier claims and corrective-action verification.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings and specifications, with knowledge of dimensional inspection and measurement techniques.
Analytical, structured and preventive mindset, with independent working and timely decision-making under production pressure.
Strong collaboration and assertive supplier communication skills, professional English and willingness to travel.
Job Category: Purchasing
Organization: Trucks Technology & Industrial
Travel Required: Frequent Travel

Do we share the same aspirations
Every day, Volvo Group products and services ensure that people have food on the table, children arrive safely at school and roads and buildings can be constructed. Looking ahead, we are committed to driving the transition to sustainable and safe transport, mobility and infrastructure solutions toward a net-zero society.
Joining Volvo Group, you will work with some of the world s most iconic brands and be part of a global and leading industrial company that is harnessing automated driving, electromobility and connectivity.
Our people are passionate about what they do, they aim for high performance and thrive on teamwork and learning. Everyday life at Volvo is defined by a climate of support, care and mutual respect.
If you aspire to grow and make an impact, join us on our journey to create a better and more resilient society for the coming generations.

WE ARE HIRING | AREA SALES MANAGER (ASM)

NoBroker.com | Residential Resale
NoBroker is expanding its Residential Resale business and looking for enthusiastic, target-oriented sales professionals to join our growing team!

HIRING LOCATIONS
Bengaluru: Varthur, Electronic City, Sarjapura Road, Kanakapura, Whitefield, Budigere, West Bangalore, Horamavu.
Mumbai: Kalyan, Shil Phata, Palava, Thane.
Chennai: Chetpet, Selaiyur.
Hyderabad: Financial District, Miyapur North Hyderabad.
Pune: PCMC, Mamudi, Kharadi.
Noida: Noida.

POSITION DETAILS
Designation: Area Sales Manager
Experience: 14 years in Field Sales
Industry: Real Estate / Non-Real Estate
Work Mode: Field Sales
Joining: Immediate joiners preferred

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Work on leads provided by the company and connect with prospective customers.
Visit customers at their preferred property locations to understand their requirements.
Conduct property visits and provide relevant property solutions.
Handle customer negotiations, follow-ups and drive deal closures.
Achieve assigned sales targets and revenue objectives.
Maintain customer relationships and update CRM records.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
14 years of experience in field sales.
Real estate sales experience will be an added advantage.
Strong communication, negotiation and convincing skills.
Ability to manage customer relationships and achieve sales targets.
Willingness to travel and work in a field-based sales role.

INTERESTED IN APPLYING?

AJ Priyadharshini

Job Title: Cluster Head - Residential Resale
Location: Bangalore
Department: Residential Resale Property
Experience Required: 4+ Years
Team Handling Experience: Managing a team of 5-10 members

About the Role
We are looking for a dynamic and results-driven Cluster Head Residential Resale to lead and manage the resale property sales operations in Bangalore. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving revenue growth, managing a team of sales professionals, building strong relationships with property owners and buyers, and ensuring smooth execution of residential resale transactions.

Key Responsibilities
1. Sales & Revenue Management
Drive sales targets and revenue growth for the Residential Resale business within the assigned cluster.
Develop and implement sales strategies to increase property listings and successful closures.
Monitor team performance and ensure achievement of monthly and quarterly targets.
Identify new business opportunities in the Bangalore residential resale market.
2. Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of 5-10 sales professionals.
Conduct regular training, coaching, and performance reviews.
Motivate the team to maintain high productivity and customer engagement.
Ensure strong pipeline management and effective lead conversions.
3. Market Development
Build strong relationships with property owners, brokers, and channel partners.
Analyze market trends, pricing strategies, and competitor activities.
Work closely with marketing teams to improve lead generation and brand visibility.
4. Operations & Customer Experience
Ensure smooth coordination between buyers, sellers, and internal teams.
Maintain high standards of customer service throughout the property resale process.
Ensure compliance with company policies and legal documentation.
5. Reporting & Strategy
Track and report cluster performance metrics to senior leadership.
Provide insights on market demand, inventory gaps, and growth opportunities.
Participate in strategic planning to expand the resale business in Bangalore.

Key Requirements
Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or related field.
4-10 years of experience in real estate sales, preferably in residential resale or secondary market transactions.
Proven experience managing a team of 5-10 members.
Strong understanding of the Bangalore real estate market.
Excellent leadership, negotiation, and communication skills.
Ability to drive performance in a fast-paced sales environment.

Key Skills
Sales Leadership
Real Estate Market Knowledge
Team Management
Negotiation & Closing Skills
Customer Relationship Management
Business Development

Description:
About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate

Description:
Responsible for availability of Raw Material & Components as per agreed delivery dates aligned to Production Schedule by effective vendor management and internal escalations.
To prepare the RM delivery schedule against Purchase Orders in alignment with the Production schedule based on supplier capacity in mind.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES
Vendor Management & Expediting
Drive proactive vendor engagement with a go-getter attitude to ensure timely deliveries.
Prepare and monitor scheduling lines post-PO release; align supplier schedules with plant requirements.
Track delivery performance, escalate critical delays, and ensure adherence to monthly supply plans.
Utilize Vendor Portal for streamlined communication and grievance resolution.
Collaborate with planning and plant teams to maintain safety stock and optimize storage utilization.
Develop and maintain procurement dashboards for performance tracking and reporting.

Operational Procurement & P2P Cycle
Own the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P process, ensuring compliance and efficiency.
Process orders via SAP MM; manage both domestic and import purchases using various Incoterms.
Implement engineering change notifications (ECR/ECN) and manage rejection material disposal within defined timelines.
Understand and apply payment terms such as LC/BG in procurement transactions.
Ensure the Long Lead Time parts are well planned based on Season requirement
Supplier RM wise (ABS) monitoring and ensure uninterpreted supplies.

Inventory & Material Management
Manage raw material inventory and refine lead times based on plant requirements.
Measure and report RM/component availability against production plans.
FSN Analysis & Aging Inventory Analysis
Indirect Purchase (Opex/Capex) Experience.

Governance & Compliance
Ensure adherence to government norms related to taxation, safety, and environmental regulations.
Apply 5S, QC tools, and process control charts to enhance procurement operations.
Support corporate SCM initiatives across logistics, planning, strategic sourcing, and supplier development.
Desired Skills & Experience
Strong analytical and communication skills.
Exposure to vendor negotiations, import/export regulations, and compliance frameworks.
SAP End user skill level important
Must have experience in relevant Consumer durable /Appliance industry, handled Metals/Plastics/Packaging/Fabrication item.
Indirect purchase experience

Role & responsibilities: Qualified and passionate professionals for the Academic Session 2027-2028 with knowledge in lesson planning, teaching, assessing and evaluating, trainings, student motivation, curriculum planning & result oriented approach.

Teaching Positions:
PGT (B.ED Mandotary): Accountancy, Business Studies, Economics, Chemistry, Psychology, Computer Science, Geography, Fine Arts, and Nepali.
TGT (B.ED Mandotary): Science, Mathematics, Social Studies, Computer Science, and English.
STEAM / Robotics: Teaching Robotics, AI, IoT, or related technology/electronics fields.
Performing Arts: Music, Classical Dance, Dance, Theatre/Drama, or equivalent.
PTI / PE Teacher (Preferred Female): Sports training, coaching, and sports management, yoga.
Specialized & Administrative Positions:
Special Educator, Child Counsellor.
Executive Assistant to Principal.
HR with required qualification and previous experience in educational organization.

How to Apply: Candidates may send their updated resume to principal@dpsgangtok.com or info@dpsgangtok.com with the position applied for mentioned in the subject line. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next round.

Preferred candidate profile:
PGT: Postgraduate degree in the relevant subject with B.Ed./M.Ed., minimum 60% marks, and at least 5 years of CBSE/ICSE/IB Board-class teaching experience.
TGT: Postgraduate degree in the relevant subject with B.Ed./M.Ed., minimum 60% marks, and at least 3 years of experience.
STEAM / Robotics: B.Tech./M.Tech./M.Sc. in Technology/Electronics.
Performing Arts: Graduate/Postgraduate in Performing Arts with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience.
PTI / PE Teacher: B.P.Ed./M.P.Ed. or equivalent in Physical Education and Sports Sciences with a minimum of 3 years of experience (school-level sports experience preferred).
Special Educator: RCI-registered with Diploma/Graduation/Postgraduation in Special Education (B.Ed. Special Education or equivalent).
Child Counsellor: Postgraduate degree in Psychology (M.A./M.Sc. or equivalent) with relevant counselling experience.
Executive Assistant to Principal: Graduate/Postgraduate with computer proficiency (MS Office/Google Workspace) and a minimum of 3 years of experience.
HR (Human Resources): Graduate/Postgraduate (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred) with a minimum of 3 years of experience in HR operations, recruitment, and administration.
General Requirements: All qualifications must comply with CBSE by-laws. Excellent communication skills are essential. Teachers with residential school experience and exposure to other education boards will be given preference.
Perks and benefits:
Remuneration will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
Opportunity to be part of a purpose-driven learning community at a CBSE-affiliated institution.

Description:
Job Description
A Sales Advisor is responsible for delivering the best customer experience that contributes to the store s sales and profit. As a Sales Advisor, you ll always put customers first, offer assistance, and share your product and fashion knowledge. You ll create an environment that is easy for customers to shop through store operations and great garment care. You will also share your knowledge and skills with your colleagues, offering help where needed to build positive working environment.
Key Responsibilities
Provide great customer experience.
Fold, hang, display and merchandise garments to maximise selling opportunities.
Actively process, stock and replenish garments on the sales floor and in the stock room.
Open, unpack and label merchandise with security tags.
Support customer purchases and returns in the register. Qualifications
To be successful in the role as Sales Advisor, we believe you are a team player with a proactive and helpful approach, fostering collaboration and collective success. You have a positive mindset, where you are eager, optimistic and motivated when interacting with colleagues and customers. We also believe you are flexible and able to adjust to changing circumstances and customer needs, and that you can take initiatives and independently in a quick and effective way address customers needs. In addition, you are communicative and socially confident, fostering a positive interaction with colleagues and customers.
What you need to succeed:
Previous experience within retail, merchandising and/or customer service.
Effective time management - being stress-resistant and good at prioritisation.
Have a customer service mindset where you always prioritise the customers needs while serving as a brand ambassador.
Being fashion knowledgeable and have a genuine interest in fashion trends.
Have a selling mindset with the ability to approach and fulfil customer needs.

Description:
Senior Resident Paediatrics

Role Overview
The Senior Resident Paediatrics is a full-time, post-MD/DNB clinical and academic tenure position at a leading university-run super speciality teaching hospital and medical college integrating compassionate care, advanced medicine, teaching and research. The role delivers round-the-clock paediatric and neonatal care across the wards, emergency, NICU, PICU and outpatient services, while supporting the training of undergraduate and postgraduate medical students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of the Department of Paediatrics through the assigned unit faculty and supervises Junior Residents, interns and nursing teams on duty. It is a tenure position of up to 3 years under National Medical Commission (NMC) norms, suited to a qualified paediatrician seeking clinical depth alongside teaching and research exposure.

Work Mode
Work mode: work from hospital (fully on-site), with working days per hospital/NMC norms, including duty, on-call and emergency rosters as assigned by the department. No travel requirement has been specified for this role.

Key Responsibilities
Provide first-line senior clinical care to neonates, infants, children and adolescents admitted to paediatric wards, NICU and PICU, including daily rounds and clinical decision-making.
Assess, stabilise and manage paediatric and neonatal emergencies, including resuscitation, shock, respiratory distress, seizures, sepsis and poisoning.
Lead neonatal resuscitation at high-risk deliveries and caesarean sections in coordination with the obstetrics team.
Perform and supervise essential procedures such as endotracheal intubation, umbilical and peripheral vascular access, lumbar puncture, intraosseous access and surfactant administration, as clinically indicated.
Initiate and monitor respiratory support, including oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation, under faculty guidance.
Conduct paediatric outpatient and specialty clinics, including growth and development assessment, nutrition counselling, well-baby care and follow-up of high-risk newborns.
Implement immunisation services in line with the national immunisation schedule and Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) recommendations, including counselling of parents.
Take on-call and emergency duties as per the departmental roster, ensuring timely handover and continuity of care across shifts.
Teach and mentor MBBS students, interns and Junior Residents through bedside teaching, case presentations, skills sessions and assessments under competency-based medical education.
Maintain accurate, timely and legally sound medical records, including admission notes, progress notes, consent, discharge summaries and death certification.
Communicate clearly and compassionately with parents and families on diagnosis, prognosis and treatment plans, including breaking difficult news and obtaining informed consent.
Adhere to infection control, antimicrobial stewardship, patient safety and quality protocols, and participate in clinical audits and mortality and morbidity reviews.
Participate in departmental academic activities and clinical research, including journal clubs, seminars, case reports and approved research projects.
Coordinate with paediatric surgery, obstetrics, radiology, laboratory and other super speciality teams for multidisciplinary care and timely referrals.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a medical college recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MD (Paediatrics) or DNB (Paediatrics) from an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited institution, completed with results declared by the date of joining.
Valid registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, with the postgraduate qualification registered or eligible for registration.
Age below 45 years at initial appointment, as per prevailing NMC norms for Senior Residents in broad specialties.

Required Experience
Experience range: 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB paediatric clinical experience. Freshly qualified MD/DNB Paediatrics doctors are eligible to apply.
Relevant experience: postgraduate residency in Paediatrics with substantial rotations in NICU, PICU, paediatric emergency and general paediatric wards in a tertiary care or teaching hospital.
Preferred experience: prior work as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in Paediatrics in a medical college, teaching hospital or multi-specialty tertiary care hospital.
Industry preference: medical colleges, university teaching hospitals, super speciality hospitals and high-volume tertiary paediatric or neonatal care centres.

Technical and Functional Skills
Neonatal resuscitation and stabilisation in line with Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) and National Neonatology Forum (NNF) guidelines.
Paediatric emergency and critical care management in line with Paediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) principles, including airway, breathing and circulation support.
Working knowledge of respiratory support: oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation.
Procedural competence: intubation, umbilical venous and arterial catheterisation, intraosseous access, lumbar puncture, surfactant administration and exchange transfusion.
Fluid, electrolyte and nutritional management, including parenteral nutrition in neonates and critically ill children.
Management of neonatal jaundice, prematurity, sepsis, respiratory distress, malnutrition, diarrhoeal disease and common infectious diseases of childhood.
Interpretation of blood gases, laboratory results and paediatric and neonatal imaging.
Growth monitoring, developmental assessment, immunisation practice and preventive paediatrics.
Clinical documentation on hospital information systems or electronic medical records, and adherence to evidence-based IAP and NNF protocols.
Bedside teaching and assessment methods under competency-based medical education.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Compassionate, family-centred communication with children and parents, including counselling under stress and breaking difficult news.
Composure, sound judgement and rapid decision-making during emergencies and night duties.
Team leadership on duty, guiding Junior Residents, interns and nursing staff with clarity and respect.
Collaboration with faculty, nursing, allied health and other clinical departments.
Strong professional ethics, integrity, patient confidentiality and respect for child rights and safeguarding.
Teaching aptitude, patience and a willingness to mentor learners.
Time management, reliability on rosters and accountability for patient outcomes.
Cultural sensitivity and the ability to communicate with patients from diverse linguistic and social backgrounds.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Valid NRP, PALS and Basic Life Support (BLS) certifications.
Fellowship or certificate training in Neonatology, Paediatric Critical Care or a related paediatric subspecialty.
Publications, case reports or conference presentations in Paediatrics or Neonatology.
Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research and exposure to medical education workshops.
Membership of the Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) or National Neonatology Forum (NNF).
Exposure to hospital quality, accreditation and patient safety programmes.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate has completed MD or DNB Paediatrics at a reputed NMC-recognised medical college or NBEMS-accredited hospital with a high patient load, and has trained across neonatal, paediatric intensive care, emergency and general paediatric services. Candidates with 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB experience as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in recognised teaching hospitals or reputed tertiary care centres are preferred, as are those with a stable, verifiable work record. The role suits doctors building a career in academic paediatrics or preparing for super-speciality training, as Senior Resident experience in a recognised teaching institution is relevant to NMC eligibility norms for teaching faculty positions.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is offered as a competitive annual CTC (Total Cost to Company) in Indian Rupees (), commensurate with qualification, experience and institutional norms. Benefits follow institutional policy and are shared with shortlisted candidates at the offer stage. The role offers structured clinical exposure across neonatal and paediatric critical care, protected involvement in teaching and research, and the experience of working in a super speciality academic environment.

Application Instructions
Send your resume, mentioning the role "Senior Resident – Paediatrics", via email to careers@execvera.com, or by LinkedIn message, or by WhatsApp message to 9071197415. Include copies of your MBBS and MD/DNB certificates, your medical registration, a summary of NICU and PICU exposure, and your current notice period. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete the screening questionnaire and appear for an interview.
