Description:
Job Description


Overview
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) Transporation Business is looking to appoint a number of Technical Manager s to support the delivery of complex civil engineering and multidisciplinary designs across a range of major projects.Drawing upon a diverse skill set and a proven track record of delivery, AtkinsRalis GTC's Transporation business is playing an integral role in some of the most challenging and exciting engineering projects in the Transportation realm. We pride ourselves in offering a truly multi-disciplinary capability and bring exciting opportunities to influence major projects from beginning to end. Our vision is to be the world's best Infrastructure Consultancy by leveraging BIM and embracing the digital future to bring about transformational benefits for the Transportation Engineering industry.This key post will be based out of Bangalore/ Gurgaon where we have thriving AtkinsRalis office, which deliver to all AtkinsRalis regions across the world. Our portfolio of work continues to grow, and we will offer a challenging and rewarding opportunity to apply knowledge, experience, and problem-solving skills.


Your Role
Responsibilities
Leading the team and Produce AutoCAD and MicroStation 2D drawings and other deliverables.
Actively contribute to project design development by contributing to internal coordination.
Produce all types of Highways discipline 2D Drawings and other deliverables.
Perform self-assurance of all Highways discipline drawing and model deliverables.
Provide quality control for compliance to company/project standards of deliverables.
Maintain a high level of competency of all BIM software tools used at AtkinsRalis


About You
Requirements
A Bachelor's degree or Diploma holder in Civil Engineering with minimum of 15 to 20 years of industry experience, preferably in the Highways Domain.
Must be an advanced user or expert user in Autodesk AutoCAD, Civil3D, and Bentley MicroStation with a minimum of 10 to 15 years.AutoCAD experience must, detailed understanding of the CAD user interface and all its features to perform.
MicroStation experience must, detailed understanding of the MicroStation user interface and all its features to perform.
Technical proficiency in the use of the latest common CDE systems: Bentley ProjectWise and Autodesk Vault.
Must be well versed in best practices for use of Autodesk AutoCAD, and Bentley MicroStation and other industry standard BIM platforms.
Track record in BIM design and coordination including multidisciplinary projects and ideally demonstrable experience within a Civil Engineering Design environment particularly the Highways domain.Technical awareness/knowledge of engineering design issues including awareness of health and safety risks.
Qualifications and Attributes
Excellent time management skills.Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Bachelor's degree or Diploma holder in Civil Engineering with minimum of 15 to 20 years of industry experience, preferably in the Highways Domain.Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivationAbility to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues.
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment.
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customersHighly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.


Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.


About AtkinsRalis
We're , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Employee


Job Type

At AtkinsRalis , we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

Description:
Level 6: GN - SC&E - PRH - Process Excellence - Senior Manager
Management Consulting Senior Manager - Industry & Workflow Advisor / Value Architect
Accenture Strategy and Consulting
Business Unit: Strategy & Consulting, Global Network | Areas of Work: Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) | Level: Senior Manager | Location: Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai | Overall Relevant Exp: 10+ years
As part of Accenture's Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value - taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
You are a senior, process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes - working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations - turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
Roles & Responsibilities
Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps - and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
Owns enterprise value realization - defines the value story, value metrics, KPIs, and success metrics, governs the business case, and drives benefits realization at portfolio level.
Defines and governs the agentic solution design and AI adoption strategy across engagements - agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
Leads business development and pre-sales for AI-led reinvention pursuits - shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact.

Must-have skills
Deep process design and architecture expertise - Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis & Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
Command of core Business Architecture techniques - Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge - including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
Strong native AI fluency - NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs end to end.
Experience leading and aligning cross-functional teams - engineering, data, and business - to deliver outcomes.
Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.


Qualification

Overview
Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization. Engage in BIM and Scan-to-BIM workflows.
Support project setup, customization, and delivery tracking.

Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo.

Interest or exposure to Scan-to-BIM workflows

Description:
Key Responsibilities
1. Databricks Enterprise Strategy
Define and own the enterprise-wide Databricks platform strategy, roadmap, and adoption model in line with business goals.
Set up a Databricks Center of Excellence (CoE), including best practices, reusable frameworks, and engineering standards.
Assess new Databricks capabilities (Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Serverless, Photon, Mosaic AI, Databricks SQL) and lead their adoption.
Drive platform cost optimization (FinOps), workspace strategy, and capacity planning.
Act as the primary technical liaison with Databricks and cloud vendor partners.
2. Advanced DABs (Databricks Asset Bundles) Framework
Design and implement an enterprise-grade CI/CD framework using Databricks Asset Bundles for consistent, repeatable deployments.
Standardize Infrastructure-as-Code and Configuration-as-Code practices across environments (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod).
Integrate DABs with DevOps tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and Terraform.
Build reusable bundle templates, deployment patterns, and automated testing and validation pipelines.
Ensure version control, environment promotion, and release governance across all Databricks workloads.
3. Governance Implementation
Lead the design and rollout of data governance using Unity Catalog, covering access controls, data lineage, auditing, and data discovery.
Implement data security, privacy, and compliance controls (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, CCPA, as applicable).
Define data quality frameworks, metadata management standards, and data ownership and stewardship models.
Work with InfoSec, Risk, and Compliance teams to enforce policies such as row/column-level security, data masking, and fine-grained permissions.
Set up monitoring, observability, and audit mechanisms across the data platform.
4. Data Lakehouse Architecture
Architect and evolve the enterprise Data Lakehouse using Delta Lake and the Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
Design scalable data models that support analytics, BI, ML/AI, and real-time use cases.
Lead migrations from legacy data warehouses, Hadoop, and on-prem platforms to the Databricks Lakehouse.
Ensure performance tuning, storage optimization (Z-Ordering, Liquid Clustering, partitioning), and high availability.
Enable data sharing through Delta Sharing and support data mesh and data product approaches where relevant.
5. Cloud Architecture (AWS / Azure)
Design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud-native data architectures on AWS and/or Azure.
Oversee the integration of Databricks with cloud services, such as:
Azure: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Synapse, Entra ID, Purview
AWS: S3, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, IAM, Redshift, Lake Formation
Define networking, identity, and security architecture, including VNet/VPC injection, Private Link, and SSO/SCIM.
Drive disaster recovery, business continuity, and multi-region strategies.
6. Enterprise Data Pipeline Design
Lead the design and delivery of robust batch and streaming pipelines using PySpark, Spark SQL, Structured Streaming, Delta Live Tables, and Auto Loader.
Establish reusable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration frameworks (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, ADF).
Ensure pipelines meet SLAs, scalability, reliability, and data quality requirements.
Promote engineering excellence through code reviews, testing standards, modular design, and documentation.
Enable real-time and near-real-time data processing for critical business use cases.
7. Portfolio Management
Manage a portfolio of data engineering programs and projects, ensuring delivery on scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
Prioritize initiatives based on business value, ROI, and strategic alignment.
Own resource planning, budgeting, vendor management, and risk mitigation across the portfolio.
Report progress, KPIs, and outcomes to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
Run delivery governance using Agile, SAFe, or hybrid methodologies.
People Leadership
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers, architects, and tech leads, including onshore and offshore teams.
Build a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
Drive hiring, performance management, and career development for the team.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Mandatory Skills
1. Advanced Prompt Engineering.
Experience with structured outputs (JSON mode, function/tool calling) and system prompt design.
Ability to systematically test, version, and optimize prompts for quality and token efficiency.
Knowledge of prompt injection risks and mitigation techniques.
2. LLM Architecture Design
Strong understanding of transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, tokenization, and context windows.
Ability to design scalable LLM system architectures, including agents, memory, tool use, and orchestration layers.
Experience making trade-off decisions on model selection, latency, cost, and accuracy.
3. RAG System Implementation
Hands-on experience building production RAG systems end-to-end.
Proficiency with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, Milvus, Qdrant, or pgvector.
Knowledge of embedding models, chunking strategies, hybrid search (semantic + keyword), re-ranking, and query transformation.
Experience evaluating RAG pipelines using tools like RAGAS, TruLens, or custom metrics.
4. Fine-tuning Strategy
Ability to determine when fine-tuning is the right approach compared with prompting or RAG.
Hands-on experience with PEFT techniques (LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning, and alignment methods (RLHF, DPO).
Experience with dataset curation, cleaning, and preparation for fine-tuning.
Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, TRL, Axolotl, or Unsloth.
5. LangChain / LlamaIndex (Advanced)
Deep, hands-on experience building complex chains, agents, and multi-step workflows.
Proficiency with LangGraph, LCEL, custom tools, retrievers, memory modules, and callbacks.
Experience with LlamaIndex indexing strategies, query engines, and data connectors.
Ability to extend frameworks with custom components when needed.
6. Multi-model Integration
Experience integrating and orchestrating multiple LLM providers and open-source models.
Ability to implement model routing, fallback mechanisms, load balancing, and cost optimization.
Exposure to multimodal models (text, image, audio, vision-language).
Familiarity with gateways and abstraction tools such as LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or similar.
7. Production Deployment
Proven experience deploying LLM applications to production at scale.
Proficiency with model serving frameworks such as vLLM, TGI, Ollama, Triton, or TensorRT-LLM.
Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including services like Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
Experience with LLMOps and observability tools such as LangSmith, MLflow, Weights & Biases, Langfuse, or Arize.
Understanding of caching, batching, quantization, rate limiting, and latency optimization.

Description:
About the Role:
Grade Level (for internal use): 11
Role Summary
The Application Cloud Security Lead will serve as a key security leader within the SP Global Energy Division BISO team, responsible for coordinating security initiatives across application, cloud, and AI-enabled environments. This role directly supports the protection of applications, data, systems, and reputation by proactively managing cyber risk, strengthening resilience and embedding security into everything we do.
The successful candidate will partner with technology, product, engineering, cloud, risk, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure security is integrated into architecture, delivery, operations, and innovation. The role will focus on security architecture reviews, application security governance, cloud security enforcement, AI security oversight, risk remediation, and alignment with enterprise cybersecurity standards.
This position requires a hands-on security leader who can translate cybersecurity requirements into practical controls, influence engineering teams, guide secure design decisions, and drive measurable improvements in cyber resilience across the Energy Division.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate application, cloud, and AI security initiatives across the SP Global Energy Division in alignment with SP Global's cyber risk management objectives.
Conduct security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data flows, integrations, and AI-enabled solutions to identify risks and recommend secure design improvements.
Partner with engineering, product, architecture, cloud, and business teams to embed security requirements into solution design, development, deployment, and operations.
Enforce application security controls, including secure coding practices, vulnerability remediation, authentication, authorization, secrets management, dependency security, and software supply chain risk management.
Oversee cloud security control implementation across public cloud environments, including identity and access management, network security, encryption, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration.
Review and assess AI and machine learning use cases for security risks, including data leakage, prompt injection, model exposure, access control, third-party AI risk, and misuse scenarios.
Track, prioritize, and drive remediation of application, cloud, and AI security findings, exceptions, and risk acceptances in partnership with accountable technology owners.
Support cyber risk assessments, compliance reviews, audit requests, and security reporting related to Energy Division applications, cloud services, and AI-enabled platforms.
Develop and maintain metrics, dashboards, and executive-level reporting to communicate security posture, risk trends, remediation progress, and key security initiatives.
Serve as a trusted security advisor and liaison between the Energy Division and Enterprise cybersecurity teams, promoting secure-by-design practices and consistent adoption of security standards.
Required Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
5-8+ years experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on application security, cloud security, security architecture, and/or technology risk management.
Experience conducting security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data platforms, and enterprise technology solutions.
Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD security, container security, Kubernetes security, infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets management, and software supply chain security.
Experience with cloud security tools such as CSPM, CWPP, CNAPP, SIEM, vulnerability management platforms, container scanners, and identity governance tools.
Familiar with AI security concepts such as prompt injection, model access control, sensitive data exposure, model monitoring, adversarial testing, AI red teaming, and third-party AI risk.
Experience working with public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders including technology, product, risk, compliance, privacy, legal, and business teams.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security risks to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to prioritise risks, influence remediation, and drive outcomes in a complex enterprise environment.
Relevant certifications such as CISSP, SABSA, CCSK, Cloud Vendor Certifications (e.g. AWS Certified Security Specialty, AWS Certified Solution Architect, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer) or equivalent credentials.

Description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.
Your Role
Demonstrate strong understanding of Process Mining technologies and solutions offered by leading platforms such as Celonis, SAP Signavio, and related tools.
Design and develop KPIs and performance metrics tailored to specific business processes and client use cases. Build end-to-end Analysis Dashboards, Execution Apps, and insights-driven visualizations to support operational decision-making.
Work extensively with Celonis components, including Views, Action Flows, Skills, Knowledge Models, Simulation, and Data Explorer. Utilize Signavio Process Insights, Process Intelligence, and Plug Gain accelerators to drive transformation outcomes.
Identify, define, and implement Execution Gap use cases across various business workflows. Establish and manage connections to diverse data sources using APIs, RFCs, and other integration mechanisms.

Create custom connectors and set up end-to-end live data connectivity across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments.
Develop and optimize complex SQL, PQL (Process Query Language), and Signavio Signal queries to support data modeling and analysis. Implement Multi-Event Log structures for complex process scenarios and custom mining requirements.
Collaborate with clients to gather, understand, and translate requirements into robust process-mining solutions.Present insights, findings, and recommendations effectively through strong presentation and communication skills.
Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to explore processes, detect inefficiencies, and recommend optimizations.
Knowledge of OCPM (Object-Centric Process Mining) concepts and implementation approaches. It is beneficial for candidates to have implementation experience with Celonis AI features such as Process CoPilot, Insights Explorer, PI Graph, MCP, AI Agents, and the Annotation Builder.

What you'll love about working here
We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance.
At the heart of our mission is your career growth. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professions are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities.
Equip yourself with valuable certifications in the latest technologies such as Generative AI.

Description:
Senior Manager - Risk, Fraud and Audit
Location: Mumbai/Gurgaon/Bangalore
Experience: 8-12 years
Industry: Payments (Mandatory)

About EnKash
EnKash is a full stack payments company offering a unified platform for payables, receivables, corporate cards, and expense management. Backed by key RBI licenses including PA-O & PA-P and PPI, EnKash enables merchants to automate financial operations with compliance and control.

About the Role
We are looking for a seasoned Risk & Compliance professional with strong expertise in payments for managing our PA & PPI license This role will play a critical part in strengthening risk governance, ensuring regulatory compliance, and managing fraud across payment flows, card systems, and merchant transactions. You will work at the intersection of risk, compliance, and operations, driving robust controls across both issuance and acquiring environments in a highly regulated fintech landscape. The person is expected to coordinate internally & externally with banks, regulators, FIUs, LEAs etc and help manage risk in the ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities
Fraud Risk Management & Monitoring: Design and implement end-to-end fraud prevention and detection strategies across payment gateway/acquiring flows/ issuing flows, including real-time monitoring and risk mitigation.
Fraud Investigations & Incident Response: Lead investigations, manage chargebacks/disputes, and handle fraud incidents across card transactions, merchant payments, and gateway flows, ensuring timely resolution and escalation.
Regulatory Compliance & Reporting: Ensure adherence to RBI guidelines across PAPG, PPI, including KYC/KYB, AML transaction monitoring, FIU-IND STR reporting, and regulatory submissions.
Risk Assessment & Control Framework: Conduct comprehensive risk assessments across acquiring ecosystems, identifying vulnerabilities in transaction flows, integrations, settlements, and merchant onboarding. Audit & Governance: Drive internal and external audits, strengthen governance frameworks, and ensure robust internal controls, documentation, and audit readiness.
Policy Development & Process Excellence: Develop and enhance risk, compliance, and fraud management policies/SOPs aligned with regulatory requirements and industry best practices across both ecosystems.
Stakeholder Management & Training: Collaborate with product, tech, business, and compliance teams; present risk insights and drive organization-wide awareness on fraud prevention and regulatory compliance.

What Were Looking For
8-12 years of experience in Audit, Risk, Fraud, or Compliance roles within fintech
Strong exposure to PAPG (Payment Aggregator/Payment Gateway) ecosystems and/or Prepaid Payment Instruments ecosystems.
Solid understanding of RBI regulations, including KYC/KYB, AML transaction monitoring, fraud management, and digital payments compliance
Hands-on experience in fraud risk management, transaction monitoring, and chargeback handling across cards and/or payment gateway environments
Proven experience managing internal/external audits and regulatory interactions
Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills
Managing and closing LEA/FIU queries.

Why Join EnKash?
Opportunity to work across both acquiring (PAPG) and issuance (PPI) ecosystems
Exposure to complex, high-scale payment and regulatory frameworks
High ownership role with direct impact on risk strategy and governance

How to Apply Send your resume to: careers@enkash.com

About EnKash
EnKash is Indias premier corporate spend management and payments powerhouse, revolutionizing the way businesses control and optimize their financial operations. Our all-in-one, self-serve platform enables companies to seamlessly manage payables, receivables, corporate cards, and every aspect of expense management with precision and ease. Trusted by leading enterprises and financial institutions, EnKash drives unmatched efficiency, ensures regulatory compliance, and powers frictionless, end-to-end business payment flows.To know more about EnKash, please visit www.enkash.com.

Description:
BACKEND ENGINEER PYTHON & AZURE INTEGRATIONS
Publicis Global Delivery | India (Mumbai / Bangalore / Pune / Hyderabad / Gurgaon) | 5–8 years
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer to design, develop and maintain scalable backend services and enterprise integrations. The candidate will be responsible for building robust APIs, integrating business applications such as Salesforce and Microsoft 365, and developing secure, event-driven backend workflows using Python and Azure services.
The role requires strong backend engineering fundamentals, experience with cloud-based application development, API integrations, authentication mechanisms and distributed systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop and maintain scalable backend services using Python and FastAPI.
Build and manage REST APIs for integrating enterprise applications and business systems.
Develop integrations with Salesforce, SharePoint, Outlook and Microsoft Teams using REST APIs and Microsoft Graph API.
Implement asynchronous processing, background jobs and event-driven workflows.
Work with Azure services including Cosmos DB, Azure Functions, App Service, API Management and Service Bus/Event Grid.
Implement secure authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0 and managed identities.
Design and manage application state, data persistence and long-running workflows using Cosmos DB.
Implement error handling, retries, idempotency, timeouts and fault-tolerant mechanisms.
Monitor application performance, troubleshoot production issues and maintain structured logging and audit trails.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable and scalable backend solutions.

Description:
Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (Dayforce)
Job description
is responsible for independently managing assigned workstreams and supporting end-to-end Dayforce HCM implementation projects across functional areas, including Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, and Talent Management, as well as technical areas such as Data Conversion, Integrations, and Reporting. The role requires strong expertise in one or more Dayforce modules, with a working understanding of related modules and cross-functional dependencies. Key responsibilities include requirements gathering, business process design, solution design, system configuration, data migration and validation, integrations, reporting, testing, cutover, and post-go-live activities. The position involves collaborating closely with clients, project managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into effective HCM solutions, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure timely, high-quality project delivery. Additionally, the role supports regulatory compliance, process optimization, and transition to managed services while ensuring solution quality and alignment with client business objectives.
Essential Responsibilities
Support the end-to-end implementation and transformation of Dayforce HCM solutions for external clients, covering discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, within your primary module and in coordination with other module workstreams.
Own assigned Dayforce functional workstreams, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones, deliverables, and client requirements.
Facilitate client discovery workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, document current-state HR and payroll processes, business rules, organizational structures, and data flows, validate design decisions, resolve open items, and align client needs with Dayforce capabilities.
Translate business and functional requirements into Dayforce configurations, solution design documents, configuration workbooks, and test scenarios.
Support data migration activities, including coordination of legacy data extraction, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure accurate conversion into Dayforce.
Collaborate with technical and integration teams on inbound and outbound integrations between Dayforce and third-party systems, including data mapping, integration testing, error resolution, and data flow validation.
Plan and execute testing activities, including functional, system integration (SIT), user acceptance (UAT), regression, and end-to-end business process testing; support payroll parallel testing where applicable by validating calculations, analyzing variances, and reconciling results; and manage defects through resolution.
Advise clients on Dayforce capabilities, HCM business processes, regulatory compliance considerations, and leading practices, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and optimization by assessing manual workarounds, control gaps, and system capabilities.


Requirements
48 years of relevant experience in HCM implementation, HR technology consulting, HR transformation, or enterprise HRIS projects, including hands-on Dayforce HCM implementation experience.
Hands-on experience configuring Dayforce in at least one primary module (Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, or Talent Management), with working knowledge of cross-module dependencies.
Experience across the end-to-end Dayforce implementation lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, data migration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support.
Experience independently managing a functional workstream, facilitating client workshops, translating business requirements into system solutions, troubleshooting configuration issues, and delivering documentation and project milestones.
Solid knowledge of HCM data migration, mapping, validation, reconciliation, integration testing, and defect management.

Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

About The Role


Job Title -

Instructional Design - Associate

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:12 - Associate

Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Experience:Minimum 0-3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:-0-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Description:
Job Description


Overview
The BIM Designer/Lead Designer role at AtkinsRalis GDC Transportation focuses on delivering advanced BIM and CAD designs for major global rail and bridge infrastructure projects. Based in Bangalore or Gurgaon, the position involves creating and managing 3D models, producing detailed 2D drawings, coordinating multidisciplinary BIM workflows, and ensuring compliance with AtkinsRalis standards and international BIM practices. The role requires strong modelling expertise, understanding of BIM standards, experience with tools like MicroStation, OpenBuildings, ProjectWise/ACC, and the ability to collaborate within large engineering teams. It offers excellent growth opportunities within a world-leading infrastructure consultancy.


Your role
Should be able to develop CAD/BIM 3D Models / 2D Drawings to the standards codes
Should be able to produce medium to complex 3D modelling for bridges Rail structures
Competent in producing GA and RC detailing drawings for bridges and Rail structures.
Work with the Information Manager and project teams to assist in the development and implementation of BIM strategies, BIM Execution Plans, workflows and processes on projects in accordance with AtkinsRalis Corporate Standards, Client requirements and industry best practice.
Should be able to produce 3D models and extract information directly from models to create 2D drawings, schedules, setting out, quantities and other deliverables.
Should be able to develop models and technical content including clash detection and compliance with BEP.
Should be able to follow OCRA process in EDMS workflow
Should have strong written verbal communication in English
Experience of working in Common Data Environment (CDE) like ProjectWise / ACC
Apply AtkinsRalis Quality, Safety Environmental (QSE) standards and Business Management System (BMS).


About You
Requirements
Must have Civil Engineering background with preferable Rail domain experience.
Experience of Bridge Detailing, reinforcement detailing, structural steel detailing and schedules.
Hands-on experience of industry standard Rail BIM Platforms such as OpenBuildings Designer, MicroStation Connect (3D).
Proven experience of a range of CAD and BIM industry standards including an understanding of UK BIM Level 2 requirements. Understanding of BIM Standards such as BS1192 and PAS1192 Part 2 is also desirable.
I-Twin or Bentley Cloud Services with capabilities to federate individual discipline BIM Models. Setup, maintain and run clash rules and clash tests across federated BIM Models
Working experience in Revit Structures including 3D RC detailing would be an added advantage
Qualifications and attributes
Excellent time management skills.
3 to 5 years of relevant experience
Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Diploma/Degree holder in Civil Engineering with sufficient and relevant experience.
Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivation
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment
Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
Ability to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers
Highly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.
Working knowledge of British / American Standards


Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.


About AtkinsRalis
We're , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
Worker Type Contingent Worker
Job Type Loan of Personnel
At AtkinsRalis , we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

We pride ourselves in offering a truly multi-disciplinary capability and bring exciting opportunities to influence major projects from beginning to end. Our vision is to be the world's best Infrastructure Consultancy by leveraging BIM and embracing the digital future to bring about transformational benefits for the Transportation Engineering industry.
This key post will be based out of Bangalore where we have thriving AtkinsRalis office, which deliver to all AtkinsRalis regions across the world. Our portfolio of work continues to grow, and we will offer a challenging and rewarding opportunity to apply knowledge, experience, and problem-solving skills.
Your Role
Responsibilities
Produce AutoCAD and MicroStation 2D drawings and other deliverables.
Actively contribute to project design development by contributing to internal coordination.
Produce all types of Highways discipline 2D Drawings and other deliverables. Perform self-assurance of all Highways discipline drawing and model deliverables.
Provide quality control for compliance to company/project standards of deliverables.
Maintain a high level of competency of all BIM software tools used at AtkinsRalis.
About You
Requirements
A Bachelor's degree or Diploma holder in Civil Engineering with minimum of 4 to 6 years of industry experience, preferably in the Highways Domain.
Must be an advanced user or expert user in Autodesk AutoCAD, Civil3D, and Bentley MicroStation with a minimum of 2 to 3 years.
AutoCAD experience must, detailed understanding of the CAD user interface and all its features to perform.
MicroStation experience must, detailed understanding of the MicroStation user interface and all its features to perform.
Technical proficiency in the use of the latest common CDE systems: Bentley ProjectWise and Autodesk Vault.
Must be well versed in best practices for use of Autodesk AutoCAD, and Bentley MicroStation and other industry standard BIM platforms.
Track record in BIM design and coordination including multidisciplinary projects and ideally demonstrable experience within a Civil Engineering Design environment particularly the Highways domain.
Technical awareness/knowledge of engineering design issues including awareness of health and safety risks.
Qualifications and attributes
Excellent time management skills.
Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Bachelor's degree or Diploma holder in Civil Engineering with minimum of 4 to 5 years of industry experience, preferably in the Highways Domain.
Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivation
Ability to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers
Highly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Process all guest check-ins, verifying guest identity, form of payment, assigning room, and activating/issuing room key. Set up accurate accounts for each guest according to their requirements. Enter Marriott Rewards information. Ensure rates match market codes, document exceptions. Secure payment prior to issuing room key, verify/adjust billing. Compile and review daily reports/logs/contingency lists. Complete cashier and closing reports. Supply guests with directions and property information. Accommodate guest requests, contacting appropriate staff if necessary. Follow up to ensure requests have been met. Process all payment types, vouchers, paid-outs, and charges. Balance and drop receipts. Count and secure bank at beginning and end of shift. Obtain manual authorizations and follow all Accounting procedures. Notify Loss Prevention/Security of any guest reports of theft.
Assist management in training, evaluating, counseling, motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Develop/maintain positive working relationships; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Follow company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure personal appearance is clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Ensure adherence to quality standards. Enter and locate information using computers/POS systems. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Inspect guest rooms, public areas, pool, etc. after being cleaned by Housekeeper to ensure quality standards. Run sold room reports, verify room status, determine discrepant rooms, prioritize room cleaning, and update status of departing guest rooms. Assist Housekeeping management in managing daily activities. Act as a liaison to coordinate the efforts of Housekeeping, Engineering, Front Office, and Laundry. Document and resolve issues with discrepant rooms with the Front Desk. Prepare, distribute, and communicate changes in room assignments. Communicate issues to next shift. Complete required paperwork.
Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Move, lift, carry, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 55 pounds without assistance and in excess of 55 pounds with assistance. Ability to push and pull a loaded housekeeping cart and other work-related machinery over sloping and uneven surfaces. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Stand, sit, kneel, or walk for an extended period across an entire work shift. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Description:
Job Details
Location: Sonipat, Haryana
Department: Department of Psychology
Reports To: Dr. Naseer Ahmad Bhat, Principal Investigator
Role Type: Full-time Fixed-term (24 months)
Experience: 0-2 years (Freshers with relevant training welcome)
Job Summary
The Research Assistant will support all phases of a funded seed grant project on affective dynamics and mental health in Indian college students using variations of experience sampling methods/ambulatory assessments. Working closely with the Principal Investigator, the RA will coordinate participant recruitment and data collection across three study waves, and contribute to data processing and preliminary analysis. At six months, success looks like all Wave 1 participants recruited, consented, and onboarded, EMA data collected with about 70% prompt compliance, and the Wave 1 dataset cleaned and ready for analysis.
Roles and Responsibilities
Coordinate participant recruitment across partner colleges in Delhi NCR, including screening, consent procedures, and onboarding.
Set up, configure, and monitor the EMA platform for the two-week signal-contingent EMA protocol, troubleshooting technical issues and ensuring data integrity throughout.
Administer wave-level questionnaire batteries at Wave 1, Wave 2, and Wave 3, maintaining accurate participant tracking records.
Manage and clean questionnaire datasets, perform data quality checks (compliance rates, missing data, ICC screening), and maintain a secure, anonymised data repository.
Assist with literature searches, reference management, and preparation of research manuscripts, conference presentations, and progress reports to the funding body.
Liaise with the Institutional Review Board, maintain ethical compliance documentation, and support participant safeguarding procedures including safety screen monitoring.
What We Are Looking For
Qualifications
Master's degree in Psychology, Clinical Psychology, or a related behavioural science discipline. A four year bachelors degree with mastery in required skill sets is also welcome.
Prior experience in empirical research - including data collection, survey administration, or quantitative data management - is desirable. Freshers with strong research methods training are encouraged to apply.
Proficiency in R is required. Competence in multivariate and longitudinal data analysis, Structural Equation Modelling (SEM), Dynamic Structural Equation Modelling (DSEM), network analysis, and panel data techniques is strongly desirable.
Experience with ESM platforms or ambulatory assessments or mobile health apps is an advantage.
Who You Are
You are highly organised and reliable - able to manage participant schedules, platform checks, and data logs simultaneously without loss of accuracy.
You communicate clearly and professionally with student participants, college coordinators, and the PI, and can represent the study credibly in the field.
You are proactive and conscientious: you flag data quality issues or compliance drops early and bring solutions, not just problems, to the PI.
You are genuinely interested in mental health research and comfortable working in a rigorous, deadline-driven academic research environment with significant autonomy.

Description:
Academic Counsellor
Locations - Indore / Bangalore / Pune - Wakad / Pune - Kothrud)

About the Role
As an Academic Counsellor, you will play a key role in guiding potential learners, helping them identify the right career path, and showcasing how upGrads programs can accelerate their journey. You will be responsible for driving enrollments and revenue by nurturing leads, providing consultative counselling, and closing sales in a highly competitive environment.

5 Reasons to Join upGrad Offline Learning Centres
1.Performance Incentives: Target monthly incentive of INR 30,000, with potential to earn 1.5X/2X of that based on performance.
2.Career Growth: Promotion opportunities in 1 year or lateral movement across other Business Units at upGrad.
3.Continuous Upskilling: Access 100% free upGrad programs for yourself and a 50% discount for your family.
4.Comprehensive Health & Wellbeing: Benefit from INR 5L medical insurance for yourself and your family, plus a 24x7 mental health helpline for all-round support.
5.Employee Referral Bonus: Receive INR 15,000 for every successful employee referral bring great talent to upGrad and get rewarded.

Key Responsibilities
Engage with potential learners through calls, video sessions, and in-centre meetings to understand their career goals and recommend suitable programs.
Drive weekly & monthly enrollment and revenue targets by effectively converting leads into admissions.
Manage the complete sales lifecycle from first interaction to enrollment and post-sales support.
Track and improve key performance metrics such as counselling sessions, conversion rates, and revenue.
Maintain accurate learner records on CRM and share feedback with the Marketing team to improve lead quality.
Work closely with centre teams to ensure a smooth learner journey and high satisfaction levels.

Skills & Experience
Graduate with 25 years of experience in consultative or B2C sales (education industry exposure preferred).
Strong communication, persuasion and relationship-building skills.
Organized, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities under pressure.
Empathetic listener with ability to build trust and focus on learner success.
Comfortable with CRM tools and basic MS Office proficiency.

Job Role :
Profitability Management - Maintaining & optimizing profitability for the branch
Target setting & management Monitoring branch targets in numbers & volumes
Portfolio quality management - through superior underwriting, working closely with collections
Cost management managing all branch operating costs including cost of acquisition, operations etc.
People management Motivating team, handling HR & administration function of the branch
Customer experience management - Ensuring superior customer experience and handling customer service in terms of collections, pre closures & service issues

Achieve contributed value targets set for the branch
Ensure sales volumes for multiple products, sourcing quality & underwriting diligence to meet sales targets while controlling delinquencies and frauds
Provide superior customer experience

Minimize pre & post disbursal discrepancies
Monitoring Performance
Monitoring Branch performance in terms of key drivers i.e.
Contributed Value.Volumes / Profitability / Expenses / Losses
Employee Retention
Employee Productivity
Customer experience
Monitor individual performance of each employee, continuously work to maximize productivity
People Management
Motivate and develop branch team
Drive branch team to excel.
Manage and mentor the team and keep attrition of branch staff low
Conduct regular meeting with branch staff
Provide open and honest feedback and ask for feedback.

Mandatory Skills :
7-8 Years experience, with atleast 4 years in Retail Assets
Ability to plan & execute
Strong inter-personal skills and leadership ability,
Ability to create professional work culture that encourages enthusiasm and team spirit
Understanding of credit risks & operational risks.
Ability to manage and implement change by taking complete ownership

Description:
Senior Software Engineer (C# .NET Azure)
With a global team of around 5600+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work beyond global borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technology backbone of the biggest logistics company of the world. All our locations have earned #GreatPlaceToWork certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experiences.

Digitalization. Simply delivered.
Were very excited to see the positive impact of our work but also recognize the potential is much larger. This is why we need you!
#DHL #DHLITServices #GreatPlace #JobLocations #Indore #Chennai # Bangalore

Grow together.
We operate in an agile/DevSecOps manner, with product-oriented teams holding end-to-end responsibility for product success. Our work follows Scrum practices, including stand-ups, reviews, and iterative deployment. While not strictly by the book, we embrace agile principles, learning from failures and getting better every day.

About the IoT team
We are a supportive, quality-driven group of tech enthusiasts who strive to improve daily and are eager to assist you on your journey with us! Our global team includes members from India and Germany, collaborating via Microsoft Teams, Jira, and Confluence. We are aiming to provide a platform that accelerates IoT adoption for operational excellence, customer experience, and employee safety. We built a global platform that processes data from millions of connected devices across DHL and are developing modular use cases for real-time shipment monitoring (e.g. for life science and healthcare shipments) and actionable insights.

Tech stack
Our IoT platform is built on Microsoft Azure, featuring a micro-services architecture and Azure DevOps for continuous integration and delivery, utilizing Docker and Kubernetes. We primarily use .NET Core, C#, and Angular for coding.

Ready to embark on the journey? Heres what we are looking for:
Were looking for a Software Engineer in our IoT team who does both product development (we also do something with AI) where you will have an opportunity to directly impact customer experience in DHL as well as support existing IoT use case implementations.

What do we expect from you?
Proven experience as a Software Engineer with a strong portfolio of projects
Excellent problem-solving skills
Individual with positive energy and can-do attitude
A desire to grow and continuously improve in a fast-paced environment
Strong knowledge in .NET Core and C#
Strong code-reading skills and knack for writing clean, testable, easily maintainable code
Experience with Microsoft Azure Cloud PaaS services
Extensive knowledge in Entity Framework Core
Experience in MS SQL Server
Very good written and spoken English
Willingness to work in the UK shift

Good to have:
Experience with Azure DevOps and Azure Kubernetes Service
Thorough understanding of the responsibilities of the platform, database, API, caching layer, proxies, and other web services used in the syste
Job Locations: Bangalore, Chennai and Indore
An array of benefits for you:
Hybrid work arrangements to balance in-office collaboration and home flexibility.
Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
Medical Insurance: Self + Spouse + 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent -in-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease.
In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

Job Description

HGS has been assisting global customers since 2003 bringing data to life as their Trusted Analytics and Planning partner. Title : SAP Consultant
Skills: SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA & S/4HANA CDS Views
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore/ Indore
Total Exp: 03-08 Years
Notice Period: Joining in 1 to 2 months, FTE only
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled SAP Technical Consultant with strong expertise in SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA development, and S/4HANA CDS Views to support enterprise-wide analytics, reporting, and data integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have 3-8 years of progressive SAP experience with hands-on exposure to data modeling, performance optimization, and cross-functional collaboration in modern SAP data landscapes.
Core Responsibilities
Technical Development & Implementation
Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and end-users to analyze requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
Design, develop, and implement technical solutions across SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Support migration and upgrade activities from legacy systems while maintaining data consistency, quality, and integrity
Participate in technical workshops with business users to gather requirements and contribute to SAP solution design
SAP BW Development & Data Modeling
Design and develop SAP BW/BW4HANA data models using InfoObjects, Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and Open ODS Views
Build and maintain transformations, DTPs, and process chains for efficient data loading and delta management
Develop and optimize BEx queries and analytical reports to support operational and management reporting needs
Implement extraction using standard and custom ODP-based data sources, including SAP ERP/S4HANA extractors
Apply LSA++ modeling principles to design layered, scalable, and maintainable BW data architectures
S/4HANA CDS Views Development
Design and develop ABAP CDS (Core Data Services) views and entities with associations, annotations, and calculations
Implement data models using ABAP CDS views for operational reporting, embedded analytics, and real-time insights
Create and enhance customer-specific CDS views and analytical queries to meet business requirements
Optimize existing CDS views for improved performance and data modeling efficiency
Develop solutions using SAP BTP/BAS and S/4HANA Private Cloud/On-premise environments
Integrate CDS views with Fiori applications and other analytics platforms
Native HANA Development & Performance Optimization
Design and develop Native HANA solutions (HANA 1.0 and HANA 2.0 XSA) using Calculation Views, Attribute Views, and Analytic Views
Create SQL script solutions, stored procedures, and mixed modeling scenarios for analytics use cases
Support BWoH and BW4HANA modeling activities, including Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and ODP extractors
Perform optimization and troubleshooting of Calculation Views and SQL queries using standard performance tuning techniques
Assist with ABAP to HANA SQL conversions and AMDP script implementations
Support HANA security models, transport management, and lifecycle management activities
SAP Functional Knowledge
Good understanding of core S/4HANA/ECC modules including SD, MM, FI/CO, HR, WM, PP, and supply chain processes
Basic knowledge of master data management and data governance practices
Education and Experience:
Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field, with a University degree (Master/Diploma/PhD) in IT, and strong independent, team-oriented, and accountable work ethic.
3-8 years of SAP development experience, focusing on SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Hands-on experience in at least one full-cycle SAP BW/BW4HANA implementation
Working knowledge of ABAP CDS view development and Native HANA modeling
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently as well as in a team
This role is ideal for a motivated SAP professional who is passionate about leveraging SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS technologies to deliver reliable, enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions as part of a collaborative technical team.
Application Process
Qualified candidates should submit:
Detailed resume highlighting project experience
Cover letter describing relevant technical achievements
Portfolio of completed data analytics projects (if available)
Professional references from previous SAP implementations
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
Working at HGS
At HGS, our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.
Interested candidates please share your profile to ___________@teamhgs.com

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits ETC
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep IE while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Job Title: PPRT Teacher Location: Indore, Radio Colony

Job Overview: We are looking for a warm, responsible, and energetic Daycare & PPRT Teacher to support early childhood learning and provide a safe, engaging environment for young children.

Key Responsibilities:
Supervise and care for children in the daycare and pre-primary section.
Plan and conduct age-appropriate learning activities.
Ensure safety, hygiene, and well-being of all children.
Maintain attendance, daily records, and parent communication.
Support overall classroom management and learning routines.
Requirements:
Minimum 1-2 years of experience in daycare or early childhood teaching.
Strong communication, patience, and child-handling skills.
Ability to create a joyful, nurturing learning atmosphere. Role & responsibilities
AboutCompany:
Podar Education was started and operates with the prime purpose of building young minds to spearhead a dynamic future globally. Podar is a growing network that which has a wide spectrum of brands including pre-primary options, primary, secondary schools, junior colleges, part-time courses and teacher training courses.
Headquartered in Mumbai, there are a host of Podar Schools all across India. Podar offers a wide choice of academic boards including International General Certificate of Secondary Education (IGCSE), International Baccalaureate (IB), Indian Certificate of Secondary Education (ICSE), Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) and Secondary School Certificate (SSC).
Podars key strength emanates from its teaching team. The schools employ the best quality teachers, most of whom have years of experience and a commitment to quality education. National and international trainings are a regular feature to keep the staff abreast with the latest educational developments around the world.
A focus on technology and innovative educational teaching methods has helped Podar establish a leading position among schools in India. In all Podar schools, technology is given special attention and state-of-the-art facilities are available for all the students.
Podar also lays extensive emphasis on sports and extra-curricular activities. Specialized and experienced coaches are deployed in a wide spectrum of sporting disciplines. The schools participate and excel in various inter-school sports tournaments.
CompanyAddress: PODAR CENTRE, 85, CHAMBARBAUG P.O LANE, MUMBAI - 400012, MUMBAI, Maharashtra, India

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Check figures, postings, and documents for correct entry, mathematical accuracy, and proper codes. Organize, secure, and maintain all files, records, cash and cash equivalents in accordance with policies and procedures. Record, store, access, and/or analyze computerized financial information. Maintain accurate electronic spreadsheets for financial and accounting data. Classify, code, and summarize numerical and financial data to compile and keep financial records, using journals, ledgers, and/or computers. Prepare, maintain, and distribute statistical, financial, accounting, auditing, or payroll reports and tables. Complete period-end closing procedures and reports as specified. Prepare, review, reconcile, and issue bills, invoices, and account statements according to company procedures.
Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets; protect the privacy and security of guests and coworkers. Address guests service needs in a professional, positive, and timely manner. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones and emails using appropriate etiquette. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Job Description Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Engineer
Experience: 3 Years
Job Title: GCP Data Engineer
Work Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore / Indore
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled GCP Cloud Engineer with 3 years of hands-on experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, cloud infrastructure, deployment, monitoring, and automation. The ideal candidate should have experience in managing cloud environments and supporting scalable, secure, and reliable cloud solutions.
Required Skills & Responsibilities
3 years of hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Good knowledge of GCP services such as:
Compute Engine (GCE)
Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
Cloud Storage (GCS)
BigQuery
Cloud Functions / Cloud Run
Cloud SQL
Experience with IAM, service accounts, roles, and permissions.
Good understanding of VPC, subnets, firewall rules, and networking.
Experience in deploying and managing applications on GCP.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab, or Cloud Build.
Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
Knowledge of cloud monitoring and logging using Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging.
Understanding of cloud security, backup, and disaster recovery concepts.
Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Good to Have
Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer certification.
Knowledge of Python or Shell scripting.
Exposure to DevOps practices and automation.
Understanding of AWS or Azure cloud platforms.
Candidate Expectations
Strong communication and analytical skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period preferred.

AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).
