Description:
Job Description QA/QC Engineer (Railway Tunnel Project)
Designation: QA/QC Engineer
Department: Quality Control
Project: Railway Tunnel / Railway Infrastructure
Experience: 5–10 Years (relevant tunnel experience preferred)
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering
Location: Project Site
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced QA/QC Engineer with railway tunnel construction experience to ensure that all civil construction activities comply with approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and applicable codes.
Key Responsibilities
Implement and maintain the project Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) plan.
Inspect railway tunnel construction activities, including excavation, rock support, shotcrete, rock bolting, grouting, waterproofing, and concrete lining.
Monitor tunnel excavation and construction activities as per approved drawings and method statements.
Conduct inspections and coordinate material testing, laboratory tests, and field tests.
Verify the quality of concrete, reinforcement, cement, aggregates, and other construction materials.
Prepare and maintain Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), checklists, inspection requests, and quality records.
Coordinate with the client, consultant, and construction team for inspections and approvals.
Identify non-conformities (NCRs), recommend corrective actions, and ensure closure.
Ensure compliance with approved method statements, technical specifications, and relevant IS/IRC/railway standards.
Prepare quality reports, test reports, and documentation for audits.
Monitor subcontractor quality and ensure compliance with project requirements.
Support internal and external quality audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
Required Skills and Experience
Experience in railway tunnel construction projects is preferred.
Knowledge of tunnel excavation methods, including NATM, where applicable.
Knowledge of shotcrete, rock bolts, lattice girders, steel ribs, grouting, and tunnel lining.
Experience in QA/QC documentation, material testing, and site inspections.
Familiarity with drawings, specifications, method statements, and ITPs.
Good coordination and communication skills with clients and consultants.
Preferred Experience
Candidates with experience in railway tunnels, underground structures, highway tunnels, or other major infrastructure projects will be preferred.

Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.
Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities.
Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly.
Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner.
Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.
Administrative Tasks:

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Job description
Onycon Infrastructure is great career opportunities for experienced Assistnat Mechanial Engineer with 5-8 yrs experience in Repair and Maintainence of Equipment and Machinery fom a construction Background. The role will primary manage Site Mechanical Engineer Activities.
Opportunity for 5- 8 YRS Experience Assistant Mechanical Engineer from Construction Background
Applicant's from Assam and Guwahati , Northeast location can also welocme for this opening.

Position:
Experience: Opportunity for 5- 8 YRS Experience Assisnant mechanical Engineer from Construction Background
Our Industry: Construction/ Heavy Civil Infrastructure
Location: Manipur (Noney Market Site Location)

About the Role
Onycon Infrastructure is Urgently Hiring 5- 8 YRS Experience Assistant Mechanical Engineer from Construction Background
The role will provide hands-on exposure to Maintainence of Mchineray & Equipments,Repair of Equipments, Documentation Work like mainting log sheet and reports.

Key Responsibilities

1)Maintainence and Repair:
Manage the operation, maintenance, and repair of heavy construction equipment and machinery at the project site.

2)Planing and Monitoeing:
Plan and monitor preventive and breakdown maintenance to minimize equipment downtime.Oversee equipment deployment, utilization, fuel consumption, and maintenance records.

4)Co-ordination:
Coordinate with site teams for machinery availability and operational requirements.Coordinate with vendors and service providers for repairs, spare parts, and technical support.

5)Supervision and Team Handling:
Supervise mechanics, technicians, operators, and equipment maintenance activities.Monitor equipment performance, maintenance costs, spare parts inventory, and service schedules.

6)Procedures:
Ensure compliance with equipment safety standards and maintenance procedures.Ensure optimum utilization and availability of plant and machinery for railway tunnel construction activities.

8)Documentation:
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly equipment performance and maintenance reports.

Requirements:
5-8 YRS of Experience in Repair & Maintainence of Euipment from a construction background.
Diploma / B.E. in Mechanical Engineer, Diploma / B.E. in Automobile Engineering.
Hands-on experience with heavy construction equipment, maintenance planning, troubleshooting, and equipment management.
Knowledge of preventive maintenance, spare parts.
Strong coordination, team management, and problem-solving skills.
Willingness to work at the Manipur project site.

Education
UG: Diploma / B.E. in Mechanical Engineer, Diploma / B.E. in Automobile Engineering

Description:
Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks & financial instruments. To further enhance merchant & business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm's B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytm Payment PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. India's largest digital lending story is brewing here. It's your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
Job Description
Overview
Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization.
The Protection Control (PC) Design team plays a critical role in ensuring the safe operation, monitoring, automation, and protection of power system assets. The team develops engineering designs for 11kV,33kV,132kV,275Kv and 400kV substations, including protection schemes, control systems. Opportunities include working on complex international projects, developing detailed engineering deliverables, supporting multidisciplinary coordination, and driving design excellence through digital engineering tools and industry best practices. This role is ideal for professionals passionate about substation protection and control engineering, electrical system reliability, digital transformation, and delivering innovative solutions for the evolving energy sector.
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking an experienced Electrical Protection Control (PC) Lead Designer with 5-10 years of substation design experience and strong proficiency in AutoCAD to join our Bangalore office. This role involves supporting the delivery of Protection Control engineering and CAD deliverables for 132 kV to 400 kV AIS and GIS substations, covering both greenfield and brownfield projects across domestic and international markets.
The successful candidate will be responsible for developing high-quality PC design outputs, including protection schematics, control and relay panel drawings, wiring diagrams, interconnection diagrams, AC/DC schematics, cable schedules, and Substation documentation. Working closely with Protection Engineers and multidisciplinary project teams, the role requires ensuring compliance with international standards, client specifications, and project quality requirements.
This position offers the opportunity to contribute to complex projects across Power Generation, Transmission Distribution (TD), Renewable Energy and nuclear sectors, while supporting the digital transformation of substations through modern engineering practices and innovative design solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical understanding of substation protection and control systems, excellent drafting skills, and a commitment to delivering engineering excellence.


Your role
Key Responsibilities
Prepare Protection Control (PC) deliverables for 132 kV to 400 kV AIS/GIS substations
Develop SLDs, KLDs, AC/DC schematics, LVAC/LVDC diagrams, tripping schemes, relay wiring diagrams, panel layouts and cable schedules.
Prepare interface/interconnection diagrams, terminal block drawings, SCADA/SCS drawings, communication drawings and As-Built documentation.
Develop transformer, feeder and busbar protection drawings in accordance with project requirements.
Develop Control Protection Bay Control Drawings, Relay Panel Drawings, DC Distribution Schemes, AC Auxiliary Schemes, RTU/SCADA Drawings, SCS Drawings, LAN/Fiber Network Drawings, Cable Routing Termination Drawings, As-Built Documentation.
Develop and maintain engineering drawings using AutoCAD and other approved CAD tools in accordance with project and client standards.
Coordinate with Protection, Primary, Civil, Telecom, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to support project delivery.
Support design reviews, drawing updates, revisions, and preparation of As-Built documentation.
Perform self-checks and quality reviews to ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery of engineering documentation.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
Mentor junior staff and contribute to team motivation.
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are seeking an experienced Protection Control (PC) Lead Designer with:
Proven experience in 132kV to 400kV AIS/GIS Substation Protection Control design for both Greenfield and Brownfield projects.
Strong knowledge of protection schemes, control systems, SCADA, SAS, and IEC 61850-based substations.
Proficiency in AutoCAD and Raster Design; exposure to MicroStation, Revit, or other engineering design tools is advantageous and experience in preparing protection schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, interconnection diagrams, and cable schedules.
Good understanding of IEC, IEEE, utility, and client-specific standards related to substation design.
Ability to coordinate effectively with Protection Engineers, Primary, Civil, Telecom, and multidisciplinary project teams.
Experience in preparing, checking, and reviewing PC drawings while ensuring quality, accuracy, and compliance with project requirements.
A strong grasp of drawing standards, CAD/BIM protocols, and project workflows.
Familiarity with National Grid (UK) standards is a significant advantage.
Ability to prepare and check complex drawings, ensuring quality and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
Exposure to international substation projects and utility standards is an advantage.
Strong technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to mentor junior designers and support project delivery.
About you
Technical Competencies
Essential
Proficiency in AutoCAD Raster Design
Excellent drafting and detailing skills.
Strong understanding of substation protection and control systems.
Strong understanding of CAD/PC standards and drawing protocols.
Ability to prepare and check PC Interface drawings.
Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD standards, project procedures, and drawing control requirements
Desirable
Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC).
Experience in 132 kV, 220 kV, and 400 kV AIS/GIS substation Protection Control design projects.
Experience in greenfield and brownfield substation projects.
Proficiency in AutoCAD; exposure to Raster Design, MicroStation, Revit, or other electrical CAD tools is advantageous.
Behavioural Competencies
Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality, accuracy, and compliance.
Ability to work independently and mentor junior designers.
Proactive, accountable, and capable of managing multiple priorities.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Collaborative team player with leadership potential.
Responsive to client requirements and project deadlines.
Committed to continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and engineering excellence.
Ability to manage, motivate, and support design teams effectively.

Rewards benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage
Medical insurance for you and your dependents
Annual leave balance in accordance with local labour law
Flexible and hybrid work solutions
Opportunity for local and global internal transfers
Company gratuity scheme
Discretionary bonus program
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Senior Manager (Corporate HR, M&A, Payroll Operations & Compliance)
Role Summary
You will oversee workforce planning, talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, compensation and benefits, employee relations, and legal compliance.
Manage end-to-end payroll processing, HR operations, and statutory compliance across the organization. Ensure accurate and timely salary disbursements, maintain employee data integrity, and keep company policies and filings aligned with applicable labor and tax laws.
Responsible for leading people-related activities across the acquisition lifecycle, from due diligence and pre-close planning through employee transition, integration, and post-close stabilization.
Key Responsibilities
1. Talent Acquisition & Onboarding:
F Partner with department heads on manpower planning, manage hiring pipelines, and run structured onboarding programs.
F Employee Relations & Culture:
F Handle grievances, resolve workplace conflicts, support employee engagement, and uphold company policies.
2. Performance & Learning:
F Coordinate appraisal cycles, support career development, and roll out training initiatives.
F Compensation, Benefits & Payroll:
F Administer salaries, benefits, and statutory/payroll processes (such as PF, ESI, and TDS in India).
3. Compliance & HR Operations:
F Maintain accurate HRIS/employee records, track people metrics, and ensure adherence to labor laws and internal policies (including POSH compliance).
4. Pre-Merger: Due Diligence & Risk Assessment
A. Talent & Leadership Audit:
F Identify key personnel, critical revenue-generators, and flight risks.
F Liability & Compliance Review:
F Audit employment contracts, change-of-control clauses, severance agreements, ongoing grievances, and underfunded pension or benefit plans.
B. Cultural Compatibility:
F Evaluate values, leadership styles, and engagement levels to spot major friction points early.
F Deal Negotiation & Valuation
C. Retention & Incentives:
F Help structure stays bonuses, equity rollovers, and compensation packages to lock in key talent.
D. Synergy Validation:
Test assumptions around headcount reductions, restructuring, and organizational design to ensure cost/revenue targets are realistic.
5. Post-Merger Integration (PMI) & Day 1 Execution:
A. Operational Continuity:
F Ensure payroll, medical benefits, HRIS systems, and data flow seamlessly from Day 1 so employees get paid accurately and on time.
B. Organizational Design:
F Redefine reporting lines, eliminate redundancies humanely (with outplacement/counseling support), and align job tiers.
C. Cultural Integration:
F Build a blended corporate culture through active change management and transparent leadership.
D. Communication:
F Over-communicate through multi-channel updates to counter uncertainty, build trust, and keep morale stable
6. Payroll Operations
F Process monthly payroll accurately and on schedule, including salaries, bonuses, reimbursements, overtime, and full-and-final (F&F) settlements.
F Collect, verify, and reconcile attendance, leave, and compensation change inputs with HR and Finance teams.
F Manage statutory and voluntary deductions (such as PF, ESIC, TDS, Professional Tax, LWF, NPS, or benefits contributions), tax declarations, and payslip generation.
F Resolve employee payroll queries and grievances promptly and maintain audit-ready payroll records.
7. Corporate HR Operations:
F Oversee employee lifecycle administration from onboarding and transfers to promotions, policy updates, and offboarding.
F Maintain accurate employee master data, digital records, and HRIS/payroll system workflows.
F Prepare regular MIS reports, headcount/payroll analytics, and leadership updates.
8. Statutory & HR Compliance:
F Ensure timely filings, challan payments, and annual returns under applicable labor, wage, and tax laws.
F Support internal, statutory, and vendor audits by providing required documentation and reconciliations.
F Keep employee handbooks, workplace policies, and employment records aligned with current regulations.

Preferred candidate profile
I. MBA in HR with 10+ years in corporate HR, talent/org design, Payroll Operations & Compliance with proven hands-on M&A lifecycle experience.
II. Strong grasp of payroll accounting, labor laws, statutory deductions, and tax compliance.
III. Strong understanding of HR disciplines and their interdependencies, including compensation, benefits, HR operations, talent acquisition, talent management, employee relations, payroll, mobility, HR technology, and HR business partnering.
IV. Strong business and financial acumen to evaluate cost drivers, financial exposure, and workforce costs, and balance transaction objectives with employee experience, compliance, and operational readiness.
V. Deep understanding of the HR M&A lifecycle, including due diligence, pre-close planning, employee transition, integration, stabilization, and transition to steady-state operations.
VI. High attention to detail, strict confidentiality, deadline ownership, problem-solving, and clear stakeholder communication.
VII. Proficiency in HRMS/payroll software and advanced Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, data validation).

Description:
Requisition Id: 1747346 React Developer ( Remote )
Job Title: Senior React.js Front-End Developer
Location: Remote
Experience: 4 - 8 Years
Notice Period: Immediate Joiners
About the Role:
We are looking for a talented and experienced React.js Front-End Developer to join our dynamic web development team. You will be responsible for building high-quality, scalable, and performant web applications using React.js, working closely with cross-functional teams including UX/UI designers, backend developers, and product managers.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop, maintain, and enhance responsive web applications using React.js and related front-end technologies.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement pixel-perfect, user-friendly interfaces.
Optimize components for maximum performance across a wide range of devices and browsers.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices.
Integrate RESTful APIs and manage state using Redux or Context API.
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and continuous integration.
Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing applications as needed.
Mentor junior developers and help improve front-end development processes.
Required Skills Qualifications:
4 - 8 years of professional experience in front-end development using React.js .
Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 , and modern front-end build tools (Webpack, Babel, etc.).
Experience with state management libraries like Redux , Context API , or similar.
Familiarity with RESTful APIs, asynchronous programming, and handling API integrations.
Knowledge of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and accessibility standards.
Experience with version control tools such as Git .
Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team.
Good communication skills to coordinate with remote and on-site teams.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with TypeScript is a plus.
Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) or server-side rendering frameworks like Next.js.
Work Environment:
Hybrid working model with a combination of in-office (Mumbai/Bangalore) and remote work.
Collaborative and fast-paced environment focused on innovation and continuous learning.

Job Description: SAP HCM Payroll / SAP SuccessFactors ECP Consultant
Key Responsibilities
Payroll Configuration & Support
Configure and support SAP HCM Payroll and SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll (ECP).
Design, build, test, and deploy payroll solutions for India and US payroll requirements.
Configure payroll schemas, PCRs, wage types, payroll areas, periods, retro calculations, and off-cycle payroll.
Troubleshoot payroll issues and perform root cause analysis.
Implementation & Transformation
Participate in end-to-end implementation, rollout, migration, and support projects.
Lead payroll workshops and requirement gathering sessions.
Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with technical teams for developments.
Support payroll transformation initiatives from SAP ECC Payroll to ECP.
Compliance & Statutory Requirements
Manage statutory payroll compliance for India including:
Provident Fund (PF)
Employee State Insurance (ESI)
Professional Tax (PT)
Labour Welfare Fund (LWF)
Income Tax/TDS
Gratuity
Full & Final Settlement
Understanding of US payroll processes including taxation, earnings, deductions, garnishments, benefits, and regulatory compliance.
Integration & Interfaces
Work on inbound and outbound payroll interfaces.
Collaborate with third-party payroll vendors, ADP, benefit providers, banks, and statutory agencies.
Support integrations between:
SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central
Employee Central Payroll
SAP CPI/BTP Integration Suite
Time Management systems
Finance and Banking systems
Testing & Deployment
Prepare and execute:
Unit Testing
SIT
UAT
Parallel Payroll Testing
Payroll Reconciliation
Ensure successful payroll go-live and hypercare support.
Stakeholder Management
Engage with HR, Payroll, Finance, and Compliance teams.
Provide payroll process recommendations and best practices.
Mentor junior consultants and support knowledge transfer activities.
Required Qualifications
Education
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related discipline.
MBA/PGDM is an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 2-3 end-to-end SAP Payroll or ECP implementations.
Experience in global support and AMS engagement.
Strong exposure to India Payroll.
Exposure to US Payroll is highly preferred.
Mandatory Technical Skills
SAP HCM Payroll
Payroll Schemas
Personnel Calculation Rules (PCR)
Wage Types
Time Evaluation Integration
Retroactive Accounting
Off-Cycle Payroll
Payroll Control Center (Preferred)
SAP SuccessFactors
Employee Central Payroll (ECP)
Employee Central Integration
Compound Employee API
Replication Framework
Integration Knowledge
SAP CPI / SAP Integration Suite
IDocs
Web Services
Middleware Integrations
SFTP-Based Interfaces

Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.

Description:
CCNA CISCO Certification is mandatory. (Candidate must have claer the exam , training certified will not help.)

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a Network Implementation Engineer to perform the staging, configuration, migration, and cutover of enterprise and data center network environments. This role is responsible for turning Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and High-Level Designs (HLDs) into production reality across Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and security ecosystems. The ideal candidate has deep Cisco CLI expertise, hands-on experience executing maintenance windows, and familiarity with Cisco's controller-led architectures (Catalyst Center).
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst (9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500 Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE / NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.
The skills Required
Routing- Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge on MPLS will be a advantage.
Switching- Deep understanding on switching concept like STP, HSRP, VRRP, Portchannel, Switch Stacking, VTP.
Wireless- Hands on experience on cisco air OS and catalyst controllers (8500,5520,9800), Access point, RF fundamentals, WLAN fundamentals.
Experience & Certifications
Experience: 6 months of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize operational disruption.


Location Pune /Noida/Chennai/Bangalore
Shift – 24*7
Work Mode – Work from office
Looking for immediate joiners

Role & responsibilities :
Change Communications Consultant
Job Description
A Change Communications Consultant is responsible for developing and implementing communication strategies that support organizational change initiatives. During periods of change, this role helps keep stakeholders informed, engaged, and aligned with organizational goals, ensuring a smooth and successful transition.
Key Responsibilities
Collaborate with change management teams to understand the impact of change initiatives and develop communication strategies that reduce resistance and drive adoption.
Design and tailor communication approaches for different audiences, translating complex concepts into clear, engaging, and impactful messages.
Create and deliver communication materials to support change programs, including presentations, newsletters, email campaigns, and leadership communications.
Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of communication efforts, gathering stakeholder feedback and refining strategies as needed.
Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure communication activities are aligned across the organization.
Facilitate communication between leadership, project teams, and employees to maintain transparency and engagement.
Required Skills & Experience
Proven experience in developing and executing communication strategies for organizational change initiatives.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong project management and organizational capabilities.
Experience using communication and collaboration tools/platforms.
Exceptional stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
Ability to adapt and thrive in dynamic and evolving environments.
Strategic mindset combined with creative problem-solving skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
Experience with PTC Windchill and/or PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) systems.
Automotive industry experience or strong domain knowledge in the automotive sector.
Background in change management or organizational development initiatives.
Change Management certification such as Prosci or ACMP.
Familiarity with digital communication tools and employee engagement platforms.
Experience working in large, complex, and matrixed organizations.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

Description:
Role : Counterparty Onboarding Relationship Manager - Supply Chain Finance

Department: Supply Chain Finance Counter-party Team.

Location: Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Chennai, Chandigarh, Lucknow, and Hyderabad.


Role Summary

Own endtoend onboarding of vendors, dealers and other counterparties under anchorled Supply Chain Finance programs. Ensure fast, compliant onboarding, smooth activation and strong earlystage engagement to drive utilization and portfolio hygiene.

Key Responsibilities

Engage with vendors/dealers to explain SCF products, benefits and onboarding process.
Manage complete onboarding workflow: KYC, documentation, risk checks, approvals and limit setup.
Coordinate with Credit, Risk, Ops, Legal and Tech for frictionless onboarding and compliance.
Drive activation: ensure counterparties utilize limits and monitor your portfolio growth and quality.
Monitor counterparty-level ageing/overdue, flag early warning indicators, follow-up for payments, support Collections on early bucket resolution, and ensure anchor alignment on disputes.
Resolve operational issues, documentation gaps and onboarding bottlenecks.
Maintain MIS, funnel trackers and adherence to onboarding TATs.
Support Anchor Relationship Managers with utilization, reactivation and earlycycle portfolio hygiene.

Key KPIs

Counterparties onboarded
Onboarding TAT (Pre-sanction documentation Approval post-sanction documentation Golive)
Documentation quality / monitor deferrals.
Firstdrawdown % and utilization support

Candidate Profile

Experience: 4 to 10 years in SCF, Working Capital, Trade Finance, MSME lending or onboarding roles.
Skills: Strong communication, KYC/AML understanding, documentation accuracy, process discipline, Excel/CRM familiarity.
Traits: High ownership, speed, detailorientation, customer empathy.

Education
Graduate/MBA preferred.
Certifications in KYC/Compliance/SCF are advantageous.

Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect with over 10 years of experience in designing, architecting, and delivering enterprise-scale technology solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong domain knowledge, deep technical expertise, and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and resilient platform architectures.
This role will drive architecture strategy, technology modernization, platform governance, and solution design while collaborating with business stakeholders, engineering teams, product owners, and leadership.
Key Responsibilities
Solution Architecture & Design
Define end-to-end solution architecture for enterprise applications and platforms.
Translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable, and secure technical solutions.
Create architecture blueprints, design documents, integration patterns, and technical roadmaps.
Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards and technology strategy.
Platform Strategy & Governance
Drive platform architecture decisions and technology standardization.
Establish architectural principles, design patterns, and governance frameworks.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption strategies.
Lead platform modernization and digital transformation initiatives.
Domain & Business Leadership
Demonstrate strong understanding of business processes and industry domain.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand challenges and identify technology opportunities.
Act as a trusted advisor for business and technology leadership.
Ensure solutions effectively address business goals and customer needs.
Technical Leadership
Provide architectural guidance to development and engineering teams.
Conduct architecture reviews and ensure adherence to best practices.
Lead solution discussions across cross-functional teams.
Mentor senior engineers and technical leads.
Integration & Cloud Architecture
Design APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and integrations.

Human Development, Human Resources Management, Organizational Behavior Studies, Organizational Management, Sociology, Psychology

Description:
Job description
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Job summary

Job Description
Internal Audit (UK Territory)
Level: Senior Associate
Line of Service: Risk Advisory
Service Area: Internal Audit UK (C&G/ FS)
Location: Acceleration Centre (India), supporting UK onshore teams
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time

Role Overview (Clear Differentiation)
This role sits within UK Internal Audit and the Senior Associate will perform judgement-led Internal Audit work, including risk assessment, control design evaluation, audit issue formulation, and report drafting, aligned to UK Internal Audit standards and practices.
The role requires individuals who can think like internal auditors, not testers, with the ability to assess end-to-end processes, identify root causes, and articulate meaningful audit insights to UK stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
End-to-End Internal Audit Delivery
Deliver UK Internal Audit engagements across planning, fieldwork, and reporting phases, in line with PwC Internal Audit methodology.
Develop Risk and Control Matrices (RCMs), based on process walkthroughs and risk assessment.
Evaluate control design adequacy and operational effectiveness using professional judgement, not tick-box testing.
Perform targeted substantive testing where required to support audit conclusions.
Independently draft audit observations, issues, and root-cause analyses, clearly articulating:
What is wrong
Why it matters (risk and impact)
Why it occurred
What should be done to remediate
Draft high-quality Internal Audit reports suitable for senior management and Audit Committee consumption.
Ensure issues and recommendations are risk-focused, proportionate, and pragmatic, aligned to the clients UK regulatory environment.
Lead client walkthroughs and deep-dive process discussions, demonstrating strong understanding of end-to-end business processes, risks, and controls.
Act as a key offshore point of contact for UK engagement teams and clients, engaging confidently with stakeholders beyond evidence collection.
Challenge management appropriately and constructively where control weaknesses or design gaps are identified.
Quality, Standards & Methodology
Ensure audit documentation, RCMs, and reports comply with Internal Audit Standards (IIA) and PwC quality requirements.
Support or perform quality reviews of audit work, focusing on audit judgement, clarity of conclusions, and linkage between risks, controls, testing, and findings.
Other Responsibilities
Take ownership of allocated audit areas or workstreams, managing timelines and deliverables independently.
Review and coach junior team members, helping them move beyond testing to risk-based Internal Audit thinking.
Support UK Managers and Senior Managers in managing predominantly offshore or hybrid engagements.

Skills & Experience Required
4 to 8 years experience in Internal Audit (3rd line of defense), preferably supporting UK or similar mature IA environments.
Demonstrable experience in:
Risk assessment and RCM development (beyond testing)
Audit report and issue drafting
Leading client walkthroughs and audit discussions
Strong understanding of Internal Audit concepts, audit lifecycle, and risk-based assurance.
Prior experience in Financial Services (Banking or Insurance) preferred. (Only for FS Recruitment)

Qualifications
Bachelors or Masters degree in Commerce, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or equivalent.
CA / ACCA / CIA preferred.

Description:
SUMMARY
Account Manager ETS Operations

Summary
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to lead our Employee Transportation Services (ETS) operations across major Indian cities. In this pivotal role, you will serve as the primary liaison for key corporate clients, ensuring the delivery of exceptional transportation solutions. The ideal candidate will blend strategic account management with hands-on operational expertise to drive client satisfaction, foster long-term partnerships, and optimize service efficiency. This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of employee mobility for leading organizations while managing a diverse portfolio of accounts.

Responsibilities
Cultivate and maintain comprehensive relationships with corporate clients, serving as their dedicated point of contact for all matters.
Address daily operational requests, manage service escalations, and resolve account-specific inquiries promptly and effectively.
Develop robust client partnerships to maximize satisfaction rates and ensure high levels of account retention.
Collaborate closely with internal operations teams to guarantee seamless service execution and strict adherence to agreed-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Supervise end-to-end transportation logistics, including route optimization, staff rostering, vehicle allocation, and trip coordination.
Oversee the performance of fleet vendors, transport partners, and on-ground teams to uphold rigorous service quality standards.
Continuously monitor operational metrics to identify performance gaps and execute timely corrective measures.
Manage client performance reviews, generate detailed MIS reports, coordinate billing processes, and maintain accurate account documentation.
Proactively identify avenues for business expansion, account growth, and the enhancement of service delivery models.


Requirements
Possess a minimum of three years of relevant experience in Account Management, Client Relationship Management, Fleet Operations, or Transportation Services.
Demonstrate a proven track record of managing corporate clients and successfully handling high-value accounts.
Exhibit superior communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management abilities.
Show versatility in balancing client-facing duties with the practical execution of operational tasks.
Display strong analytical skills for problem-solving and effective management of complex escalations.
Maintain a solid understanding of fleet management principles, transportation logistics, and service delivery frameworks.
Be proficient in using MS Excel, creating MIS reports, and interpreting operational dashboards.
Possess excellent verbal and written communication capabilities.
Preferred Industry Background
Candidates with prior experience in the following sectors are highly encouraged to apply:
Food Delivery and Restaurant Account Management
Quick Commerce and E-commerce Key Account Management
IoT Solutions, including GPS Tracking and Dashcam Sales
Automobile Sales and Account Management
Real Estate Sales and Client Relationship Management
Fleet Management and Transportation Services

Job Title: Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-2/P4-1
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM / based on business requirements
Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist will provide operational visibility across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Hot Cut and related provisioning activities. The role will focus on data validation, identifying aging orders and operational risks, analyzing trends and ensuring the right issues are escalated to the right teams at the right time.
The role will work across provisioning teams, Operations, internal stakeholders and external carriers/vendors to drive issues through resolution.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor operational data across network provisioning activities.
Validate order, milestone and provisioning information for accuracy and completeness.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, recurring issues and delivery risks.
Analyze operational trends and highlight areas requiring attention.
Identify data discrepancies and work with the responsible team to correct them.
Determine which issues require escalation based on aging, customer impact, due date and operational risk.
Drive the right escalation to the right team at the right time.
Track escalated issues through closure rather than only raising the escalation.
Coordinate with Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations and other internal teams.
Coordinate with carriers/vendors regarding provisioning delays and unresolved dependencies.
Provide clear operational insights and status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
Support root-cause analysis for repeat issues.
Identify process gaps based on data and operational trends.
Recommend improvements to reduce aging, exceptions and repeated escalations.
Support reporting and dashboard automation to improve operational visibility.
Required Skills
Good understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Experience working with operational data, reports or dashboards.
Strong analytical and data-validation capability.
Ability to identify trends, exceptions and operational risks.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning/order escalations.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies and dependencies.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple teams and vendors.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Confidence to raise risks and communicate issues to stakeholders.
Strong ownership and follow-through.
Good to Have
Experience across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design or Network Provisioning.
Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience.
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom systems.
Advanced Excel skills including PivotTables, lookups and formulas.
Power BI/dashboard development experience.
SQL knowledge for validation and analysis.
Power Automate, VBA or Python experience.
Experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.

Description:
Location: Bangalore, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Thales India Engineering Competency Center in Bangalore is seeking a HW Test bench Lead- maintenance role.
In this role, you will manage Test Bench/ Automated Test Equipments maintenance and sustenance activities, which includes conducting scheduled maintenance procedure, inspecting, and troubleshooting test bench equipment.
These test benches primarily support various Thales defense applications and its products.

Essential skills:
Test Bench Hardware systems knowledge such as COTS Test and measurement instruments from different OEMs including NI Hardware including PXI systems, Industrial PC (PICMG SBC ) and VME systems.
5 +yrs Experience in handling various interface form factors such as PCI, PCIE, PCIe, CPCI, PXI, PXIe, VME etc.
Experience in Test Bench development or maintenance using COTS test measurement equipment, custom designed interface test adapters, PCBAs
Experience of testing avionics communication interfaces/buses such as MIL-STD-1553B, ARINC 429 , Serial RS 485 / 422, CAN etc is desirable.
Experience on interface cards such as Discrete IO, Analog, serial (RS232/422/482), synchro etc on various form factors listed above.
Problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
Experience in testing and knowledge of test equipment for measurement and control.
Hands on experience in handing various measuring tools such as Digital Oscilloscope, Function / wave generators up to 18GHz, Spectrum Analyzers, RF power meters etc.
Experience in analyzing / understanding electrical schematics, Cable Harness drawings and block diagrams.

Responsibilities:
As a maintenance engineer you will be responsible for undertaking periodic maintenance procedure and ensure the test system / bench are reliable.
Identify faults, efficiency and safety issues.
Respond to equipment breakdowns, provide first line diagnostic and arrange repairs or replacements.
Execute functional tests and validate the results against established standards
Perform quality inspections to ensure compliance with safety regulations.
Should work closely with multi discipline teams and organize to fix the issues.
Preparation of the associated report and log maintenance to keep track of tasks
Collaborative work applying quality standards and internal processes
Should be able to estimate and monitor costs of maintenance.

Job Description


Overview


Water Management Consultancy (WMC) is a key part of the Infrastructure division within AtkinsRalis' Water and Environment Business. Serving both UK and international clients, our projects span flood defence, hydraulic structures, ports, and maritime engineering. The WMC team brings together a diverse range of expertise, including river and coastal engineering, hydrology, hydraulics, dam engineering, hydraulic gates, and maritime engineering.
In this role, you'll be instrumental in delivering a variety of projects, with a particular emphasis on integrated water management. This includes hydrodynamic catchment modelling, sustainable drainage, water-sensitive urban design, river restoration, software development, research, and client and stakeholder engagement. This opportunity is ideal for those seeking technical challenges and looking to contribute to advanced, industry-leading projects.




Your role
Be highly motivated, proactive, and possess a "can-do" attitude.
Be skilled in collaborative working, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate strong organizational and time management abilities.
Be flexible and open to new challenges.
International experience.
Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards Chartership.

Description:
SQL DBA Azure
Pune / Bangalore / Noida:
5 Days – Work from Office
What does a successful SQL DBA – Azure do at Fiserv?
We are looking for a skilled SQL DBA with hands-on Azure experience to join our team and support the administration, performance, availability and security of critical database environments. In this role, you will manage SQL Server databases across on-premises and cloud environments, support production systems and help ensure reliable, scalable, and high-performing database operations.
A successful candidate brings strong SQL Server database administration experience, practical knowledge of Azure services and the ability to work across infrastructure, application, and development teams. This role is important to maintaining database stability, supporting cloud initiatives and driving operational excellence.
What you will do
Administer, monitor and maintain SQL Server database environments across development, test and production systems
Manage databases in Azure environments, including support for cloud-hosted database services and related platform operations
Perform database installation, configuration, upgrades, patching and migration activities across on-premises and Azure platforms
Monitor database health, performance, storage and availability and take proactive action to prevent issues
Perform backup, recovery, restoration and disaster recovery support for business-critical databases
Troubleshoot database issues and optimize performance through tuning, indexing, query analysis and configuration improvements
Support high availability and disaster recovery solutions for SQL Server environments
Ensure database security, user access management and compliance with operational and security standards
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, cloud and application support teams to resolve issues and support new initiatives
Automate routine database administration tasks where appropriate
Support production releases, environment readiness and operational transitions
Maintain technical documentation, standards, support procedures and runbooks
Participate in incident management, root cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts
What you will need to have
4 to 10 years of experience in SQL Server database administration
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server in production environments
Hands-on experience with Azure, including Azure SQL Database, Azure virtual machines or other Azure data services
Experience in database backup and recovery, performance tuning, security and monitoring
Strong knowledge of SQL Server installation, configuration, patching and upgrade processes
Experience supporting high availability and disaster recovery configurations
Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills
Experience working in cross-functional support and delivery environments
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, work and military experience
What would be great to have
Experience with Snowflake
Familiarity with Azure automation, scripting or infrastructure support
Experience with PowerShell or other scripting tools
Knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps or infrastructure-as-code practices
Experience in financial services, payments or other regulated environments
Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and alerting tools

Description:
MS Dynamics Developer/Consultant
Location: Pune, India
Experience: 4 to 10 years

What does a successful MS Dynamics Developer do at Fiserv?

In this role, you will design, develop and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions that help drive operational efficiency, improve user experience and support business growth. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, configure and customize solutions, and deliver scalable, high-quality applications that align with enterprise standards.
What you will do:
Design, develop, customize and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions based on business and technical requirements
Work with stakeholders to gather, analyze and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications
Configure and customize Dynamics modules, workflows, forms, dashboards and integrations
Develop plugins, custom workflows, reports and enhancements within the Microsoft Dynamics environment
Integrate MS Dynamics with other enterprise applications and third-party platforms
Support data migration, system upgrades, deployments and environment management activities
Troubleshoot application issues, identify root causes and provide timely resolution
Perform unit testing, system testing and support user acceptance testing
Create and maintain technical documentation, process documents and support materials
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, QA and business teams to deliver reliable solutions
Ensure solutions follow security, compliance and coding best practices
Provide ongoing production support and continuous improvement recommendations

What you will need to have:

4 to 10 years of overall IT experience
Hands-on experience working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Microsoft Dynamics CRM
Strong experience in customization, configuration and development within MS Dynamics
Create and manage copilot agents
Experience with C#, .NET, JavaScript, plugins, workflows and web services
Experience in integrating Dynamics with external systems using APIs or middleware
Good understanding of Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps
Experience with SQL Server and data migration activities
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology or related field

What would be great to have:
Experience with Dynamics 365 CE, CRM or ERP modules based on business need
Knowledge of Azure services and cloud-based integrations
Experience in DevOps, CI/CD pipelines and release management
Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards
Microsoft Dynamics certifications
Experience working in an enterprise environment with global teams
Understanding of Agile delivery methodologies

About Us
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company and a pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution. Paytm builds technologies that empower small businesses with payments and commerce solutions.
Our mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them into the mainstream economy through technology.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):

Ensure adherence to agreed turnaround times to meet productivity and quality benchmarks.

Demonstrate flexibility to work in rotational shifts.
Exhibit innovation and clarity in both written and verbal communication.

Job Title: Network Provisioning Lead
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P4-I
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM / based on business requirements
Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Lead will provide day-to-day operational leadership for telecom provisioning activities covering Order Entry, Circuit Design, ASR, and circuit implementation. The role will ensure workload is effectively managed, provisioning milestones are achieved, quality standards are maintained, and operational issues are resolved or escalated appropriately.
Key Responsibilities
Lead day-to-day activities across the assigned provisioning workstream.
Manage work allocation, priorities, aging orders and critical due dates.
Monitor productivity, quality, SLA/TAT and delivery performance.
Support team members with telecom, provisioning, process and tool-related questions.
Review complex provisioning issues and guide the team toward resolution.
Coordinate with Planning, Order Management, ASR, Design, Operations and other internal teams.
Work with carriers/vendors where support or follow-up is required.
Identify delivery risks and take appropriate action before committed dates are impacted.
Ensure process adherence, documentation and inventory updates are completed correctly.
Support knowledge transfer and readiness as activities transition to the India team.
Coach team members and identify skill or knowledge gaps.
Drive process improvement and automation opportunities across the workstream.
Provide regular operational updates to management and stakeholders.
Required Skills
Strong understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Working knowledge of Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design and/or network implementation.
Good understanding of telecom circuits, carrier provisioning and network operations.
Experience leading or coordinating an operational team.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making capability.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and critical deliverables.
Strong stakeholder/vendor coordination.
Good communication and confidence in leading operational discussions.
Positive attitude, ownership and adaptability.
Good to Have
Experience as a Team Lead, SME or senior provisioning engineer.
Exposure to Granite/XNG, carrier portals or telecom OSS/BSS systems.
Knowledge of SLA/TAT, aging and operational KPI management.
Excel, Power BI or dashboard/reporting experience.
Power Automate, VBA, Python or other automation experience.

Description:
Job Title: Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-2/P4-1
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM / based on business requirements
Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist will provide operational visibility across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Hot Cut and related provisioning activities. The role will focus on data validation, identifying aging orders and operational risks, analyzing trends and ensuring the right issues are escalated to the right teams at the right time.
The role will work across provisioning teams, Operations, internal stakeholders and external carriers/vendors to drive issues through resolution.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor operational data across network provisioning activities.
Validate order, milestone and provisioning information for accuracy and completeness.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, recurring issues and delivery risks.
Analyze operational trends and highlight areas requiring attention.
Identify data discrepancies and work with the responsible team to correct them.
Determine which issues require escalation based on aging, customer impact, due date and operational risk.
Drive the right escalation to the right team at the right time.
Track escalated issues through closure rather than only raising the escalation.
Coordinate with Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations and other internal teams.
Coordinate with carriers/vendors regarding provisioning delays and unresolved dependencies.
Provide clear operational insights and status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
Support root-cause analysis for repeat issues.
Identify process gaps based on data and operational trends.
Recommend improvements to reduce aging, exceptions and repeated escalations.
Support reporting and dashboard automation to improve operational visibility.
Required Skills
Good understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Experience working with operational data, reports or dashboards.
Strong analytical and data-validation capability.
Ability to identify trends, exceptions and operational risks.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning/order escalations.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies and dependencies.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple teams and vendors.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Confidence to raise risks and communicate issues to stakeholders.
Strong ownership and follow-through.
  Good to Have
Experience across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design or Network Provisioning.
Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience.
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom systems.
Advanced Excel skills including PivotTables, lookups and formulas.
 Power BI/dashboard development experience.
SQL knowledge for validation and analysis.
Power Automate, VBA or Python experience.
 Experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.

Description:
Job Title: Network Provisioning Lead
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P4-I
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM / based on business requirements
Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Lead will provide day-to-day operational leadership for telecom provisioning activities covering Order Entry, Circuit Design, ASR, and circuit implementation. The role will ensure workload is effectively managed, provisioning milestones are achieved, quality standards are maintained, and operational issues are resolved or escalated appropriately.
Key Responsibilities
Lead day-to-day activities across the assigned provisioning workstream.
 Manage work allocation, priorities, aging orders and critical due dates.
Monitor productivity, quality, SLA/TAT and delivery performance.
Support team members with telecom, provisioning, process and tool-related questions.
 Review complex provisioning issues and guide the team toward resolution.
Coordinate with Planning, Order Management, ASR, Design, Operations and other internal teams.
 Work with carriers/vendors where support or follow-up is required.
 Identify delivery risks and take appropriate action before committed dates are impacted.
Ensure process adherence, documentation and inventory updates are completed correctly.
Support knowledge transfer and readiness as activities transition to the India team.
Coach team members and identify skill or knowledge gaps.
Drive process improvement and automation opportunities across the workstream.
Provide regular operational updates to management and stakeholders.
  Required Skills
Strong understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Working knowledge of Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design and/or network implementation.
Good understanding of telecom circuits, carrier provisioning and network operations.
Experience leading or coordinating an operational team.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making capability.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and critical deliverables.
Strong stakeholder/vendor coordination.
Good communication and confidence in leading operational discussions.
Positive attitude, ownership and adaptability.
  Good to Have
Experience as a Team Lead, SME or senior provisioning engineer.
Exposure to Granite/XNG, carrier portals or telecom OSS/BSS systems.
Knowledge of SLA/TAT, aging and operational KPI management.
Excel, Power BI or dashboard/reporting experience.
Power Automate, VBA, Python or other automation experience.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Summary
Function SummarySales Manager - Tele Sales role at Axis Max Life Insurance focuses on driving virtual insurance sales through digital platforms. Key responsibilities include conducting virtual meetings, generating leads, and achieving sales targets. The role requires strong communication, relationship management, and customer service skills. Candidates with sales experience in insurance or financial services are preferred. We are seeking a proactive and customer-focused Virtual Field Sales Representative to join our insurance sales team. The ideal candidate will leverage technology to conduct virtual meetings and webinars, build relationships, and sell insurance products to potential clients. The role requires excellent communication skills, a self-driven attitude, and a passion for sales in the insurance industry.


Key Responsibilities
Conduct virtual meetings and product presentations to prospective clients via video calls, webinars, or online platforms.
Prospect and generate new leads through digital channels such as social media, emails, and online marketing campaigns.
Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of prospects through regular follow-ups and nurturing of relationships.
Provide personalized insurance advice and product recommendations based on customer needs. Achieve sales targets and KPIs by converting leads into policies.
Collaborate with team members and use CRM software to track and report sales activities and progress.
Stay updated on the latest insurance products, industry trends, and regulations to offer the best advice to clients.
Manage customer inquiries and concerns, providing excellent customer service throughout the sales process.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers to encourage repeat business and referrals.


Key Competencies / Skills
Handling Customer Complaints
Relationship
Leading people
Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to build rapport via virtual channels
Lead generation
Self-motivated
Organization
Ability to work independently and manage multiple virtual sales processes simultaneously
Knowledge of CRM systems and online sales tools


Qualifications Experience
Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred).
Proven experience in sales, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.

Job SummaryWe are seeking a proactive and customer-focused Virtual Field Sales Representative to join our insurance sales team. Handling Customer Complaints
Relationship, Leading people, Effective

Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to build rapport via virtual channels.
Self-motivated with a high level of professionalism and organization.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple virtual sales processes simultaneously.
Knowledge of CRM systems and online sales tools.
