Description:
Clinical Informatics Apprenticeship Job description About the role: We are seeking a highly motivated Clinical Informatics Apprenticeship to join our team, contributing to our efforts in transforming healthcare delivery through Value-Based Care (VBC) initiatives. The ideal candidate will have a strong clinical background, basic understanding of the U.S. healthcare system, and a passion for leveraging data to drive better health outcomes and cost efficiencies. We are looking for individuals who will thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and are keen to significantly grow their skills and knowledge in clinical data analysis, clinical coding, and risk analysis. Clinical Informatics Apprenticeship will work directly with our clinical data analysts, prior authorization and utilization management reviewers, qualified clinical informaticists, and data scientists. This role bridges clinical knowledge with analytics, clinical information exchange, supporting strategic decision-making and operational efficiency across our value-based care programs.
What We Offer:
A challenging and rewarding experience at the intersection of healthcare and technology.
Direct mentorship from experienced clinical informaticists, data scientists, and analysts.
Opportunity to make a tangible impact on Value-Based Care initiatives.
Exposure to cutting-edge tools and methodologies in clinical data analysis.
A collaborative and supportive team environment dedicated to professional growth.
A Day in the Life
Collaborate and Learn: Work alongside clinical data analysts to evaluate and assist in extracting meaningful insights from electronic clinical data.
Data Translation: Assist in the translation of non-standard electronic clinical data into standard clinical codes (e.g., ICD, CPT, SNOMED).
Clinical Review Support: Support reviews of prior authorizations and utilization management guidelines, offering insights from both provider and payer perspectives.
Communication Presentation: Prepare and present findings and recommendations to both clinical and non-clinical stakeholders, effectively translating complex data into actionable strategies.
Process Improvement: Identify and recommend innovative ideas, processes, and/or procedures for enhancements, additions, and modifications to improve existing workflows and processes.
Regulatory Awareness: Research and stay informed on key updates related to CMS, HCC, NCQA, HEDIS, and other regulatory frameworks relevant to VBC and CMMI programs.

What you Need:

Clinical Background: Clinician experienced in direct patient care or clinical experience in a U.S. healthcare setting.
Data Familiarity: Familiarity with data concepts; exposure to SQL, FHIR, or experience working with clinical or claims datasets.
Analytical Aptitude: Demonstrated ability to approach clinical and operational challenges with a data-driven mindset, translating them into data requirements and potential insights.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and clinical problem-solving skills.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex information clearly.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Assurance - Senior Associate
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity
We re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team s work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.
Ideally, you ll also have
Proficiency in MS - Excel, MS - Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will manage the daily operations of the front office and guest services teams, ensuring that all guests receive outstanding service. You will manage check-in and check-out processes, resolve guest concerns, and lead a team of front desk agents and guest service representatives to meet the hotel s service standards. As a Front Office Front Office Executive, you re not just managing daily front office operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Proven experience in a front office or guest service management role within the hospitality industry.
Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate staff.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a guest-centric approach.
Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail, with the ability to handle high-pressure situations.
Proficiency in hotel property management systems (PMS) and front office operations.
Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Oversee daily front office operations: Overseeing Front Office activities, including guest service, registration, room inventory, and adherence to policies and standards
Monitor and elevate service: Assist in tracking guest satisfaction, addressing service issues, and guiding the team to implement improvements that enhance the guest experience
Support revenue initiatives: Assist in promoting hotel services and executing up-selling tactics to drive room occupancy and revenue growth
Facilitate team knowledge: Provide regular updates and training to ensure the team is well-informed of hotel offerings, services, and local attractions
Delight our guests: Welcome guests, respond to inquiries, and resolve concerns promptly to uphold service standards
Oversee VIP guest experience: Review VIP reservations and ensure an elevated and seamless check-in and check-out experience
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support front office team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will oversee the daily operations of the front office and guest services teams, ensuring that all guests receive outstanding service. You will manage check-in and check-out processes, resolve guest concerns, and lead a team of front desk agents and guest service representatives to meet the hotel s service standards. As a Assistant Manager Front Desk, you re not just overseeing daily front office operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Proven experience in a front office or guest service management role within the hospitality industry.
Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate staff.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a guest-centric approach.
Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail, with the ability to handle high-pressure situations.
Proficiency in hotel property management systems (PMS) and front office operations.
Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Lead daily front office operations: Overseeing Front Office activities, including guest service, registration, room inventory, and adherence to policies and standards
Monitor and elevate service: Assist in tracking guest satisfaction, addressing service issues, and guiding the team to implement improvements that enhance the guest experience
Support revenue initiatives: Assist in promoting hotel services and executing up-selling tactics to drive room occupancy and revenue growth
Facilitate team knowledge: Provide regular updates and training to ensure the team is well-informed of hotel offerings, services, and local attractions
Delight our guests: Welcome guests, respond to inquiries, and resolve concerns promptly to uphold service standards
Oversee VIP guest experience: Review VIP reservations and ensure an elevated and seamless check-in and check-out experience
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support front office team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Job Description


Overview

Our team within the Canada Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.
We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecycle-from concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.
Atkins Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking a Civil 3D Designer to join our Water BIM team. This role will be based at our Bangalore Gurugram office, contributing to world-class projects by creating detailed 3D models, coordinating multidisciplinary designs, and ensuring compliance with international standards.



Your Role

Roles Responsibilities
Excellent in 3D Modelling of Pipe networks (Dry and Wet), Grading, Corridors, Cut and Fill using Civil 3D.
Excellent in Multidisciplinary 3D model coordination using Navisworks
Check model for Stage Completeness, Dimensional accuracy against modelling standards.
Ensure Level of Quality control for Completeness and adherence to company standards of all Drawings produced.
Stay informed the best practices methodologies in BIM implementation.
Able to perform and coordinate on multi-disciplinary projects and effective implementation of BEP and BIM workflows.
Ability to determine appropriate record/As-built, test pit, drawings and point cloud data.
Identify and solve drawing/ modelling problems and troubleshooting Civil 3D issues.
Identify new logical ideas for automation to improve efficiency.
In depth knowledge of engineering drawings and specifications. Ability to work using engineers' calculations and design in producing drawings / 3D modelling.
Ensures accuracy and adapts a detail-conscious approach; carefully checks details at each stage to avoid errors.
Ensure timely planning and delivery by proactively managing assumptions, dependencies, and risk.
Follow GTC BMS processes to projects
Use of Vehicle tracking
Software Skills
Autodesk Civil 3D
AutoCAD
Navisworks
MicroStation, ORD (Preferred )
ProjectWise / Forma
Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

Required Skills Competencies
Strong understanding of: Civil engineering drawings and construction methods
Ability to work with Survey data, point clouds
Good communication and coordination skills
Attention to detail and quality-focused approach
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision



About You

Qualifications Skills
Graduate Engineers (bachelor's degree) with 3 to 5 years or Diploma in Engineering with up to 7-10 years of relevant experience in the BIM domain or duly qualified having exceptional work experience track record.
Desirable Experience
Canada / UK infrastructure or consultancy project experience
Experience working within ISO 19650 BIM environment
Awareness of Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows



Rewards Benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Description:
Role MDM Architect
Locations – Pune | Bangalore | NCR | Hyderabad
Your Responsibilities includes, but not limited to:
Understand the technical landscape current as well as desired future state Assess the current state architecture & understand current business processes for managing Master Data Management solutions.
Assess the functional and non-functional requirements of desired future state MDM solution Prepare the to-be architecture including data ingestion, data quality rules, data model, match/merge, workflows, UI, batch integration and real-time services.
Extensive hands-on experience in installation and configuration of core Informatica MDM Hub components such as Hub console, Hub Store, Hub Server, Cleanse/Match Server and Cleanse Adaptor.
Ability to deliver full lifecycle MDM projects for clients including Data modeling, Metadata management, design and configuration of matching and merging rules, design and configuration of standardizing, cleansing and deduplication rules.
Create Design Document and data models addressing business needs for the client MDM environment - Contribute to creating reusable assets and accelerators for MDM platforms.
Will also be involved in integration/transfer of data across multiple systems, streamlining data processes and providing access to MDM data across the enterprise.
Make technology decisions related to the Client MDM environment & Interpret requirements and architect MDM solutions.
Provide subject matter expertise on data architecture and data integration implementations across various downstream system.
Coordinate with Project Managers and participate in project planning and recurring meetings.
Collaborate with other team members to review prototypes and develop iterative revisions.
Must have Skills:
12+ years of experience & should have hands on experience of working in MDM Projects and hands on experience in one or more MDM tools like Informatica or Reltio and has expertise in defining matching/ merging & survivor-ship rules.
Should have strong commercial knowledge of key business processes & compliance requirements within Pharma Industry across multiple master data domains like Physician & Product
Hands on experience in industry data quality tools like Informatica IDQ, IBM Data Quality.
Must be proficient reading and understanding data models and experience working with data and databases.
Strong technical experience in the areas of Master Data Management, Meta data management, Data Quality, Data Governance, Data Integration (ETL) and Data Security
Experience with (all stages of MDM SDLC) planning, designing, building, deploying and maintaining scalable, highly available, mission critical enterprise-wide applications for large enterprises
Should have experience in integrating MDM with Data Warehouses and Data Lakes
Excellent query writing skills with Working knowledge of Oracle, SQL server, and other major databases
Good knowledge of SOA/Real-time integration, Pub-Sub Model and Data Integration with Various CRM systems like Veeva, Siebel.
Expertise in engaging with business users to understand the business requirements and articulate the value proposition.
Should have experience working with 3rd Party Data Providers like IQVIA, SHS, Veeva etc
Solid experience in configuring 3rd Party Address standardization tools Like or Tools Similar to Address Doctor, Loqate
Provide subject matter expertise on data architecture and data integration implementations across various downstream systems
Possesses excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, innovative presentation skills
Experience with RFP/RFI and pre-sales
Education:
BE/B.Tech/MCA/BCA/BSC CS with 60%+
Why Axtria: -
Axtria (www.Axtria.com) is truly a New-Age Software Product Unicorn, a first of its kind in providing the cloud software and data analytics to the Life Sciences industry globally. We help Life Sciences companies transform the product commercialization journey to drive sales growth and improve healthcare outcomes for patients. We are acutely aware that our work impacts millions of patients and lead passionately to improve their lives.

Fractal is one of the most prominent providers of Artificial Intelligence to Fortune 500 companies.Fractals vision is to power every human decision in the enterprise, and bring AI, engineering, and design to help the worlds most admired companies.Fractal currently has 4000+ employees across 16 global locations, including the United States, UK, Ukraine, India, Singapore, and Australia.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Azure Lead Architect to join our consulting practice. In this leadership role, you will work with enterprise clients to design, build, and modernize cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure. You will be responsible for leading architecture engagements, defining cloud strategies, and guiding cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of Azure-based solutions for complex enterprise applications.
Define cloud architecture and roadmap in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
Assess client s current environment and make architecture recommendations for cloud adoption, migration, and optimization.
Own end-to-end solution architecture and act as a trusted advisor to client leadership.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, Data, and Application teams to align cloud solutions with enterprise strategy.
Mentor and guide development teams on best practices in cloud architecture.
Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and cost-benefit analysis.
Support pre-sales and proposal development including effort estimation, technical solutions, and client presentations.
Stay updated with the latest Azure offerings and industry trends.
Required Skills Qualifications
12+ years of experience in IT, with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Azure architecture and implementation.
Strong expertise in Azure services such as Azure App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps, ARM/Bicep/Terraform templates.
Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert) preferred.
Bachelors or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Prior experience in a client-facing consulting role.
Knowledge of other cloud platforms like AWS or GCP is a plus.
Why Join Us
Opportunity to work with top-tier clients across industries.
Exposure to cutting-edge cloud projects and digital transformation programs.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Learning and development opportunities with access to cloud certifications and trainings.

Description:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.
Cadence Design Systems is seeking Analog CAD engineers to support the growing analog design and custom layout team building IP using the Cadence design tools (Virtuoso, Pegasus, Quantus, etc. ) to build high speed interfaces used in chips found in cars, cell phones, data centers, etc.
You will get the opportunity to collaborate with circuit implementation experts to contribute to the development of exciting chips, work with the best-in-class EDA tools and interact with the Cadence engineers using developing those tools to improve those tools.
Analog CAD tasks
The Analog CAD team is a part of the Cadence Design IP development group responsible for supporting the design and layout teams as they design analog IP circuits. They support the design teams in the different steps of the design and layout flow: design capture, pre and post-layout simulation, optimization, layout, EM/IR analysis, thermal analysis, reliability, 2. 5D and 3D IC, etc.
We also collaborate with the best in class tools developed by Cadence to improve them and tailor them to our needs.
We also build tools to help increase the efficiency of the teams and the quality of the circuits. We collaborate with the teams to improve their flows and design methodologies.

Additional
BSEE, MSEE
Previous experience in Analog CAD support
Very good understanding of circuit design and layout design
Exposure to Cadence Virtuoso Layout and physical verification tools is a plus
Team player, driven, self-motivated, innovative and autonomous
Excellent communication, presentation and customer service skills
We re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can t.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Grwoth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Operational Management: Oversee order fulfillment, including inbound/outbound sorting, scanning, bagging, and loading. Ensure timely dispatches and adherence to Turnaround Time (TAT).
Team Supervision: Lead, train, and manage delivery executives, loaders, and warehouse associates. Handle shift allocations, attendance tracking, and roster management.

Issue Resolution: Handle on-ground escalations, address high-aging shipments, and investigate the root cause of shipment damages or delays.
Compliance: Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), safety guidelines, and company policies.

Preferred candidate profile
Experience: Typically requires a minimum of 1-3 years in logistics, supply chain, or delivery operations.
Skills: Strong team-handling capabilities, problem-solving skills, and basic proficiency in using logistics or warehouse software for reporting.
Education: A bachelor's degree is usually required, with a preference for degrees in Supply Chain Management or Logistics.

Description:
Position Summary
The ideal candidate must be well versed with Paint shop process and equipment.
Must be able to recognize the abnormalities in Conveyors, ASU-exhaust system, Rotary equipment like Pumps and blowers, Baking ovens (Direct & indirect type both), Electrified Monorail Hoists, Paint line circuits and related components.
Working exposure with robot maintenance is preferable.
Must have key expertise for basic Trouble shooting and fast restoration of system /equipment.
Must have knowledge about condition Based Monitoring (Vibration analysis and Thermography).
Should be able to handle shift operation independently by ensuring smooth & reliable operation of equipment. Personnel shall also be responsible for spares management i.e., keeping track of spares stock and raising requisitions timely to ensure timely availability of spares. Must be an expert with Microsoft Office applications and SAP- PM module.
Must have knowledge of annual budgeting cycle, defining scope of activities for Service requests, Creation of Purchase requisitions, chasing up with service purchase for creation of Purchase order.
Daily Job involves handling / manning of 15-20 blue collar employees and contractual service providers.

Key Responsibilities:
Carrying out PM activities as per schedule.
Trouble shooting & Breakdown Maintenance
Spares Management
Breakdown analysis, PSR and Corrective actions.
Implementing improvement projects.
Maintaining records and documentation related to IATF standard
Records and documentation for OHSMS (ISO 45001), EMS (ISO 14001)
Updating and monitoring assigned key deliverables i.e. MPs and CPs in TQM way
Daily Work Management as per defined Key Performance Indicators
Updating and monitoring assigned key deliverables i.e. MPs and CPs in TQM way
Records keeping related to contractual services
Creation of Service PRs and Machinery Spare PRs
Chasing up with service purchase for PO creations of services
Manpower and Job Planning for periodic shutdowns to carry out scheduled maintenance activities.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Experience
5-10 years of experience in Mechanical Maintenance
Preferred Industry
Automobile Industry preferably from Paint Shop

Description:
Job Title Relationship Associate
Location Branch Name (as per requirement)
Department Bancassurance
Function Bancassurance YBL - Sales
Reporting to Center Manager
Band 5


Job Summary
This role involves establishing and strengthening relationships with branch managers and staff to generate leads, the candidate will actively participate in branch activities. The incumbent will be responsible for closing sales and ensuring follow-up on issuance.
A key aspect of the role is to increase the bank s customer awareness about life insurance solutions and achieve targeted penetration of cross-sell within the branch s customer base. The candidate will effectively drive reward and recognition programs for bank staff and regularly train them on life insurance concepts and new product introductions.


Key Responsibilities
Establishing strengthening relationship with branch manager staff to gain leads from them.
Involvement in work site activities (putting up stalls and making presentations in corporate.
Closing sale and following up on issuance.
Increasing bank s customer awareness about Life Insurance solutions and achieve the targeted penetration on cross sell within the branch s customer base.
Drive effectively the Reward and recognition programs launched for the bank staff.
Train the bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.


Key skills required
Communication skills
Strategic thinking
Product Knowledge
Problem solving
Time management
Customer relationship management
Deal closing skills
Goal oriented
Customer centricity


Desired qualification and experience
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
6 months to 3 years of experience in sales
Good communication skills - English regional language (preferred)
Age group: 21-28 years
Preferably has own conveyance

Description:
Job Summary
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance Job Title: Assistant Relationship Manager - Broca. The Assistant Relationship Manager at Axis Max Life Insurance will be responsible for managing and nurturing client relationships to enhance customer satisfaction and retention. The primary focus will be to support the sales team in achieving targets by providing excellent service and aiding in plan implementation and customer inquiries. The role includes conducting client meetings, preparing reports, managing client data, and ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory guidelines. The Assistant Relationship Manager will also assist in onboarding new clients and will act as a point of contact for any support or queries from clients. This role presents an excellent opportunity to develop a career in relationship management within the insurance industry while contributing to the growth and success of Axis Max Life Insurance.


Responsibilities
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to promote customer loyalty and retention.
Support senior relationship managers in executing sales strategies and achieving targets.
Address client inquiries and provide timely and accurate information regarding insurance products and services.
Prepare and present reports on client feedback, sales performance, and market trends to enhance service offerings.
Assist in the onboarding process for new clients, ensuring a seamless transition and satisfaction.
Ensure adherence to regulatory standards and company policies during all client interactions.
Utilize CRM tools to manage client information and interactions, maintaining up-to-date records.


Skills and Tools Required
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with clients and team members.
Proficiency in CRM software to manage client relationships and data.
Analytical skills to assess client needs and market trends effectively.
Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment to achieve organizational goals.
Attention to detail and strong organizational skills to manage multiple client accounts.
Basic understanding of insurance products and financial principles is desirable.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for report generation and presentations.
Prior experience in customer service or sales, preferably in the insurance or financial sector, is a plus.
This role presents an excellent opportunity to develop a career in relationship management within the insurance industry while contributing to the growth and success of Axis Max Life Insurance.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Desired Skills

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
AboutCompany: Swiggy is an Indian online food ordering and delivery company. Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bangalore and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[4] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart, and same-day package deliveries with Swiggy Genie.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic, results-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations, including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.


Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.

Description:
Job Purpose


This position is open with Bajaj Finance ltd.
Engage with channel partners to build and strengthen relationship. Build distribution for Rural consumer Product Finance and distribution mapping for Rural consumer Product Finance.




Achieving exceeding Business goals and targets for Consumer Durables -Creating a strong compliant sales culture to drive acquisitions, profitability and employee development-Manage the Distribution through Dealer relations and servicing the Dealers, and their concerns in an appropriate manner.-Managing the Delinquency of the business sourced to ensure health of portfolio
-Effectively engage Operations Risk teams to understand and contribute to overall processes profitability across locations
-Identifying the need of sales training, analyzing changing market trends, channel deployment etc. Also giving feedback suggestions to the RSM/NSM -Ensure implementation of promotional plans contests and suggesting new and innovating promotion plan for the area of work.-Recruiting and Retaining high performers. -Ensuring highest levels of employee relationship, motivation engagement to drive results high levels of employee satisfaction.-Supporting collections team in ensuring 100% collections MAJOR CHALLENGES:
-struggling to find and keep talented employees. -Customer always seeking the latest technology, most efficient service, instant gratification, and a customized experience. -Retaining employees as they have banking sector as an option available.
-Online Market as well effected / impacted in filed. DECISIONS ; -Implement a sales management process that guides the teams decision on how to effectively manage this time and decide who to spend with. -Connect with field Teams Spending the Maximum time to Our Team. Link performance with rewards and recognition as par their achievement. -Design and Develop a Customer (Dealer and Business Partners) Visit frequency plan for their field. INTERACTIONS: Internal Clients:Roles you need to interact with inside the organization to enable success in your day to day work -Provide market and product related feedback to HO (Managers / Senior hierarchy )-Credit Team for high ticket approvals -Operation for customer services and file disbursement -Risk team for approval declined cases due to specific reasons e.g. policy-FCU Team for fraud cases validation -Collections for bucket cases and FEMI cases or problematic cases External Clients: Roles you need to interact with outside the organization to enable success in your day to day work:External Clients include dealer and business Partners. Identify New key dealer outlets New Business Partners to support sales External Clients include dealer and business Partners. Identify New key dealer outlets New Business Partners to support sales by Achieving Origination Targets. ASSC (Authorized Sales Service Center), Serving the existing external walk in customers at dealers and Increasing business opportunities.




a)Qualifications :
-Graduation / Post graduation
-Strong analytical skills to drive channel performance and drive profitability
-People Relationship Management skills
-Excellent Communication and Negotiation Skill
b)Work Experience:
-Graduation / Post graduation with 4 to 6 years and MBA with 3-4 years of relevant experience in sales
DIMENSIONS
(Key numerical data which will reflect the scope and scale of activities concerning this job)

Financial Dimensions
(These should be quantifiable numerical amounts)
As a manager, you''ll need to define Business scope. Defining what is needed is the first step. setting Business goals and allocating to Team. the Business scope should have a tangible objective for the organization
-In Festive seasons minimum 15k cases in a quarter
-Normal days minimum 9K cases in a quarter
-Cross sell targets 650 IPC to be maintained



Other Dimensions
(Significant volume dimensions associated with the job)
Total Team Size: 29
Number of Direct Reports: 6
Number of Indirect Reports: 23 (off role)
Number of Outsourced employees: 18 (ASCC)
Number of locations: in the range 5 to 7
Number of products: 2

Description:
Job Purpose


This position is open with Bajaj Finance ltd.





General Admin (Facility Management RM)
1. Control branch OPEX expenses within set budget.
2. Maintain regular Maintenance Hygiene of branches.
3. Timely closer on Issues including RM activity.
4. Timely Payment of branch expense bills.
5. Expense control of general expenses of branches.
6. Branch Feedback of employees seniors visiting branches.
7. Maintain proper data / records of all expenses of all locations managers supervised.
8.Monthly branch visits .
Infrastructure (NEW Projects under BASE)
1. Identification of new premises as per company requirement (Location rate).
2. Close on documentation legal clearance.
3. Having the civil work (as required) completed.
4. Installation of furniture fixtures.
5. Coordination with infra vendors.
6. Ensuring the branch is complete handed over to business well in TAT
Statutory Compliances
1. Ensuring the LOI is signed well within the TAT. (within 5 working days from receiving the legal clearance stability
2. Ensuring the lease agreement is signed well within the TAT. (within 10 working days from signing the LOI
3. Ensuring the lease agreement is registered well within the TAT. (within 20 working days of receiving the approval from H.O)
4.the shops establishments application is applied the certificate is received well within the TAT. (within 10 days of branch completion)
5.security related equipments are up to date under AMC renewals are done prior to expiry of contract.
6. Renewals of all Lease agreements AMC contract done prior to the expiry date.
7. Ensuring all statutory documents / certificates are displayed at the common area (reception) in line to compliance.





1. Graduate in any discipline with experience of working in Administration preferred
2. Inclination to have knowledge/ exposure on legal/ compliance matters.
3. Exposure in handling govt. / legal Issues
4. Team management interpersonal Skills
5. Good on negotiations and Vendor development Management
6. Well versed with MS Word, Excel, Power Point
7. Willing to Travel

Description:
Manager - Operations
About the company
Treebo Hospitality Ventures (THV) is a hotel group operating with a mission of "democratizing the joy of travel". We focus on the affordable segments of the market economy to mid-market to cater to the next
100 million travellers who will experience the joy of travel over the next 10 years. We offer these guests a high-quality experience at an affordable price point, with a portfolio of 800+ hotels across 120+ cities.
We operate through multiple brands catering to different sub-segments:
Itsy (10001500)
Treebo and Treebo Premium (15003000)
Medalio, our newly launched affordable luxury brand (3000–6000 per night)
We are the most loved hotel chain in the affordable segment, with an average rating of 7.8/10 across independent review platforms — and we are just getting started

About the Role
As an Area General Manager, you will be responsible for executing the company’s strategic vision of democratizing the joy of travel. You will be responsible for a given area and the portfolio there in to ensure highest levels of guest experience, product quality and business & profitability of the assets. While managing the operations and enabling sales for your portfolio, you will also drive the expansion of our hotel portfolio
across your area and beyond through your network. This is a mission critical role that requires a perfect balance of delivering operational excellence, relationship management, and a business development mindset.
Key Responsibilities -
1) Operational Excellence
Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple hotel properties in your area, ensuring adherence to brand standards and service benchmarks
Drive compliance with Treebo's brand standards and SOPs, health and safety guidelines, and service quality norms
Conduct audits, quality assurance checks, and drive corrective/preventive actions through hotel partners to maintain Treebo standards
Act as the key liaison between the company and hotel partners, ensuring seamless coordination and timely issue resolution
Monitor and enhance overall guest satisfaction by ensuring prompt and effective service recovery mechanisms
2) Business Development & Growth
Identify, evaluate, and onboard new hotel properties to expand the company’s portfolio within the assigned area
Negotiate terms of the agreement and ensure complete alignment with Treebo's operating procedures before onboarding any hotel
Collaborate with the central business development team to oversee launch process of the signed properties
3) Sales & MICE
Drive regional sales performance by collaborating with internal sales teams and property owners to achieve revenue targets for your portfolio
Identify and push sales POCs to close MICE deals for your portfolio properties
Support pricing, promotions, and campaigns to drive business at the property level
Engage with local corporate clients, event organizers, and travel planners to push business to your portfolio if needed
4) Team & Partner Management
Lead, mentor, and develop on-ground portfolio hotel teams to deliver exceptional guest experience in the segment
Train hotel staff in brand values, SOPs, and customer service skills to ensure consistency
Build strong relationships with hotel owners and partners to foster collaboration and long-term association
What Are We Looking For -
Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
4–6 years of experience in hospitality management with demonstrated success in both operations and business development.
Proven experience in property acquisition and/or sales in hospitality.
Knowledge and experience in the MICE segment is highly desirable.
Analytical mindset with problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned geography.
Entrepreneurial approach with a strong focus on execution and accountability
CompanyAddress: Building H210, HustleHub Tch Park, 27th Main road, Sector 2, HSR layout, Vanganahalli Bengaluru Urban, Karnataka, 560102, BANGALORE, Karnataka, India

Description:
Job Summary
Important: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.
The Assistant will provide operational and technical IT support to approximately field staff across districts, ensuring the availability, functionality, security, and effective use of IT equipment and digital tools required for programme implementation. The position will serve as the first point of contact for field-level IT issues, providing timely troubleshooting, coordinating repairs and replacements, supporting new employee onboarding, supporting procurements and maintaining accurate records of IT assets. The role will also facilitate coordination between district teams and the Country Office/State IT/Admin function to ensure consistent IT service delivery across geographically dispersed locations. Regular inter-district travel will be required, with frequency determined by support requests and field requirements.
Responsibilities
Field-Level IT Support and Troubleshooting
Provide first-level technical support to field staff for laptop, desktop, printer, scanner, and other IT-related issues.
Diagnose and resolve common hardware, software, operating system, and application-related problems.
Support staff with email configuration, account access, password resets, software installation, system updates, and basic device configuration, subject to access permissions.
Troubleshoot internet connectivity, Wi-Fi, mobile hotspots, and network-related issues at district offices and field locations.
Provide remote support wherever feasible and undertake field visits for issues that cannot be resolved remotely.
Escalate complex technical issues to the designated IT team at Country Office or authorized service provider, as the case may be, and track them through resolution.
IT Equipment Deployment and Employee Onboarding
Configure and deploy laptops and other IT equipment for new joiners and replacement requirements.
Coordinate with HR, Administration, and district teams to ensure timely IT readiness before employees join.
Support device allocation, user account setup, installation of approved applications, and access to required systems.
Facilitate the collection, reconfiguration, and reassignment of IT equipment during employee transfers, exits, or role changes.
Ensure that devices are configured in accordance with organizational IT standards and security requirements.
IT Asset Management and Inventory Control
Maintain an updated inventory of IT assets across all districts, including laptops, desktops, printers, accessories, and other assigned equipment.
Record asset allocation, serial numbers, asset tags, user details, location, warranty status, and movement history.
Conduct periodic physical verification of IT assets in coordination with the relevant district and state teams.
Track damaged, non-functional, obsolete, lost, or unutilized equipment and recommend appropriate action.
Monitor equipment under repair, warranty claims, and replacement requirements.
Ensure timely collection and return of IT assets during employee separation and maintain supporting documentation.
Update the designated asset management system or tracker and report discrepancies for resolution.
Internet Connectivity and Field Infrastructure
Assess internet connectivity requirements at district offices and other designated programme locations.
Troubleshoot connectivity issues affecting access to programme systems, virtual meetings, email, and online reporting tools.
Coordinate with internet service providers and authorized vendors for installation, maintenance, and fault resolution.
Maintain records of connectivity-related complaints, downtime, recurring issues, and resolution timelines.
Identify locations with recurring connectivity challenges and recommend practical solutions, such as alternative connectivity options, where approved.
Support the basic setup and troubleshooting of routers, Wi-Fi devices, and other approved networking equipment.
Software, Applications, and Digital Tools
Assist field staff in installing, configuring, and using organization-approved software and programme-related digital tools.
Support basic troubleshooting of productivity applications, video-conferencing tools, browsers, printers, and document-sharing platforms.
Assist staff in accessing organizational systems and applications, coordinating with the relevant system administrator where required.
Support the rollout of software updates, security patches, and approved IT tools.
Help field staff understand basic IT procedures and the appropriate use of organizational devices and systems.
IT Security and Data Protection
Ensure that organizational IT equipment is used in accordance with approved IT guidelines.
Support implementation of device security requirements, including antivirus protection, system updates, screen locks, and approved security configurations.
Guide staff on password security, phishing awareness, safe internet use, and secure handling of organizational information.
Immediately report suspected malware, unauthorized access, lost or stolen devices, and potential data breaches to the designated IT/security team.
Support secure device handover, data backup where authorised, and device sanitisation or wiping in accordance with approved procedures.
Ensure that confidential data is not transferred, accessed, or shared through unauthorized applications or storage devices.
IT Support for Programme Activities and Meetings
Provide technical support for virtual meetings, online trainings, workshops, and programme review meetings.
Assist with the setup and troubleshooting of audio-visual equipment, projectors, displays, webcams, microphones, and speakers where available.
Support connectivity and device readiness for field-level digital data collection, online assessments, reporting, and other programme activities.
Help district teams prepare equipment and test connectivity before important programme events.
Provide on-site IT support for designated programme activities when required.
IT Helpdesk, Reporting, and Service Monitoring
Maintain a centralized log of IT requests, complaints, and incidents received from the nine districts.
Categorise issues by urgency, impact, and type, and priorities critical issues affecting programme delivery.
Track issue resolution, pending requests, vendor interventions, and recurring technical problems.
Provide periodic reports on IT support requests, resolution timelines, equipment downtime, asset status, and recurring challenges.
Maintain a district-wise tracker of IT assets, equipment under repair, connectivity issues, and pending requirements.
Identify recurring issues and recommend preventive measures to reduce service interruptions.

Role & responsibilities:

Support pre-analytical error management through timely review, documentation, and coordination for RCA and CAPA closures.
Track CC & PUP-level error trends and highlight deviations for corrective action.
Conduct internal audits of assigned partners as per defined schedules using a predefined checklist.
Prepare audit reports, document NC closures, conduct follow-ups, and escalate issues wherever required.
Monitor key pre-analytical KPIs such as sample rejection, leakage, mismatch, low volume, temperature compliance, etc.
Coordinate with interdepartmental teams to ensure compliance with sample collection, labelling, packaging, storage, and transport SOPs.
Assist in error-based training, retraining, and refresher sessions for CC & PUP personnel.
Identify and suggest ways to reduce errors and improve workflows related to pre-analytical processes.
Handle onboarding of personnel at CC & PUP.
Manage PA complaints in coordination with regional teams.

Knowledge of CRM/LIS workflows, barcode systems, and sample life cycle management.
Basic understanding of audit processes, documentation, RCA, and CAPA.
Ability to analyse error logs and KPIs with basic proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, charts) or similar tools.
Strong attention to detail and ability to identify deviations or process gaps. • Good communication, coordination, and report documentation skills.
Ability to work with CC & PUP teams and ensure compliance with SOPs.
Basic understanding of NABL portal and processe

Education Qualification:

Description:
World Change Starts with Educated Children
Important: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.
Position Overview: The Project Lead, State Project Management Unit (SPMU-QE) in partnership with Jharkhand Education Project Council (JEPC), will oversee the design and implementation of Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) initiatives for primary-grade students across Jharkhand, covering content and curriculum, teacher training, research and insights, governance and communication, and district implementation. The position is based in JEPC campus, supported by a team of 8-10 Room to Read India staff and will involve working directly with JEPC and JECRT officials, partner organizations and education stakeholders to achieve Room to Read objectives and NIPUN Mission goals in alignment with state education department quality education. Reporting to the National Lead-SPMU with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the State Lead, Jharkhand. The base location will be Ranchi, Jharkhand.
Responsibilities
Government Liaison and Strategic Partnerships
Establish and maintain strong working relationships with key state-level stakeholders including the Department of Education SSA (Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan), SCERT (State Council of Educational Research and Training), and WCD (Women and Child Development).
Represent Room to Read and SPMU-QE at state- and district-level government meetings and events.
Advocate Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) priorities and objectives with senior officials and align project activities with government policies and frameworks.
Serve as the primary representative of the State Project Management Unit (SPMU) to external partners including donors, NGOs, private sector, CBOs, and civil society organizations.
Oversight of Project Implementation
Develop strong understanding on NEP 2020, FLN Mission, State FLN guidelines, and other national and state level education policies and guidelines.
Provide strategic direction and overall leadership for the planning, execution, and monitoring of FLN interventions across the state.
Ensure alignment of SPMU activities with government FLN objectives and donor commitments.
Coordinate closely with Room to Read India country office departments for administrative and technical support.
Lead project governance mechanisms and provide guidance for state, district, and block-level implementation.
Lead and support additional activities and responsibilities that get added periodically during the duration of the project.
Program Management, Monitoring Reporting
Oversee the development and execution of Annual Work Plans and ensure timely achievement of milestones and deliverables.
Lead the design and implementation of monitoring, evaluation, and learning systems to track progress and inform decision-making.
Ensure timely preparation and submission of high-quality programmatic and financial reports to Room to Read India Country Office and state government officials.
Facilitate regular project reviews, technical working group meetings, and learning exchanges to drive continuous improvement.
Maintain data quality standards and promote evidence-based reporting.
Manage budget, procurement and payments strictly as per organization policies, processes and compliances.
Advocacy and Knowledge Dissemination
Lead advocacy efforts to build awareness and drive policy engagement on FLN goals and strategies.
Organize and participate in events, presentations, and dissemination activities to share program progress, innovations, and best practices.
Develop strategic communication materials and ensure consistent messaging with all stakeholders.
Build and maintain formal and informal communication channels with government and non-governmental partners.
Lead project campaigns and events at state, district and block level.
Team Leadership and Capacity Building
Lead and manage the SPMU team, including setting goals, performance evaluation, and professional development.
Supervise and mentor the SPMU team, fostering a high-performing, collaborative work culture. Ensure that all SPMU staff have appropriate individual operational plans linked to project priority and annual work plans. Complete all performance management activities including performance planning, monitoring, and annual performance appraisals.
Promote and ensure organization s core values, policies and procedures.
Cultivate a learning-focused team culture that values accountability, innovation, and shared ownership of results.
Qualifications
Required
Master's degree in Education, Public Policy, Social Sciences, or related field.
Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in large-scale education programs, preferably with government or NGO partnerships.
Demonstrated experience in leading multi-disciplinary teams and complex program operations.

Job Summary
Important: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.
Position Overview: The Project Lead, State Project Management Unit (SPMU-QE) in partnership with Jharkhand Education Project Council (JEPC), will oversee the design and implementation of Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) initiatives for primary-grade students across Jharkhand, covering content and curriculum, teacher training, research and insights, governance and communication, and district implementation. The position is based in JEPC campus, supported by a team of 8-10 Room to Read India staff and will involve working directly with JEPC and JECRT officials, partner organizations and education stakeholders to achieve Room to Read objectives and NIPUN Mission goals in alignment with state education department quality education. Reporting to the National Lead-SPMU with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the State Lead, Jharkhand. The base location is Ranchi.
Responsibilities
Government Liaison and Strategic Partnerships
Establish and maintain strong working relationships with key state-level stakeholders including the Department of Education SSA (Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan), SCERT (State Council of Educational Research and Training), and WCD (Women and Child Development).
Represent Room to Read and SPMU-QE at state- and district-level government meetings and events.
Advocate Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) priorities and objectives with senior officials and align project activities with government policies and frameworks.
Serve as the primary representative of the State Project Management Unit (SPMU) to external partners including donors, NGOs, private sector, CBOs, and civil society organizations.
Oversight of Project Implementation
Develop strong understanding on NEP 2020, FLN Mission, State FLN guidelines, and other national and state level education policies and guidelines.
Provide strategic direction and overall leadership for the planning, execution, and monitoring of FLN interventions across the state.
Ensure alignment of SPMU activities with government FLN objectives and donor commitments.
Coordinate closely with Room to Read India country office departments for administrative and technical support.
Lead project governance mechanisms and provide guidance for state, district, and block-level implementation.
Lead and support additional activities and responsibilities that get added periodically during the duration of the project.
Program Management, Monitoring Reporting
Oversee the development and execution of Annual Work Plans and ensure timely achievement of milestones and deliverables.
Lead the design and implementation of monitoring, evaluation, and learning systems to track progress and inform decision-making.
Ensure timely preparation and submission of high-quality programmatic and financial reports to Room to Read India Country Office and state government officials.
Facilitate regular project reviews, technical working group meetings, and learning exchanges to drive continuous improvement.
Maintain data quality standards and promote evidence-based reporting.
Manage budget, procurement and payments strictly as per organization policies, processes and compliances.
Advocacy and Knowledge Dissemination
Lead advocacy efforts to build awareness and drive policy engagement on FLN goals and strategies.
Organize and participate in events, presentations, and dissemination activities to share program progress, innovations, and best practices.
Develop strategic communication materials and ensure consistent messaging with all stakeholders.
Build and maintain formal and informal communication channels with government and non-governmental partners.
Lead project campaigns and events at state, district and block level.
Team Leadership and Capacity Building
Lead and manage the SPMU team, including setting goals, performance evaluation, and professional development.
Supervise and mentor the SPMU team, fostering a high-performing, collaborative work culture.
Ensure that all SPMU staff have appropriate individual operational plans linked to project priority and annual work plans.
Complete all performance management activities including performance planning, monitoring, and annual performance appraisals.
Promote and ensure the organization's core values, policies and procedures.
Cultivate a learning-focused team culture that values accountability, innovation, and shared ownership of results.
Qualifications
Master's degree in Education, Public Policy, Social Sciences, or related field.
Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in large-scale education programs, preferably with government or NGO partnerships.
Demonstrated experience in leading multi-disciplinary teams and complex program operations.
Proven ability to work with government bodies and influence policy and practice in the education sector.
Strong project management, analytical, and communication skills.
Familiarity with FLN Mission, National Initiative for Proficiency in Reading with Understanding and Numeracy (NIPUN) Bharat, and state education systems.
Proficiency in English and Hindi; knowledge of local languages will be an advantage.

Description:
*Role: Business Development / Expansion Role – OYO (Field Profile)*
*What is this role about?*
This role is about **expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets*
You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.
This is a *field-based role* and requires regular travel.
*What will you do in this role?*
• Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
• Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
• Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
• Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
• Negotiate commercials and close property signings
• Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
• Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
• Review agreements and service levels with property owners
• Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams
*How is your performance measured?*
• Number of sellable rooms signed every month
• Number of rooms made live and available for booking
• Gross margin generated from signed properties
*Education:*
• Graduation mandatory
• MBA preferred
**Experience & Skills:**
• 1–5 years of relevant experience
• Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
• Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
• Analytical and data-driven mindset
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
• Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
• Good Excel skills and professional email writing
*Stakeholders you will work with:*
*Internal:*
• Business Development Head
• Hub Head
• Central Team
• Operations Team
• Transformation Team
• Legal Team
*External:*
• Property Owners
• Real Estate Brokers
*In simple words:*
Your role is to *find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable*.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Contractor Training & Competency Governance
Develop, implement, and continuously improve contractor safety training and competency management systems across the organization.
Ensure alignment of contractor competency requirements with organizational safety standards and regulatory requirements.
Training Management
Design and oversee contractor safety induction programs to ensure completion before deployment at worksites.
Develop and coordinate specialized safety training programs for high-risk activities, including :
Work at Height
Excavation Safety
Scaffolding Safety
Confined Space Entry
Lifting & Rigging Operations
Electrical Isolation and Electrical Safety
Other areas as identified in future
Drive adoption of innovative and technology-enabled learning methodologies.
Competency Assessment & Verification
Establish structured competency assessment and certification processes for contractor personnel.
Implement periodic refresher training and competency revalidation programs.
Conduct effectiveness verification through field observations, assessments, audits, and workplace interactions.
Ensure only trained and competent contractor personnel are deployed for critical activities.
Monitoring & Compliance
Maintain contractor training databases and refresher schedules.
Track compliance against training requirements and competency standards.
Support safety audits, inspections, and compliance reviews related to contractor workforce management.
Develop dashboards and reports for senior leadership on contractor training and competency performance.
Incident Learning & Continuous Improvement
Analyse incidents, near misses, audit findings, safety observations, and compliance gaps to identify training needs.
Drive continual improvement in contractor safety awareness and capability development programs.

Desired candidate function
He /She should be Managing Safety Training and/ or Skill upgradation functions

Description:
Dear Candidate,

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Site Engineer to manage waterproofing, retrofit, repairs application projects across. The candidate will be responsible for site execution, billing, coordination with applicator manpower, and client interaction to ensure timely and quality project completion.

Please go through the Job Profile. Interested candidate are required to share their profile at shraddha.bhosle@jsw.in

Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Execution & Supervision
Supervise waterproofing application works at site.
Ensure work is executed as per technical specifications and quality standards.
Conduct site inspections and resolve technical issues.
Maintain daily progress reports.
2. Billing & Documentation
Prepare client RA bills and subcontractor/applicator bills.
Measure work quantities and maintain proper billing records.
Coordinate with accounts for timely submission and approvals.
Maintain material reconciliation statements.
3. Manpower Coordination
Coordinate with applicator teams and subcontractors.
Ensure availability of required manpower and materials.
Monitor productivity and discipline at site.
Provide technical guidance to applicators.
4. Client Coordination
Act as the primary point of contact at site.
Attend client meetings and provide project updates.
Handle site-related queries and ensure client satisfaction.
Coordinate for approvals, inspections, and certifications.
5. Planning & Material Management
Plan daily and weekly work schedules.
Ensure proper storage and usage of waterproofing materials.
Monitor material consumption and reduce wastage.
Preferred Candidate Profile:
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
25 years of experience in waterproofing or construction site execution.
Good knowledge of waterproofing systems (PU coating, APP membrane, injection grouting, etc.).
Strong billing and measurement skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and billing software.
