Job Summary
The Assistant will provide operational and technical IT support to approximately field staff across districts, ensuring the availability, functionality, security, and effective use of IT equipment and digital tools required for programme implementation. The position will serve as the first point of contact for field-level IT issues, providing timely troubleshooting, coordinating repairs and replacements, supporting new employee onboarding, supporting procurements and maintaining accurate records of IT assets. The role will also facilitate coordination between district teams and the Country Office/State IT/Admin function to ensure consistent IT service delivery across geographically dispersed locations. Regular inter-district travel will be required, with frequency determined by support requests and field requirements. The base location will be Palamu/Hazaribagh.
Responsibilities
Field-Level IT Support and Troubleshooting
Provide first-level technical support to field staff for laptop, desktop, printer, scanner, and other IT-related issues.
Diagnose and resolve common hardware, software, operating system, and application-related problems.
Support staff with email configuration, account access, password resets, software installation, system updates, and basic device configuration, subject to access permissions.
Troubleshoot internet connectivity, Wi-Fi, mobile hotspots, and network-related issues at district offices and field locations.
Provide remote support wherever feasible and undertake field visits for issues that cannot be resolved remotely.
Escalate complex technical issues to the designated IT team at Country Office or authorized service provider, as the case may be, and track them through resolution.
IT Equipment Deployment and Employee Onboarding
Configure and deploy laptops and other IT equipment for new joiners and replacement requirements.
Coordinate with HR, Administration, and district teams to ensure timely IT readiness before employees join.
Support device allocation, user account setup, installation of approved applications, and access to required systems.
Facilitate the collection, reconfiguration, and reassignment of IT equipment during employee transfers, exits, or role changes.
Ensure that devices are configured in accordance with organizational IT standards and security requirements.
IT Asset Management and Inventory Control
Maintain an updated inventory of IT assets across all districts, including laptops, desktops, printers, accessories, and other assigned equipment.
Record asset allocation, serial numbers, asset tags, user details, location, warranty status, and movement history.
Conduct periodic physical verification of IT assets in coordination with the relevant district and state teams.
Track damaged, non-functional, obsolete, lost, or unutilized equipment and recommend appropriate action.
Monitor equipment under repair, warranty claims, and replacement requirements.
Ensure timely collection and return of IT assets during employee separation and maintain supporting documentation.
Update the designated asset management system or tracker and report discrepancies for resolution.
Internet Connectivity and Field Infrastructure
Assess internet connectivity requirements at district offices and other designated programme locations.
Troubleshoot connectivity issues affecting access to programme systems, virtual meetings, email, and online reporting tools.
Coordinate with internet service providers and authorized vendors for installation, maintenance, and fault resolution.
Maintain records of connectivity-related complaints, downtime, recurring issues, and resolution timelines.
Identify locations with recurring connectivity challenges and recommend practical solutions, such as alternative connectivity options, where approved.
Support the basic setup and troubleshooting of routers, Wi-Fi devices, and other approved networking equipment.
Software, Applications, and Digital Tools
Assist field staff in installing, configuring, and using organization-approved software and programme-related digital tools.
Support basic troubleshooting of productivity applications, video-conferencing tools, browsers, printers, and document-sharing platforms.
Assist staff in accessing organizational systems and applications, coordinating with the relevant system administrator where required.
Support the rollout of software updates, security patches, and approved IT tools.
Help field staff understand basic IT procedures and the appropriate use of organizational devices and systems.
IT Security and Data Protection
Ensure that organizational IT equipment is used in accordance with approved IT guidelines.
Support implementation of device security requirements, including antivirus protection, system updates, screen locks, and approved security configurations.
Guide staff on password security, phishing awareness, safe internet use, and secure handling of organizational information.
Immediately report suspected malware, unauthorized access, lost or stolen devices, and potential data breaches to the designated IT/security team.
Support secure device handover, data backup where authorised, and device sanitisation or wiping in accordance with approved procedures.
Ensure that confidential data is not transferred, accessed, or shared through unauthorized applications or storage devices.
IT Support for Programme Activities and Meetings
Provide technical support for virtual meetings, online trainings, workshops, and programme review meetings.
Assist with the setup and troubleshooting of audio-visual equipment, projectors, displays, webcams, microphones, and speakers where available.
Support connectivity and device readiness for field-level digital data collection, online assessments, reporting, and other programme activities.
Help district teams prepare equipment and test connectivity before important programme events.
Provide on-site IT support for designated programme activities when required.
IT Helpdesk, Reporting, and Service Monitoring
Maintain a centralized log of IT requests, complaints, and incidents received from the nine districts.
Categorise issues by urgency, impact, and type, and priorities critical issues affecting programme delivery.
Track issue resolution, pending requests, vendor interventions, and recurring technical problems.
Provide periodic reports on IT support requests, resolution timelines, equipment downtime, asset status, and recurring challenges.
Maintain a district-wise tracker of IT assets, equipment under repair, connectivity issues, and pending requirements.
Identify recurring issues and recommend preventive measures to reduce service interruptions.

Description:
SUMMARY
Network Expert
Summary
Our organization is looking for a seasoned Network Expert possessing deep proficiency in IBM Cloud to design and deploy resilient Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) architectures. This critical position focuses on the strategic implementation of subnets, routing configurations, and security firewalls. The successful candidate will bring advanced knowledge of core networking principles, including Transit Gateways, TCP/IP protocols, DNS administration, BGP dynamic routing, prefix filtering, Site-to-Site IPSec VPNs, VPC routing tables, and load balancing mechanisms. Furthermore, the role demands strong operating system administration skills to guarantee uninterrupted network functionality.

Location: Jamshedpur

Experience: 10-15 years
Responsibilities
Architect and establish intricate VPC ecosystems, encompassing subnet structures and routing protocols.
Set up and oversee firewall configurations to fortify network boundaries.
Continuously track network performance metrics to detect bottlenecks and enhance throughput efficiency.
Troubleshoot and resolve connectivity challenges across diverse environments, including multiple VPCs, on-premises data centers, Power Virtual Server (PowerVS) instances, and third-party cloud platforms.
Ensure system reliability by effectively managing the underlying operating systems.

Requirements
Documented expertise in TCP/IP and BGP routing protocols.
Proven track record of working specifically with IBM Cloud solutions.
A minimum of 10 to 15 years of professional experience within the field of network engineering.
Extensive technical understanding of Transit Gateways, DNS services, prefix filtering, and Site-to-Site IPSec VPNs.
Skill in administering VPC routing tables and executing load balancing strategies.
Proficiency in performing essential operating system administration duties.

Linux Administrator

Summary

In this vital position, the ideal candidate will design and oversee local and network storage solutions, with a specialized emphasis on Logical Volume Manager (LVM) setups. Manage and maintain the Linux server environment within the IBM Cloud ecosystem.
Architect and administer storage frameworks, focusing on the deployment and optimization of Logical Volume Manager (LVM) systems.
Formulate and carry out strong backup procedures while establishing routine snapshot scheduling.
Continuously track system performance, with a focus on optimizing CPU usage, memory allocation, and disk I/O scheduler efficiency.
Adjust operating system kernel parameters, including sysctl settings, to improve overall system stability and data throughput.

Documented professional history as a Linux Administrator.
Proven proficiency in working with IBM Cloud infrastructure.
A career background of 5 to 10 years in system administration positions.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Title: Project Manager - YouthRise
Education: B.Sc in Rural Development Science, B.A - Bachelor of Arts in Development Studies, Rural Development / Rural Studies, Social Work, Social Sciences (General), Bachelor of Social Work in Any Specialization
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Project Management, Program ManagementStakeholder Management, About company, ChildFund India works towards ensuring that children from the most marginalized sections of the society become able, confident, and responsible adults.
Description:
Role & responsibilities
The Project Manager will be overall lead for the project titled YouthRise currently being implemented in Khunti and West Singhbhum districts of Jharkhand. The incumbent will be responsible for end-to-end project planning, implementation and monitoring across 100 target villages of the project. This includes program planning, execution, team management, engagement with the government line departments, local partners management, budget oversight and management, and reporting including donor reporting. The role requires a hands-on leader who can manage a field-based team, build strong relationships with government line departments, provide technical support to local implementing partners and ensure the project delivers quality outcomes for children, youth and communities in the target districts within the project timelines and approved budget. The Project Manager is also responsible for ensuring technical guidance and support to the project from different thematic specialists at National Office in Delhi/Bangalore.
Be accountable for accomplishing the project milestones, enhance relationship and networking with other stakeholders such as government departments, technical agencies, local partners, local authorities, elected representatives, peoples organizations, local communities, etc.
Develop annual, quarterly and monthly work plans, budgets, and targets in line with the overall project design and donor commitments.
Ensure smooth implementation of the project activities as per approved plan, meeting the compliance requirements.
Manage the project budget responsibly, ensuring adherence to ChildFund India's financial policies and donor guidelines.
Coordinate timely technical guidance and support from different Thematic Specialists particularly Child Protection, Youth Skilling / Livelihoods and Education to the project to ensure quality inputs to the project and its outcomes
Build and maintain strong working relationships with the District Education Department, Child Protection Unit, State/District Livelihoods Mission and leverage their support for successful implementation project activities.
Represent the organization in appropriate external forums particularly at government line department level.
Prepare periodic and qualitative reports with inputs from technical team and finance team for submission to the donor on quarterly and annual basis.
Conduct periodic monitoring visits to the project to review activity implementation and address gaps through requisite support.
Managing the team and provide them necessary technical and operational guidance and support including capacity building/specific trainings.
Establish monitoring and tracking frameworks and coordinate with the MEL and Research team to undertake project related assessments baseline, midline and endline to generate project evidence as well as establishing uninterrupted flow of project data and information on a regular basis.
Coordinate with Communication Team for producing project impact stories, video documentation, case stories, etc. to capture project impact and its submission to the donor.
Conduct monthly, quarterly and annual reviews with the project staff and report on the progress with feedback for further improvement on a regular basis.
Provide required feedback to the project team with corrective measures and technical support on a regular basis.
Support in identifying consultants & technical / resource agencies for specific technical assignments planned under the project.
Submit timely and quality narrative and financial reporting to the Specialist, State Program and Partnership and/or Regional Lead Program & Partnerships as well as other stakeholders as required.
Undertake monitoring visits to local partners to observe activity implementation, review the project progress including budget monitoring and technical guidance.
Lead local partner capacity assessments, draw capacity building plans and ensure its implementation with technical support from both internal and external experts.
Be the focal point for all partner related communications, reporting and government engagement to implement project activities.
Ensure partners submit timely quality program and financial reports and its submission with technical review.
Ensure child safeguarding and child protection standards are upheld across all project activities and community engagements.
Identify risks, challenges, and opportunities in implementation and proactively flag these to management with recommended solutions.

Perform any other responsibilities as assigned by the reporting manager relevant to the program's goals.

Preferred candidate profile
Education: Bachelors degree in social work, Education, Development Studies, Management, or a related field.

Work Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in NGO sector, of
which minimum of 3 to 5 years experience in management and leading specific project/program.

Language Proficiency: Strong communication skills (both verbal and written) in Hindi & English. Jharkhand local languages will be an asset.
Skills and Abilities: Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and comfort with basic data and reporting tools. Willingness to travel extensively within Khunti and West Singhbhum districts and undertake frequent field visits to program locations to interact with children, youth, women and communities as well as local partners. Excellent presentation, public speaking and interpersonal skills. Self-driven, result oriented and experience of managing teams. Be gender sensitive with strong conviction and skills for the empowerment of excluded and disadvantaged children.
Job Knowledge: Self-driven, result oriented and experience of managing teams. Strong experience in building networks and developing relations with stakeholders both government and non-government at district and state level. Demonstrated experience in capacity building of staff and partners including training, mentoring and leadership. Knowledge of participatory community development approaches. Previous experience of designing and implementing Child Protection and/or Livelihoods projects would be an asset. Prior experience of working with government line departments and leveraging resources for the benefit of program participants would be advantageous. Sound understanding of budget management and donor reporting requirements.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Salary starts at INR 925,000/- per annum plus benefits, with scope for consideration for adjustment in line with the experience, skills, and knowledge the selected candidate brings.
Benefits (subject to the provisions of the approved Employee Manual):
Provident Fund and Gratuity as per Indian Labour Law
Annual Merit-based Performance Salary increase.
Health Insurance Coverage - to support the well-being of employees and their families.
Leave and Holiday framework that supports rest, renewal, and personal priorities Annual Leave (24 days), Casual Leave (10 days), Sick Leave (10 days), Special Leave (5 days), Maternity Leave (26 weeks), Paternity Leave (2 weeks), Exam Leave (5 days), Holidays (15 days)
Hybrid and flexible work schedule options for eligible roles to enable effective offsite working while staying connected and productive.
Learning and Development opportunities to support growth and build future-ready capabilities.
AboutCompany:
ChildFund India works towards ensuring that children from the most marginalized sections of the society become able, confident, and responsible adults.

Our work brings health, education, child protection, youth skilling, livelihoods, and climate resilience into an integrated approach that responds to childrens changing needs as they grow — from early childhood through adolescence and into young adulthood.

ChildFund India's core values are the principles and beliefs that guide behaviour, decision-making, and culture. Our values of Connection, Honesty, Innovation, Learning, and Diverse Lived Experiences reflect our highest aspirations for how we go about our work every day in the communities we serve and with each other.

Job Description (JD)
Consultant / Assistant Manager Internal Audit
Location: Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Chennai & Bangalore
Function: Governance, Risk and Compliance Services (GRCS) Department: Risk Consulting
Role Overview
Consultant / Assistant Manager Internal Audit will be responsible for managing and executing internal audit, risk consulting and process improvement engagements across multiple industries. The role involves leading project teams, managing client relationships, ensuring quality deliverables, supporting business development activities and contributing to the growth of the GRCS practice
Key Responsibilities
A. Internal Audit & Risk Advisory
Lead risk-based internal audits, process audits and risk consulting engagements.
Conduct Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and risk assessments.
Evaluate business processes, identify operational risks and assess internal controls.
Perform SOX 404, Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and regulatory compliance reviews.
Identify control gaps and recommend process improvements and risk mitigation measures.
Execute control self-assessments, revenue assurance and continuous monitoring activities.
B. Project Management & Execution
Manage multiple internal audit and risk consulting projects simultaneously.
Lead project teams and oversee project planning, execution and delivery.
Ensure project quality, profitability and adherence to timelines and budgets.
Report project progress and key risks to the Director / Partner.
Act as the primary client contact throughout project execution.
C. Client & Stakeholder Management
Manage client relationships and understand business requirements.
Conduct stakeholder discussions and management presentations.
Communicate audit findings, control gaps and recommendations.
Support clients in implementing corrective actions and process improvements.
D. Team Management & Leadership
Supervise, coach and mentor junior team members.
Review team deliverables and ensure quality standards.
Conduct training and support team capability development.
Manage team performance and promote effective collaboration.
E. Business Development & Practice Growth
Identify business opportunities and contribute to lead generation and deal closure.
Support proposals, pre-sales activities and RFP responses.
Identify cross-selling opportunities across KPMG service lines.
Contribute to revenue growth and client relationship development.
F. Thought Leadership
Contribute to developing new solutions and service offerings.
Participate in knowledge management and practice development initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, regulatory developments and emerging risks.
3. Key Service Offerings
Risk-Based Internal Audit
Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and Risk Assessment
Business Process Consulting
SOX 404 and Internal Financial Controls (IFC)
Regulatory and Contractual Compliance
Corporate Governance Advisory
Revenue Assurance and Control Self-Assessment
Continuous Auditing / Monitoring
Accounting Manuals Development
Capital Projects Audits
Project-Focused Control Assessment
Setting Up Internal Audit Functions
4. Educational Qualifications
- MBA / Chartered Accountant (CA)
Preferred Certifications:
CIA Certified Internal Auditor
CISA Certified Information Systems Auditor
CPA Certified Public Accountant
CMA Certified Management Accountant
ACCA Association of Chartered Certified Accountants

Description:
Position Summary

The IT Assistant will provide operational and technical IT support to approximately field staff across districts, ensuring the availability, functionality, security, and effective use of IT equipment and digital tools required for program implementation.

The position will serve as the first point of contact for field-level IT issues, providing timely troubleshooting, coordinating repairs and replacements, supporting new employee onboarding, supporting procurements and maintaining accurate records of IT assets. The role will also facilitate coordination between district teams and the Country Office/State IT/Admin function to ensure consistent IT service delivery across geographically dispersed locations.

Travel: Regular inter-district travel will be required, with frequency determined by support requests and field requirements.

2. Key Roles and Responsibilities

A. Field-Level IT Support and Troubleshooting

Provide first-level technical support to field staff for laptop, desktop, printer, scanner, and other IT-related issues.
Diagnose and resolve common hardware, software, operating system, and application-related problems.
Support staff with email configuration, account access, password resets, software installation, system updates, and basic device configuration, subject to access permissions.
Troubleshoot internet connectivity, Wi-Fi, mobile hotspots, and network-related issues at district offices and field locations.
Provide remote support wherever feasible and undertake field visits for issues that cannot be resolved remotely.
Escalate complex technical issues to the designated IT team at Country Office or authorised service provider, as the case may be, and track them through resolution.

B. IT Equipment Deployment and Employee Onboarding

Configure and deploy laptops and other IT equipment for new joiners and replacement requirements.
Coordinate with HR, Administration, and district teams to ensure timely IT readiness before employees join.
Support device allocation, user account setup, installation of approved applications, and access to required systems.
Facilitate the collection, reconfiguration, and reassignment of IT equipment during employee transfers, exits, or role changes.
Ensure that devices are configured in accordance with organisational IT standards and security requirements.

C. IT Asset Management and Inventory Control

Maintain an updated inventory of IT assets across all districts, including laptops, desktops, printers, accessories, and other assigned equipment.
Record asset allocation, serial numbers, asset tags, user details, location, warranty status, and movement history.
Conduct periodic physical verification of IT assets in coordination with the relevant district and state teams.
Track damaged, non-functional, obsolete, lost, or unutilised equipment and recommend appropriate action.
Monitor equipment under repair, warranty claims, and replacement requirements.
Ensure timely collection and return of IT assets during employee separation and maintain supporting documentation.
Update the designated asset management system or tracker and report discrepancies for resolution.

D. Internet Connectivity and Field Infrastructure

Assess internet connectivity requirements at district offices and other designated programme locations.
Troubleshoot connectivity issues affecting access to programme systems, virtual meetings, email, and online reporting tools.
Coordinate with internet service providers and authorised vendors for installation, maintenance, and fault resolution.
Maintain records of connectivity-related complaints, downtime, recurring issues, and resolution timelines.
Identify locations with recurring connectivity challenges and recommend practical solutions, such as alternative connectivity options, where approved.
Support the basic setup and troubleshooting of routers, Wi-Fi devices, and other approved networking equipment.

E. Software, Applications, and Digital Tools

Assist field staff in installing, configuring, and using organisation-approved software and programme-related digital tools.
Support basic troubleshooting of productivity applications, video-conferencing tools, browsers, printers, and document-sharing platforms.
Assist staff in accessing organisational systems and applications, coordinating with the relevant system administrator where required.
Support the rollout of software updates, security patches, and approved IT tools.
Help field staff understand basic IT procedures and the appropriate use of organisational devices and systems.

F. IT Security and Data Protection

Ensure that organisational IT equipment is used in accordance with approved IT guidelines.
Support implementation of device security requirements, including antivirus protection, system updates, screen locks, and approved security configurations.
Guide staff on password security, phishing awareness, safe internet use, and secure handling of organisational information.
Immediately report suspected malware, unauthorised access, lost or stolen devices, and potential data breaches to the designated IT/security team.
Support secure device handover, data backup where authorised, and device sanitisation or wiping in accordance with approved procedures.
Ensure that confidential data is not transferred, accessed, or shared through unauthorised applications or storage devices.

G. IT Support for Programme Activities and Meetings

Provide technical support for virtual meetings, online trainings, workshops, and programme review meetings.
Assist with the setup and troubleshooting of audio-visual equipment, projectors, displays, webcams, microphones, and speakers where available.
Support connectivity and device readiness for field-level digital data collection, online assessments, reporting, and other programme activities.
Help district teams prepare equipment and test connectivity before important programme events.
Provide on-site IT support for designated programme activities when required.

H. IT Helpdesk, Reporting, and Service Monitoring

Maintain a centralised log of IT requests, complaints, and incidents received from the nine districts.
Categorise issues by urgency, impact, and type, and prioritise critical issues affecting programme delivery.
Track issue resolution, pending requests, vendor interventions, and recurring technical problems.
Provide periodic reports on IT support requests, resolution timelines, equipment downtime, asset status, and recurring challenges.
Maintain a district-wise tracker of IT assets, equipment under repair, connectivity issues, and pending requirements.
Identify recurring issues and recommend preventive measures to reduce service interruptions.

I. Staff Orientation and Basic IT Capacity Building

Conduct basic orientation sessions for new and existing staff on the appropriate use of laptops, email, approved applications, and IT security practices.
Develop or share simple user guides and troubleshooting instructions for frequently reported issues.
Help staff adopt standard procedures for raising IT requests and reporting technical incidents.
Identify common IT skill gaps among field staff and recommend targeted support or refresher sessions.

4. Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Applications, or a related discipline.
Approximately 23 years of relevant experience in IT support, desktop support, helpdesk operations, or field-level IT service delivery.
Experience providing technical support across multiple offices or geographically dispersed locations would be an advantage.
Practical knowledge of laptop and desktop troubleshooting, Windows operating systems, printers, basic networking, Wi-Fi, and internet connectivity.
Familiarity with Microsoft 365 or similar productivity applications, email systems, video-conferencing tools, and basic endpoint security.
Experience maintaining IT asset registers, service request trackers, and equipment repair records.
Ability to communicate technical information in simple language to non-technical users.

5. Core Competencies

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills - a responsive approach to staff support.
Ability to prioritise requests and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Strong documentation and record-keeping skills.
Ability to work independently across multiple districts.
Willingness to travel regularly to district offices and field locations.
Commitment to confidentiality, data protection, and organisational IT policies.

International Customer Support Executive Voice | Chat | Email

Company: Teleperformance
Job Role: International Customer Support Executive
Job Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan
Work Mode: Work From Office
Process: International Voice / Chat / Email
Hiring: Freshers & Experienced Candidates
Working Days: 5 Days Working
Shifts: Rotational Shifts
Week Offs: Rotational Week Offs
Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY
Looking for an exciting career opportunity in the International BPO industry? Teleperformance is hiring enthusiastic and customer-focused candidates for International Customer Support operations.
We are inviting applications from candidates across PAN India who are interested in working in Jaipur. Whether you are a fresher looking to start your professional journey or an experienced candidate looking for career growth, this is an excellent opportunity to develop your skills and work with international customers.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES
Handle international customer queries through Voice, Chat and Email support channels, depending on the assigned process.
Assist customers with service-related queries, complaints, account concerns and general support requirements.
Manage inbound customer calls professionally and provide accurate information and effective resolutions.
Respond to customer queries through live chat and email while maintaining professional communication.
Ensure excellent customer experience through active listening, empathy and a customer-centric approach.
Handle customer complaints, escalations and follow-ups within defined turnaround times.
Maintain customer records, update internal systems and follow process guidelines.
Demonstrate strong problem-solving, multitasking and customer-handling skills.
Maintain quality standards and contribute towards customer satisfaction and customer delight.

PREFERRED CANDIDATE PROFILE
Excellent English communication skills are mandatory.
Freshers with strong English communication skills can apply.
Undergraduate candidates with a minimum of 6 months of documented BPO / Customer Support experience can apply.
Graduates and postgraduates from any stream are eligible.
Candidates with International BPO, Voice Process, Chat Support, Email Support and Customer Service experience will be preferred.
Basic computer knowledge and good typing skills.
Strong interpersonal skills, problem-solving abilities and a customer-focused attitude.
Comfortable working in rotational shifts and rotational week-offs.
Must be willing to relocate to Jaipur and work from the office.

EXCITING RELOCATION BENEFITS & FACILITIES
710 Days Complimentary Hotel Accommodation for eligible outstation candidates.
10,000 Relocation Bonus as per company policy.
Travel Ticket Assistance for eligible candidates relocating to Jaipur.
Free Cab Facility as per process and shift eligibility.
Five Days Working.
Professional training and development opportunities.
Career growth opportunities in Quality Analyst, SME, Team Leader and Operations roles, subject to performance and eligibility.
Applicable employee benefits and performance-based incentives as per company policy.

PAN-INDIA HIRING – JAIPUR LOCATION
Candidates from all over India are welcome to apply!
We are sourcing candidates from Delhi NCR, Gurgaon, Noida, Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Surat, Jaipur, Jodhpur, Udaipur, Kota, Ajmer, Lucknow, Kanpur, Indore, Bhopal, Chandigarh, Ludhiana, Dehradun, Patna, Ranchi, Kolkata, Bhubaneswar, Guwahati, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kochi and other cities across India.

Important: Candidates must be willing to relocate to Jaipur. This is a Work From Office opportunity.
APPLY NOW!
An excellent opportunity to begin or advance your career in the International Customer Support industry with Teleperformance.

Description:
Job Purpose
"This position is open with Bajaj Finance ltd." Duties and Responsibilities
General Admin (Facility Management RM)
1. Control branch OPEX expenses within set budget.
2. Maintain regular Maintenance Hygiene of branches.
3. Timely closer on Issues including RM activity.
4. Timely Payment of branch expense bills.
5. Expense control of general expenses of branches.
6. Branch Feedback of employees seniors visiting branches.
7. Maintain proper data / records of all expenses of all locations managers supervised.
8.Monthly branch visits .
Infrastructure (NEW Projects under BASE)
1. Identification of new premises as per company requirement (Location rate).
2. Close on documentation legal clearance.
3. Having the civil work (as required) completed.
4. Installation of furniture fixtures.
5. Coordination with infra vendors.
6. Ensuring the branch is complete handed over to business well in TAT
Statutory Compliances
1. Ensuring the LOI is signed well within the TAT. (within 5 working days from receiving the legal clearance stability
2. Ensuring the lease agreement is signed well within the TAT. (within 10 working days from signing the LOI
3. Ensuring the lease agreement is registered well within the TAT. (within 20 working days of receiving the approval from H.O)
4.the shops establishments application is applied the certificate is received well within the TAT. (within 10 days of branch completion)
5.security related equipment's are up to date under AMC renewals are done prior to expiry of contract.
6. Renewals of all Lease agreements AMC contract done prior to the expiry date.

Hiring for an Area Sales Manger at TATA CLASSEDGE LIMITED

Greetings from Tata ClassEdge!!!

We are looking for an experienced Area Sales Manager to join our team! As an Area Sales Manager, you will be responsible for developing sales programs that maximize sales from the assigned accounts to the target accounts, overseeing and conducting market research to develop and implement sales initiatives, developing and implementing sales strategies and product knowledge.
Key responsibilities:
* Develop and implement effective sales strategies to ensure consistent achievement of sales target.
* Build and maintain strong relationship with key clients.
* Provide accurate sales forecast and reports to senior management on a regular basis.
* Stay up to date with industry trends and market conditions to identify new business opportunities and potential risk.
* Coordinate with other departments to ensure smooth execution of sales orders.
* Ambitious, driven, and passionate about digital education

About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits ETC
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep IE while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Office Support Career Stream
Office Support Career Stream: Individual contributors who provide organizational related support or service (administrative or clerical) for other members within the organization. The majority of time is spent in the delivery of support services or activities, typically under supervision.


Differentiating Factors
Autonomy: Entry-level position typically requiring little to no prior experience. Works on well-defined administrative and clerical tasks. Work is routine or follows standard procedures and is closely supervised.
Organizational Impact: Works to deliver on day-to-day objectives with some impact on achievement of results for the job area, including limited disruption or expense. Delivers job responsibilities following a defined standard output or set of procedures.
Innovation and Complexity: Provides data and information when minor changes may be required based on review. Problems faced are routine and solutions clearly prescribed.
Communication and Influence: Communicates with contacts typically within immediate job area. Obtains and provides information requiring little explanation or interpretation.
Leadership and Talent Management: N/A - Job at this level are focused on self-development.


Required Knowledge and Experience
Requires no or little job knowledge of systems and procedures. 0 years of experience required.

Description:
Dear Candidate,

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Site Engineer to manage waterproofing, retrofit, repairs application projects across. The candidate will be responsible for site execution, billing, coordination with applicator manpower, and client interaction to ensure timely and quality project completion.

Please go through the Job Profile. Interested candidate are required to share their profile at shraddha.bhosle@jsw.in

Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Execution & Supervision
Supervise waterproofing application works at site.
Ensure work is executed as per technical specifications and quality standards.
Conduct site inspections and resolve technical issues.
Maintain daily progress reports.
2. Billing & Documentation
Prepare client RA bills and subcontractor/applicator bills.
Measure work quantities and maintain proper billing records.
Coordinate with accounts for timely submission and approvals.
Maintain material reconciliation statements.
3. Manpower Coordination
Coordinate with applicator teams and subcontractors.
Ensure availability of required manpower and materials.
Monitor productivity and discipline at site.
Provide technical guidance to applicators.
4. Client Coordination
Act as the primary point of contact at site.
Attend client meetings and provide project updates.
Handle site-related queries and ensure client satisfaction.
Coordinate for approvals, inspections, and certifications.
5. Planning & Material Management
Plan daily and weekly work schedules.
Ensure proper storage and usage of waterproofing materials.
Monitor material consumption and reduce wastage.
Preferred Candidate Profile:
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
25 years of experience in waterproofing or construction site execution.
Good knowledge of waterproofing systems (PU coating, APP membrane, injection grouting, etc.).
Strong billing and measurement skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and billing software.

Job Description:
Lead a team of engineers responsible for enterprise software engineering platforms and AI-enabled development capabilities.
Serve as the technical lead for GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, GitHub Copilot, and related engineering systems.
Design, implement, and support enterprise-scale engineering platforms supporting 8,000+ developers and 50,000+ repositories.
Drive adoption of AI-assisted software development tools and engineering workflows.
Architect and develop automation solutions utilizing AI technologies, APIs, and platform engineering principles.
Lead enterprise modernization and migration initiatives across software delivery platforms.
Establish technical standards, governance models, and best practices for software engineering and AI-enabled development.
Develop reusable automation frameworks, templates, and self-service engineering capabilities.
Partner with engineering, security, and architecture teams to improve software delivery performance and developer productivity.
Implement and maintain DevSecOps and software supply chain security controls.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and define enterprise adoption strategies.
Define platform health, adoption, productivity, and AI utilization metrics.
Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across the software engineering organization.
Develop technical roadmaps supporting long-term engineering and AI transformation objectives.
Required Skills:
AI & Engineering Systems: Generative AI Technologies, GitHub Copilot Enterprise, AI-Assisted Software Development, Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Agentic Development Workflows, AI Automation Solutions
Software Engineering Platforms: GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, CI/CD Platforms, Developer Experience (DevEx), Platform Engineering, Software Delivery Automation
Development & Automation: Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, Git, Workflow Automation, Infrastructure as Code
DevSecOps & Security: Software Supply Chain Security, DevSecOps Practices, Code Scanning, Secret Scanning, Dependency Management, Security Policy Automation
Cloud & Infrastructure: Azure (Preferred), Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud-Native Architectures
Preferred Qualifications:
8+ years of software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or developer productivity experience.
Experience leading technical teams and enterprise-scale engineering initiatives.
Experience administering and supporting GitHub Enterprise environments.
Experience deploying and governing GitHub Copilot Enterprise.
Experience implementing enterprise CI/CD and automation platforms.
Experience integrating AI technologies into software engineering workflows.
Experience supporting large-scale developer ecosystems.
Strong understanding of platform engineering, developer experience, and AI-enabled engineering practices.

Description:
Position Title: Team Leader Operations
Department: Operations Sales Voice (Ecommerce)
Location: Bhubaneswar

Key Responsibilities
1. Team & Performance Management
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of sales advisors to meet daily/weekly/monthly sales targets.
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
Monitor and improve team performance using operational KPIs
Implement performance improvement plans (PIP) for underperforming team members.

2. Operational Excellence
Ensure adherence to SLA, process policies, and compliance requirements.
Maintain daily and weekly operations dashboards and scorecards.
Ensure accurate score calculation, rating mechanisms, and parameter adherence.
Work closely with Quality, Training, and Workforce Management teams for smooth operations.
Support new process transitions and stabilize teams during pilot phases.
3. Sales Coaching & Customer Engagement
Coach advisors on effective sales communication, objection handling, and valuebased selling.
Ensure that every interaction focuses on convincing customers to complete their purchase from the cart.
Monitor call audits to identify gaps and implement targeted coaching sessions.
Drive bestpractice sharing to enhance sales effectiveness.


Educational & Experience Requirements
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory).
2-3 years of work experience in a relevant Contact Center sales voice process.
Prior experience in international/premium contact center environments, especially during new process transitions.
Minimum 1 year experience as a Team Leader in a sales voice sales program (current role).

Interested candidates may share the resume at
puja.vishwakarma@startek.com

SUMMARY
Summary:
The Field Sales Executive plays a vital role in driving business expansion within the paint-chemical industry by cultivating strong, lasting relationships with key trade partners including painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. This position demands consistent performance, proactive engagement, and a hands-on approach to achieve and exceed sales targets. The ideal candidate will conduct daily site visits, maintain a strong presence at assigned retail outlets, organize shop meetings, and ensure accurate reporting all contributing to enhanced market penetration and brand visibility. With a focus on customer-centric strategies and performance excellence, this role is essential to sustaining growth and strengthening market position across the assigned territories.

Location :
Hebbal
Vijayanagar
Kanakapura Road
Konanakunte
Kolar
Devanahalli
Sarjapur
Whitefield
Marathahalli
Responsibilities:
Achieve and exceed assigned sales targets consistently.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key stakeholders.
Conduct site visits per day to identify new opportunities and support customer needs.
Dedicate at least two hours daily to on-site presence at assigned retail stores to drive sales and customer engagement.
Organize and lead weekly shop meetings with applicators to promote product adoption and team alignment.
Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports through the designated online portal.



Requirements
Valid two-wheeler license is mandatory for field operations.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build relationships.
Self - motivated, disciplined, and highly driven by performance goals.
Minimum educational qualification: Graduation (preferred).
6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants, Building materials ).
Candidates from insurance or banking backgrounds or from Any other sales background with demonstrable sales aptitude are also encouraged to apply.


Benefits
Net Take Home: 16k to 23k (Negotiable)
MWA: 5,000/ -
Lucrative performance-based incentives
Absorption after 1 year based on performance
Travel allowance: 5000 per month, depending on profile

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Job Title: Business Development Manager / Senior Manager Mid-Market (B2B Sales)

Company: G4S Secure Solutions India
Location: Multiple Locations / Pan-India Hubs
Experience: 2 – 8 Years
Role Type: Full-Time, Individual Contributor

About the Role
We are looking for high-energy, target-driven Business Development Managers to drive our Mid-Market corporate sales across Pan-India hubs. In this role, you will focus on acquiring new mid-sized corporate clients and expanding business within existing accounts.
You will manage mid-sized commercial deals (ranging from 20 Lakhs to 85 Lakhs+ / 25K–100K in annual contract value), allowing you to focus purely on high-impact corporate accounts while smaller transactional inquiries are handled by our operations team.

What’s in It for You? (Compensation & Growth)
Monthly Payouts: Fast-paced monthly performance tracking with monthly commission payouts.
Multi-Year Earning Potential: Earn trailing commissions in Years 2 and 3 for multi-year contracts you close, plus an Annual Target Bonus.
Clear Career Path: High performers hitting targets for 2 consecutive years qualify for fast-track promotion to Enterprise Sales roles.

Key Responsibilities
1. New Business Acquisition (50% of your time)
Identify and pitch to potential corporate clients across industrial corridors, manufacturing plants, logistics hubs, and commercial buildings through cold calling, field visits, and networking.
Follow up on and convert inbound leads from digital marketing, website inquiries, and branch referrals.
Prepare accurate pricing proposals/cost sheets using company tools and respond to commercial RFQs while maintaining healthy profit margins.
Close multi-year security service contracts within the mid-market segment.
2. Account Expansion & Retention (35% of your time)
Build strong relationships with existing mid-market clients to expand manpower deployments across new sites.
Cross-sell electronic security solutions (CCTV, access control, and intrusion detection packages) to existing customers.
Manage timely contract renewals (targeting 90%+ retention) and execute annual price revisions aligned with statutory minimum wage updates.
3. Sales Operations & Smooth Handover (15% of your time)
Maintain up-to-date pipeline data, meeting notes, and deal stages in Salesforce (CRM).
Coordinate closely with Branch Operations and Finance teams after contract signing to ensure smooth deployment and timely billing.
Who We Are Looking For
Experience & Education:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (MBA in Sales/Marketing is a plus).
Manager: 2–5 years of proven experience in high-volume B2B / field sales.
Senior Manager: 5–8 years of proven B2B / commercial services sales experience.

Skills & Competencies:
Sales Hustle: Strong track record in B2B field sales, cold calling, lead qualification, and closing deals quickly.
Client Relationship Management: Ability to engage and negotiate with Business Owners, Plant Heads, Facility Managers, and Purchase Officers.
Commercial Acumen: Comfortable working with pricing/costing sheets, profit margins, and basic labour compliance/minimum wage structures.
Tech-Savvy: Hands-on experience using CRM tools (like Salesforce) and MS Excel.
(Preferred) Basic understanding of manned guarding or electronic security systems (CCTV, access control).

Key Skills (Tags for Naukri Posting)
B2B Sales Corporate Sales Business Development Field Sales New Client Acquisition Account Management Key Account Management Lead Generation Cold Calling Salesforce Facility Management Sales Security Services CCTV Sales Commercial Sales

Description:
Key Roles and Responsibilities
1. Patient Consultation: Provide medical consultation and clinical examination to infants, children and adolescents attending the health camp.
2. Growth & Development Assessment: Assess children's physical growth, nutritional status and developmental milestones.
3. Diagnosis & Treatment: Diagnose and manage common childhood illnesses such as fever, cough, cold, diarrhoea, respiratory infections, anaemia and other paediatric conditions.
4. Nutritional Assessment: Identify malnutrition, undernutrition and nutritional deficiencies and provide appropriate dietary guidance.
5. Immunisation Counselling: Educate parents about the importance of routine immunisation and recommend vaccination as per the national immunisation schedule.
6. Newborn & Infant Care: Provide guidance on breastfeeding, complementary feeding, newborn care and essential infant healthcare practices.
7. Prescription: Prescribe appropriate medicines and treatment based on the child's age, weight and clinical condition.
8. Early Identification: Identify developmental delays, congenital conditions and other health concerns requiring specialised medical attention.
9. Referral Services: Refer children with serious or complicated medical conditions to appropriate government or specialised healthcare facilities.
10. Parent Counselling: Educate parents and caregivers on child nutrition, hygiene, preventive healthcare and healthy child development.
11. Medical Documentation: Maintain patient consultation records, diagnosis, prescriptions, growth assessment and referral details.
Required Qualification & Experience
MBBS with MD/DNB in Paediatrics.
Valid medical registration.
Relevant experience in child healthcare and management of paediatric conditions.
Experience in community health camps will be preferred.
Computer Knowledge

Description:
Key Roles and Responsibilities
1. Patient Consultation: Provide consultation and medical examination to women attending the health camp, particularly regarding reproductive and maternal health.
2. Gynaecological Assessment: Assess patients' medical history, menstrual health, reproductive health and other gynaecological concerns.
3. Maternal Healthcare: Provide guidance on antenatal care (ANC), postnatal care (PNC), pregnancy-related complications and safe motherhood.
4. Diagnosis & Treatment: Identify and manage common gynaecological conditions such as menstrual disorders, PCOS, vaginal infections, white discharge, pelvic pain and menopause-related concerns.
5. Family Planning: Counsel women and couples on family planning methods, contraception and reproductive health.
6. Preventive Healthcare: Create awareness regarding cervical cancer, breast cancer, menstrual hygiene, reproductive health and the importance of regular health check-ups.
7. Screening & Referral: Identify high-risk pregnancies and other serious gynaecological conditions and refer patients to appropriate healthcare facilities for further investigation and treatment.
8. Prescription: Prescribe appropriate medicines and recommend diagnostic investigations as per clinical requirements.
9. Health Counselling: Provide counselling on nutrition, personal hygiene, maternal health and healthy lifestyle practices.
10. Medical Documentation: Maintain patient consultation records, prescriptions, screening details and referral records.
11. Coordination: Coordinate with other specialist doctors, nursing staff, pharmacists and diagnostic teams for effective patient care.
Required Qualification & Experience
MBBS with MD/MS/DNB in Obstetrics & Gynaecology.
Valid registration with the relevant Medical Council.
Relevant experience in managing gynaecological and obstetric cases.
Experience in community health camps and maternal healthcare services will be preferred.

Description:

1. Patient Consultation: Provide dental consultation and oral health examinations to beneficiaries attending the health camp.
2. Dental Assessment: Examine teeth, gums, oral cavity and identify common dental problems.

Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
Job Summary
The agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customer in a)Resolving policy service needb)Renewal collection to resolve policy holder s service needs, Cross sale opportunity.


Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment -Develop various sources of agent hiring build a team of agent agent pipe line.
Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referral for new agent hiring.
Conduct Career Seminar of prospects.
Follow agent hiring mechanism other hiring norms.
Agent Development -Ensure product knowledge by AMLI ways of training Field demonstration (FOD s).
Development of agent prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits.
Work with agent on planning and reviewing of activities and goals.
Identify the training needs of the agent and work with Trainers to improve the same.
Meet Business Targets -Achievement of monthly, quarterly yearly business plans.
Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc.
Ensure companies product mix sales ratio and adhere to the business norms.
Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan.
Customer Centricity -Be AMLI brand ambassador a customer champion.
Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty.
Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need.
Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.
Measures of Success:-Achievement of business plan GPA.
Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.
Number MTD Active.
Persistency as per grid.
Number of EC/MDRT agent.


Qualifications and Experience
Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience
At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria : 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Description:
Job Title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
Location: Gopalpur, Odisha


Job Summary
The Maintenance Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the reliable operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of production equipment within the TOPCon solar cell/module manufacturing facility. The role involves preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance, troubleshooting equipment issues, optimizing machine performance, and supporting new equipment installations to achieve maximum uptime and operational efficiency.


Responsibilities
Ensure smooth operation and maintenance of TOPCon solar cell/module manufacturing equipment.
Execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance activities to maximize equipment uptime.
Diagnose equipment failures and implement corrective actions for continuous improvement.
Coordinate with OEMs and vendors for troubleshooting and servicing requirements.
Maintain maintenance schedules, spare parts inventory, and equipment records.
Drive reliability improvement initiatives and reduce machine downtime.
Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards.
Support installation, commissioning, and qualification of new equipment.
Train operators on basic maintenance and machine handling practices.


Qualifications
B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Communication Engineering, Electrical Electronics Engineering

Description:
Project Role : Cloud Platform Engineer

Project Role Description : Designs, builds, tests, and deploys cloud application solutions that integrate cloud and non-cloud infrastructure. Can deploy infrastructure and platform environments, creates a proof of architecture to test architecture viability, security and performance.

Must have skills :Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform

Good to have skills:NA
Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification:15 years full time education

Summary:
As a Cloud Platform Engineer, a typical day involves designing and constructing cloud-based application solutions that seamlessly integrate both cloud and traditional infrastructure components. The role includes building and testing these solutions to ensure they meet performance and security standards. Additionally, the engineer deploys infrastructure and platform environments and develops proof of architecture models to validate the feasibility and robustness of proposed designs. Collaboration with various teams to align architecture with organizational goals is also a key part of the daily activities, ensuring that solutions are scalable, secure, and efficient.

Roles & Responsibilities:

- Expected to be a SME with deep knowledge and experience.
- Should have Influencing and Advisory skills.
- Responsible for team decisions.
- Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
- Expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams.
- Lead the evaluation and implementation of new cloud technologies to enhance platform capabilities.
- Mentor and guide junior team members to foster professional growth and knowledge sharing.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Must To Have Skills:
Proficiency in Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform.
- Experience with cloud infrastructure deployment and management.
- Strong understanding of cloud security principles and best practices.
- Ability to design and validate architecture proofs focusing on performance and security.
- Skilled in integrating cloud and non-cloud systems to create cohesive solutions.
- Familiarity with automation tools and scripting for infrastructure provisioning and deployment.

Additional Information:

- The candidate should have minimum 15 years of experience in Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform.
- This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
- A 15 years full time education is required.



Qualification
15 years full time education

Designation: Electrical Engineer
Job Brief: Join JSW Steel Limited's Maintenance Department as a key technical professional responsible for ensuring the reliability and efficiency of electrical systems within a large-scale manufacturing environment. This role demands expertise in electrical engineering principles applied to heavy industrial equipment, with a focus on preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and system optimization to support continuous steel production operations. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to implement innovative solutions that enhance operational safety, reduce downtime, and improve energy efficiency in alignment with JSW Steel's commitment to excellence and sustainability.
Responsibilities:
Develop, implement, and oversee preventive and corrective maintenance plans for electrical equipment and systems in the steel manufacturing plant.
Conduct detailed electrical inspections and diagnostics to identify faults and recommend effective solutions to minimize production interruptions.
Collaborate with mechanical and process engineering teams to integrate electrical systems with overall plant operations and optimize performance.
Manage and supervise electrical maintenance teams, ensuring adherence to safety standards and regulatory compliance.
Analyze electrical system failures and implement root cause analysis to prevent recurrence and improve system reliability.
Coordinate with vendors and contractors for procurement, installation, and commissioning of electrical components and systems.
Maintain accurate documentation of maintenance activities, electrical schematics, and compliance records.
Lead initiatives for energy conservation and electrical system upgrades to enhance operational efficiency and reduce costs.
Ensure compliance with industry standards, safety protocols, and environmental regulations specific to electrical maintenance in manufacturing.
Provide technical training and mentorship to junior engineers and maintenance staff to build team capability.
Skills:
Industrial Electrical Systems Maintenance
Electrical Troubleshooting and Diagnostics
Preventive and Predictive Maintenance
Electrical Safety Standards Compliance
Power Distribution and Control Systems
PLC Programming and Automation
Root Cause Analysis
Energy Management and Conservation
Technical Documentation and Reporting
Team Leadership and Training
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field from a recognized institution.
Professional certification in electrical maintenance or industrial automation (e.g., Certified Maintenance Reliability Professional, Electrical Safety Certification) is highly desirable.
Required work experience

Description:
Job Summary
Position: Manager - Concurrent / Prepayment Audit.
Join a leading stainless-steel manufacturer as the pre-payment control gatekeeper at our Jajpur plant. 100% concurrent / prepayment audit of all invoices - Project, Logistics, Raw Material, MRO & Operations - before payment is released. Prevent leakages, ensure compliance and drive recoveries within a robust SAP-based continuous audit framework.


Key Responsibilities
Pre-audit of all invoices before payment (3/4-way match in SAP).
Verify PO, GRN, BOQ/JMR, rates, LD & contractual terms.
Detect duplicate, advance & overpayments; plug leakages.
Cover Project, Logistics, RM, MRO & Operational invoices.
Maintain audit trackers, aging, recovery & MIS dashboards.
Coordinate with Finance, Purchase, Projects & vendors.
Individual Contributor and mentor the location concurrent audit team.


What you bring
Qualified CMA / MBA (Fin) / Inter-CA (CIA/CISA preferred).
4-8 years in concurrent / prepayment /Accounts Payable / internal audit.
Hands-on in SAP FICO & MM (MIRO, MIGO, ML81N, FBL1N).
Strong in Accounts Payable (AP) or invoice processing prepayment audit.
Experience in project, logistics, RM & MRO invoice review.
Advanced Excel & PPT.
Strong stakeholder management & integrity.


Key Skills & Competencies
SAP Proficiency - Hands-on working knowledge of SAP FICO & MM modules - vendor invoice verification (MIRO), PO/GRN 3-way & 4-way matching (ME23N, MIGO), FBL1N vendor ledger, service entry sheets (ML81N), payment blocks and release strategy.
Prepayment / AP Audit - Deep expertise in Accounts Payable (P2P) cycle, prepayment / pre-audit of invoices before release of payment, TDS/GST validation, duplicate payment detection and vendor reconciliation.
Invoice Domain Coverage - Ability to audit all invoice categories - Project (Civil / Mechanical / Structural / E&I) , Logistics & Freight, Raw Material (RM), MRO and Operational / service invoices.
Stakeholder Management - Strong engagement with Finance, Purchase, Projects, Stores, Logistics, Plant Operations and vendors; ability to resolve queries with documentation and traceability.
Analytics & Automation - Advanced Excel, Automate for audit trackers, aging analysis, KPI scorecards and continuous monitoring.
Compliance & Governance - Sound knowledge of GST, TDS, Indian INCO, statutory compliances, internal controls.
