SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.

Location: Sambalpur and Cuttack

Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.

AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
Zonal Human Resources Lead

Role Overview:

Position Summary:
The Zonal Human Resources Lead is responsible for overseeing and leading end-to-end HR service delivery for both direct and indirect employees across branch operations. This role acts as a strategic and operational HR partner focused on talent retention, performance management, employee grievance redressal, statutory labor compliance, and championing occupational health and safety standards in alignment with company values.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

1. HR Business Partnering & Operations
HR Strategy & Budgeting: Formulate and execute the annual branch HR plan and operating budget in alignment with business priorities and Hub HR objectives.
Workforce Planning & Talent Acquisition: Collaborate with the central recruitment team to ensure timely hiring, seamless onboarding, induction, and deployment of direct and indirect branch staff.
Employee Lifecycle & Records Management: Maintain accurate employee personal files and partner with the HR Shared Services / Transaction Center to ensure real-time ERP data integrity.
Performance & Talent Development: Drive the timely closure of the Performance Development Review (PDR) process for indirect staff; partner with the training function to identify training needs and ensure compliance with mandatory training programs.
HR Analytics: Compile, analyze, and present branch HR metric dashboards and reports to Hub and Corporate HR stakeholders.

2. Employee Relations, Engagement & Grievance Redressal

Grievance Resolution: Promptly address, manage, and resolve employee queries/grievances escalated beyond the central HR Helpdesk/Wish Center purview.
Employee Voice & Engagement: Conduct structured town halls, listening tours, and communication sessions to gather employee sentiment and implement corrective action plans.
Cross-Functional Escalation: Coordinate closely with Centers of Excellence (CoEs), Employee Relations (ER), and Shared Services for smooth conflict resolution.

3. Statutory & Regulatory Compliance

Compliance Management: Partner with the central ER and Compliance teams to guarantee strict adherence to local labor laws, statutory acts, and client-site audit mandates.
Quality Standards: Drive documentation and procedural compliance for the HR chapter of ISO audits and corporate quality accreditations.
Vendor & Agency Oversight: Liaise with regulatory agencies and third-party staffing vendors as needed for audits and labor compliance.

4. Occupational Health & Safety

Workplace Safety: Promote adherence to corporate Health & Safety policies and safe working protocols across all branch facilities and operational deployments.
Incident Management: Drive safety awareness campaigns, conduct safety drills, report on-site incidents, and facilitate swift incident resolution.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Success Metrics
Plan vs. Actual: Adherence to branch HR headcount plan and operational budget.
Operational Execution: % completion of recruitment targets, PDR cycles, and statutory training.
Retention: Branch voluntary attrition rate compared to internal benchmarks.
Service Delivery: Grievance resolution turnaround time (TAT) and employee engagement scores.
Audit & Risk: Zero critical non-compliance observations during statutory or client audits.
Safety: Number of workplace Health & Safety incidents reported/resolved.
Key Relationships & Stakeholders
Internal Stakeholders: Branch Manager & Operations Team, Hub HR Business Partners, Hub ER Team, Corporate/HQ HR, Talent Acquisition Team, Learning & Development Team, HR Shared Services / Wish Center, Payroll & Benefits Team.
External Stakeholders: Statutory & Labor Law Authorities, Government Regulatory Bodies, Third-party Staffing & Logistics Vendors.
Education
Minimum: Bachelors Degree / Diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Preferred: Masters Degree or MBA with a specialization in Human Resources / Industrial Relations.
Experience
3 to 7 years of solid HR Generalist / HR Business Partnering experience within a structured corporate environment.
Workforce Scale: Demonstrated experience managing HR operations for large distributed/field-force teams (direct and indirect/blue-collar workforce) is strongly preferred.
Competencies & Skills
HR Expertise: Deep functional knowledge of Indian labor laws, statutory compliances (PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Minimum Wages, Contract Labor Act), performance management, and HR ERP tools.
Operational Agility: Proven capability to navigate complex, fast-paced environments and manage competing operational priorities.
Communication: Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills with the ability to influence branch leaders and front-line workers alike.
Leadership & Ethics: High standard of personal integrity, empathetic grievance handling, and collaborative stakeholder management.

Description:
Job Description Cluster Manager
Role objective
The Cluster Manager is primarily responsible for driving sales and building the loan portfolio across assigned branches, while ensuring good customer service, quality business and disciplined branch operations.
Key responsibilities
1. Sales and portfolio growth
Set branch-wise sales priorities and follow up with the sales team on customer acquisition and loan disbursements.
Monitor branch performance, identify gaps and take corrective action to achieve business targets.
Ensure portfolio growth is supported by proper customer verification, adherence to company policies and quality lending practices.
2. Customer service and branch readiness
Ensure every operating branch opens by 9:30 a.m. Escalate any delay immediately.
Ensure at least two employees are present at each branch. Where staffing falls short, contact Pavan Kalyan immediately to arrange deputation.
Ensure customers receive prompt, courteous service and that complaints and service delays are addressed quickly.
3. Auction-loan follow-up
Follow up with customers and branch staff on loans identified for the June auction.
Ensure each affected customer receives the auction message through WhatsApp, in line with the companys communication process.
Track customer responses and repayment commitments, and ensure branch staff complete the required follow-up.
4. Branch expansion
Identify suitable premises for new branches with the assistance of Team Leaders from nearby branches.
Coordinate site visits and submit shortlisted premises for review and approval.
5. Recruitment and staffing coordination
Follow up with HR on hiring the sales team for existing and proposed branches.
Coordinate with Deepika from MIS to download candidate profiles based on the required locations, such as Nagarkurnool, Mahabubabad and Nalgonda.
Assist AVPs and VPs in uploading candidate profiles onto FINS.
Send emails proposing the rejoining of suitable former employees and follow up with HR on the necessary approvals and joining arrangements.
Performance expectations
The Cluster Manager will be assessed on portfolio growth, loan disbursements, customer service, business quality, timely branch opening, staffing readiness and completion of assigned auction follow-ups.
- Each operating Branch is opened by 9.30am;
- If any Branch opening after 9.30am, shall be escalated;
- Min two employees are present in the Branch; If not, shall reach out Pavan Kalyan for deputation
- Follow up June Auction Loans with customers and Branch staff;
- Shall send Auction message to each customer through whatsapp;
- Identify premises for new Branches with the help of TLs of nearby Branches
- Follow up with HR as regards hiring of Sales team;
- Reach out Deepika of MIS to download profiles using location – For example – Nagarkurnool, Mehabubabad, Nalgonda.
- Shall help AVPs and VPs to upload profiles on FINS;
- Shall send mails for rejoining of staff;
- Follow up with Sales Team for Loan Disbursements.

Deliver goods accurately and efficiently to designated locations, maintaining excellent customer service standards.
Complete all required documentation, including bills of lading, delivery receipts, and daily logs, with accuracy and timeliness.

Must be medically fit for commercial driving, with successful completion of eyesight and health examinations.
Age must be below 40 years at the time of application.

Description:
We are looking for a talented Computer Vision Developer to design and implement advanced image and video processing solutions.
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in computer vision algorithms, deep learning frameworks, and real-time image analysis, enabling innovative AI-driven applications.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop and optimize computer vision models for image classification, object detection, segmentation, and tracking.
Implement solutions using OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.
Work on image preprocessing, feature extraction, and data augmentation techniques.
Integrate vision models into production systems and optimize for real-time performance.
Collaborate with data scientists, ML engineers, and product teams to deliver AI solutions.
Ensure model accuracy, scalability, and deployment efficiency.
Stay updated with the latest research and advancements in computer vision and deep learning.
Required Skills:
Strong experience with OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar libraries.
Proficiency in Python (and optionally C++ for performance-critical tasks).
Knowledge of image processing techniques and computer vision algorithms.
Experience with CNNs, object detection models (YOLO, Faster R-CNN), and segmentation models (Mask R-CNN, U-Net).
Familiarity with GPU acceleration and model optimization for deployment.
Preferred Skills:
Experience with video analytics, 3D vision, or AR/VR applications.
Knowledge of edge deployment (NVIDIA Jetson, TensorRT).
Understanding of cloud-based AI services (AWS Sagemaker, GCP AI Platform).

Location: PAN INDIA

EXPERIENCE:5-10 YEARS

Description:
Job description

SAP MDG Consultant
Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)
Experience:
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.

SAP MDG
Data Governance

Data Replication
Data Validation

SAP Migration Cockpit
SAP Cloud Integration
SAP Fiori for MDG
SAP BTP Exposure
Data Migration Projects
Data Warehousing Concepts
Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)
Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP MDG Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience
Generic Data Analyst or Data Steward profiles without SAP MDG experience

WE ARE HIRING: Field Sales Engineers (15 Openings Across India)

BT Print & PKG Solutions LLP is expanding! We are looking for dynamic, target-driven Field Sales Engineers to spearhead B2B sales for our advanced industrial coding, marking, and inspection portfolioincluding CIJ/TIJ Printers, Laser Marking Machines, and AI Inspection Systems.

If you thrive in industrial automation or high-velocity B2B sales and want to partner with leading manufacturers across the Food, Pharma, Beverage, Dairy, and Electronics sectors, we want to hear from you!

Locations: Kolkata | Delhi | Pune | Mumbai | Hyderabad | Chennai | Bangalore | Punjab

Openings: 15 Positions

Compensation: Competitive & Negotiable (Based on experience, location & industry standards)

What You’ll Do:
Drive Growth: Develop new business within your assigned territory and crush sales targets.

Pitch & Demonstrate: Conduct on-site client visits, technical presentations, and live product demos.

Nurture Accounts: Build strong, long-term relationships with existing clients to maximize retention.

Collaborate: Work alongside our service engineers to ensure smooth installation and after-sales support.

Represent & Report: Attend industry trade shows/exhibitions, track market intelligence, and share weekly/monthly pipeline reports with management.

What We’re Looking For:
Education: B.E./B.Tech (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics preferred) OR MBA in Sales & Marketing.

Experience: 3–7 years in B2B field sales across Industrial Machinery, Automation, Packaging Solutions, or Banking/Financial Sales. (Prior experience in coding & marking equipment is a strong advantage!)

Skills: Solid technical aptitude for machinery, strong negotiation skills, and a self-starter attitude.

Mobility: Extensive regional travel is mandatory; owning a 2-wheeler or 4-wheeler is an added advantage.
AboutCompany: BT Print is built upon the philosophy that business is about positively impacting social ecosystem including lives of people and enhancing value of business activities. Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an Tech Lead (Backend Developer) - Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will leverage advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets, helping solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
Responsibilities
- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing machine learning models to enhance data-driven decision-making processes
- Collaborating with client support teams to design and develop robust data solutions that drive business growth
- Utilizing data science algorithms and troubleshooting techniques to optimize data analysis and visualization
- Mentoring team members to leverage their unique strengths and improve performance on client engagements
- Analyzing system components to identify linkages and interactions for comprehensive data solutions
- Taking ownership of projects, including planning, budgeting, execution, and completion, to meet client expectations
- Encouraging innovation and the use of technology to enhance delivery and inspire team development
- Addressing conflicts and engaging in challenging conversations with clients and stakeholders to maintain project alignment
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree from Tier 1
- At least 7 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering
- Strong proficiency in Python for production-grade application or service development.
- Experience designing, implementing, and integrating REST APIs.
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerised service deployment.
Strong working knowledge of PostgreSQL, including schema design, querying, and performance tuning.
- Proficiency with Git-based collaborative development workflows.
- Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including clean code, automated testing, design patterns, and maintainability.
- Working knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience setting technical direction, reviewing code, resolving complex issues, and mentoring engineers.
- Experience with asynchronous APIs, messaging platforms, or event-streaming technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
- Exposure to agentic development using frameworks such as LangGraph, the OpenAI SDK, or Google ADK.
- Leveraging tools and methodologies to generate innovative solutions

Description: We are seeking an experienced Billing Platform Senior Manager Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end solution architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise Billing Platform implementations across the entire Quote-to-Cash lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in both Billing and Revenue capabilities, with extensive experience in subscription billing, usage-based billing, pricing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, financial integrations, and enterprise application architecture. As a trusted advisor to clients, the Senior Manager will drive business transformation initiatives by translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing Billing Platform solutions aligned with industry best practices. The role requires a strong blend of functional, technical, and consulting expertise, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams, engage with executive stakeholders, and deliver large-scale digital transformation programs. The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end solution ownership, including solutioning, architecture, business process design, functional and technical design, application configuration, integrations, data migration, development oversight, proof of concepts, testing strategy, deployment planning, user enablement, and post-go-live support. The role also requires strong leadership in project management, delivery governance, team management, quality assurance, risk management, and stakeholder communication while driving successful project milestones. Additionally, the Senior Manager will play a key role in practice development by contributing to solution accelerators, AI-enabled delivery, capability building, pre-sales, client workshops, and thought leadership initiatives. The individual will work closely with client executives, business stakeholders, product teams, architects, functional consultants, and technical teams to deliver end-to-end Q2C solutions that optimize revenue operations, improve business outcomes, and support enterprise growth. Years of Experience: 14 - 20 Years Position Requirements: Own the solution architecture and design for enterprise Quote-to-Cash transformations across Billing and Revenue, including subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, payments, collections, revenue recognition, and financial integrations. Lead end-to-end Billing Platform solution architecture for large-scale implementation programs. Manage end-to-end implementation programs by overseeing project planning, solution design, configuration, development, integrations, data migration, testing, deployment, and hypercare while leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality outcomes on time and within budget. Define enterprise architecture, solution blueprints, and implementation roadmap. Partner with client executives, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, facilitate workshops, perform fit-gap analysis, develop scalable solution designs, and provide strategic recommendations aligned with industry best practices. Excellent client-facing skills and communication (written/verbal) skills Establish delivery governance, manage project risks and dependencies, review solution quality, ensure compliance with architectural standards, and drive successful milestone execution through proactive stakeholder communication and issue resolution. Contribute to practice development through pre-sales, estimations, proposals, AI-enabled delivery accelerators, capability building, mentoring, solution assets, thought leadership, and the development of reusable frameworks that enhance delivery efficiency and support business growth. Build and maintain billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, and revenue-related processes. Design and develop integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, CRM systems, Payment gateways, Tax engines and Data warehouses Strong hands-on experience with billing platform and experience with APIs, integrations, and data reconciliation. Understand customer business processes/functional specifications and independently drive technical solutioning to delivery Ability to lead business discussions with customers, discover requirements, frame a problem statement, lead solution workshops and deliver a Technical solution Must ensure teams follow the correct procedures, best practices and documentation requirements across project phases Drive solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:
• Design and implement microservice-based applications using Python and
frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI.

security practices.

Functions, AWS Lambda).

Angular/React.

Good To have:
Certifications in AI/ML, Deep Learning and NLP from Learning platforms such as Coursera,
Udemy or equivalent.
Certifications on Cloud Architecture (GCP/Azure/AWS)
Experience building MCP servers or Agent to Agent applications.
Fine tuning LLMs and Hosting LLMs on Premises

Job Description
As a WS practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients overcome their transformation challenges by developing their compensation strategies through analysis of industry benchmarks, company policies and culture, and employee performance. As part of the team, you will support in preparing job architecture framework, executive pay packages, Incentives design, equity valuations, compliance and regulatory requirements, and financial planning and reporting.
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to)
Role & responsibilities
As a Senior Associate in Workforce Solutions -5-8 years Rewards, you will engage with clients to analyze their reward and benefits strategies, design competitive compensation structures, and develop attractive benefits packages. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on providing consulting services related to human resources, talent management, and organizational development. You will work closely with clients to optimize their workforce, enhance employee engagement, and drive organizational effectiveness.
As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems and manage assigned workstreams. You will develop deliverables within client service engagements, using your understanding of the firm's methodologies and technology resources. You will also have the opportunity to build meaningful client relationships and mentor Associates and other junior team members. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will support clients in overcoming transformation challenges by developing compensation strategies through analysis of industry benchmarks, company policies, and employee performance. You will also prepare job architecture frameworks, executive pay packages, and incentives design, while engaging with client leadership to translate workforce insights into actionable business recommendations.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client needs to develop comprehensive compensation strategies and solutions
- Designing competitive and equitable compensation structures and benefits packages
- Interpreting market and organizational data to assess the impact of rewards decisions
- Developing global guidelines and methodologies that align with business strategies
- Engaging with client leadership to translate workforce insights into actionable recommendations
- Leading business data evaluation to draw conclusions and develop insightful rewards strategies
- Identifying and tracking key risks, project KPIs, and opportunities for project planning
- Assisting practice leadership with client proposals and thought leadership initiatives
- Benchmarking client data using market compensation survey databases
- Utilizing analytical tools like Alteryx, Tableau, and PowerBi for data analysis and reporting
- Managing tasks in a fast-paced and flexible environment to support client needs
- Collaborating within a team setting to foster efficient and innovative ways of working

Description:
Role: GIS Performance Tester
Experience: 5-6 years
Staff Level: Senior Associate
Education: BE/BTECH or equivalent
Key responsibilities:
Define GIS performance testing strategy covering web, desktop, and servicelevel workloads (ArcGIS Server, Utility Network, Feature Services).
Identify performancecritical GIS workflows (pan/zoom, tracing, edits, large spatial queries, batch jobs).
Create realistic GIS workload models based on editor, viewer, integration, and batch processing usage patterns.
Design test scenarios for: 
Map rendering and symbology scaling
Feature service queries (attribute + spatial)
Utility Network traces and validations
Web GIS Load Test scenarios
Concurrent editing and versioned data access 
Load and Stress Simulation:Execute load, endurance, and stress tests to determine how GIS (likeArcGIS Server) perform under high user traffic, specifically testing 2D/3D map rendering and data querying.
Bottleneck Analysis: Monitor system KPIssuch as CPU utilization, memory, response times, and throughput—to identify bottlenecks related to spatial analysis or database queries.
Result Reporting: Create detailed performance analysis reports that highlight the system's performance, identifying areas for improvement or potential downtime.
Collaborate with Functional Analysts to map business flows into performance test cases.
Prior experience in GIS Testing assignments will be an advantage.
Collaboration & Optimization:Work with GIS developers and architects to suggest infrastructure changes, database tuning, or code optimizations to resolve issues.
Perform RCA on performance issues and recommend improvement opportunities.
Essential Qualifications:
Minimum of 5 years’ working experience with Esri ArcGIS Software (Enterprise, Desktop, Server, ArcGIS Pro, Online)
Understanding of ArcGIS Enterprise Architecture- ArcGIS Server, Portal, data Store etc.
Understanding of ArcGIS Pro concepts: Maps, Projects, Layout templates, Editing Templates, Tasks etc.
Understanding of Esri geoprocessing tools: model Builder
Understanding of Geodatabases: Versioning and Spatial data Types

Experience: 5-6 years
Staff Level: Senior Associate
Education: BE/BTECH or equivalent
Key responsibilities:
Define GIS performance testing strategy covering web, desktop, and servicelevel workloads (ArcGIS Server, Utility Network, Feature Services).
Identify performancecritical GIS workflows (pan/zoom, tracing, edits, large spatial queries, batch jobs).
Create realistic GIS workload models based on editor, viewer, integration, and batch processing usage patterns.
Design test scenarios for: 
Map rendering and symbology scaling
Feature service queries (attribute + spatial)
Utility Network traces and validations
Web GIS Load Test scenarios
Concurrent editing and versioned data access

Result Reporting: Create detailed performance analysis reports that highlight the system's performance, identifying areas for improvement or potential downtime.
Collaborate with Functional Analysts to map business flows into performance test cases.
Prior experience in GIS Testing assignments will be an advantage.
Collaboration & Optimization:Work with GIS developers and architects to suggest infrastructure changes, database tuning, or code optimizations to resolve issues.
Perform RCA on performance issues and recommend improvement opportunities.
Essential Qualifications:
Minimum of 5 years’ working experience with Esri ArcGIS Software (Enterprise, Desktop, Server, ArcGIS Pro, Online)
Understanding of ArcGIS Enterprise Architecture- ArcGIS Server, Portal, data Store etc.
Understanding of ArcGIS Pro concepts: Maps, Projects, Layout templates, Editing Templates, Tasks etc.
Understanding of Esri geoprocessing tools: model Builder
Understanding of Geodatabases: Versioning and Spatial data Types

As an OAC Senior Developer, you will work with technical and project teams to design and deliver enterprise-grade data integration solutions for some of our Fortune 1000 clients. 19-23 years of hands-on experience with Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) , including KM development and topology configuration.
Experience with Oracle Data Integrator 11g/12c/ODI Marketplace Edition.
Exposure to Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) or Fusion Data
Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills, with experience on one or more relational databases on Oracle.
Solid understanding of ELT/ETL architecture, data warehousing concepts, and dimensional modeling.
Experience with Oracle GoldenGate for real-time replication and Change Data Capture (CDC).
Exposure to OCI Data Integration / Data Transforms and cloud-native, serverless integration patterns.
Experience migrating on-premise ETL workloads to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
Working knowledge of Oracle Autonomous Database and Oracle Exadata Cloud Service as integration targets.
Exposure to Big Data connectivity (Hadoop, Hive, Spark, Kafka) within ODI or GoldenGate for Big Data.
Experience with job scheduling, load plans, and ODI agent (Standalone/JEE/Colocated) administration.
Preferred
Experience with Oracle GoldenGate 21c/23ai.
Exposure to Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) or Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) as downstream consumers of ODI pipelines.
Experience in Oracle BI Apps (OBIA).
Exposure to one or more of the following: Python, R, or UNIX shell scripting.

Systematic problem-solving approach.
Ability to debug and optimize code and automate routine tasks.
Exposure to ODI SDK and Groovy scripting for automation.Role & responsibilities

Description:
PwC US CONSULTING SOLUTIONS - MANAGEMENT CONSULTING Our Management Consulting team works with our global clients to design and implement growth, operational and customer focused strategies for sustainable competitive advantage. Our thought leadership and unparalleled experience help clients turn formidable challenges into market advantage across the value chain and around the globe. Additionally, our extensive expertise in various industries allows us to serve clients with consulting services with a focus on the most profitable elements of the value chain to create scalable businesses that will deliver increased sustainable profits.  Our Management Consultants work with the client and project teams to support global engagements from India through activities that are driven toward delivering results - conduct analyses and develop insights, prepare excel models, analyze large sets of data, capture as-is processes, prepare work plans, design to-be processes. In addition, consultants also support project lead, work directly with client teams, and facilitate meetings to enable decision making, organize and prepare recommendations on client issues, and participate actively in new business development, thought leadership and firm building activities. PRACTICE OVERVIEW: WORKFORCE SOLUTIONS
At PwC, this team of consultants works with their US counterparts to develop both short and long-term Workforce Solutions for our clients. Our practitioners facilitate transformation by conducting strategic change initiatives, assisting transformative leadership initiatives, designing HR processes, developing, and implementing learning interventions that align with the clients business strategy. Some of our key capabilities include: 
HR Strategy & Operations 
NextGen Change  
Organization & Talent  
Rewards & Benefits 
Workforce Technology – Enabling Apps 
POSITION REQUIREMENTS: Key Responsibilities: As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growthAs such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to): Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies: 
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Bloom’s taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery – spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training. 
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 1–3 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements: 
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.
What skill does it take? Must-have
An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work. 
Will to work in a fast-paced environment with sometimes unpredictable circumstances or changes, comfortable working in ambiguity. 
Self-motivated with a passion for client work and teamwork. 
Strong project management skills. 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels. 
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs. 
Ability to develop and present new, innovative ideas and conceptualize new approaches and solutions. 
Will to learn, adopt and lead new ways of doing things (e.g., personas, journey mapping, gamification, etc.). 
Proficiency in leveraging GenAI tools to enhance productivity, analysis, and delivery quality. 
Ability to work with data to transform information into actionable insights. 
Foster an efficient, innovative, and team-oriented work environment.  
Strong work ethics, proactive, and professional behavior. 
Good-to-have
Effective storytelling and communication skills to various audiences (written and verbal). 
Strategic, creative thinker and problem solver. 
Analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and metrics to assess training effectiveness. 
Supports engagement managers in delivering engagements by identifying and addressing client needs. 
Exhibits strong ability to work independently as well as in a highly collaborative team environment. 
Demonstrated experience supporting client-facing consulting engagements and mentoring junior team members. 
Hands-on experience utilizing AI tools and capabilities such as prompt engineering, AI-assisted analysis, and creating workforce-specific solutions.

Description:
Position Name
React Angular
Position Level
Senior 1 & 2
Employment Type
Permanent
Position Details
EY's GDS Assurance Digital teams mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our audit clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY's core Assurance practice, you'll develop a deep Audit related technical knowledge and outstanding database, data analytics and programming skills.
Ever-increasing regulations require audit departments to gather, organize and analyse more data than ever before. Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. Effectively and efficiently handling the variety and volume of data is often extremely challenging and time consuming for a company.
EY's GDS Assurance Digital team members work side-by-side with the firm's partners, clients and audit technical subject matter experts to develop and incorporate technology solutions that enhance value-add, improve efficiencies and enable our clients with disruptive and market leading tools supporting Assurance.
GDS Assurance Digital provides solution architecture, application development, testing and maintenance support to the global Assurance service line both on a pro-active basis and in response to specific requests.
EY is currently seeking Software Engineer to join the GDS Assurance Digital practice in Bangalore, India, to work on various Microsoft technology based projects for customers across the globe.
Requirements
A Bachelor's degree (BE/BTech/MCA & MBA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Accounting, Finance or a related field with adequate industry experience.
Technical skills requirements
BE/BTech/MCA with a sound industry experience of 4.5 to 7 Yrs.
Strong experience in MVC, .Net Core and Entity Framework.
Strong React JS or Angular JS experience.
Solid working knowledge of relational database development: MS SQL/SQL Azure, EF 6, EF Core
Storing experience in ASP .NET, C# and or VB.NET, Windows or Web based development, Web API, Web Services, Application Blocks
Basic knowledge in Azure stack like Logic apps, Azure functions and Web Apps and deployment solutions
Unit testing: NUnit, Moq, jest
Experience using distributed version control systems: Git/SVN
Should have understanding and experience of software development best practices.
Excellent business communication
JSON and Rest API integration
Need to work as a team member to contribute in various technical streams of Microsoft Technologies.
Nice to have skill
Basic knowledge in one of the following technologies: Angular, React
Experience in Azure DevOps
Experience in Agile / Scrum methodology
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities
An ability to quickly understand complex concepts and use technology to support data modeling, analysis, visualization or process automation
Selects appropriately from applicable standards, methods, tools and applications and uses accordingly
Ability to work within a multi-disciplinary team structure, but also independently
Demonstrates analytical and systematic approach to problem solving
Communicates fluently orally and in writing and can present complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences
Able to plan, schedule and monitor work activities in order to meet time and quality targets
Able to absorb rapidly new technical information, business acumen, and apply it effectively
Ability to work in a team environment with strong customer focus, good listening, negotiation and problem-resolution skills
Additional skills requirements
The expectations are that a Senior will be able to maintain long-term client relationships and network and cultivate business development opportunities
Provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing engagement manager of engagement status, and managing staff performance.
Must have presentation skills - ability to create PowerPoint deck to communicate solution architecture to various stakeholders.
Should have understanding and experience of software development best practices
Excellent business communication, Consulting, Quality process skills
Must be a team player

Description:
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Position Name-Senior Manager
Position Details
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, the Digital Senior Manager will be responsible for working closely and leading teams with associates, seniors, team leaders, assistant managers, and handling service delivery for an Area/Region/Solution/Sector. The principal objectives will be to ensure that consistent and high-quality service is provided by the team by taking end-to-end project ownership and accomplishing the define goals. The Innovation Manager is responsible for the overall success of implantation of solutions/ideas that can bring more business or can bring efficiencies by digitalize the manual work.
Requirements (including experience, skills and additional qualifications)
Requirement & Qualification
A Bachelor's/ Masters degree (BE/BTech/MCA/MTech & MBA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Accounting, Finance or a related field with adequate industry experience.
15-20 years experience (demonstrated competence, depth, and breadth) of operational and project/Program management experience
Strategize and outline goals and objectives of the program
Monitor multiple projects through the entire program cycle, Manage the daytoday detailed aspects of multiple projects, Coordinate and utilize resources for multiple projects in the program
Communicate program objectives, goals, and progress to program directors, executives, upper management, and stakeholders
Experience in independently leading the organization wide Tech Initiatives along with managing the delivery of those initiatives spanning across
Automation Robotics Process Automation, SharePoint/ React, .NET, Web Portal development, Cloud etc.
Transformation Business Process Reengineering, Business Process
Optimization
Data Visualization PowerBI, Spotfire etc.
Knowledge & ability to manage Financial Accounting engagements across domains
Ability to manage tight deadlines and multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously.
Prior experience with agile methodologies and practices
Awareness on cloud technologies is required
The individual will assist the management team in developing and coaching team members as well as ensuring that resources are deployed in the most effective manner
While the individual will be based at our Bangalore office, the role requires the person to travel to other countries on a short or long-term basis for client engagements.
Good to have
PMP Certifications or equivalent certification
Scrum Product Owner or Scrum Master Certifications
Key Responsibilities:
Develop strong relationship with onshore stakeholders (Areas leadership and champion network) and manage their expectations on service delivery
Building Centralized Data storage system
Building Data Strategies for the team
Built good understanding of Sources and Target sources by understanding the GDS Assurance Business.
Responsible for identifying and creating new service offerings/Solutions
Responsible for ensuring high quality consistent and efficient service is provided by the team to the Project teams of different areas/regions
Responsible for managing the operational aspects of Project management such as, resource management, Metrics & Reporting, performance management and elements of risk management
In addition, the Manager will be responsible to build strong relationships with local teams and clients, identifying areas where GDS can improve quality of, and increase the scope of work
Experience in coordinating projects and interdependencies between various projects within the program
Additional skills requirements:
Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility and self-discipline.
Must have demonstrated project management experience.
Knowledge of firms reporting tools and processes.
Proactive, organized and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
Analyses complex or unusual problems and is able to deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What working at EY offers
At EY, were dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way thats right for you
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Star Bucks is looking for Store Operations to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

The Store Operations Specialist is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the daily operations of our retail stores. They play a vital role in ensuring a seamless customer experience, managing inventory, and implementing operational processes to enhance store efficiency. This role requires a detail-oriented individual with strong organizational and communication skills. Key Responsibilities : Customer Service : Provide exceptional customer service by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive shopping experience. Train and mentor store staff on customer service best practices. Inventory Management : Monitor and manage store inventory levels to prevent stockouts and overstock situations. Coordinate with suppliers for timely replenishment of inventory. Conduct regular stock audits and maintain accurate inventory records. Store Layout and Merchandising : Collaborate with the visual merchandising team to ensure attractive and effective product displays. Optimize store layout for a smooth flow of customers and improved product visibility. Operational Efficiency : Develop and implement operational procedures to streamline store processes and reduce operational costs. Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to store operations. Loss Prevention : Implement loss prevention strategies to minimize theft and ensure the security of store assets. Conduct periodic security audits and recommend improvements as needed. Employee Training and Development : Train and coach store staff on operational procedures, customer service, and product knowledge. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Compliance and Safety : Ensure the store complies with all safety and regulatory requirements. Implement safety protocols and conduct regular safety drills.

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Locations- Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kolkata, Noida, Kochi, Coimbatore

Description:
Position: MLOps
Experience: 5-9 Years
Location: PAN India
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for talented MLOps with 5-9 years of experience to design, automate, deploy, and maintain scalable cloud-native applications and machine learning platforms. The ideal candidate should have expertise in cloud technologies, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, containerization, monitoring, and operational excellence across multi-cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
MLOps
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for model development, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
Automate machine learning workflows using MLOps best practices.
Deploy and manage ML models in production environments.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Platform teams.
Implement model monitoring, performance tracking, and drift detection mechanisms.
DevOps
Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.
Manage code repositories, branching strategies, and release processes.
Implement DevSecOps practices and security controls.
Improve deployment efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
CloudOps
Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Monitor cloud resources, performance, cost, and availability.
Troubleshoot infrastructure and application issues.
Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Implement infrastructure-as-code and cloud governance standards.
AboutCompany:
Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 46 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over three decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.
To learn more about Infosys and see our ideas in action please visit us at www.Infosys.com

Description:
Extensive SAP S/4HANA Finance expert with solution design experience across the full FI stack, preferably with an accounts and finance background.
Lead a team of Finance specialists; facilitate and guide the implementation and support teams.
Ability to lead and facilitate design workshops, assessments, and planning sessions, demonstrating leadership experience in project management.
Lead dynamic, interactive requirements-gathering sessions with stakeholders throughout the enterprise.
Strong, hands-on expertise across core SAP FI modules:
FI-GL (General Ledger) New GL, document splitting, parallel ledgers/accounting principles, chart of accounts design, financial statement versions, and period-end closing activities.
FI-AR (Accounts Receivable) — customer master data, credit management, dunning, incoming payments, down payments, and customer-side intercompany processes.
FI-AP (Accounts Payable) — vendor master data, payment runs, payment terms, down payments, automatic/electronic payments, and vendor reconciliation.
Asset Accounting (FI-AA) — asset classes, depreciation areas, parallel valuation, asset acquisitions/retirements/transfers, and integration with GL and CO, including regulated utility plant and FERC asset classification where applicable.
Bank Accounting / Treasury integration — bank master data, electronic bank statement processing, cash management, and bank reconciliation.
Taxation — tax procedures, tax codes, withholding tax, and statutory/compliance reporting requirements.
Basic, working knowledge of Controlling — Cost Center Accounting (CO-CCA), Profit Center Accounting (CO-PCA), and Internal Orders — sufficient to support FI-CO integration points and cross-module postings; deep Product Costing or Material Ledger specialization is not required for this role.
Strong knowledge of FERC (Federal Energy Regulatory Commission) regulatory reporting for the utilities/energy industry, including FERC Form 1/2/6 preparation, regulatory chart of accounts mapping, and FERC account classification within SAP.
Hands-on experience configuring FERC-compliant Asset Accounting structures — Continuing Property Records (CPR), Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC, both debt and equity components), Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) capitalization, retirement units, and regulatory versus book depreciation.

Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience , At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria : 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year

Description:
Group Company: Indorama India Pvt Ltd
Business Unit: Spandex
Office Location: Baddi
Department: Filament Spinning
Designation: Filament Spinning Engineer
Reporting to: Filament Spinning Engineer
Job Brief: To handle the Filament Spinning processes and related activities at the Indorama plant under the supervision of HOD in order to meet quality standards and deliverables within defined organisational standards and procedures.
Responsibilities:
Core Responsibilities:
1.Responsible for shift-based manpower distribution, operator overtime tracking, and planning of the next 24 hours' scheduled or unscheduled activities.
2.To perform 24-hour quality gradation analysis and daily entry of breaks, waste, and quality details on board.
3.To do a 24-hour packing memo analysis, identify repeating endpoints, and take corrective action.
4.Monitoring safety incidents and PPE (Personal Protective Equipment), and filling up the event form and sharing it within 24 hours of any safety incident.
5.To oversee the identification of poor positions in the winder and to take corrective action based on the daily breakage report.
6.To oversee the monitoring of winder change, winder PM, winder tripping, and the updating of comoli data.
7.To oversee the segregation of downgraded bobbins based on lab results and to undertake the necessary corrective actions.
8.Oversee the preparation of waste and mixing reports each shift, as well as processing of technical data updates in the process folder.
9.To oversee the audit of the empty tube and bobbin weight and to confirm the findings with the superior.
10.To look after bobbin mixing based on breaks entry and perform analysis to take corrective action.
11.Taking care of Comoli data updates and comoli parameter changes in response to lab results.
12.To enter information on 24-hour breakages and analyse it, as well as to take care of SOC and trash updates.
13.Take care of the new product Trial follow up and compilation of the report.
14.Monitoring product performance on a regular basis and discussing it in the daily track up meeting.
15.Tracking of recurrent mechanical, instrumentation, engineering jobs, as well as scheduling pack changes, candle filter changes, and following up with quality for lab result confirmation.
16.Oversee production changes, bottom filter, bottom perforated plate change plan, oil change follow up, and department inventory maintenance.
17.Responsible for the daily tracking and issuance of paper tubes, sticker rolls, and ribbon, as well as handling dirty and broken bobbins (due to human error), as well as their name declaration and operator training.
18.Provide training to contract labourers and keep track of the availability of shift-based packs and candles.

Key Interactions: Networking with Internal Stakeholders
Education and Experience: A Graduate Degree Textile Engineering or equivalent is preferred
Competencies:
Production process knowledge
Computer knowledge
Communication skills

Skills: MS Office
Certification / Software: MS Office
Performance Measures:
Gradation % age
Machine availability loss time
Waste percentage
Safety incidents

Language: English,Hindi

Description:
Job description Sales (LAP) Sales Manager
Job Type: Full-time
About IIFL Finance: IIFL Finance is a leading financial services provider in India, known for its comprehensive range of solutions including loans, insurance, and investment products. We are expanding our footprint and are excited to offer opportunities in the LAP (Loan Against Property) segment in the LAP region.
Position Overview: We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Sales Representative to join our LAP team at IIFL Finance. This role involves promoting our Loan Against Property products, building relationships with clients, and achieving sales targets in the LAP region. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial sales and a deep understanding of the local property market.
Key Responsibilities:
DSA Network for Sales Maximization: Maximize sales through a network of DSA by effectively managing connector and builder relationships to ensure strong business
Disbursement Target Management and Achievement: Drive Disbursement Target vs Achievement for LAP product - as per expected business growth plan.
Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams such as underwriting and customer service to ensure smooth customer service.
Market Research: Stay informed about local real estate trends, property values, and competitive offerings. Use market insights to refine sales strategies and identify new opportunities.
Desired Candidate Profile:
3+ years of experience strong understanding handling LAP Product
Problem Solving ability
Bachelors degree in finance or any other field - Graduation is a must

Key Responsibilities -
1) Operational Excellence
Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple hotel properties in your area, ensuring adherence to brand standards and service benchmarks
Drive compliance with Treebo's brand standards and SOPs, health and safety guidelines, and service quality norms
Conduct audits, quality assurance checks, and drive corrective/preventive actions through hotel partners to maintain Treebo standards
Act as the key liaison between the company and hotel partners, ensuring seamless coordination and timely issue resolution
Monitor and enhance overall guest satisfaction by ensuring prompt and effective service recovery mechanisms

Train hotel staff in brand values, SOPs, and customer service skills to ensure consistency
Build strong relationships with hotel owners and partners to foster collaboration and long-term association

Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
46 years of experience in hospitality management with demonstrated success in both operations and business development.
Proven experience in property acquisition and/or sales in hospitality.
Knowledge and experience in the MICE segment is highly desirable.
Analytical mindset with problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned geography.
Entrepreneurial approach with a strong focus on execution and accountability.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Role Purpose
Lead development, industrialization, maintenance, and lifecycle management of production tools, molds, dies, jigs, fixtures, and gauges. Ensure tooling readiness, reliability, quality, productivity, cost competitiveness, and minimum production downtime at the Gagret plant.

Key Responsibilities
Own tooling strategy and execution for NPI, capacity expansion, localization, and continuous improvement.
Lead design, development, trials, validation, and production release of injection molds, press/progressive tools, sheet-metal tools, jigs, fixtures, gauges, and assembly/welding/testing fixtures.
Apply DFM/DFA, GD&T, DFMEA/PFMEA, APQP, PPAP, MSA, and SPC during tooling development and industrialization.
Establish preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance covering tool-life monitoring, refurbishment, calibration, critical spares, and replacement planning.
Reduce defects, breakdowns, changeover time, and tooling-related downtime using RCA, TPM, Lean, and Kaizen.
Coordinate with R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Maintenance, Industrial Engineering, Purchase, and Supply Chain for pilot builds, ramp-up, and stable production.
Develop toolmakers and machining/fixture vendors; manage RFQs, technical evaluation, trials, acceptance, cost, delivery, and localization.
Lead tooling engineers, designers, tool-room technicians, and external partners with safety, quality, delivery, and cost accountability.

Candidate Requirements

B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, or Tool Engineering. PG Diploma/M.Tech in Tool Design or Manufacturing preferred.
12-18 years in tooling design/development, industrialization, and high-volume plant support.
At least 8 years leading tooling/tool-room teams and cross-functional projects.
Exposure in Injection molds, press/progressive tools, sheet-metal tooling, jigs, fixtures, gauges, assembly/welding fixtures, and tool validation.
Desirable hands-on responsibility for preventive/predictive maintenance, refurbishment, spares planning, tool-life improvement, and downtime reduction.
Exposure in Battery, inverter/UPS, energy storage, automotive components, electrical/electronics, or comparable high-volume manufacturing.
GD&T, DFM/DFA, PFMEA, APQP/PPAP, MSA/SPC, RCA, Lean, TPM, and vendor development.
Working knowledge of SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, NX, or AutoCAD.
AboutCompany:
