With a legacy spanning over 38 Years, Luminous has built a robust presence in the energy and residential solar space. Its wide portfolio of innovative products, including inverters, batteries, and best-in-class solar solutions that is designed to provide the end-to-end energy management ecosystem with reliability, safety, and efficiency.
As the demand for reliable, clean, and efficient power growsespecially among home consumers, as a consumer energy fulfillment company, Luminous fulfils the evolving energy needs of millions of households and businesses across the world. The company operates seven state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, supported by an expansive network of over 28 sales offices and 100,000 channel partners across India. Today, Luminous powers over 100 million Indian homes and is expanding its reach globally, with a presence in more than 40 international markets.
Research and development, and continuous innovation, drive Luminous to constantly enhance the efficiency and lifespan of products, the convenience of consumers, and to stay ahead of technological trends. As an emerging Prosumer technology brand, the companys vision goes beyond just providing power; it's about empowering consumers. Through their flagship Connect-X app and integrated technologies, consumers get real-time insights and complete transparency over their energy ecosystems, through valuable information on energy consumption and monitoring, solar energy generation, and inverter performance.
The companys culture is a true representation of inclusion, allyship, and empowerment. Luminous remains committed to responsible business practices, demonstrated through extensive Corporate Social Responsibility programs supporting Education & Employment, Environmental conservation, and Electrification through Solar.
With a passionate team and a relentless drive to innovate, Luminous continues to set benchmarks in the energy sector. Its consistent recognition, such as five consecutive Consumer Superbrand Awards for residential power backup, underscores its trusted reputation in homes across India and beyond.
Luminous Power Technologies is more than an energy solutions company its a catalyst for a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

Description:
Position- Lab Technician
Location- Shimla

Qualification Required- DMLT, BMLT
Experience- 1- 5 years

Role & responsibilities

To perform assigned analytical testing procedures in an accurate, precise, and timely manner in the assigned lab.
To perform routine and non-routine activities pertaining to laboratory testing and reporting and maintaining external and Internal Quality control.
Maintain required records and documentation.
Follow the laboratory's procedures for specimen handling and processing, test analyses, reporting and maintaining records of patient test result.
Analyze specimens using approved testing procedures as per SOP's, review and release test results.

Qualification: DMLT, BMLT

AboutCompany:
Established in 1949, Dr Lal PathLabs today is the largest and most respected diagnostic service provider in the country. It has a proven track record of over six decades for strict adherence to international standards and benchmarks. Dr Lal PathLabs offers widest test menu and has a pan India presence in all important cities and towns of India, in the form of state-of-the-art laboratories and patient service centres.

The company has more than 190 Labs and over 2000 centres across India and international operations in Nepal and Bangladesh.

It serves over 13 million customers every year through its widest test menu and panels in the disciplines of Molecular Diagnostics, Biophysics, Flow Cytometry, Immunophenotying, Cytogenetics, Endocrinology, Genetics, Nutrition and Metabolism, Oncology, Toxicology, Immunohistochemistry, Infectious diseases, Biochemistry, Haematology, Histopathology and Cytology.

Dr Lal Path Labs has internationally accepted external and internal quality assurance programs in place. The Company is India's highest accredited laboratory, with accreditation from College of American Pathologists (CAP), National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL), Ministry of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and ISO 9001:2000 certification.

Description:
Axis Max Life Insurance is seeking an Associate Sales Manager for our Branch Banking division. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales and achieving targets through effective management of a branch sales team. You will play a crucial role in developing and implementing sales strategies, fostering client relationships, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. You will also oversee the training and development of team members, promoting a culture of excellence and performance.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead and manage a team of sales executives to achieve sales targets.
- Develop and execute sales strategies to increase market share and revenue.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to ensure repeat business and referrals.
- Monitor sales performance and provide coaching and feedback to team members.
- Conduct regular market analysis to identify opportunities for growth.
- Ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
- Collaborate with other departments to enhance service delivery and customer experience.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Proven experience in sales management, preferably in the insurance or financial services sector.
- Strong leadership and team management skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to analyze market trends and customer needs.
- Proficient in using CRM software and other sales management tools.
- Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
- Knowledge of insurance products and regulatory requirements is an advantage.
- Self-motivated with a results-driven approach.

Join Axis Max Life Insurance as an Associate Sales Manager and take your career to new heights while contributing to the success of our branch banking operations.

Description:
Axis Max Life Insurance is seeking a motivated and dynamic Associate Sales Manager for our Branch Banking division. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth by managing a team of sales executives, building strong relationships with clients, and ensuring exceptional customer service. The role includes identifying new business opportunities, promoting insurance products, and achieving sales targets while maintaining compliance with company policies and industry regulations.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead and manage a team of sales executives to achieve sales objectives and targets.
- Develop and implement effective sales strategies to expand the customer base.
- Cultivate and maintain relationships with existing clients to ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
- Conduct training and mentoring sessions for team members to enhance their sales skills and product knowledge.
- Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth.
- Prepare reports and presentations on sales performance for upper management.
- Collaborate with other departments to ensure smooth operations and consistency in service delivery.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong leadership and team management skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Sales-oriented mindset with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
- Ability to analyze financial data and market trends.
- Familiarity with insurance products and services.
- Proficient in using CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Strong problem-solving abilities and decision-making skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications:
- A Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, or a related field.
- Previous experience in sales, preferably in the insurance or financial services industry.
- Relevant certifications in insurance sales would be an added advantage.

Join Axis Max Life Insurance and be a part of a dynamic team that values excellence, innovation, and professional growth.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
New Product Development & Introduction: Lead Packaging projects & trials at Factory level with focus on line performance, cost efficiency on time delivery and product quality. Provide packaging input within the AGs proposing and evaluating best packaging alternatives for new products and improvements to existing products. Organise and document factory trials including machinability, shelf-life, storage handling, laboratory and transport tests for validation of new packaging and changes in specifications.
Nestle Continuous Excellence: Conduct value analysis; identify and recommend cost improvements and source reduction opportunities. Initiate (or participate in) DMAIC exercises. Guardian of packaging quality going out of the factory lines.
Safety, Quality & Compliance: Implement packaging related quality and compliance directives. Drive quality improvements in our packaging. Assist Factory QA to review packaging related on-line/off-line controls - to implement packaging monitoring plans. Participate in supplier audits.
Packaging Specifications: Manage GLOBE database of packaging materials. Supplier development: Support Packaging Head Office and Procurement in the selection, assessment and development of new suppliers/converters. Raise packaging material complaints with suppliers & collaborate to resolve them.
People & Know How: Ensure development of competencies of packaging assistants & disseminate packaging best practices and knowledge at the shop floor (e.g. "One Point Lessons"). Source & utilise training materials available within the Group (or develop training materials as appropriate) Packaging Material and Packaging Lines Efficiency in line with the goals of NCE Zero waste, Zero loss: Accountable for efficiency in Packaging Lines and Materials usage. Support to Procurement on local & zone level. Consumer Complaints: Analyze consumer complaints related to packaging, propose & implement corrective actions.

Preferred candidate profile
Academic Experience:
Graduate in Engineering, preferably in Packaging, Mechanics, Industrial, Chemistry or Automation or equivalent (Materials Science, Printing).

Operational Experience: Packaging development in FMCG Packaging development and packing operation in FMCG.
Problem solving approach.
Project management.
Supplier & converter auditing.

Knowledge
1. Nestl Corporate Business and Nestl Management & Leadership Principles, Nestl on the Move, Nestl Leadership Framework.

2. Competent in Packaging Safety, Quality and Compliance.

3. Basic knowledge in production planning.

4. Aware of customer and consumer understanding.

5. Aware of relevant technology platforms, people management tools & practices in the Nestle context.

6. Good understanding of NPDI process.

7. Good understanding of NCE methodologies in particular TPM & LEAN.

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

3. Line Clearance during all critical process during Dispensing, Manufacturing, Filling & Stoppering and Packing operation.

16. Collection and evaluation of Batch process parameters(CPP), Quality attributes from batch record and analytical record.
17. To review the Non Viable trends of Production Area.
18. To Perform any other works as and when assigned by HOD.

Description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot  issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Position: Water Supply Design Specialist

Location: Shimla, Himachal Pradesh
Project Duration: 2 Years (Project-Based Assignment)
Qualification: M.Tech in Environmental Engineering / Water Resources Engineering. Ph.D. in Environmental Engineering, Water Resources Engineering, or related discipline will be preferred.

Experience: Minimum 10 years of total professional experience with at least 8 years of relevant experience in water supply system design and preparation of DPRs for water infrastructure projects. Candidates should have hands-on experience in the design of Water Treatment Plants (WTPs) of 5 MLD and above capacity, hydraulic modelling using WaterGEMS and EPANET, and water supply projects in hilly terrain. Experience in externally aided projects will be preferred. Maximum Age: 45 Years

Purpose & Scope of Position
The Water Supply Design Specialist will be responsible for the design, hydraulic analysis, and technical evaluation of water supply infrastructure systems. The role focuses on developing efficient and sustainable water supply solutions, optimizing system performance through hydraulic modelling, and ensuring that designs meet applicable engineering standards, project requirements, and client expectations.

Key Responsibilities
Prepare and review DPRs, design reports, calculations, technical specifications, BOQs, and tender documents for water supply projects.
• Carry out hydraulic modelling and network analysis using WaterGEMS and EPANET.
• Design water supply systems including intake structures, transmission mains, distribution networks, pumping stations, service reservoirs, and water treatment plants.
• Perform demand assessment, hydraulic calculations, pipe sizing, pressure analysis, and network optimization.
• Design and review Water Treatment Plants (WTPs) of 5 MLD and above capacity.
• Prepare technical drawings, design criteria, and engineering documentation for water supply infrastructure.
• Ensure compliance with CPHEEO guidelines, BIS standards, and applicable engineering practices.
• Review design submissions, technical reports, and engineering deliverables prepared by consultants and contractors.
• Coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure integration of design inputs and project requirements.
• Provide technical support during design reviews, approvals, and implementation stages.

Required Experience and Exposure
Proven experience in the design of urban and rural water supply systems.
• Extensive experience in preparation and review of water supply DPRs and detailed engineering designs.
• Strong expertise in hydraulic modelling, network analysis, and system optimization using WaterGEMS and EPANET.
• Experience in design and review of Water Treatment Plants (WTPs) with capacities of 5 MLD or higher.
• Exposure to externally aided infrastructure projects will be an advantage.
• Experience in water supply projects in hilly and mountainous regions is highly desirable.

Competencies
Candidates should possess strong expertise in water supply engineering and hydraulic modelling with demonstrated proficiency in WaterGEMS and EPANET. The ideal candidate should have sound knowledge of water treatment processes, transmission and distribution systems, pumping systems, storage infrastructure, demand forecasting, network optimization, and design standards. Experience in DPR preparation, technical evaluations, design reviews, engineering documentation, and multidisciplinary coordination is essential. Strong analytical, report-writing, and problem-solving skills are highly desirable.

Preferred Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be an M.Tech-qualified Environmental or Water Resources Engineer with significant experience in water supply system design and hydraulic modelling. The candidate should have independently handled or substantially contributed to water supply DPRs, WTP design assignments, and hydraulic network studies using WaterGEMS and EPANET. Experience on externally aided projects and water supply projects in hilly regions such as Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, or similar terrain will be highly preferred. The candidate should be capable of delivering technically robust, efficient, and sustainable water supply designs while working effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

To create and updating the Standard Operating Procedures and their compliance.

Responsible to use through knowledge of Water System Operation and Maintenance of all Utilities Equipments i.e. including Pre Treatment (MGF Softener), UF, RO, EDI, Purified Water supply and distribution, system and maintaining respective documentation (Whenever applicable).

Description:
Process all guest check-ins, check-outs, room assignments, and room change/late check-out requests. Secure payment; activate/reissue room keys. Ensure rates match market codes, document exceptions. Verify/adjust billing for guests.

Communicate to appropriate staff when guests are waiting for an available room. Advise guest of messages. Clear departures in computer system. Coordinate with Housekeeping to track room status and guest concerns. File guest paperwork or documentation.

Operate telephone switchboard station. Run and check daily reports, contingency lists, and credit card authorization reports. Supply guests with directions and information. Answer, record, and process all guest calls, requests, questions, or concerns; follow up to ensure each has been met to guests satisfaction. Arrange transportation for guests/visitors. Count and secure bank at beginning and end of shift. Cash-guests checks, process all payment types, vouchers, paid-outs, charges, and provide change. Notify Loss Prevention/Security of any reports of theft.

Follow company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of employees. Comply with quality assurance standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Travel Technology
Operations Specialist
The opportunity
The Travel Technology Operations Specialist supports technology and AI initiatives across the Travel, Meetings & Events (TME) portfolio. Acting as the operational representative and communication bridge between Enterprise Technology (ET), business subject matter experts (SMEs) and delivery teams, the role ensures operational realities, business impacts and market-specific considerations are understood throughout the solution lifecycle.
Working across ET, project teams, local Travel Managers and operational stakeholders, the role translates operational expertise into clear, actionable input for technology teams and communicates solution direction, impacts and decisions back to SMEs. This two-way coordination helps ensure travel technology and AI solutions are practical, well-informed, supportable and fit for purpose once live.
Key responsibilities Operational representation
Provide operational insight and business context throughout Travel Technology and AI solution delivery.
Help delivery teams understand travel processes, market variations, user impacts and support considerations.
Coordinate the collection, organisation and validation of operational content from SMEs to support knowledge bases used by AI-enabled travel solutions.
Identify operational risks, dependencies and practical constraints, and raise them with the project team.
Stakeholder and SME coordination
Act as the primary communication bridge between ET, delivery teams and business and operational SMEs.
Identify and engage the appropriate SMEs, coordinating their participation in workshops, walkthroughs and validation activities.
Translate operational knowledge into clear, structured input for technology teams and communicate technical direction, decisions and impacts back to SMEs in accessible business language.
Engage traveler user groups early to validate strategy and proposed deliverables, gathering feedback to inform decision-making, prioritization and delivery planning.
Maintain clear information flows, decisions and follow-ups so ET and project teams can access the operational expertise needed to inform their work.
Operational review and validation
Review proposed solutions from an operational perspective, including process impacts, market considerations and support implications.
Provide clear operational feedback and recommendations without owning requirements, functional design or technical decisions.
Confirm that key operational assumptions are practical and scalable.
Deployment and stabilisation support
Support deployment readiness by confirming that operational impacts have been identified and relevant stakeholders engaged.
Provide local Travel Managers with the operational input needed to support market communications and engagement.
Gather post-go-live feedback, provide business context for issue assessment and identify improvement opportunities.
Scope
In scope: Travel-specific TME tools and automations, non-Concur travel integrations, AI-enabled travel solutions owned by TME Innovation, coordination of operational content for AI knowledge bases, and related travel ecosystem technology.
Out of scope: Concur ownership or support; business analysis; requirements or functional documentation; process or solution design ownership; technical architecture; project budgets, timelines or governance; formal ownership of communications, training or change management; and technical ownership of AI platforms or knowledge-base architecture.
Skills and experience
Experience in corporate travel, travel operations, business operations or a technology-enabled service environment.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, coordination and relationship-building skills, with the ability to bridge technical and operational audiences.
Ability to understand complex operational processes and translate risks, impacts and business knowledge into clear, structured information.
Experience working across functions, markets and cultures in a global environment.
Practical problem-solving skills and the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively.
Experience supporting technology implementation, operational change, knowledge management or continuous improvement is desirable.
Knowledge of corporate travel technology, AI-enabled solutions, Travel Management Companies or the wider supplier ecosystem is desirable.
What success looks like
ET, delivery teams and the right operational stakeholders and SMEs are connected at the right time, with clear two-way communication.
Operational risks, impacts and market considerations are identified early, translated appropriately and communicated clearly.
Operational knowledge is collected, validated and organized to support accurate, maintainable knowledge bases for AI-enabled solutions.
Solutions are practical, supportable and aligned to operational needs.
Local Travel Managers receive accurate operational input to support market engagement.
Post-go-live feedback and lessons learned inform future improvements.
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Job Title - Solution Architect - AI - Manager - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 7 -Manager
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore
Must have skills:Generative AI,Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI, , Large Language Models (LLMs)

Good to have skills:Model Context Protocol (MCP)/ Agent2Agent (A2A)
Experience:10 - 15 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect - AI with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience designing and architecting AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise solution architecture and experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role will be responsible for defining end-to-end AI solution architectures covering application, data, AI/ML, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational components. The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.
The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.


Roles and Responsibilities
Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.
Define architectures for LLM-based applications, including prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, model routing, grounding, knowledge bases, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi-agent architectures.
Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.
Establish architectural standards for AI observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, evaluation, performance management, reliability, and operational support.
Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers, application developers, DevOps/MLOps teams, cloud engineers, and security teams to guide implementation and ensure alignment with the target architecture.
Lead architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology assessments, and design governance activities while communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to conduct AI use-case discovery, technical feasibility assessments, architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and solution option analysis.
Ability to create and communicate high-level architecture, detailed solution architecture, sequence diagrams, data flows, integration diagrams, deployment architectures, and architecture decision records.
Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses.
Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, application architecture, cloud architecture, data architecture, solution architecture, or related technology roles.
Minimum 3 years of experience designing or implementing AI-based solutions, including Generative AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI.
Demonstrated experience working as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Cloud Architect, AI Architect, or equivalent senior architecture role.
Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale, production-grade solutions involving multiple applications, platforms, integrations, and data sources.
Hands-on architecture experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, document retrieval, and enterprise knowledge bases.
Strong hands-on architecture experience with at least one major cloud platform:
AWS - for example Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker,
Microsoft Azure - for example Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search,
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) - for example Vertex AI, Gemini, BigQuery
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, APIs, serverless architectures, containers, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, API gateways, authentication and authorization, OAuth/OIDC, networking, secrets management, encryption, and enterprise security architecture.
Strong understanding of enterprise data architectures including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, relational databases, NoSQL databases, vector databases, and streaming platforms.
Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture including Identity and Access Management, Role-Based Access Control, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, and secure API design.
Strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, scalability, security, maintainability, complexity, and time to market.
Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent technologies.
Experience designing integrations between AI solutions and enterprise systems using APIs, messaging platforms, event buses, queues, workflow engines, and integration platforms.
Experience designing highly available, scalable, fault-tolerant, secure, and cost-effective enterprise solutions.
Experience taking technology solutions through multiple lifecycle stages including discovery, architecture, proof-of-concept, implementation, deployment, and production support.
Experience with prompt engineering, context management, grounding techniques, model selection, model evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and AI guardrails.
Experience defining deployment strategies for AI applications across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
Experience working with enterprise security, risk, compliance, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions meet organizational and regulatory requirements.
Experience estimating solution complexity, cloud infrastructure requirements, implementation effort, technical dependencies, and architecture risks.
Understanding of common AI orchestration and development frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, DSPy, or equivalent technologies.
Understanding of AI production monitoring including model/application performance, latency, token consumption, cost, prompt and response tracing, model failures, retrieval quality, and system availability.
Understanding of Agentic AI concepts, including AI agents, planning and reasoning workflows, tool/function calling, agent orchestration, workflow automation, and multi-agent systems.
Understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, MLOps, LLMOps, containerization, Kubernetes, and automated deployment practices.
Understanding of data ingestion, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data quality, metadata management, data governance, and data security concepts.
Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, AI governance, model risk management, data privacy, prompt security, content moderation, explainability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Knowledge of emerging AI interoperability patterns and protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication is desirable. Any experience with UCP is also a plus.
Familiarity with observability platforms and technologies such as OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent tools.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage effectively with business leaders, product owners, enterprise architects, engineering teams, security teams, and senior management.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate multiple technical approaches and clearly articulate architectural trade-offs.
Ability to provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to cross-functional engineering teams without necessarily being responsible for direct people management.
Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business problems, challenge assumptions, identify technical risks, and recommend pragmatic solutions.
Ability to work across multiple projects and technology domains while maintaining consistency with enterprise architecture principles and standards.

Additional Information
Relevant cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified:Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent certifications.
AI/ML or Generative AI certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Google, Databricks, NVIDIA, or other recognized technology providers are advantageous.
Experience working in large enterprise environments, consulting organizations, or complex multi-cloud transformation programs.
Experience defining or contributing to organizational AI architecture standards, Generative AI platforms, AI Centers of Excellence, or enterprise AI governance frameworks would be advantageous.

Description:
SAP CPI Consultant JD
About the Role
We are looking for experienced SAP CPI Consultants to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting integration solutions using SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) and SAP Integration Suite.The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SAP CPI, SAP Integration Suite, iFlows, Groovy Scripting, OData Services, API integrations, and cloud-based integration scenarios. Experience in implementation, migration, enhancement, and support projects is highly preferred.
Location: Bangalore,Chennai,Mysuru,Noida,Nagpur,Mumbai,Hyderabad,Kolkata,
Coimbatore,Thiruvanandhapuram,Mangaluru,etc
Experience: JL4: 2-5 Years | JL5: 5-9 Years
Roles & Responsibilities
Design, develop, and support integration solutions using SAP CPI and SAP Integration Suite.
Develop and maintain iFlows for cloud-to-cloud and cloud-to-on-premise integrations.
Create and enhance integration scenarios using SOAP, REST, IDoc, RFC, and OData services.
Develop custom integration logic using Groovy Scripts.
Configure adapters, mappings, content modifiers, routers, and exception handling mechanisms.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize integration interfaces.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams to understand business requirements and integration needs.
Perform unit testing, SIT, UAT support, defect resolution, and production support activities.
Prepare technical specifications and integration documentation.
Participate in implementation, rollout, migration, upgrade, and support projects.
Support SAP S/4HANA integration initiatives.
Ensure adherence to integration best practices, security standards, and governance processes.
Qualifications
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in SAP CPI/Integration Suite.
B.E./B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc/MBA or any Postgraduate degree.
Mandatory Skills
SAP CPI,CLOUD PLATFORM,INTEGRATION SUITE,IFLOWS,GROOVY SCRIPT,ODATA,ODATA

Title: Telecom Engineer (Metro Railways) Contractual role - Kochi
EmploymentType: Siemens Direct Contract Experience Level: Junior (5 Years) Industry: Metro Rail / Transportation Telecom Systems Job Summary: We are seeking an skilled Telecom Engineer to oversee our Metro Rail projects in the South Region, encompassing the state of Keral (Kochi City). The ideal candidate should possess a Engineering Graduate with minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience; out of which a minimum of 3+ years’ experience in Telecommunication domain in Metro Railway project or similar transportation system environment. The Telecom Engineer will be responsible for design, installation, testing, commissioning, integration, operation, and maintenance of all telecommunication systems that support safe, reliable, and efficient train operations by ensuring compliance with safety, quality and regulatory standards. Key Responsibilities: System Design & Engineering in Coordination with Design Manager: • Review Employer's Requirements, Specifications, and Standards. • Prepare telecom system architecture and detailed engineering designs. • Develop system layout drawings, schematics, cable routing plans, and interface documents. • Coordinate with signaling, power supply, rolling stock, civil, and MEP teams. • Ensure compliance with Metro Rail standards, IEC, EN, IEEE, and local regulations. Telecommunication Systems Management in coordination with Project Manager, Design Manager, Interface Manager, Testing & Commissioning Engineer, Quality Manager, EHS Manager, and system OEMS/Vendor partners: • Fiber Optic Communication Network (OFC) o Design and supervise installation of fiber optic backbone networks. o Conduct fiber splicing, OTDR testing, and link performance verification. • Telephone Systems o Manage Emergency Telephone System (ETS). o Manage Operational Telephone System (OTS). o Configure IP-PBX and VoIP systems. • Radio Communication System o Implement TETRA, LTE, or other radio systems. o Ensure communication coverage throughout tunnels, stations, viaducts, and depots. o Coordinate radio frequency testing and optimization. • CCTV Surveillance System o Supervise installation of CCTV cameras and recording systems. o Configure Network Video Recorders (NVRs) and video management software. o Ensure integration with Operations Control Center (OCC). Page1 | 3 • Passenger Information System (PIS) o Configure audio and visual passenger information systems. o Integrate train arrival/departure information. o Ensure real-time announcements and display functionality. • Public Address System (PAS) o Design and configure station and depot PA systems. o Ensure emergency and routine announcements are delivered effectively. o Test audio clarity and coverage. • Master Clock System o Implement synchronized master and slave clock systems. o Ensure synchronization across all stations and operational areas. • Access Control & Intrusion Detection o Implement access control systems. o Configure card readers, biometric devices, and monitoring systems. o Ensure integration with security management systems. • Installation & Site Supervision o Supervise telecom equipment installation at stations, depots, tunnels, and OCC. o Monitor cable tray installation and cable pulling activities. o Ensure installation quality according to approved drawings and method statements. o Verify contractor compliance with safety requirements. • Testing & Commissioning o Prepare Inspection and Test Plans (ITP). o Conduct Site Acceptance Test (SAT). o Perform integrated system testing. o Support Trial Running and revenue operation readiness activities. 6. Documentation & Reporting • Prepare: o Method statements o Risk assessments o Inspection reports o Test reports o As-built drawings o O&M manuals • Maintain project progress reports and punch lists. 7. Safety & Quality Management • Ensure compliance with: o Metro Rail Safety Requirements o Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) procedures o HSE standards and regulations • Participate in safety audits and inspections. 8. Project Management Responsibilities. • Track telecom installation and commissioning progress. • Coordinate with vendors and subcontractors. • Participate in technical and progress review meetings. 9. Operation & Maintenance Support • Assist during trial operations. • Troubleshoot telecom system faults. • Train operations and maintenance personnel. • Support defect liability period (DLP) activities. Page2 | 3 Qualifications and Skills: • Education: Engineering Graduate, Bachelors of Degree in Electronics & Communications, Telecommunication or Electrical Engineering Experience & Skills: • Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience, out of which a minimum of 3+ years of hands-on experience in Telecommunication domain in Metro Railway Projects or similar transportation network system • Sound technical skills on Telecommunication systems for Metro Railway project or similar environment • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. • Willingness to travel as per project needs. • Ability to work independently and take ownership of project deliverables. • Ability to adopt technical skills faster • Demonstrated commitment to EHS practices

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for Executive Assistant who would be required to work in a team environment in delivering the secretarial needs of the global EY office senior management team such as diary management, calendar management, travel management, documentation, tool support and other administrative requirements that may arise on a need basis.
Role Details
Discipline: Executive Assistance CoE
Role Type: Assigned Support / Associate
Responsibilities
The primary role and responsibility of this position will be to work in a team environment and deliver administrative services including, but not limited to
Diary Management - Provide support to the project team members on maintaining and managing key project meetings and the meeting location
Calendar Management - Maintaining project teams calendar to showcase all key events that needs to be planned.
Meetings Management - Working closely with the project teams and other stakeholders in scheduling/organizing the meeting or conference call
Travel Management - Support the project team members in booking the travel tickets
Workshop or Area visit Plan - Help in planning the agenda, for workshops/area visits by handling the logistics of stay, food and printing, etc.
Documentation - Recording the minutes of the meeting with clear emphasis on the key action points from the meeting. Maintaining the project database and ensure all documentations are captured and organized for ease of access.
Training Management - Provide support in setting up training by sending out invites, enabling cut-off point for training sessions, issuing confirmations and/or offering alternative dates. Supplement delegates with correct pre-work and sessions
Tool Support and administration - Administrative support on various internal/external tools used across EY offices
Data Processing and administration - Data capture, processing and administration of business information
Skills and attributes for success
The role requires someone who can manage several concurrent activities, with strong multi-tasking, prioritization, organizational and time management skills.
Administration and organization
Enjoys problem solving

Description:
EYP Staff EYP Financial Restructuring Job Description
Support financial restructuring and turnaround advisory business development activities under the guidance of senior team members. Assist with proposal development support including:
Financial analysis of companies - reviews of historical and forecast performance, profitability, cash flows, working capital and capital structure
Support the team in understanding clients businesses, key financial trends, profitdrivers and potential areas of risk or improvement
Conduct desktop market and industry research, gather relevant data and summarize findings into meaningful insights
Assist with benchmarking analyses, including capital and debt mix, working capital levers, revenue trends and product performance
Prepare clear and well-structured Excel analysis, PowerPoint presentations and supporting reports for business development requirements.
Assist in preparing materials for client discussions, internal reviews and pursuit meetings.
Document the analysis and procedures performed, ensuring that work products are accurate, organized and aligned with project objectives.
Coordinate with team members across different service lines and locations to support data collection and timely project delivery.
Contribute ideas, ask relevant questions and work collaboratively with colleagues in a multicultural and multidisciplinary environment.
Demonstrate attention to detail, adaptability and a willingness to learn while managing assigned responsibilities and deadlines.
This internship provides hands-on exposure to financial restructuring, turnaround, capital advisory and transaction-related projects, supported by structured learning and coaching.
Candidate Profile
Ideal for candidates looking to start their career in finance
Strong academic foundation in finance, accounting and financial statement analysis.
Basic understanding of corporate finance concepts such as cash flow, working capital, debt, capital structure and business performance.
Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and draw logical conclusions.
Good desktop research skills and the ability to identify, organize and summarize relevant market and company information.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with an interest in developing financial analysis and presentation skills.
Knowledge of how to leverage AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot in a business setting would be an added advantage.
Ability to communicate clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce accurate, well-structured work.
Proactive, curious and willing to learn new concepts, industries and analytical approaches.
Able to work effectively both independently on assigned tasks and collaboratively as part of a project team.
Comfortable working across multiple tasks and adapting to changing project requirements and deadlines.
Prior internship, academic project or coursework in corporate finance, banking, restructuring, transactions or consulting would be an advantage but is not mandatory.
Familiarity with the MENA business environment, banking products or Islamic Finance would be an added advantage.
Fluency in English is required, while knowledge of Arabic would be an added advantage.

Experience doing secondary research using Google and other external sources like Factiva, Company Inforgator, BoardEx, OneSource etc

Private Equity/Investment Banking Industry experience preferable but not essential.

Job Summary
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.


EY- Assurance Senior
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.


The opportunity
We're looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.


Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on ones own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across ones aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead ones GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.


Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.


To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.


Ideally, you'll also have
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.


What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY - FB and Event Service Expert
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a banquet or event. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side. Our FB Service Experts is skilled in a wide range of event functions and able to take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests experience is well taken care of from start to finish.

Whether setting tables and event materials communicating with the kitchen, interacting, and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the FB Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintece needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.

Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Job Summary
The agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customers in resolving policy service needs, renewal collection to resolve policy holder's service needs, and cross-sale opportunities.


Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment: Develop various sources of agent hiring; build a team of agent pipeline.
Agent Development: Ensure product knowledge by AMLI ways of training; Field demonstration (FODs).
Meeting WFYP Business targets
Conducting Career Seminars for Agents
Communicating Agent RnR regularly
Meet Business Targets: Achievement of monthly, quarterly yearly business plans.
Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc.

Description:
Job Summary
The Regional Contracts & Supplier Governance Assistant Manager serves as a key enabler of effective contract management, supplier governance, and procurement compliance across the UK&I business. This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end contract lifecycle, supporting supplier onboarding and governance activities, and ensuring adherence to contractual, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
Acting as a central point of coordination between business stakeholders, Procurement, Risk, Finance, and suppliers, the Assistant Manager drives operational excellence through robust governance, process optimization, reporting, and continuous improvement. The role ensures that third-party engagements are managed efficiently, risks are mitigated, and supplier relationships deliver sustainable value and strategic business outcomes.
Your key responsibilities
Manage contract and supplier governance mailboxes, providing guidance and coordinating contract requests through to execution.
Draft, review, negotiate, and administer supplier contracts while ensuring compliance with procurement and governance requirements.
Oversee contract execution processes, including approvals, DocuSign workflows, and maintenance of executed agreements.
Maintain contract repositories, lifecycle trackers, renewals, and audit-ready documentation.
Support supplier onboarding, vendor enablement, and supplier due diligence activities.
Manage supplier governance programs, MSA renewals, performance reviews, and compliance obligations.
Ensure adherence to risk, compliance, and third-party governance frameworks, escalating issues where required.
Support procurement and sourcing activities, including supplier evaluations and governance approvals.
Prepare management reports, dashboards, and analytics on contracts, suppliers, compliance, and performance metrics.
Coordinate audit reviews, remediation activities, invoice governance, and payment-related issue resolution.
Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, stakeholder training, and continuous enhancement of contract management practices.
Ariba supply chain management life cycle
Skills and attributes for success
Demonstrates expertise in leveraging advanced analytics platforms and visualization tools (such as Power BI, ThoughtSpot, or similar) to transform raw data into actionable insights.
Skilled in designing interactive dashboards, reports, and visual narratives that enable stakeholders to quickly interpret trends, patterns, and performance metrics.
Presentation and facilitation skills - Ability to drive meetings, build presentations that interpret the data, creating valuable business insights and delivering the message to the stakeholders
Work under minimal direction/supervision - Be accountable for projects assigned, take complete ownership and drive projects end to end
Business acumen and Adaptability Capable of quickly understanding the needs of the business and be able to align with changing customer expectations
Quick learner - Ability to grasp or quickly understand the process, objectives / intricacies of projects and move to delivery mode in a short span
Attention to detail - Utmost importance to numbers, formatting etc.
Excellent Communication - Listening, reading, writing & speaking skills
MS Office skills: Advanced level experience in Excel reporting & PowerPoint.
Power BI/Other BI tools/ Alteryx - Data Integration and Data Visualization etc.
High degree of professionalism and integrity
To qualify for the role, you must have
Graduate / Post-graduate - (Business Administration, Information and Data Science) with 6 - 8 years work experience in professional services industry.
Strong understanding of data analytics, best practices when developing solutions and experience in solution development, specifically utilizing Microsoft Power Platform.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ideally, youll also have
The role demands expertise in Power BI and related Microsoft Power Platform tools, including PowerApps and Power Automate, to design, develop, and maintain robust data solutions. A strong work ethic, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to accuracy and timeliness are essential to ensure high-quality deliverables.
What we look for
Self-motivated towards continuous learning and upskilling.
Solution oriented - Ability to focus on solutions in case of ambiguity /uncertainties and not stuck with the problem.
Display a positive attitude, interest in learning new things, capability to work under pressure and thinking out of the box with strategic mindset.
Content management Familiar with maintenance of SharePoint, MS office (Excel and PowerPoint proficiency is a must)

Description:
Job Summary
In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a skilled Infrastructure Data Analyst to support and evolve EY's I&O data analytics and reporting capabilities globally. This is a unique role that bridges deep data analysis with practical infrastructure knowledge, enabling the firm to transform operational data from across its data center, compute, network, storage and observability platforms into actionable intelligence.
A key focus of this role is providing the analytical intelligence layer for the Hyperconverged Service Platform (HCSP) EY's next-generation infrastructure automation platform built on Kubernetes, Temporal and Terraform. The Data Analyst will own the measurement, reporting and continuous improvement analysis of HCSP's provisioning performance, workflow reliability, SLA attainment, drift detection efficacy and operational impact across EY's global data center estate directly enabling the platform team to measure success, identify failure patterns and demonstrate value.
Your key responsibilities
The I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst collects, processes and analyzes operational data from across EY's infrastructure platforms with a particular focus on HCSP platform telemetry transforming raw data from workflow orchestration systems, provisioning engines, log aggregation platforms, ITSM tools and capacity management systems into meaningful insights and visualizations.
The role requires a strong analytical skill set combined with sufficient infrastructure and platform automation awareness to understand the context of the data being analyzed. The analyst will serve as the analytical authority for HCSP KPI reporting tracking metrics such as provisioning SLA attainment, orchestrator failure rates, manual touchpoint reduction, rollback success rates and catalog drift elimination and will partner with the HCSP engineering team, I&O leadership and service management to drive a data-informed culture of continuous platform improvement.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong experience designing and delivering data analytics solutions using Power BI, including complex DAX measures, data models and report publishing.
Proficiency querying and analyzing data from ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) including KQL query development and Kibana dashboard creation.
Experience working with large, multi-source operational datasets and transforming them into executive and operational reporting.
Ability to analyze and report on platform automation data, including:
Workflow execution metrics
OPA policy evaluation outcomes and policy compliance trends
Drift detection signals
ServiceNow order intake volumes, ticket correlation
Good understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including:
Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
Virtualization platforms Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware
Kubernetes cluster concepts pods, namespaces, workloads and resource utilization
Network fundamentals VLANs, DNS, IP management
Storage and compute provisioning concepts
Experience with SQL or KQL for querying structured and semi-structured data sources.
Experience integrating data from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) into analytical reporting.
Familiarity with APM and monitoring tooling (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Prometheus or equivalent) as data sources.
Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion from multiple infrastructure and platform data sources.
Scripting capability to automate data extraction and transformation tasks:
Python (pandas, NumPy, requests)
PowerShell
Bash
Strong written and verbal communication skills able to present HCSP performance findings and SLA trend analysis to both technical and senior business audiences.
Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
Ability to work effectively with global engineering and service management teams across multiple time zones.
To qualify for the role, you must have experience with
Power BI report and dashboard development 57 years.
Power BI data modelling, DAX development and Power Query (M) transformations 57 years.
ELK stack data analysis Elasticsearch queries and Kibana dashboard development 35 years.
SQL data analysis and querying against operational data stores 57 years.
KPI definition, metric design and SLA/OLA reporting for platform or infrastructure services.
Data integration from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy or equivalent).
Working with infrastructure and platform automation monitoring data metrics, logs, workflow events and traces.
Building capacity planning and trend analysis reports for infrastructure and automation platforms.
Kubernetes and container platform telemetry consumption and analysis.
Workflow orchestration data analysis Temporal, Argo or equivalent execution logs and metrics.
OPA policy evaluation data analysis and compliance reporting.
Drift detection and configuration audit data analysis.
Windows Server and Linux operating system concepts sufficient to contextualize infrastructure data.
Virtualization platform familiarity (Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware vSphere or Azure Stack HCI).
Python scripting for data extraction, transformation and automation 35 years.
PowerShell scripting for Windows infrastructure data collection.
Executive reporting and stakeholder presentation delivery.
Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or equivalent cloud observability data sources (preferred).
Working with CMDB data to enrich infrastructure and platform analytics (preferred).
Ideally, you'll also have
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification (desired).
Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired).
Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) or Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (better to have).
ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics or Databricks (better to have).
Experience with Grafana or similar open-source visualization platforms.
Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel) as a telemetry standard for HCSP platform automation data.
Experience analyzing data from Temporal.io workflow execution APIs or audit logs.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
STS Cross-Function Reporting Analyst
EY Technology:
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 450,000 people in more than 160 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connect to our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated into the client services we deliver and are key to us being more innovative as an organization.
EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:
Client Technology (CT) focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
Enterprise Technology (ET) - ET supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. ET will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on better user experience.
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protects EY and client data, and our information management systems.
The opportunity
The Cross-Function Support Reporting Analyst partners closely across the Security Technology Services (STS) organization and Information Security to support and management of Security products and services. This includes analytics and reporting, service reviews, service improvements, service transition, introduction and readiness, and other activities as identified pertaining to end-to-end service management of internal security technology offerings.
Your key responsibilities
Analyse and interpret security tools data to generate various reports.
Develop and maintain dashboards and visualizations to present security metrics to stakeholders.
Collaborate with various security support teams to gather data and insights for reporting purposes.
Monitor reports and dashboard to ensure data accuracy and relevance.
Prepare regular and ad-hoc reports for management.
Identify trends and patterns in security data to inform decision-making.
Skills and attributes for success
Conceptual knowledge of security applications and technologies, as well as operating system platforms including Cloud technologies
Proficiency in Azure Cloud services, with a strong understanding of Azure security tools such as Azure Security Center, Azure Monitor, and Azure Sentinel
Advanced knowledge in Power BI and connecting it with various data sources, including Azure platform, SQL databases and other models.
Knowledge in scripting (Python) and API would be an added benefit
Analytical acumen and solution orientation to provide recommendations to teams and leaders in support of avoiding financial, operational, and security risks to EY and our customers
Build and maintain strong relationships across all levels of a matrixed, geographically and culturally dispersed organization
Possess knowledge of the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) to drive compliance in Incident, Problem, and Change processes and drive as necessary
To qualify for the role, you must have
Degree in Computer Science or related discipline, or equivalent work experience
5 - 7 years working within Information Technology in a global firm
Advance knowledge in Power BI and DAX
Knowledge of Azure Data Explorer, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Log Analytics
Working knowledge of data analysis programming or scripting languages, such as Python (with libraries like pandas, NumPy) or PowerShell
Experience with Azure SQL and database management systems for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Certifications in data visualization or analytics platforms.
What we look for
Critical thinking skills demonstrating analytical and systematic approach to problem solving, data quality validation, business insights generation
Experience working in a global virtual environment
Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills
Experience in Stakeholder Management Data Storytelling
Good judgment, tact, and decision-making ability
Ability to understand and integrate cultural differences and motives and to work with cross cultural teams.
Ability to deal with ambiguity and change, and exercise appropriate time management to meet deadlines
Ability to work autonomously but also within a team environment where necessary
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. :
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you
