Description:
Job Summary
Discipline: GDS Enablement Services Growth & Innovation
Role title: Quantum Senior Associate
The Quantum Senior Associate will play a hands-on delivery role across Quantum Technology initiatives, with stronger ownership for solution design, technical execution, stakeholder communication and delivery quality than an Associate role. The role requires practical experience in quantum-safe security and/or quantum computing, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business and delivery outcomes.
The role is expected to have a primary focus on quantum safety, including post-quantum cryptography readiness, and a secondary focus on quantum computing use cases such as optimization, machine learning and simulation.
Responsibilities
Support the development of quantum safety and quantum computing solutions, prototypes and demonstrations.
Contribute to post-quantum cryptography readiness assessments, including data gathering, analysis and documentation.
Develop and evaluate quantum algorithms and workflows for selected optimization, machine learning and simulation use cases.
Build and maintain software tools, accelerators and proof-of-concept assets using established engineering practices.
Prepare technical documentation, assessment reports and presentation materials for internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including cybersecurity, AI/ML, platform engineering and product teams.
Participate in testing, validation and benchmarking activities to assess solution performance and applicability.
Stay current on developments in quantum computing, post-quantum cryptography and related emerging technologies.
Quantum Specialist Responsibilities
Quantum Cyber / Safety:
Support quantum risk assessments and identify areas that may require future cryptographic modernization.
Assist in prototyping and benchmarking post-quantum cryptography algorithms within applications and services.
Contribute to analysis of quantum-safe and hybrid cryptographic approaches and document findings.
Support development of crypto-inventory and discovery capabilities to identify legacy cryptography dependencies.
Execute testing of hybrid key exchange mechanisms and document performance observations.
Assist with implementation and validation of crypto-agility patterns, certificate updates and key management enhancements.
Contribute to creation and maintenance of migration guides, standards documentation and operational runbooks.
Quantum Compute & Algorithms:
Develop and evaluate quantum algorithms using industry-standard quantum development platforms.
Support experimentation and testing to assess the practicality of quantum use cases.
Build proof-of-concept solutions for optimization, simulation and emerging Quantum + AI use cases.
Perform basic resource estimation and analysis of quantum circuits and algorithm performance.
Compare classical and quantum approaches and document observations and recommendations.
Maintain reproducible experimentation environments using Python, Jupyter notebooks, containers and source control tools.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements
Foundational understanding of quantum computing concepts, including qubits, gates, quantum circuits and current hardware limitations.
Basic understanding of post-quantum cryptography concepts, key encapsulation mechanisms, digital signatures and emerging standards.
Familiarity with cryptographic concepts such as public-key cryptography, certificates and secure communication protocols.
Experience with at least one quantum development platform such as Qiskit, PennyLane, Cirq, Azure Quantum or AWS Braket.
Proficiency in Python programming and familiarity with commonly used scientific and data analysis libraries.
Working knowledge of software development fundamentals, including version control and testing practices.
Ability to design and execute experiments, analyse results and communicate findings effectively.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work collaboratively in global, cross-functional teams.
Interest in emerging technologies and willingness to continuously learn new concepts and tools.
Education and Experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
25+ years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas:
Software development or engineering
Applied cryptography or cybersecurity
Data science, machine learning or advanced analytics
Quantum computing research or development
High-performance or scientific computing
Experience developing prototypes, proof-of-concepts or technical solutions using modern programming languages and frameworks.
Familiarity with Python and scientific computing libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, pandas or similar tools.
Exposure to quantum computing concepts, quantum software development kits or post-quantum cryptography is preferred but not mandatory.
Understanding of cybersecurity and cryptography fundamentals is desirable.
Experience working in agile, research or innovation-focused environments is advantageous.
Ability to independently complete assigned deliverables while collaborating effectively with senior team members.
Publications, hackathons, certifications, research projects or open-source contributions related to quantum technologies are beneficial but not required.
Willingness to work with global teams and support overlap with US East Coast hours when needed.

Description:
PROJECT MANAGER - PM Ekta Mall, Aizawl (EPC Project)

Company: Mayasheel Ventures Limited
Location: Aizawl, Mizoram (site-based)
Industry: Construction / EPC - Commercial Retail

About the Project:
Mayasheel Ventures Limited is the EPC contractor for PM Ekta Mall, Aizawl, a commercial mall project being executed for HITES (HLL Infra Tech Services, a subsidiary of HLL Lifecare Limited). The project covers full civil and MEP execution - including electrical, HVAC, fire protection, plumbing, lifts and allied services - delivered under detailed technical specifications, approved-makes and a consultant/client approval regime.

Role and Responsibilities:
- Lead overall site execution of the project: plan, coordinate and monitor civil and MEP works to meet project schedule, quality standards and contract specifications.
- Act as the primary point of contact with the client (HITES) and consultants: obtain approvals on shop drawings, materials/makes, deviations, and technical submissions in line with the contract's approved-makes and specification regime.
- Manage procurement and vendor coordination: float enquiries against BOQ, evaluate vendor quotations, follow up on material deliveries, and ensure ordered items match approved makes and specifications.
- Maintain drawing and BOQ discipline on site: work from the latest approved drawings and BOQs, flag mismatches between drawings, BOQ quantities and site conditions, and escalate variations for client approval before execution.
- Review and certify contractor/sub-contractor running bills and measurements; maintain documentation for billing, approvals and correspondence.
- Manage and mentor the site team (engineers, supervisors, surveyor/billing staff); allocate work, review daily progress and resolve site-level technical issues.
- Track project schedule, prepare progress reports, and coordinate sequencing between civil, electrical, HVAC, firefighting and other services to avoid rework.
- Ensure quality checks and safety practices on site in accordance with contract specifications and statutory requirements.
- Handle site logistics and planning in the Aizawl context, including material movement on hill roads, monsoon-impacted scheduling and remote-site resource planning.

Preferred Candidate Profile:
- B.E./B.Tech in Civil or Electrical/Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institute.
- 10+ years of experience in execution of commercial building projects (malls, hotels, hospitals or institutional buildings), with at least 3-5 years in a Project Manager or senior site leadership role on EPC projects.
- Strong working knowledge of both civil and MEP execution: electrical distribution, HVAC, fire protection, plumbing and building services coordination.
- Experience working under client/consultant approval systems - shop drawings, material approvals, approved-makes compliance, deviation approvals and specification-driven execution.
- Good command over BOQs, rate analysis, measurement/billing certification and vendor/sub-contractor management.
- Proficient in reading drawings (civil and services), MS Office/Excel; exposure to project scheduling tools preferred.
- Strong communication and coordination skills for client, consultant, vendor and team management.
- Willingness to be based full-time at the Aizawl site; prior experience of working in remote or difficult-terrain project locations will be an advantage.

Perks and Benefits:
- Accommodation provided by the company.
- Fooding (meals) provided by the company.
- Other benefits as per company policy.

Description:
Title Counsellor - Opioid Substitution Therapy (OST)
Location: YRG MERF Integrated Care Clinic, Aizawl, Mizoram
Organisation: YR Gaitonde Medical Educational Research Foundation (YRGMERF)


Job Summary

Key Responsibilities
A. OST counselling (as per NACO OST guidelines) - Pre-induction counselling: assess readiness, explain OST, its benefits and limits, and obtain informed consent for treatment.
Ongoing counselling on adherence, dose-related concerns, craving, relapse prevention and lifestyle change.
Counselling on take-home doses, safe storage and responsible use, where applicable.
Risk-reduction counselling on HIV, hepatitis B and C, STIs and TB; promote safe injecting practices and overdose prevention.
Referral and follow-up for HIV testing (ICTC), ART, hepatitis care, TB (NTEP), mental health and de-addiction services; confirm that referrals are completed.
Family and partner counselling, and support groups for clients and caregivers, with the clients consent.
Use the monthly irregular / pre-LFU list to follow up clients by phone and through the linked IDU Targeted Intervention; document tracking outcomes.
Maintain counselling records and update registers and SOCH/MIS entries on time.
Uphold confidentiality and the rights of clients under the HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017.
Young people on OST - Offer youth-friendly, non-judgemental counselling suited to young adults who are new to treatment.
Address issues common to this group - family conflict, peer pressure, education and livelihood, relationships, sexual health and mental health.
Work with outreach staff and peer educators to bring in and retain young clients.
Open trial functions - Complete Good Clinical Practice (GCP) / Human Subjects Protection training before taking up any study task.
Explain the study to eligible clients in plain Mizo or English and support the informed consent process as set out in the protocol.
Deliver counselling sessions exactly as specified in the study manual; record each session on the fidelity checklist.
Administer study questionnaires and complete case report forms accurately and on schedule.
Support participant retention - appointment reminders, tracing of missed visits and follow-up as per the protocol.
Report adverse events, protocol deviations and client distress to the Medical Officer and Study Coordinator without delay.
Keep study participants data confidential and stored as per the studys data management plan.
Protecting study integrity (no contamination) - Use study materials, messages and tools only with enrolled study participants and only as the protocol allows.
Do not share study content with non-study clients, other staff, peer workers or outside organisations.
Keep study counselling and routine OST counselling clearly separate in records and in practice.
Raise any doubt about what may or may not be shared with the Study Coordinator before acting.
Team and reporting - Take part in daily clinic huddles, weekly case reviews and study team meetings.
Submit monthly counselling and study activity reports.
Carry out any other task assigned by the clinic in-charge in line with the programme.


Requirements
Essential (in line with NACO norms for NACP counsellors) - Either: Postgraduate degree in Psychology, Social Work, Sociology, Anthropology, Human Development or Nursing, with at least 1 year of counselling experience in the health sector; Or: Graduate degree in the same disciplines, with at least 3 years of counselling experience in the health sector.
Fluency in Mizo (spoken and written) and working knowledge of English.
Basic computer skills - MS Office, email and data entry.
Desirable - Experience of counselling at an OST centre, IDU Targeted Intervention, de-addiction or harm reduction setting.
Experience of working with young people. Prior experience in a research study; GCP certification. NACO / SACS counsellor training.
Candidates from the community of people who use drugs or people living with HIV who meet the criteria are encouraged to apply.


Personal Attributes
Non-judgemental, empathetic and comfortable working with people who use drugs.
Disciplined in following protocols and keeping accurate records.
Trustworthy with confidential information.
Able to work in a team and with flexible hours when the clinic needs it.

Description:
Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodical improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.
Requirements
Desirable Attributes: Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Flexibility to travel extensively within the assigned region.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced MEP Engineer (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) to oversee and manage MEP works for a government building project under the EPC mode. The candidate will be responsible for planning, execution, coordination, quality control, site supervision, and timely completion of all MEP activities in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
Key Responsibilities

Manage day-to-day MEP site activities, including electrical, plumbing, firefighting, HVAC, and other building services.
Review and coordinate MEP drawings, technical specifications, BOQs, and installation layouts.
Supervise site engineers, technicians, subcontractors, and vendors to ensure proper execution of MEP works.
Coordinate with civil, structural, architectural, and other project teams to avoid clashes and ensure smooth execution.
Liaise with government officials, clients, consultants, and contractors for inspections, approvals, and technical clearances.
Monitor material procurement, consumption, manpower, and resource utilization to ensure cost-effective execution.
Ensure proper installation, testing, commissioning, and handover of all MEP systems.
Maintain quality standards and ensure compliance with applicable codes, safety regulations, and approved project specifications.
Prepare progress reports, measurement sheets, billing documents, and material reconciliation reports.
Identify and resolve technical issues and ensure timely completion of MEP works as per the project schedule.

Candidate Requirements
B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in building construction.
Experience in government projects and EPC execution preferred.
Good knowledge of MEP drawings, BOQs, billing, and site execution.
Strong coordination, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in hill-area or sloping terrain projects will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate
A hands-on professional capable of independently managing MEP site operations, coordinating with multiple teams, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring timely project delivery.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Cost Expert
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 4 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Biomedical Engineering/Medical electronics or Electronic.
-Certifications in cost analysis or financial planning preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum of 15 years of experience in cost analysis of medical equipment or related fields.
-At least 7 years of experience in the medical or healthcare sector.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 2 projects.
-Experience working on Japanese ODA Loan Projects in any sector.
-At least 1 year of experience in SAARC or ASEAN regions (preferable).
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
-Strong knowledge of procurement processes and cost optimization techniques.

Role Responsibilities:
Cost Estimation Budgeting:
-Lead the estimation of preliminary project equipment costs during the basic design phase, ensuring accurate forecasting of all associated costs.
-Develop cost models and prepare detailed cost estimates for medical equipment procurement and installation.
-Identify and quantify the costs related to equipment, components, consumables, transportation, and installation work, ensuring that the budget is comprehensive and aligned with project objectives.
Survey Data Collection:
-Conduct surveys of existing or similar healthcare facilities to gather information on operational and maintenance costs of medical equipment.
-Assess the existing equipment in operational facilities to understand their functionality, lifespan, and associated costs to make informed decisions.
-Collect data on the cost of spare parts, consumables, and other supplies necessary for the proper functioning of medical equipment.
Evaluation of Local Distributors Service Providers:
-Survey local distributors for warranty services, maintenance contract availability, and pricing.
-Evaluate the reliability and service offerings of local vendors, ensuring they meet the operational needs of the project and provide cost-effective maintenance solutions.
Cost Breakdown Analysis:
-Collect and analyze detailed data on equipment-related costs, including main components, consumables, transportation costs, turnkey work, maintenance contracts, and other related services.
-Ensure a thorough understanding of all cost components and provide a comprehensive cost breakdown for each equipment item.
-Collaborate with procurement teams to optimize cost-efficiency and select the best value options for the project.
Tender Evaluation Compliance:
-Assist the Project Management Unit (PMU) in evaluating financial documents related to equipment tenders, ensuring that the costs are in line with the project s financial goals.
-Review tender submissions for compliance with project specifications, budget constraints, and cost-effectiveness.
-Provide recommendations on cost optimization and value for money, ensuring that all financial aspects of the tender align with project needs.
Cost Reporting Documentation:
-Prepare and maintain detailed reports on cost estimations, budgets, and financial evaluations related to medical equipment.
-Ensure that all cost reports are accurately documented and available for review by the project team and stakeholders.
-Track and report any changes in cost projections, identifying areas where cost savings or adjustments can be made.
Collaboration with Project Stakeholders:
-Work closely with the project team, including procurement specialists and clinical engineers, to align equipment cost management with overall project goals.
-Provide regular updates on cost estimations, procurement strategies, and cost optimization efforts to senior management and stakeholders.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Educational Qualifications

Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Description:
About the company

Treebo Hospitality Ventures (THV) is a hotel group operating with a mission of "democratising
the joy of travel". We focus on the affordable segments of the market economy to
mid-market to cater to the next 100 million travellers who will experience the joy of travel
over the next 10 years. We offer these guests a high-quality experience at an affordable price
point, with a portfolio of 800+ hotels across 120+ cities.
We operate through multiple brands catering to different sub-segments:
Itsy (1000–1500)
Treebo and Treebo Premium (1500–3000)
Medalio, our newly launched affordable luxury brand (3000–6000 per night)

We are the most loved hotel chain in the affordable segment, with an average rating of 7.8/10
across independent review platforms — and we are just getting started

About the Role
As an Area General Manager, you will be responsible for executing the companys strategic vision of
democratizing the joy of travel. You will be responsible for a given area and the portfolio there in to ensure
highest levels of guest experience, product quality and business & profitability of the assets. While managing
the operations and enabling sales for your portfolio, you will also drive the expansion of our hotel portfolio
across your area and beyond through your network. This is a mission critical role that requires a perfect
balance of delivering operational excellence, relationship management, and a business development mindset.

Key Responsibilities
1) Operational Excellence Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple hotel properties in your area, ensuring adherence to
brand standards and service benchmarks
Drive compliance with Treebo's brand standards and SOPs, health and safety guidelines, and service
quality norms
Conduct audits, quality assurance checks, and drive corrective/preventive actions through hotel partners
to maintain Treebo standards
Act as the key liaison between the company and hotel partners, ensuring seamless coordination and
timely issue resolution
Monitor and enhance overall guest satisfaction by ensuring prompt and effective service recovery
mechanisms
2) Business Development & Growth
Identify, evaluate, and onboard new hotel properties to expand the company’s portfolio within the
assigned area
Negotiate terms of the agreement and ensure complete alignment with Treebo's operating procedures
before onboarding any hotel
Collaborate with the central business development team to oversee launch process of the signed
properties
3) Sales & MICE
Drive regional sales performance by collaborating with internal sales teams and property owners to
achieve revenue targets for your portfolio
Identify and push sales POCs to close MICE deals for your portfolio properties
Support pricing, promotions, and campaigns to drive business at the property level
Engage with local corporate clients, event organizers, and travel planners to push business to your
portfolio if needed
4) Team & Partner Management
Lead, mentor, and develop on-ground portfolio hotel teams to deliver exceptional guest experience in the
segment
Train hotel staff in brand values, SOPs, and customer service skills to ensure consistency
Build strong relationships with hotel owners and partners to foster collaboration and long-term association

What Are We Looking For
Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
4–6 years of experience in hospitality management with demonstrated success in both operations and
business development.
Proven experience in property acquisition and/or sales in hospitality.
Knowledge and experience in the MICE segment is highly desirable.
Analytical mindset with problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned geography.
Entrepreneurial approach with a strong focus on execution and accountability

AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Associate Regional Manager to join our team at Axis Max Life Insurance Limited. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in the insurance industry and excellent leadership skills.


Roles and Responsibility
Develop and implement regional business strategies to achieve sales targets and expand market share.
Lead and manage a team of sales professionals to ensure they meet their targets and provide coaching and training as needed.
Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including branch managers, agents, and customers.
Analyze market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities and threats.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and launch new products and services.
Monitor and control expenses to ensure profitability and efficiency.


Job Requirements
Proven experience in a similar role within the insurance industry.
Strong understanding of life insurance products and services.
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to analyze data and make informed decisions.
Strong problem-solving and negotiation skills.
Experience in managing and developing high-performing teams.

About the Role:

The Branch Head (BH) is responsible for coordinating and overseeing all branch operations and implementing strategies to increase productivity and performance levels in order to achieve the branchs financial targets. They are responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning of the branch and its compliance with the rules and regulations. They should maintain good relations with the key account holders of the Bank to ensure deepening of accounts and thus generating revenue.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure efficient daily operation of a branch, including lending, product sales and customer service in accordance with the banks objectives
Prepare the plan for the growth of branch business in consultation with the Cluster Head
Implement the plan through the Branch team so as to achieve the top line goals
Establish and strengthen relations with key customers (e.g. top 10%) to generate sustained business.
Review daily/ periodic reports (e.g. overdrawn accounts, temporary overdrafts, cash retention limit, office accounts, etc.) and take proactive action to ensure profitable and ethical business.
Ensure audit related deliverables, both internal and external are met as per the prescribed norms
Ensure compliance with due processes and guidelines
Create a performance oriented environment leading to high employee motivation and productivity
Ensure that all staff are adequately trained on the products of the bank, sales processes and various policies of the bank
Resolve, report any disruptions (e.g. strike or local disturbance) and take appropriate action to ensure that the branch operations are run smoothly.
Liaison with the cluster office and other branch offices to ensure the smooth management of operations and the achievement of overall business goals.
Ensure proper upkeep of branch premises and assets including safety and security

Qualifications:

Optimal qualification for success on the job is:
Graduate/ MBA (Marketing) preferred from a recognized institute
NCFM and AMFI Certifications
10-15 years of experience in the BFSI sector

Role Proficiencies:

For successful execution of the job, the candidate should possess the following:
Knowledge of banking products and services
Knowledge of regulatory guidelines and norms
Good communication (both verbal and written) skill in both English and the local language
Ability to manage complex client situations
Ability to manage risk and uncertainty for self and team within a dynamic priority-setting environment
Ability to handle pressure and meet deadlines

Managing complete claims operation & end to end process.

Job Purpose:
Responsiblefor evaluating and underwriting loan applications received via digitalchannels. Focus on quick, accurate decisioning with policy adherence, KYCverification, fraud checks, and coordination with stakeholders to achieveseamless, paperless disbursements.

Evaluate digital loan applications within definedturnaround time (TAT) using scorecards and policy rules.

Strong analyticaland decision-making skills.
Knowledge ofretail lending credit policies and scorecards.
Proficiency indigital KYC, fraud control, and MIS tools.
Attention todetail and compliance orientation.
Educational Qualifications and Experience:
Graduate /Post-Graduate in Finance, Commerce, or related field.
13 years incredit appraisal/underwriting; experience in digital/fintech lending preferred.

Job Summary
Job Purpose: Creating a strong and compliant sales culture across the channel to drive acquisitions, profitability and employee development. Culture Anchor: Work Hard - Consistently puts in effort. Plans and tracks daily progress to achieve targets. Execute with Rigor - Takes responsibility for meeting targets with focus and effort. Own It - Maintains honesty and fairness in all interactions in line with organization's policies. Act with Integrity.
Responsibilities
Managing and supporting the effective deployment of team of sales professionals with respect to that geographical area, exploring new markets and in allocating resources to most profitable opportunities.
Achieving and exceeding business goals.
Creating a strong and compliant sales culture across the channel to drive acquisitions, profitability and employee development.
Meeting up with CAT A builders and getting their projects approved with BAFL.
Negotiation with the builders for getting business in a cost effective manner.
Identifying the need of sales training, analyzing changing market trends, channel deployment etc. Also giving feedback and suggestions to the RSM.
Ensure implementation of promotional plans and contests and suggesting new and innovating promotion plan for the area of work.
Recruiting and retaining high performers.
Ensuring highest levels of employee relationship, motivation and engagement to drive results and high levels of employee satisfaction.
Ensuring that goals, PMP discussions, Development Plan discussions, ongoing coaching and feedback, skip level meetings is done on time and in an effective manner.
Effectively engage Operations and Risk teams to understand and contribute to overall processes and profitability across locations.
Sales and Collect Model - Managing collections of the acquired portfolio.
Required Qualifications and Experience
a) Qualifications: Graduates with relevant sales experience of 1-3 years (also graduates with experience of 8-10 years may apply).
b) Work Experience: Graduates with relevant sales experience of 1-3 years (also graduates with experience of 5-6 years may apply) in managing large sales channels in multiple market environments / corporate sales experience.
Prior and relevant experience in the Financial Services Industry, with specific experience of Personal Loans, Business Loans/ loans against / purchase of commercial properties.
Demonstrated success and achievement orientation.
Excellent communication skills.
Strong bias for action and driving results in a high performance environment.
Demonstrated ability to lead from the front.
Excellent relationship skills.
Strong analytical skills to drive channel performance and drive profitability.
High motivational levels and needs to be a self-starter.
Working knowledge of Excel.

To know and develop proficiency in handling internal company software platforms, ie. iCABS, SCP and any other systems that may be introduced.
Must have a good knowledge of the branch territory.
To ensure that the Service Companion usage is maximised for all the service deliveries & should be always above 95%
Organisation of schedule and planning of all service (including contracts, jobbing, call outs, etc.) requirements on a daily, weekly and monthly basis for all technicians within the branch
To ensure that all the service companion devices are active and in use. All the devices should be active 100% at any given point of time
Priority-wise planning of all due for Renewals visits, enquiries, call outs and complaints. Pending visits should be negligible (Service backlogs). Emphasis on "On Time planning
Liaise with the Sales and Service team to best accommodate urgent service visit appointments and communicate changes to affected customers timely.
Ensure customer service-related complaints or termination notifications/STOP Services are attended to effectively and promptly.
Manage service documentation and ensure all customer/technician s feedback are followed up with actions
Enter correct (error free) consumption data and TOS in the SCP to ensure command centre account profitability reflects correct data customer wise.
Ensure all service data from dockets, log cards, service orders and other sources is updated accurately into business systems in timely manner
Coordinate with the IT team for new users, device issues etc.
Supports business transition from paper-based to system and digital-based planning, visit documents, whilst upholding documentation integrity. Follow callout process so as to ensure that the complaints are delivered only after raising the ticket
Review service reports with OM, OE and BM and highlight areas of concern critical backlog and weekly trend to manager.
Reviews and provides service compliance updates daily.
Assist & help AOM / OM / Assistant Branch Manager / Branch Manager in monitoring Technician service productivity and efficiency related KPIs
Maintain positive working relationship and effective communication with Sales & Service Colleagues, Supervisor, Technician, Operations staff for any service related issues. Coordinate with Sales for any available slots, time adjustment for new sales scheduling
Work with branch management to correct service areas distributed across the business based on annual revenue from areas, time on site, travel time & routine requirements
Utilise the Route technicians for jobbing only after the route technicians routine services are delivered
Expected to be knowledgeable about company safety policies and safety (SRA) requirements on the job, be able to read and understand company policies
Any unresolved issues should be quickly elevated to the next level of management for prompt resolution
Any other similar duties as and when specified by the manager
  REPORTING
Daily, weekly & monthly (SOS) State of Service for Branch. Residential GSS SOS should also be the priority
Weekly reporting of pending jobs, ageing profiles to ABM/BM
Monthly reporting of technician wise trends.
Maintain State of Service and productivity data per technician
Maintain visibility on complaints received and report on all call outs / critical incidents received from branch.
Annual Leave planning of technicians
Ensure that each technician service productivity is achieved as per set targets
Key Result Areas:
On time service planning with ZERO pending services every month
Monitoring SCP active devices & Usage on weekly basis
Minimum expectancy on SCP active device(100%) & usage >95%
Achieving progressive improvement in State of Service (SOS) and meet SOS targets assigned by the branch
Minimizing service backlog (meet our contractual obligations)
  Competencies (Skills essential to the role):
Be decisive
Attention to details and accuracy
Planning & organizing
Analytical skills
Customer oriented
Negotiation skills
Ability to work patiently in a dynamic service environment
  Educational Qualification / Other Requirement:
Minimum graduation with 1 to 3 years of relevant experience of managing team
Basic computer skills - for reporting/work management (Advanced computer skills would be an added advantage)
Communication - speaking on phone to external customers & internally with technicians, other Operations colleagues.
Knowledge of territory which is handled for planning
Occasional Travel required within the Division
Liaise with the Operations Manager, Operations Executive, Service Supervisors to establish service requirements and provide information, assurance and advice as required
Communicate all service issues in a timely manner to the ABM/BM, Operations Manager

Description:
FACTORY HEAD

Role Purpose
The Factory Head will have full responsibility for the Cuddalore (Tamil Nadu) manufacturing facility, leading all plant operations to deliver safe, compliant, cost-effective and quality production from continuous extraction processes. The role owns plant P&L-linked targets, people leadership and statutory compliance, and drives operational excellence and capacity growth.
Key Responsibilities
Plant Operations & Production
Lead end-to-end plant operations: production, maintenance, utilities, quality, warehouse and dispatch.
Ensure uninterrupted, optimised running of continuous extraction processes to meet production plans, yield and throughput targets.
Drive process optimisation, debottlenecking and capacity enhancement; reduce solvent losses, energy and conversion costs.
Quality, Safety, Health & Environment
Build and sustain a strong safety culture; ensure zero-incident operations, with particular attention to solvent handling, pressure systems and process safety.
Ensure compliance with Factories Act, Pollution Control Board norms, hazardous chemicals rules and all applicable statutory and environmental regulations.
Maintain quality systems and ensure adherence to product specifications, customer requirements and audit readiness (ISO and other certifications).
Cost, Budget & Performance
Prepare and manage the plant budget; control manufacturing cost, raw material consumption and inventory.
Track and review KPIs: yield, OEE, downtime, cost per unit, safety and quality metrics.
Projects & Technology
Lead expansion, debottlenecking and new-process commissioning projects from planning through stabilisation.
Work with R&D, technical and corporate teams on scale-up, technology transfer and continuous improvement (Lean, Six Sigma, TPM).
People & Stakeholder Management
Lead, mentor and develop the plant leadership team and workforce; build succession depth.
Maintain cordial industrial relations and engagement with employees, contractors, unions (if any), local authorities and the community.
Coordinate with Corporate, Supply Chain, Sales and Procurement to align plant output with business needs.
Candidate Profile
Education
B.E./B.Tech in Chemical Engineering (mandatory). M.Tech or MBA is an added advantage.
Experience
Around 20 years of experience in chemical process industries, with a significant tenure as Plant Head / Factory Head / Site Head.
Hands-on experience in extraction processes and in continuous process manufacturing.
Industry background restricted to Agrochemicals or Extraction industries. Candidates from other sectors will not be considered.
Skills & Competencies
Strong command of process engineering, plant operations and troubleshooting in continuous extraction.
Proven track record in process safety, statutory compliance and environmental management.
Experience in capex projects, expansion and commissioning.
Cost and P&L orientation, with strong analytical and decision-making ability.
Leadership, team building and stakeholder management at senior level.

Description:
1. Customer Complaint Management
- Receive, analyze, and respond to customer complaints within the agreed timeline.
- Coordinate containment, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions.
- Prepare and submit 8D reports, 5-Why analysis, and other customer-required reports.
- Ensure effectiveness verification and obtain customer closure approval.
2. Customer Quality Assurance
- Ensure products meet customer drawings, specifications, standards, and quality requirements.
- Monitor PPM, rejection rates, warranty claims, and field failure trends.
- Establish containment and corrective actions to prevent defective parts reaching customers.
- Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements and quality agreements.
3. Customer Audits and Visits
- Plan and coordinate customer audits, assessments, and plant visits.
- Ensure audit readiness, documentation availability, and closure of audit findings.
- Present quality performance, improvement activities, and corrective action status.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams to address customer observations.
4. New Product Development (NPD) and Launch Quality
- Review customer quality requirements during new product development.
- Coordinate APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, and validation activities, as applicable.
- Ensure process readiness, product validation, traceability, and error-proofing before launch.
- Coordinate safe launch and enhanced inspection until the required approval and stability criteria are met.
5. Cross-Functional and Supplier Coordination
- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Materials, Supplier Quality, RD, and Marketing.
- Drive supplier corrective actions for customer-related component issues.
- Ensure defective material segregation, replacement, traceability, and disposition.
- Monitor action owners and timelines until effective closure.
6. Quality Performance and Continuous Improvement
- Track customer PPM, complaints, rejection costs, warranty, and repeat failures.
- Prepare monthly quality performance reports and management reviews.
- Identify recurring issues and implement horizontal deployment across similar products and processes.
- Drive lessons learned, defect prevention, and continual improvement initiatives.
India Nippon Electricals is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in the design, development, and implementation of innovative electrical solutions for automotive applications. The Senior Engineer will be responsible for leading projects from concept through to completion, ensuring that all engineering deliverables meet quality, reliability, and performance standards.

Key Responsibilities
Design, configure, implement, and maintain healthcare integration solutions connecting company products with Electronic Health Records (EHRs), Patient Administration Systems (PAS), Laboratory Systems, National Platforms, and other healthcare applications.
Develop and support interfaces using healthcare interoperability standards including HL7 v2, FHIR, APIs, and related technologies.
Engage directly with stakeholders, hospital ICT teams, clinical users, and third-party suppliers to gather requirements and define integration approaches.
Lead technical integration activities throughout the project lifecycle, from discovery and design through testing, go-live, and post-implementation support.
Collaborate with internal Product, Engineering, Delivery, and Customer Success teams across multiple geographies to ensure successful customer outcomes.
Perform interface testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure data quality, reliability, and interoperability.
Investigate and resolve integration issues relating to connectivity, messaging, data transformation, and workflow processes.
Produce and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including interface specifications, solution designs, test plans, and support procedures.
Support customer upgrades, migrations, and enhancement projects as required.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across T-Pro's implementation and integration practices.
Build strong working relationships with healthcare customers and provide a high standard of technical support and customer service.
Assist with product testing and validation activities where required.
Required Skills and Experience
3+ years experience in systems integration, interface development, or technical implementation roles.
Experience working within healthcare environments or with healthcare software solutions.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards including HL7 v2, FHIR, SMART on FHIR, APIs, and web services.
Experience working with integration engines such as Mirth Connect (NextGen Connect) or similar platforms.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL.
Experience troubleshooting technical issues across distributed systems and multiple stakeholders.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong customer-facing and stakeholder management capabilities.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver projects within agreed timelines.
Demonstrated problem-solving skills and a proactive, customer-focused approach.
Ability and willingness to work primarily in Irish business hours (GMT/BST) to support customer projects, meetings, go-live activities, and operational requirements.
A commitment to continuous improvement and a collaborative approach to working across teams.

Title: Zonal Sales Manager
Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Channel SalesZonal Salespaint protection filmCeramic CoatingPPF, B2BDealer DevelopmentFranchisee DevelopmentNetwork DevelopmentNetwork ExpansionBusiness ExpansionDistribution NetworkWindow TintsSun films, About company, Ceramic Pro (a brand under Saboo Automotive Private Limited) is a global leader in advanced nano-ceramic coatings and automotive surface protection solutions.
Description:
We are looking for a highly driven Zonal Sales Manager to drive zonal sales, channel expansion and the development of our premium franchise and dealer network across key national hubs.

This is a field-intensive Individual Contributor (IC) and managerial role, involving direct sales responsibilities and leadership of a team of 2 to 3 members.

Employment Type: Full-Time | Hybrid | 6 Days (MondaySaturday)

1. Mandatory Industry & Product Experience

Candidates must have 5 to 10 years of core and zonal sales experience within South 2 zone comprising of the states Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Puducherry, Andaman & Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep, specifically in the Automotive Detailing Industry, with direct sales/channel exposure to the following product categories:
Ceramic Coatings
Graphene Coatings
Paint Protection Films (PPF)
Automotive Window Films / Window Tints / Sun Films

Strict Eligibility Criteria: Experience in general automotive sales, automobile dealerships, car accessories, auto components or unrelated automotive products will NOT be considered relevant unless accompanied by direct sales experience in the automotive detailing products mentioned above.

Candidates without relevant automotive detailing industry experience are requested NOT to apply.

2. Sales & Channel Management
Proven experience in channel/distribution sales, territory management and dealer/franchise network development.
Ability to drive business growth, develop customer relationships and achieve zonal sales targets.
Experience in managing and leading a team of 2 to 3 members while independently driving sales closures.

3. Travel & Territory Requirements
Willingness to travel extensively, with an expected 15 to 20 travel days per month across assigned zonal hubs and territories.
Travel expenses will be covered as per the Company's Travel Allowance Policy.
The role will primarily be territory-focused, involving dealer/customer meetings, business development, relationship management and sales closures.
Occasional visits to Hyderabad may be required for business reviews, meetings, training or other organizational requirements. Wherever possible, such visits will be communicated in advance.

4. Location & Initial Training
Permanent relocation to Hyderabad is NOT required.
Selected candidates must be willing to undergo an initial 15 to 30-day training period at our Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad office.
The training duration will be mutually discussed and agreed upon during the interview process.

5. Language Proficiency
Fluency in English, Hindi and the relevant local language(s) is mandatory.
Strong professional communication skills are essential for interacting with dealers, distributors, customers and stakeholders in the premium automobile segment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales & Revenue Growth
Own end-to-end sales and revenue generation for Ceramic Pro and Kavaca across the SOUTH 2 Zone: Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Puducherry, Andaman & Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep.
Develop sales strategies, identify business opportunities, strengthen existing accounts and drive consistent revenue growth aligned with company objectives.

2. Network Expansion & Development
Identify, evaluate, onboard and develop a strong network of detailing studios, PPF installers, car dealerships and franchise partners.
Expand market presence, improve product penetration and build a sustainable partner network.

3. Partnership & Relationship Management
Build and maintain long-term relationships with franchisees, automotive detailers, workshops, dealerships and car enthusiast communities.
Understand partner requirements, strengthen engagement, resolve operational challenges and maximize sales potential.

4. Product Knowledge & Technical Awareness
Educate partners on the applications, benefits and fundamentals of Ceramic Pro's ceramic coatings and Kavaca's PPF products.
Coordinate with technical teams to ensure adequate product knowledge, application awareness, quality standards and consistent customer experience.

5. Sales Target Achievement
Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets through territory planning, partner engagement, lead conversion and business development.
Track sales performance, identify gaps, implement corrective actions and drive revenue growth.

6. Market Intelligence & Business Development
Monitor regional market trends, customer preferences, competitor activities, pricing and emerging business opportunities.
Identify potential franchise locations and sales channels, and recommend strategies to strengthen brand visibility, competitive positioning and market share.

7. Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with technical, marketing, operations and customer support teams to facilitate partner onboarding, product training, promotional activities and ongoing business support.
Ensure effective coordination to address partner requirements, resolve business challenges and execute sales and network expansion initiatives.

Company Overview
Saboo Automotive Pvt. Ltd. is a well-established and trusted name in the automotive industry. One of our fastest-growing verticals is the premium vehicle protection segment, where we proudly represent two globally renowned brands:
Ceramic Pro: The global pioneer in advanced nanoceramic surface protection coatings, present in over 55 countries with a network of 2,500+ professionals.
Kavaca: Premium paint protection films (PPF) and advanced window films engineered for superior performance.
With an existing network of 60+ express centers (franchises) across India, we are entering an exciting phase of aggressive expansion.

Learn more at https://ceramicpro.co.in/
AboutCompany:
Ceramic Pro (a brand under Saboo Automotive Private Limited) is a global leader in advanced nano-ceramic coatings and automotive surface protection solutions.

With operations in over 55 countries and a network of 2,500+ detailing professionals, Ceramic Pro offers premium products including ceramic coatings, paint protection films, and window films. The brand is known for innovation, quality, and setting new benchmarks in automotive care.

Description:
What you ll do:
Manage the research, design, and development of critical components for Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear. Drive innovation, compliance, and industrialization to strengthen the competitiveness of MV Switchgear portfolio.
"-Supervise VCB, RMU, AIS and GIS design activities for MV Switchgear
-Define and approve type and prototype test plans covering MV Switchgear components
-Coordinate type testing with accredited labs (KEMA, CESI, GCC Lab) and oversee in-house prototype validation.
-Lead root cause analysis of failures and ensure effective corrective measures across both product families.
-Guarantee compliance with IEC / 100 / 102 / 103 / 200 standards as well as customer-specific and utility requirements.
-Maintain technical documentation supporting certifications, approvals, and type testing for both MV Switchgear projects.
-Utilize DFMEA and reliability engineering methods to strengthen robustness and long-term quality of Switchgear components.
-Coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain, electrical, and quality teams to ensure industrialization of components for both MV Switchgear.
-Collaborate with suppliers and RD institutions to localize and qualify components, reducing costs and lead times across both product lines.
-Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them
-Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions.
-Deliver the required results in timely manner with required quality and cost.
-Must make a tangible difference to his area of operation. and exceed business expectations."

Description:
(i) To advise the concerned departments in planning and organizing measures necessary for Safe Work Practices for all employees thus prevent personal injuries.
(ii) To implement Work Permit System across the Plant and create awareness on importance adhering to Safe Work Practices.
(iii) To carry our Safety Audit periodically and evaluate the effectiveness of the action taken or proposed to be taken to prevent personal injuries.
(iv) To ensure availability of personal protective equipment and usage appropriately.
(v) To advise on matters relating to carrying out of plant safety inspections.
(vi) To carry out plant safety inspections in order to observe the physical conditions of work and the work practices and procedures followed by workers and to render advise on measures to be adopted for removing the unsafe physical conditions and preventing unsafe actions by workers.
(vii) To render assistance on matters relating to reporting and investigation of industrial accidents and occupational diseases.
(viii) To encourage reporting of Near Miss and Potential hazard and address all those observations to prevent incident/accident.
(ix) To render assistance for the cases of industrial diseases contracted and in respect of dangerous occurrences reportable under rule 106 of the Pondicherry Factories Rules, 1964.
(x) To render assistance on the maintenance of such records as are necessary relating to accidents, dangerous occurrences and industrial diseases.
(xi) To conduct safety committee meeting periodically and address all such observation.
(xii) To organize in association with the concerned departments, campaigns, competitions, contests and other activities which will develop and maintain the interest of the workers in establishing and maintaining safe conditions of work and procedure; and
(xiii) to design and conduct either independently or in collaboration with the training department, suitable training and educational programs for the prevention of personal injuries and for the propagation of safety awareness.
xiv) To work for obtaining the certification of EOHS, ESG and GreenCo.
The Safety Officer will be responsible for ensuring the safety and health of all employees within the organization. This role includes developing, implementing, and overseeing safety programs and policies to maintain compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. The Safety Officer will conduct regular safety inspections, risk assessments, and audits to identify potential hazards in the workplace. This position requires the development and delivery of safety training programs to enhance employee awareness and compliance. The Safety Officer will also investigate accidents and incidents, prepare reports, and recommend corrective actions to prevent future occurrences.

Description:
About the Role:
The role involves coordinating activities related to new product introductions within the organization. It emphasizes ensuring that components are ready for production and managing the overall process of product rollouts. The position will require active engagement with cross-functional teams to facilitate smooth transitions from development to manufacturing.

About the Team:
You will be working with a dynamic and collaborative cross-functional team consisting of members from engineering, production, and quality assurance. The team is focused on driving innovation and efficiency in product development, ensuring that all members actively contribute their expertise to achieve common goals.

You are Responsible for:
Coordinating all aspects of new product introduction activities and ensuring that all parts are ready on time. Conducting production tryouts and addressing any manufacturing line issues that arise during the process. Securing necessary approvals at each stage of the product rollout and working in collaboration with the cross-functional team to resolve any challenges encountered.

To succeed in this role - you should have the following:
A strong background in electronics products such as Sensors, ECUs, DC-DC converters, Ignition coil and Rectifier and regulator. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Problem-solving abilities to quickly address manufacturing issues and the capability to adapt to changing project requirements. Experience in coordinating product introduction activities will be highly beneficial.
Job Title: Senior Engineer - NPI

Company Name: India Nippon Electricals


The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating new product introduction activities in the organization. This includes ensuring part readiness for production, conducting production tryouts to validate processes, obtaining necessary approvals, and effectively resolving any manufacturing line issues in collaboration with the cross-functional team (CFT). The role requires a strong focus on detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

Responsibilities:
- Coordinate new product introduction activities to ensure timely and efficient rollout.
- Ensure all parts are ready for production and meet quality standards.
- Conduct production tryouts to assess the manufacturing process and product functionality.
- Obtain necessary approvals from relevant stakeholders at each phase of the product introduction.
- Work closely with the cross-functional team to resolve any issues that arise on the manufacturing line.
- Monitor and report on the progress of new product initiatives and provide updates as required.
- Collaborate with engineering and quality assurance teams to ensure adherence to specifications.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong knowledge of electronics products, including Sensors, Electronic Control Units (ECU), DC-DC converters, and regulators (RR).
- Excellent project management skills to oversee multiple product introductions simultaneously.
- Strong problem-solving abilities to address manufacturing line issues effectively.
- Familiarity with manufacturing processes and standards in the electronics industry.
- Proficient in using tools for project tracking, data analysis, and reporting.
- Effective communication skills to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
- Attention to detail and a systematic approach to tasks and responsibilities.

This role is crucial for ensuring that new products are introduced successfully and efficiently into production, maintaining high standards of quality and performance.

Lead Generation

Deal Processing

Units Disbursed
st EMI Resolution
RC Collection
Qualification: Any Graduate Experience :
years work experience only in Vehicle Sales

Functional Competencies
Communication Skill
Negotiation Skill
Market/Industry Knowledge
Analytical Skill
Product Knowledge
Behavioural Competencies
Execution Excellence
Customer Centricity
Hiring Parameters:
Should be comfortable to move in the market
Should have learning attitude
Should have bike and license
Should have good knowledge of RTO
Should have product knowledge

Description:
To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency
to achieve sales & productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners.Recruit ,Coach,Mentor,Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity & Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES :
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to on boarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals & performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re- activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through companys sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE :
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English & regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills -
Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Definition-
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Skillset required-
Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior

Competency - People and Team Leadership
Definition-
Communicates a clear vision and strategy for the team to achieve organizational objectives
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required-
Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support

Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition-
Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.
Develops and delivers a compelling value proposition that clearly articulates the career opportunity, compensation, and support structure, effectively influencing and convincing high-potential advisors and partners to join the team.
Skillfully anticipates and manages advisor objections through clear communication, factual evidence, and motivational techniques.
Effectively leverages existing networks, professional referrals, and natural market opportunities to consistently generate quality leads for distribution expansion.
Demonstrates the ability to attract established and high-performing distributors or teams from competitor organizations by highlighting the unique advantages and growth opportunities the company offers.
Ensures a good selection process is followed, and successful recruits are smoothly integrated by providing initial training and necessary resources to facilitate a fast start in the role.
Skillset required-
Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

Description:
Roles & Responsibilities
Conduct daily CFT meetings and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Review and monitor production schedule adherence.
Review and monitor ILR status.
Monitor plant efficiency and identify areas for improvement.
Periodically review and update Control Plans, SOPs, Work Instructions (WI), and related documents.
Coordinate with supporting departments for facility-related requirements.
Coordinate and support IATF, TPS, PMI, OSHAS, VDA, and other system-related activities.
Carry out SAP BOM corrections and ensure accuracy of material-related data.
Carry out SAP Norms corrections and maintain accurate system data.
Ensure timely closure of Stop Advice Notes.
Monitor and ensure shift-wise NC closure.
Coordinate new product introduction / new product activities with the CFT.
Key Technical Responsibilities
The role also requires strong capability in PCBA manufacturing and final assembly, including single-piece flow and batch production, SOP/CP/PFMEA, quality problem-solving tools, line efficiency improvement, assembly rejection/rework control, defect analysis, FPY improvement, 5S/Kaizen, PCB Gerber data, through-hole and selective soldering, and electronic product manufacturing processes.
As a Senior Engineer in the Manufacturing department, you will play a crucial role in the development, optimization, and implementation of manufacturing processes. Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Growth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
